meta.scope: All current Valve website hero records; not an exhaustive executable ability database
meta.facetsPolicy: 7.41 removed facets; preserve stale fields only as raw provenance; never activate them

official.name: antimage_mana_break
official.desc_loc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
official.lore_loc: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.
notes_loc: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.

officialZh.name: antimage_mana_break
officialZh.desc_loc: 每次攻击损毁目标魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一种格斗技巧，改良自星隐寺僧侣们的温和招式，可以让魔法能量反噬其拥有者。
notes_loc: 幻象继承法力损毁的燃烧魔法为%illusion_percentage%%%。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升每次攻击燃烧的最大魔法值。

special_values.name: mana_per_hit_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 每次攻击损毁最大魔法值：

official.name: antimage_blink
official.desc_loc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
official.lore_loc: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.
notes_loc: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
official.scepter_loc: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within %empowered_mana_break_duration%s burns an additional %empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.

officialZh.name: antimage_blink
officialZh.desc_loc: 短距离传送，能让敌法师自由出入战场。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在与死亡之神遭遇时，敌法师明白了让人捉摸不定是多么重要。
notes_loc: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 施放闪烁后，%empowered_mana_break_duration%秒内的法力损毁将额外燃烧%empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%%最大魔法值，并且阻止目标在短时间内恢复或获得魔法。这个负面状态无法驱散。

official.name: antimage_counterspell
official.desc_loc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
official.lore_loc: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.
notes_loc: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
official.shard_loc: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
facets_loc: Counterspell burns a percentage of the countered spell's mana cost from its caster and does damage based on %damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%% of the burned mana cost, up to a maximum of %max_damage_from_mana_drain% damage per reflected spell.

officialZh.name: antimage_counterspell
officialZh.desc_loc: 被动提升魔法抗性。可以主动开启法术反制，创造一个环绕敌法师的反魔法外壳，抵挡和反弹所有指向性技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 经过潜心的专注后，敌法师将内在的韧性转为精心的报复。
notes_loc: 破坏会使被动魔法抗性失效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 开启后反弹指向性技能时会在敌方施法者身边制造一个敌法师的闪烁碎片。
facets_loc: 法术反制会使施法者被燃烧该技能魔法消耗的一定百分比，并且造成%damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%%燃烧魔法的伤害，最高为每次反弹技能造成%max_damage_from_mana_drain%点伤害。

official.name: antimage_persectur
official.desc_loc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
notes_loc: Full effect if caused by illusions.

officialZh.name: antimage_persectur
officialZh.desc_loc: 攻击会根据敌人缺失的魔法值造成减速。%mana_threshold%%%魔法时造成最低减速，0%%魔法时造成最高减速。敌人高于%mana_threshold%%%魔法时没有效果。
notes_loc: 幻象造成全额效果。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: antimage_mana_void
official.desc_loc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
official.lore_loc: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.
notes_loc: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
facets_loc:
Passively grants attack damage when an enemy hero's mana falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their mana falls further.

If the enemies mana falls below %threshold_pct%%% Anti-Mage gains the maximum amount of damage, as well as vision and True Sight of that hero. Applies to enemy heroes within %thirst_range% range. Bonuses stack per hero.

officialZh.name: antimage_mana_void
officialZh.desc_loc: 根据目标损失的魔法值，对目标和其周围的敌人造成伤害。所有受到伤害的单位都会被短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 敌人倒下之后，将因使用奥术而受到敌法师的惩戒。
notes_loc: 伤害的计算根据主目标失去的魔法，但是对作用范围内所有敌人均有效。
facets_loc:
敌方英雄的魔法值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%时会被动提供攻击力，而且魔法值越低，提升效果越大。

如果敌人的魔法值低于%threshold_pct%%%，敌法师获得攻击力加成的最大值，以及该英雄的视野和真实视域。会施加给%thirst_range%范围内的敌方英雄。每个英雄提供的加成效果可以叠加。

special_values.name: mana_void_damage_per_mana
special_values.heading_loc: 每点缺失魔法造成伤害：

official.name: axe_berserkers_call
official.desc_loc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
official.lore_loc: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.
official.shard_loc: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
facets_loc: Berserker's Call gives Axe increased bonus armor and increases the attack speed of the affected units.

officialZh.name: axe_berserkers_call
officialZh.desc_loc: 斧王嘲讽附近的敌方单位，强迫他们攻击自己，同时获得额外护甲。
officialZh.lore_loc: 蒙哥可汗的狂吼嘲讽使敌人不得不与他作战。
officialZh.shard_loc: 狂战士之吼会对作用下单位施加战斗饥渴。
facets_loc: 狂战士之吼提供的护甲更高，而且增加了受作用单位的攻击速度。

official.name: axe_battle_hunger
official.desc_loc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
official.lore_loc: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.
notes_loc: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
official.shard_loc: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.

officialZh.name: axe_battle_hunger
officialZh.desc_loc: 激怒一个敌方单位，使他受到持续伤害，直到他杀死一个单位或者持续时间结束。敌人只要背朝斧王还将被减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 通常英雄都无法抵挡蒙哥可汗的战斗狂怒，他们会一直受伤，直到蒙哥可汗的狂怒平息。
notes_loc: 摧毁建筑也能移除该状态效果。
officialZh.shard_loc: 多个战斗饥渴效果可以叠加在单个目标身上。

official.name: axe_counter_helix
official.desc_loc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
official.lore_loc: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.
notes_loc: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
official.scepter_loc: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

officialZh.name: axe_counter_helix
officialZh.desc_loc: 受到一定次数攻击后，斧王就会做出螺旋反击，对附近所有敌方单位造成纯粹伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 这支军队只要有斧王就不需要援军了。
notes_loc: 反击螺旋会在斧王受到攻击时触发。
拥有神杖后自身幻象的攻击不会计入触发计数。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 反击螺旋现在对击中的敌人施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使其对斧王造成的攻击伤害减少。反击螺旋不再具有冷却时间，并且斧王的攻击也会计入触发记数。

official.name: axe_culling_blade
official.desc_loc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
official.lore_loc: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.
notes_loc: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

officialZh.name: axe_culling_blade
officialZh.desc_loc:
斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。

每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 蒙哥可汗是战斗与狂怒的化身，胆敢与斧王为敌者只有死路一条。
notes_loc: 淘汰之刃的斩杀效果无法被薄葬等技能阻止。

official.name: axe_one_man_army
official.desc_loc: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.

officialZh.name: axe_one_man_army
officialZh.desc_loc: 只要斧王附近%radius%范围内没有友方英雄，他就会获得%armor_pct_as_strength%%%自身护甲值的力量加成。这个效果在接近一名友军后会在%bonus_linger_duration%秒内消失。

official.name: bane_enfeeble
official.desc_loc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
official.lore_loc: Each tendril of fear that Atropos weaves increases the vulnerability of his victims to arcane and unknown arts.

officialZh.name: bane_enfeeble
officialZh.desc_loc: 每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿特洛波斯编织的每一丝恐惧都使他的受难者承受更多的奥术和未知技艺伤害。

official.name: bane_brain_sap
official.desc_loc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
official.lore_loc: Atropos finds no greater pleasure than to harvest the fear he creates.
official.shard_loc: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%. Causes Brain Sap to become a %shard_radius% AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: bane_brain_sap
officialZh.desc_loc: 暴食一个敌方单位的生命能量，造成伤害并回复自身生命值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿特洛波斯认为收割被他亲自制造的恐惧弄崩溃的生命是至高的享受。
officialZh.shard_loc: 减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成%shard_radius%作用范围的技能。次级目标只有%shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。

official.name: bane_nightmare
official.desc_loc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
official.lore_loc: A stolen prowess from the goddess Nyctasha is to put his prey into forever sleep.
notes_loc: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
facets_loc: Bane has increased attack speed when attacking Nightmared units.
Nightmared units walk in Bane's chosen direction.

officialZh.name: bane_nightmare
officialZh.desc_loc:
让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从夜之女神妮塔莎那里偷来的能力，让猎物一觉不醒。
notes_loc: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。
facets_loc: 祸乱之源在攻击噩梦中单位时获得额外的攻击速度。
噩梦中单位会朝选定方向走去。

official.name: bane_fiends_grip
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
official.lore_loc: Victims of Atropos are frequently torn apart by vivid conjurations of their own nightmares.
official.scepter_loc: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

officialZh.name: bane_fiends_grip
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 抓住一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并持续受到大量伤害，同时每%fiend_grip_tick_interval%秒按目标最大魔法值一定比例吸取魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿特洛波斯的受害者经常因为噩梦中逼真的幻象痛不欲生。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 魔爪的冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受%scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

official.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha
official.desc_loc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

officialZh.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha
officialZh.desc_loc: 每次祸乱之源击杀敌方英雄，或者他们在祸乱之源的负面效果下阵亡，他们都会在游戏的剩余时间内获得一层恐惧的效果，使敌人对祸乱之源施加的负面状态的<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>减少。

special_values.name: max_terrors
special_values.heading_loc: 每名英雄最高恐惧叠加层数：

special_values.name: status_resistance
special_values.heading_loc: 每层恐惧降低<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>：

official.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
official.desc_loc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
official.lore_loc: Strygwyr shares his animalistic thirst for bloodshed.
notes_loc: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
official.shard_loc: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal %max_health_dmg_pct%%% of the target's max health as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
officialZh.desc_loc: 使血魔陷入渴望鲜血的狂怒中，以每秒流失一定百分比生命的代价获得攻击速度和技能增强加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 史德利古尔与人分享他那野兽般的嗜血饥渴。
notes_loc: 对血魔造成的伤害不致死。
officialZh.shard_loc: 血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成%max_health_dmg_pct%%%目标最大生命值的<font color="#d8ae53">纯粹</font>伤害。

official.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
official.desc_loc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
official.lore_loc: The Flayed Twins are ever willing to aid those who spill blood upon the field of battle.
notes_loc: Total time is a %delay% second delay plus a %abilitycastpoint% second cast time.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
officialZh.desc_loc: 血魔用圣血为一片区域洗礼。%delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip%秒后祭祀完成，区域范围内所有敌人都会受到伤害，并被<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只要有人在战场上遍洒鲜血，那么剥皮双子就乐于向他施以援手。
notes_loc: 总时间为%delay%秒的施法时间加上%castpoint_tooltip%秒的生效延迟。

official.name: bloodseeker_thirst
official.desc_loc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
official.lore_loc: Strygwyr becomes frenzied when blood is spilled.
notes_loc: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.
facets_loc: Can be activated to grant bonus movement speed and %sanguivore_multiplier%x Sanguivore heal bonus for a short duration. While on cooldown, passive Thirst move speed is reduced by %inactive_penalty_pct%%% . Cannot be cast when all enemy heroes are at full health.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_thirst
officialZh.desc_loc: 血魔能够感知到敌人的伤口中涌出的鲜血，敌方英雄的生命值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%，他的移动速度就会提升，而且生命值越低，提升效果越大。如果生命值低于%invis_threshold_pct%%%，他还将获得该英雄的视野和真实视域。焦渴的效果可以叠加。血魔可以突破最大速度限制。
officialZh.lore_loc: 史德利古尔闻到血腥味就会变得无比狂热。
notes_loc: 幻象不能触发该技能。
移动速度加成在敌人生命值低于%max_bonus_pct%%%时达到上限。
目标死亡后效果延续%linger_duration%秒。
facets_loc: 可以主动开启，短时间内获得移动速度加成和%sanguivore_multiplier%倍食血动物治疗加成。技能冷却时焦渴的被动移速加成减少%inactive_penalty_pct%%%。无法在所有敌方英雄满血时施放。

special_values.name: active_movement_speed
special_values.heading_loc: 主动开启时移动速度加成：

official.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
official.desc_loc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to %base_heal% health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
notes_loc: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
officialZh.desc_loc:
血魔每杀死一个单位都会回复部分生命，回复量为基础%base_heal%点加上该单位最大生命值的一定百分比。

友军击杀了附近的敌方英雄时会回复半额数值。
notes_loc: 非英雄单位的吸血效果减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。

special_values.name: half_bonus_aoe
special_values.heading_loc: 半额<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>作用范围：

official.name: bloodseeker_rupture
official.desc_loc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
official.lore_loc: When the Bloodseeker hunts you, injuries become fatalities.
official.scepter_loc: Increases initial damage and grants %AbilityCharges% Rupture Charges.

officialZh.name: bloodseeker_rupture
officialZh.desc_loc: 让一个敌方单位皮开肉绽，根据其当前生命值造成初始伤害。单位移动后会根据移动的距离受到伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当血魔猎杀你时，受伤就意味着死亡。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升初始伤害，并且提供%AbilityCharges%点割裂能量点数。

official.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
official.desc_loc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
official.lore_loc: The air temperature around Rylai drops rapidly, chilling all around her to the core.
notes_loc: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.
facets_loc: Crystal Nova has increased radius and grants allied heroes a physical damage barrier. Barrier is increased for Crystal Maiden.

officialZh.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤具有破坏性的冰爆，降低目标区域内的敌人的移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莉莱周围的温度急剧下降，让附近的一切被急速冻结。
notes_loc: 冰霜新星在持续时间内提供目标区域的视野。
facets_loc: 冰霜新星拥有更大的作用范围，并且为友方英雄提供一个物理伤害护盾。水晶室女身上的护盾数值更高。

official.name: crystal_maiden_frostbite
official.desc_loc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals %creep_multiplier%x damage to non-ancient creeps.
official.lore_loc: Rylai channels winds from the Blueheart Glacier, imprisoning attackers in thick blocks of ice.
notes_loc: Frostbite is considered a root.

officialZh.name: crystal_maiden_frostbite
officialZh.desc_loc: 操控冰霜包围一个敌方单位，禁止移动和攻击，并持续造成伤害。对非远古的普通单位施放将造成%creep_multiplier%倍伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莉莱引来蓝心冰川的寒风，将动手的敌人封锁在冰块里。
notes_loc: 冰封禁制为捆缚效果。

official.name: crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura
official.desc_loc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
official.lore_loc: Cold temperatures promote the essence of magic, causing Rylai's presence to allow spell usage in abundance.
facets_loc: Activating Arcane Aura temporarily increases Crystal Maiden's spell amplification and mana costs. During the duration, Crystal Maiden restores her own and her allies' Mana when casting spells. Does not affect items. Duration is paused while channeling Freezing Field.

officialZh.name: crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura
officialZh.desc_loc:
地图上所有友方单位获得额外魔法恢复。水晶室女附近%proximity_bonus_radius%范围内友军获得更高的魔法恢复。

水晶室女被动获得魔法恢复增强。
officialZh.lore_loc: 低温提升了魔法精华，莉莱的出现能够让盟友更频繁的使用魔法而不必担心消耗。
facets_loc: 主动开启奥术光环会临时提升水晶室女的技能增强，但技能的魔法消耗也会增加。在持续时间内，只要水晶室女施放技能，她和她的友军都会回复魔法。不会影响物品。极寒领域的持续施法期间持续时间会暂停。

official.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_clone
official.desc_loc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.
official.lore_loc: So convincing that some allies have spent minutes talking to the clone before they realized she wasn't speaking back.

officialZh.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_clone
officialZh.desc_loc: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近%frostbite_radius%范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 非常逼真，有些盟友和克隆体聊了几分钟才发现她没有回应。

official.name: crystal_maiden_glacial_guard
official.desc_loc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

officialZh.name: crystal_maiden_glacial_guard
officialZh.desc_loc: 水晶室女消耗在她技能上的一部分魔法会转化为<font color='#b94512'>物理护盾</font>。

official.name: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Once the place of her exile, Icewrack has become an anchor for Rylai's frigid onslaught.
notes_loc: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).
Explosions occur every %explosion_interval% seconds.
official.scepter_loc: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.

officialZh.name: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤100次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冰川残骸，莉莱曾经的流放之地，早已变成她修炼寒冰魔法的场所。
notes_loc: 减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续%slow_duration%秒）。
每%explosion_interval%秒产生一次爆炸。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低%shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%%。冰爆总数提升%shard_bonus_explosion%%%。对极寒领域内停留超过%frostbite_delay%秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

official.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
official.desc_loc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
notes_loc: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
official.scepter_loc: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

officialZh.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
officialZh.desc_loc: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 覆盖着寒冰的箭矢破空而出，将敌人彻底冻结。
notes_loc: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。

special_values.name: shard_regen_reduction_pct_per_stack
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加生命回复降低：

official.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
official.desc_loc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
official.lore_loc: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

officialZh.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放一阵狂风，<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 崔希丝特别中意肉搏中蕴含的静谧，因此她运用卓尔人的天赋终结敌人的魔法。

official.name: drow_ranger_multishot
official.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
official.lore_loc: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.
notes_loc: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

officialZh.name: drow_ranger_multishot
officialZh.desc_loc:
持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。

卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在游侠的童年，学习同时射出多支箭矢被视为不够专心的轻浮行为。而在遗迹的大战中，这样的技巧奇特地成为了必要。
notes_loc: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。

official.name: drow_ranger_glacier
official.desc_loc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.
official.lore_loc: Traxex wasn't just adopted by the Drow, she was adopted by the lands they lived in.

officialZh.name: drow_ranger_glacier
officialZh.desc_loc:
卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。

山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。
officialZh.lore_loc: 崔希丝不仅是被卓尔人收养，她还是被他们居住的大地所接纳。

official.name: drow_ranger_trueshot
official.desc_loc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus agility.
official.lore_loc: Traxex' time spent alone in the forests of her Drow home has allowed her to teach other archers how to improve their bow skills.

officialZh.name: drow_ranger_trueshot
officialZh.desc_loc: 卓尔游侠根据她自身的当前敏捷和英雄等级获得敏捷加成。附近远程英雄获得%trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%%敏捷加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 崔希丝在卓尔族森林中独处的时光让她有时间教导其他弓箭手如何提高弓技。

official.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
official.desc_loc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
official.lore_loc: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.
notes_loc: Marksmanship procs have true strike.

officialZh.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
officialZh.desc_loc: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果%disable_range%范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 卓尔游侠是弓箭手登峰造极的典型。
notes_loc: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。

official.name: earthshaker_fissure
official.desc_loc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
official.lore_loc: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.
notes_loc: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
official.shard_loc: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
facets_loc: Enemy heroes stunned by Fissure emit an echo to each nearby unit within a %echoes_radius% radius, dealing damage equal to %echoes_damage_multiplier%%% of Echo Slam's current echo damage.

officialZh.name: earthshaker_fissure
officialZh.desc_loc: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尼西埃图腾能以惊世之力使大地裂开。
notes_loc: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。
officialZh.shard_loc: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>的时间有所降低。
facets_loc: 被沟壑击中的敌方英雄会对%echoes_radius%范围内附近每个单位释放一道回音，造成的伤害等同于回音击的%echoes_damage_multiplier%%%当前回音伤害。

official.name: earthshaker_enchant_totem
official.desc_loc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
official.lore_loc: Raigor's gorilla strength can destroy mountains.
notes_loc: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
official.scepter_loc: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

officialZh.name: earthshaker_enchant_totem
officialZh.desc_loc: 强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和%bonus_attack_range%攻击距离加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 瑞格勇猛的的蛮力能摧毁山脉。
notes_loc: 攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。

official.name: earthshaker_aftershock
official.desc_loc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
official.lore_loc: The earth trembles beneath the mighty footsteps of Raigor.
notes_loc: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

officialZh.name: earthshaker_aftershock
officialZh.desc_loc: 撼地者施放技能时会引起脚下的大地震动，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>附近的敌方单位并造成额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 大地在瑞格强有力的步伐下颤抖。
notes_loc: 使用物品不会触发余震。

official.name: earthshaker_echo_slam
official.desc_loc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
official.lore_loc: Tectonic plates crack, mountains fold, and foes are crushed by the Echo Slam.

officialZh.name: earthshaker_echo_slam
officialZh.desc_loc: 穿过地面的冲击波，伤害敌方单位。每个受到攻击的敌人都会引起伤害附近单位的反射波。英雄本体将引起两次反射。
officialZh.lore_loc: 地壳开裂，山岳折叠，敌人遭回音击尽数碾压。

official.name: earthshaker_slugger
official.desc_loc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

special_values.name: projectile_body_damage_additional_percent_health
special_values.heading_loc: FLYING ENEMY'S MAX HEALTH AS DAMAGE:

officialZh.name: earthshaker_slugger
officialZh.desc_loc: 利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。

special_values.name: projectile_body_damage_additional_percent_health
special_values.heading_loc: 击飞敌人的最大生命值伤害：

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
official.desc_loc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
official.lore_loc: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
notes_loc: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
official.scepter_loc:
Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.

officialZh.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
officialZh.desc_loc: 舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%，并且每%blade_fury_damage_tick%秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 无论是战士还是法师，都害怕尤涅若的武士刀剑技。
notes_loc: 剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。
主宰在施放剑刃风暴的过程中依然可以进行物理攻击。但是只有不受剑刃风暴伤害的单位，如守卫和建筑才会受到这些物理伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
提升作用范围并减速范围内的敌人。

主宰每%attack_interval%秒对作用的敌人发动一次攻击。

official.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
official.desc_loc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
notes_loc: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.
official.shard_loc: Increases ward healing and health.

officialZh.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一个治疗守卫，按周围友军单位最大生命值的一定比例<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>他们。治疗守卫可以移动，移动速度为%healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip%。持续%abilityduration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在遮面之岛习得的仪式之一，治疗伤口时加上一点巫毒法术往往会很有效。
notes_loc: 可以控制治疗守卫。
多个治疗守卫的效果不会叠加。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。

official.name: juggernaut_blade_dance
official.desc_loc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
official.lore_loc: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

officialZh.name: juggernaut_blade_dance
officialZh.desc_loc: 主宰有一定概率在攻击时触发致命一击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 作为他对剑技传承的最后承诺，尤涅若立誓将使此剑技为世人所铭记。

official.name: juggernaut_swift_slash
official.desc_loc: Performs a short Omnislash for %duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: A briefer onslaught for those less deserving of the honor.

officialZh.name: juggernaut_swift_slash
officialZh.desc_loc: 发动一次短时间的无敌斩，持续%duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 为了不配获得荣耀的人准备的短暂猛攻。

official.name: juggernaut_bladeform
official.desc_loc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

officialZh.name: juggernaut_bladeform
officialZh.desc_loc: 主宰未受到伤害时每%stack_gain_time%秒获得一层剑心的叠加层数。每层叠加效果提供基础敏捷和移动速度加成。叠加效果在受到任何伤害时会粘滞%linger_duration%秒后再消失。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: juggernaut_omni_slash
official.desc_loc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: 'The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.'
notes_loc: You can use items during Omnislash.

officialZh.name: juggernaut_omni_slash
officialZh.desc_loc:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: “自律已有成果；勤练带来力量。”
notes_loc: 无敌斩期间可以使用物品。

official.name: mirana_starfall
official.desc_loc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
official.lore_loc: The Goddess breaks the strata to empower her Princess in the time of need.
notes_loc: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
facets_loc: Starstorm's second meteor deals more damage and blinds the target.

officialZh.name: mirana_starfall
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。%starfall_secondary_radius%范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 月之女神打破月亮的一部分地表，让她的公主在需要之时获得力量。
notes_loc: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。
facets_loc: 群星风暴的第二颗流星会造成更多伤害，并具有致盲效果。

official.name: mirana_arrow
official.desc_loc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
official.lore_loc: Lunar energies make the Princess of the Moon's arrows more deadly than most.
notes_loc: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

officialZh.name: mirana_arrow
officialZh.desc_loc: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。目标距离越远，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
officialZh.lore_loc: 明月的能量让月之公主的箭矢变得愈发致命。
notes_loc: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。

special_values.name: scepter_starstorm_target_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 主箭击中群星风暴伤害：

official.name: mirana_leap
official.desc_loc: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: None can fail to recognize Mirana's iconic white beast in the heat of battle.
official.shard_loc: Grants +%additional_charges% Leap charge.
facets_loc: Upon landing, Leap roots targets in a %root_radius% radius for %root_duration%s.

officialZh.name: mirana_leap
officialZh.desc_loc: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。速度加成持续%leap_bonus_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在战斗最激烈的时候，没人会注意不到米拉娜标志性的白色野兽。
officialZh.shard_loc: 获得+%additional_charges%跳跃能量点数。
facets_loc: 落地时跳跃会缠绕米拉娜附近%root_radius%范围内的目标，持续%root_duration%秒。

official.name: mirana_celestial_quiver
official.desc_loc: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
official.shard_loc: Grants %quiver_restore% temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.

officialZh.name: mirana_celestial_quiver
officialZh.desc_loc: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得%quiver_restore%点临时能量。

official.name: mirana_invis
official.desc_loc: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
official.lore_loc: Her tenure with Selemene allows Mirana to eclipse the ground, wrapping her allies in a cloak of shadows.
notes_loc: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.

officialZh.name: mirana_invis
officialZh.desc_loc: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态。米拉娜在持续时间内获得伤害输出加成。只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 作为赛莉蒙妮的代言人，米拉娜能将月蚀之暗投向大地，将她和她的友军隐藏在阴影中。
notes_loc: 受到作用的单位会自动停止攻击敌人。

official.name: morphling_waveform
official.desc_loc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
official.lore_loc: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.
facets_loc: Waveform attacks enemies in his path. Does not apply on-hit effects.

officialZh.name: morphling_waveform
officialZh.desc_loc: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。
officialZh.lore_loc: 轻松卷走敌人的滔滔洪水。
facets_loc: 波浪形态会攻击路径上的敌人。不会施加攻击特效。

official.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
official.desc_loc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
official.lore_loc: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.
notes_loc: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
facets_loc: Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.

officialZh.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
officialZh.desc_loc:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 变体精灵唤出自身的元素，构成波浪碾碎对手。
notes_loc: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
facets_loc: 变体打击会根据变体精灵的力量值造成眩晕。

official.name: morphling_morph_agi
official.desc_loc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
official.lore_loc: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
notes_loc: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
official.shard_loc: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

officialZh.name: morphling_morph_agi
officialZh.desc_loc: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些力量以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成敏捷。该过程可逆。
officialZh.lore_loc: 不断变化的流水让变体精灵的本质很难被辨别。
notes_loc: 属性变换不能转化物品提供的属性加成。
升级敏捷获取时也会升级力量获取。
officialZh.shard_loc: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

official.name: morphling_morph_str
official.desc_loc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
official.lore_loc: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
notes_loc: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.
official.shard_loc: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

officialZh.name: morphling_morph_str
officialZh.desc_loc: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些敏捷以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成力量。该过程可逆。
officialZh.lore_loc: 不断变化的流水让变体精灵的本质很难被辨别。
notes_loc: 属性变换不能转换物品提供的属性加成。
升级力量获取时也会升级敏捷获取。
officialZh.shard_loc: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

official.name: morphling_replicate
official.desc_loc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
official.lore_loc: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
notes_loc: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
official.scepter_loc: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

officialZh.name: morphling_replicate
officialZh.desc_loc: 使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标<font color="#FF0000">改变</font>自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
officialZh.lore_loc: 凝视变体精灵会映出一个能够模仿本体的倒影。
notes_loc: 变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 变形增加<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。

official.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
official.desc_loc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
notes_loc: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

officialZh.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
officialZh.desc_loc: 变体精灵根据当前力量值获得额外施法距离和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，根据当前敏捷值获得攻击距离和移动速度。这些效果在他变形为其他英雄时仍然有效。
notes_loc: 变形期间的攻击距离加成只有在变形为远程英雄时有效。

special_values.name: slow_resist_per_str
special_values.heading_loc: 力量转为<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>：

official.name: nevermore_shadowraze1
official.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
official.lore_loc: Nevermore's trademark for harvesting souls.
notes_loc: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
official.shard_loc: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
facets_loc: Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.

officialZh.name: nevermore_shadowraze1
officialZh.desc_loc: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 奈文摩尔标志性的灵魂收割手段。
notes_loc: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。
officialZh.shard_loc: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。
facets_loc: 对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

official.name: nevermore_frenzy
official.desc_loc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
official.lore_loc: For Nevermore, there's as much delight in the harvest as there is in the feast.

officialZh.name: nevermore_frenzy
officialZh.desc_loc:
影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续%duration%秒。在持续时间内，每%soul_collection_interval%秒他从%soul_collection_radius%范围内的%soul_collection_per_interval%个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留%linger_duration%秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。

从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在奈文摩尔看来，收获和盛宴一样令人愉悦。

official.name: nevermore_dark_lord
official.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
official.lore_loc: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.
notes_loc: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
facets_loc: Presence of the Dark Lord temporarily reduces more armor after nearby enemy heroes are killed.

officialZh.name: nevermore_dark_lord
officialZh.desc_loc: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 即使只是在影魔周围游荡，灵魂也会被侵蚀。
notes_loc: 与其他降低护甲的技能和光环完全叠加。
facets_loc: 在附近敌方英雄阵亡后魔王降临的降低护甲效果将会暂时提升。

official.name: nevermore_requiem
official.desc_loc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
official.lore_loc: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
notes_loc: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
official.scepter_loc: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

officialZh.name: nevermore_requiem
officialZh.desc_loc:
影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。

死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 那些死者的灵魂被捕获后尽数释放，毁灭他们生前的盟友。
notes_loc: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

special_values.name: requiem_slow_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 每道魔能<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>时间：

official.name: nevermore_necromastery
official.desc_loc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
official.lore_loc: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.
notes_loc: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
official.scepter_loc: Increases max souls.
facets_loc: Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.

officialZh.name: nevermore_necromastery
officialZh.desc_loc: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得%necromastery_damage_per_soul%点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得%souls_per_hero_kill%个灵魂。影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
officialZh.lore_loc: 被收割的亡魂在魂渊内外盘旋，增加了影魔的力量，也方便他扩大自己的灵魂收藏。
notes_loc: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提高灵魂数量上限。
facets_loc: 每次击杀英雄会使灵魂上限增加%max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill%个，直到影魔阵亡。

official.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
official.desc_loc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
official.lore_loc: Azwraith's proficiency at spearing his family's meal of fish is proving quite useful in the battlefield.
notes_loc: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
official.scepter_loc: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
facets_loc: Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
officialZh.desc_loc: 对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿兹瑞斯对于用长矛捕鱼养家的精通被证明在战场上非常有用。
notes_loc: 幻影长矛手附近%fake_lance_distance%范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 灵魂之矛可以向范围内敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先。提升灵魂之矛的幻象继承攻击力。
facets_loc: 幻影长矛手幻象放出的灵魂之矛会造成%illusion_lance_damage_pct%%%长矛伤害。

official.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
official.desc_loc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Dread Magus Vorn's death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to bend and fracture all spectrums of light.
notes_loc: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
facets_loc: Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
officialZh.desc_loc:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过%delay%秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受%illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少%illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 恐怖巫师沃恩的死亡让幻影长矛手获得了将自身在所有光线之中弯折破碎的能力。
notes_loc: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。
facets_loc: 幻影长矛手每缺失%hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%%生命都会额外产生一个幻象。

official.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
official.desc_loc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
official.lore_loc: Azwraith knows that on the field of battle, speed can mean everything.
notes_loc: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
officialZh.desc_loc: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿兹瑞斯明白，瞬息万变的战场上，速度就是一切。
notes_loc: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为%bonus_speed%。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

official.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
official.desc_loc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
officialZh.desc_loc: 幻影长矛手只要制造出幻象，该幻象的继承攻击力不会低于一定值，持续%duration%秒。

official.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
official.desc_loc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Each of Azwraith's lance attacks feels like two from a normal warrior; or three; or four...
official.shard_loc: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
facets_loc: Juxtapose Illusions spawn on random nearby units and deal more damage but can't be controlled.

officialZh.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
officialZh.desc_loc: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿兹瑞斯的每次刺击感觉就像一个普通战士的两次，或三次，或四次……
officialZh.shard_loc: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。
facets_loc: 并列的幻象会在附近随机单位身旁产生，继承更高的攻击力，但是无法控制。

official.name: puck_illusory_orb
official.desc_loc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed. At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
official.lore_loc: The playful Faerie Dragon delights in confusing others, vanishing and reappearing where unexpected.
notes_loc: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

officialZh.name: puck_illusory_orb
officialZh.desc_loc:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。 在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
officialZh.lore_loc: 顽皮的仙女龙很喜欢捉弄他人，突然消失再意想不到地重现。
notes_loc: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

official.name: puck_waning_rift
official.desc_loc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
official.lore_loc: With a mischievous grin, Puck spreads its enchanted powder which disrupts magical flow.
facets_loc: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.

officialZh.name: puck_waning_rift
officialZh.desc_loc: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 帕克淘气地一笑，洒出中断魔法流动的附魔粉尘。
facets_loc: 新月之痕会把敌人推开。如果技能设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），会把他们拉近。

official.name: puck_phase_shift
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
official.lore_loc: With a quip and flash, Puck returns to the alien dimension from whence it came.
notes_loc: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
official.shard_loc: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

officialZh.name: puck_phase_shift
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 带着嘲笑，帕克瞬间回到了她的异维度故乡。
notes_loc: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。
officialZh.shard_loc: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

official.name: puck_puckish
official.desc_loc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

officialZh.name: puck_puckish
officialZh.desc_loc: 每当帕克躲避攻击时，它就会分别回复最大生命值和最大魔法值的%mana_and_health_restore_pct%%%。躲避指向性技能的弹道将回复%dodged_spell_multiplier%倍数值。防御塔的攻击不会对此生效。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: puck_dream_coil
official.desc_loc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
official.lore_loc: The Faerie Dragon sows confusion by forcing its enemies to vividly dream about their own mortality.
official.scepter_loc: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

officialZh.name: puck_dream_coil
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和<font color='#e3d59e'>束缚</font>。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 仙女龙散播混乱，让敌人陷入鲜活的梦境，见证自己死亡的命运。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时攻击也会继续。

official.name: pudge_meat_hook
official.desc_loc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
official.lore_loc: The Butcher's hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.
notes_loc: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
official.shard_loc:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
facets_loc: Meat Hook deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled, but base damage is reduced.

officialZh.name: pudge_meat_hook
officialZh.desc_loc: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 屠夫的肉钩是噩梦的象征，锋利的倒钩暗示了他嗜血的本性。
notes_loc: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。
officialZh.shard_loc:
肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。

肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。
facets_loc: 肉钩会根据牵引的距离造成额外伤害，但基础伤害减少。

official.name: pudge_rot
official.desc_loc: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
official.lore_loc: A foul odor precedes a toxic, choking gas, emanating from the Butcher's putrid, ever-swelling mass.
notes_loc: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: pudge_rot
officialZh.desc_loc: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 有毒的气体从屠夫腐烂肿胀的肉体中放出，味道恶心得令人窒息。
notes_loc: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 腐烂的作用范围提升%bonus_rot_radius%，伤害提升%bonus_rot_damage%点，并且可以降低敌人的%scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%生命回复。

official.name: pudge_flesh_heap
official.desc_loc: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.
official.lore_loc: The Butcher gives new meaning to the words 'meat shield.'

officialZh.name: pudge_flesh_heap
officialZh.desc_loc: 帕吉用一层血肉包裹自己，可以格挡所有来源的所有类型伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 屠夫赋予“肉盾”这个词新的含义。

official.name: pudge_innate_graft_flesh
official.desc_loc: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining %flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount% bonus Strength for each stack.
notes_loc: Enemy Heroes that die within %flesh_heap_range% of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

officialZh.name: pudge_innate_graft_flesh
officialZh.desc_loc: 每次帕吉击杀敌方英雄时，他的皮肤就会永久变厚，获得的每层叠加效果为%flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount%点额外力量。
notes_loc: 帕吉附近%flesh_heap_range%范围内敌方英雄阵亡时他都会获得一层叠加效果，不论击杀者是谁。

official.name: pudge_dismember
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
official.lore_loc: 'When I'm through with these vermin, they'll be fit for a pie!'
notes_loc: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
facets_loc: Dismember increases Strength when dealing damage to heroes.

officialZh.name: pudge_dismember
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒%pull_units_per_second%的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引%pull_distance_limit%距离。
officialZh.lore_loc: “等我干掉这些蠢货以后，就可以把它们做成肉饼了！”
notes_loc: 即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。
facets_loc: 肢解每次对英雄造成伤害时都会提升自身力量值。

official.name: razor_plasma_field
official.desc_loc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
official.lore_loc: The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.

officialZh.name: razor_plasma_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 闪电幽魂用等离子的力量统治着永劫之墟。

official.name: razor_static_link
official.desc_loc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
official.lore_loc: Razor's polarity channels electricity into his being, draining the power of his opposition.
notes_loc: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.
official.shard_loc: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.

officialZh.name: razor_static_link
officialZh.desc_loc: 在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 雷泽的极性吸引电流通向自身，以汲取他对手的力量。
notes_loc: 链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过%drain_range_buffer%后断裂。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升施法距离。减缓目标的移动速度，数值为连接生效时%move_speed_factor%倍的攻击力窃取量。

official.name: razor_storm_surge
official.desc_loc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
official.lore_loc: Merely approaching the Lightning Revenant is rewarded with shock therapy.
notes_loc: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
official.shard_loc: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

officialZh.name: razor_storm_surge
officialZh.desc_loc: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 仅仅是靠近闪电幽魂就会体验免费的电击疗法。
notes_loc: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
officialZh.shard_loc: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为%eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%倍，打击冷却时间减少%strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

official.name: razor_unstable_current
official.desc_loc: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.

officialZh.name: razor_unstable_current
officialZh.desc_loc: 被动提升雷泽的移动速度。

official.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
official.desc_loc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
official.lore_loc: Ride the lightning.
notes_loc: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

officialZh.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
officialZh.desc_loc: 强大的闪电风暴，打击生命值最低的敌方单位，造成伤害并削弱护甲。
officialZh.lore_loc: 掌控闪电。
notes_loc: 每次打击都会以范围内血量最低的敌方单位为目标。
风暴之眼优先打击受到静电连接作用的英雄。
连续施放的风暴之眼可以叠加。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。

official.name: sandking_burrowstrike
official.desc_loc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
official.lore_loc: Crixalis often lies in wait, burrowing under the surface to ambush his adversaries.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

officialZh.name: sandking_burrowstrike
officialZh.desc_loc:
沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克里瑟历斯经常钻入地下埋伏，等待伏击敌人。
notes_loc: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

official.name: sandking_sand_storm
official.desc_loc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
official.lore_loc: Some say Crixalis is a mirage; his carapace appearing then vanishing between the whirling sands of the Scintillant Waste.
notes_loc: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
facets_loc: Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.

officialZh.name: sandking_sand_storm
officialZh.desc_loc: 沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
officialZh.lore_loc: 有人认为克里瑟历斯只是传说中的幻影，因为他的甲壳在闪烁荒原的沙尘中总是若隐若现。
notes_loc: 沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。%fade_delay%秒后将再次隐形。
facets_loc: 沙尘暴的作用范围提升，并且沙王在其中获得隐身效果。
沙尘暴能以%sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%%沙王移速的速度跟随沙王，并且只要和沙王相距不超过%sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster%就不会消失。
当沙王在沙尘暴中攻击敌人时，他会对目标施加致盲的负面状态。

official.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
official.desc_loc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
official.lore_loc: Crixalis is certainly capable of mercy, but the soul of the sand finds few foes worth sparing.
official.shard_loc: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.

officialZh.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心%inner_radius%范围内敌人将受到%inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克里瑟历斯当然有怜悯之心，但是沙之魂并没有发现有多少敌人值得他的饶恕。
officialZh.shard_loc: 被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

official.name: sandking_caustic_finale
official.desc_loc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.
official.lore_loc: An injection from Crixalis makes one brittle and as dry as the arid wastes, subject to implosive demise.

officialZh.name: sandking_caustic_finale
officialZh.desc_loc: 沙王的攻击对敌方单位注入毒液，使他们死亡时发生剧烈爆炸，造成固定数值的伤害加上基于阵亡单位最大生命值的额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克里瑟历斯的毒液让受害者变得脆弱并且干涸如干旱的荒地，最后爆炸而死。

official.name: sandking_epicenter
official.desc_loc: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
official.lore_loc: Many an explorer was lost to the quicksands of the Scintillant Waste.
notes_loc: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
official.shard_loc: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
official.scepter_loc: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).

officialZh.name: sandking_epicenter
officialZh.desc_loc: 经过%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
officialZh.lore_loc: 许多探险家丧生于闪烁荒原的流沙。
notes_loc: 地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
officialZh.shard_loc: 每%shard_interval%秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 地震的脉冲开始时每%spine_tick_rate%秒会在随机地点产生%scepter_explosions_per_pulse%片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的%scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%%，对击中的敌人造成%spine_damage_pct%%%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生%shard_explosions_per_pulse%次攻击。

official.name: storm_spirit_static_remnant
official.desc_loc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for %abilityduration% seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
official.lore_loc: Raijin Thunderkeg's duality allows him to admire himself in shocking fashion.
notes_loc: Remnants take %static_remnant_delay% second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a %static_remnant_damage_radius% radius, but will only be triggered in %static_remnant_radius%.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.

officialZh.name: storm_spirit_static_remnant
officialZh.desc_loc: 风暴之灵制造一个充满爆炸性能量的自身残影，会向目标地点走去，持续%abilityduration%秒。如果有人接近就会引爆造成伤害，残影持续%abilityduration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 雷神·风暴烈酒的二象性让他可以欣赏自己被电时的百态。
notes_loc: 残影在技能施放%static_remnant_delay%秒后才能实体化。
残影在持续时间内拥有顺畅视野。
残影爆炸将伤害%static_remnant_damage_radius%码作用范围内的单位，但是触发范围是%static_remnant_radius%码。
可以对自身施放，这样会原地施放。

official.name: storm_spirit_electric_vortex
official.desc_loc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
official.lore_loc: Raijin's thunderous, boisterous energy often draws others into an electrifying situation.
official.scepter_loc: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
facets_loc: Electric Vortex applies a debuff to the enemy that lasts for %enemy_overload_duration%s making their next attack target themself and trigger an Overload Charge.

officialZh.name: storm_spirit_electric_vortex
officialZh.desc_loc: 将一个敌人拖到风暴之灵所在位置的涡流。
officialZh.lore_loc: 雷神狂暴的雷霆力量总是让其他人为之一电。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 电子涡流变成范围型技能，可以作用于风暴之灵周围所有敌人。
facets_loc: 电子涡流会对敌人施加%enemy_overload_duration%秒的负面效果，使敌人下次攻击会以自身为目标，并触发一次超负荷。

official.name: storm_spirit_overload
official.desc_loc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
official.lore_loc: Pow!  Zip!  Zap!
notes_loc: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.
official.shard_loc: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to %shard_activation_duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.

officialZh.name: storm_spirit_overload
officialZh.desc_loc: 施法时会产生电荷，在风暴之灵下次攻击时被释放，对附近敌人造成伤害并减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 啪！嘶！咝！
notes_loc: 使用物品不会触发超负荷。
超负荷效果不会叠加。
officialZh.shard_loc: 施放后风暴之灵和附近友方英雄获得%shard_activation_charges%次超负荷效果。提供额外攻击速度。持续最多%shard_activation_duration%秒，或效果用尽。

official.name: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
official.desc_loc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
official.lore_loc: The Storm is coming in.
notes_loc: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.

officialZh.name: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
officialZh.desc_loc: 风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为%ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%%，每移动100距离消耗%ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
officialZh.lore_loc: 风暴来袭。
notes_loc: 行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。

official.name: storm_spirit_galvanized
official.desc_loc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of %mp_per_kill% mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every %level_divisor% levels. Loses %charges_per_death% charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains %perma_mp_per_kill% Mana Regen permanently.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.

officialZh.name: storm_spirit_galvanized
officialZh.desc_loc: 风暴之灵每次击杀都会获得一点提供%mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复的能量，每%level_divisor%级也会获得一点能量。每次阵亡会损失%charges_per_death%点能量。另外每次获得一点能量时他还会永久获得%perma_mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法通过击杀获得新的叠加效果。

official.name: sven_storm_bolt
official.desc_loc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
official.lore_loc: The Rogue Knight's iron gauntlet, taken from the school of his father, strikes his foes to their core.
official.scepter_loc: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

officialZh.name: sven_storm_bolt
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 流浪剑客从他父亲的学校里取得的精铁护手能对敌人造成致命打击。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成%scepter_bonus_damage%点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

official.name: sven_great_cleave
official.desc_loc: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.
official.lore_loc: The Vigil Knights still seek to reclaim the stolen Outcast Blade from Sven, a weapon capable of cutting wide swaths through lesser warriors.

officialZh.name: sven_great_cleave
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯温以巨力攻击，并对所有附近的敌方单位造成分裂攻击伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 守夜骑士团仍然在试图从斯温那里取回被偷走的弃誓之刃，一把能在低阶战士中杀出条大路的利剑。

official.name: sven_warcry
official.desc_loc: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts %duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Calling a few lines from the Vigil Codex fortifies Sven's obedience to his rogue code. So poetic!
official.shard_loc: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.

officialZh.name: sven_warcry
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯温的战吼激励着同伴作战，提升他们的护甲和移动速度。持续%duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 吟诵守夜人法典的句子能够强化斯温对其流浪法则的遵从。太有诗意了！
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升作用范围和移动速度加成。现在战吼不可驱散，并提供%base_barrier_amount%点<font color='#b94512'>物理伤害护盾</font>。

official.name: sven_gods_strength
official.desc_loc: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for %abilityduration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: With the strength that shattered the Sacred Helm, the Rogue Knight stands unopposed in melee combat.
notes_loc: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.

officialZh.name: sven_gods_strength
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯温爆发出他流浪剑客的力量，获得攻击力加成和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，持续%abilityduration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 凭借能够击碎神圣之盔的力量，流浪剑客在近身肉搏中未尝一败。
notes_loc: 额外攻击力是基于斯温的基础攻击力和主属性数值。

official.name: sven_wrath_of_god
official.desc_loc: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

officialZh.name: sven_wrath_of_god
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯温从力量中获得额外攻击力。

official.name: tiny_avalanche
official.desc_loc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

officialZh.name: tiny_avalanche
officialZh.desc_loc: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当受到山岭巨人召唤时，毫无生气的石头也会很有杀伤力。

official.name: tiny_toss
official.desc_loc: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
official.lore_loc: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
notes_loc: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is %duration%s.

officialZh.name: tiny_toss
officialZh.desc_loc: 抓起小小身旁%grab_radius%范围内最近的单位，不论敌友，扔向目标单位或神符，落地时将造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 小小那巨大的身形让他能够随意抛起最强壮的勇士。
notes_loc: 你可以投掷队友，但他们不会受到伤害。
投掷对建筑物造成33%的伤害。
可以对减益免疫单位施放，但是不能将他们扔起，或对他们造成伤害。
飞行时间是%duration%秒。

official.name: tiny_tree_grab
official.desc_loc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
official.lore_loc: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
notes_loc: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

officialZh.name: tiny_tree_grab
officialZh.desc_loc: 抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 木棍和石头就能让骨头散架，而建筑也将马上步其后尘。
notes_loc: 树木扔出后技能进入冷却。

official.name: tiny_tree_channel
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.
official.lore_loc: Sticks thrown from stones are like to shatter many bones.

officialZh.name: tiny_tree_channel
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 小小进行持续施法，随机将自身周围的树木扔向目标范围。每棵树对该区域内敌人造成的伤害为小小的攻击伤害加上扔树的额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从石头上扔的木棍能打断很多骨头。

official.name: tiny_insurmountable
official.desc_loc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes_loc: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

officialZh.name: tiny_insurmountable
officialZh.desc_loc: 小小从力量中获得<font color='#b99012'>状态</font>和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>还会降低攻击速度减少的影响。
notes_loc: 不可逾越不会减少长大的攻击速度降低效果。

special_values.name: str_to_slow_resist_pct
special_values.heading_loc: <font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>的力量值系数：

special_values.name: str_to_status_resist_pct
special_values.heading_loc: <font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>的力量值系数：
