official.name: tiny_grow
official.desc_loc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
official.lore_loc: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
official.shard_loc: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

officialZh.name: tiny_grow
officialZh.desc_loc: 小小崎岖的身体不断成长，提升了攻击力、移动速度、护甲和投掷的威力，但攻击速度降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 亲眼看着丘陵变成山峦是震撼的——特别是这座山将他的敌人毁灭的时候。
officialZh.shard_loc: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。

official.name: tiny_toss_tree
official.desc_loc: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.
official.lore_loc: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.

officialZh.name: tiny_toss_tree
officialZh.desc_loc: 将树木扔向目标单位，触发自身对其的攻击，并且对周围目标造成溅射伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就算是敌人也能分享小小对树木的热情。

official.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
official.desc_loc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
official.lore_loc: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.
official.shard_loc: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
facets_loc: Magic Missile deals %damage_per_lasthit% bonus damage for every creep the enemy has killed.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
officialZh.desc_loc: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 魔法箭是天怒一族的简朴战技，现在也是仙德尔莎主要的复仇工具。
officialZh.shard_loc: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的%bounce_range_pct%%%魔法箭施法距离内。
facets_loc: 魔法箭造成额外伤害，敌人每击杀一个非英雄单位为%damage_per_lasthit%点额外伤害。

official.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
official.desc_loc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
official.lore_loc: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
officialZh.desc_loc: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。
officialZh.lore_loc: 仙德尔莎那挥之不去的低语暗示着她的裁决将至。

official.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
official.desc_loc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
official.lore_loc: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.
notes_loc: Break disables the damage aura.
official.scepter_loc:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
officialZh.desc_loc: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得%self_multiplier%%%额外加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管盟友可能不会理解她对于复仇那无休止的热爱，但作战时他们还是会利用她的狂热。
notes_loc: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。

复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

official.name: vengefulspirit_retribution
official.desc_loc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals %bonus_damage%%% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_retribution
officialZh.desc_loc:
复仇之魂的攻击同时被视为远程和近战，可以获得相应加成。

只要敌方英雄击杀了复仇之魂，他们会获得一个负面效果，直到下次阵亡，期间复仇之魂会对他们造成%bonus_damage%%%额外伤害。同一时间只能存在一个负面效果。

official.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
official.desc_loc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
official.lore_loc: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.
notes_loc: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

officialZh.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
officialZh.desc_loc: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 牺牲只是为了复仇付出的小小代价。
notes_loc: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

official.name: windrunner_shackleshot
official.desc_loc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
official.lore_loc: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.
notes_loc: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
facets_loc: Shackleshot applies to all units and trees behind the target unit and grants Windranger bonus attack damage for each additional shackled unit and tree. Creeps and trees grant less bonus damage.

officialZh.name: windrunner_shackleshot
officialZh.desc_loc: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间减少至%fail_stun_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 风行者的诸多弓技中，有一种用密集的绳索来束缚目标，让其难以逃脱的箭矢。
notes_loc: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。
facets_loc: 束缚击会对目标单位身后的所有单位和树木施加，每个额外束缚的单位和树木都会使风行者获得攻击力加成。非英雄单位和树木提供的攻击力加成较少。

special_values.name: bonus_damage_per_hero
special_values.heading_loc: 每个英雄的攻击力加成：

official.name: windrunner_powershot
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
official.lore_loc: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.
notes_loc: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
facets_loc: Enemy heroes hit are executed if below a health threshold. The execute threshold is based on the arrow's power.

officialZh.name: windrunner_powershot
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在早年的训练生涯，莱瑞蕾学会了射出足以破开树木击中目标的强力箭矢。
notes_loc: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
facets_loc: 被击中的敌方英雄血量低于临界值就会被秒杀。秒杀血量是基于箭矢的威力。

official.name: windrunner_windrun
official.desc_loc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
official.lore_loc: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.

officialZh.name: windrunner_windrun
officialZh.desc_loc: 提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莱瑞蕾运用疾风之力抵御来临的攻击。

official.name: windrunner_gale_force
official.desc_loc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.
official.lore_loc: At last Lyralei has learned to call upon the might of her true birthright.

officialZh.name: windrunner_gale_force
officialZh.desc_loc: 以矢量为目标。召唤出一阵强风，将目标区域内所有敌人朝目标方向推去。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莱瑞蕾终于学会召唤她真正本源的力量。

official.name: windrunner_focusfire
official.desc_loc: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
official.lore_loc: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.
notes_loc: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
facets_loc: Focus Fire no longer requires a target, instead firing at random enemies within Windranger's attack range + %bonus_range%. Fires a fixed number of attacks per second, and can only hit the same enemy every 4 shots. Prioritizes Heroes.

officialZh.name: windrunner_focusfire
officialZh.desc_loc: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莱瑞蕾具备狂风般地向敌人轰射出无数箭矢的无双本领——尽管牺牲了不少威力。
notes_loc: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。
facets_loc: 集中火力不再需要施法目标，而是对风行者攻击距离 + %bonus_range%范围内的随机敌人发动攻击。每秒发动固定次数的攻击，并且每4箭才会击中一次同个敌人。以英雄优先。

official.name: windrunner_tailwind
official.desc_loc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
official.scepter_loc: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.

officialZh.name: windrunner_tailwind
officialZh.desc_loc:
施放技能会召唤一阵顺风，向风行者提供短时间的移动速度爆发。移动速度加成在顺风持续时间的半途开始逐渐衰减。

被动提升风行者的移动速度上限。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。

special_values.name: movespeed_bonus
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加移动速度加成：

official.name: zuus_arc_lightning
official.desc_loc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
official.lore_loc: Arc Lightning is Zeus' favorite spell to use against puny mortals.

officialZh.name: zuus_arc_lightning
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 弧形闪电是宙斯在对付渺小的凡人时最喜欢用的法术。

official.name: zuus_lightning_bolt
official.desc_loc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
official.lore_loc: A shocking punishment for rebellious heathen.
notes_loc: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

officialZh.name: zuus_lightning_bolt
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对那些反叛的异教徒最震慑的天罚。
notes_loc: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。

official.name: zuus_heavenly_jump
official.desc_loc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.
official.lore_loc: Though temporarily barred from the heavens, Zeus can still manage a measure of godly flight.

officialZh.name: zuus_heavenly_jump
officialZh.desc_loc: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管宙斯暂时被禁止进入天界，但他还是可以进行一定程度上的神圣飞行。

official.name: zuus_cloud
official.desc_loc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
official.lore_loc: Where the thunder god's ire grows, storm clouds quickly gather.
notes_loc: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.

officialZh.name: zuus_cloud
officialZh.desc_loc: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 雷神的怒气滋长之地，雷云也会很快聚集。
notes_loc: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得%cloud_bounty_tooltip%金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。

official.name: zuus_lightning_hands
official.desc_loc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.
official.lore_loc: A helping hand from Aghanim lets the fallen Lord of Heaven tap into some of his old strengths.

officialZh.name: zuus_lightning_hands
officialZh.desc_loc: 宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 来自阿哈利姆的援手让跌落神坛的天界之王重新发挥出他昔日的部分力量。

official.name: zuus_thundergods_wrath
official.desc_loc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
official.lore_loc: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.
facets_loc: Damage is dealt to one enemy at a time, moving from lowest health hero to highest. If an enemy is killed by this ability, the damage for all subsequent enemies is increased.

officialZh.name: zuus_thundergods_wrath
officialZh.desc_loc: 用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害，无论他们身在何处。在打击前提供每个英雄的真实视域。
officialZh.lore_loc: 神王毁灭一切胆敢反抗他的敌人，他们无所遁形。
facets_loc: 从最低生命值的英雄开始，逐一对敌人造成伤害，最后是生命值最高的敌人。如果有敌人被这个技能击杀，那么接下来所有敌人受到的伤害都会增加。

official.name: zuus_static_field
official.desc_loc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
official.lore_loc: The air crackles with static when the Thundergod walks the world.
facets_loc: Static Field deals more damage to nearby enemies.

officialZh.name: zuus_static_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 宙斯攻击或通过技能击中敌人都会电击他们，造成他们当前生命值一定百分比的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当天神行于世间，空气中满是静电爆裂。
facets_loc: 静电场对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。

official.name: kunkka_torrent
official.desc_loc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
official.lore_loc: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.
notes_loc: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

officialZh.name: kunkka_torrent
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 世界中心喷涌出的上古之洪流，应舰队统帅的召唤而来。
notes_loc: 初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。

official.name: kunkka_tidebringer
official.desc_loc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
official.lore_loc: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.
facets_loc: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.

officialZh.name: kunkka_tidebringer
officialZh.desc_loc: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 迷失的铁帆海军灵魂依附在昆卡信赖的宝剑——潮汐使者之中，助它消灭洪流恶魔。
facets_loc: 潮汐使者每击中一名英雄，冷却时间都会减少。

official.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
official.desc_loc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
official.lore_loc: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.
facets_loc: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.

officialZh.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
officialZh.desc_loc: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。
officialZh.lore_loc: 舰队统帅诸多神秘能力中的一种，能用于战斗或娱乐。
facets_loc: X标记送回目标后，昆卡和回归点附近友军都会获得幽灵船的统帅朗姆酒效果。

official.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
official.desc_loc: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
official.lore_loc: Deleterious to landlubbers, no one holds their rum like a sailor.
notes_loc: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

officialZh.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
officialZh.desc_loc: 如果昆卡受到来自敌方英雄、建筑或肉山的伤害会使他的生命低于%damage_threshold%%%临界值，那么他会浸在统帅朗姆酒中，获得移动速度加成，并且延后承受即将受到的%ghostship_absorb%%%伤害，持续%buff_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 朗姆酒对于旱鸭子来说就是毒药，他们不像水手，喝两口就醉了。
notes_loc: 在朗姆酒效果消失后造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。

official.name: kunkka_tidal_wave
official.desc_loc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.
official.lore_loc: A good sailor knows the timing of the tides like the back of his hand.

officialZh.name: kunkka_tidal_wave
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放一道在昆卡身后出现的潮汐波。造成点伤害，并将敌人沿着波浪拖拽距离。敌人被拖拽时无法攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 优秀的水手对潮汐的时间了如指掌。

official.name: kunkka_ghostship
official.desc_loc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
official.lore_loc: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
notes_loc: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.
official.scepter_loc: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

officialZh.name: kunkka_ghostship
officialZh.desc_loc:
召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。

被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 铁帆舰队最后的战舰虽然只是个幻影，但它给昆卡的敌人带来的死亡却是完全真实的。
notes_loc: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为%ghostship_speed%。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 幽灵船在目标地点以%fleet_interval%秒的间隔产生%fleet_count%艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射%num_cannon_volleys%波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成%cannon_ball_damage_pct%%%幽灵船伤害。

official.name: lina_dragon_slave
official.desc_loc: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
official.lore_loc: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.
notes_loc: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

officialZh.name: lina_dragon_slave
officialZh.desc_loc: 莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在纷争之国的荒焦之地，为了娱乐，莉娜学会了操纵沙漠飞龙的火焰吐息。
notes_loc: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

official.name: lina_light_strike_array
official.desc_loc: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
official.lore_loc: Lina's essence allows her to focus the sun's energies, causing air to combust at will.
notes_loc: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.

officialZh.name: lina_light_strike_array
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莉娜的精华让她能够集中太阳的能量，随时让空气燃烧。
notes_loc: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

official.name: lina_fiery_soul
official.desc_loc: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Dancing flames embody Lina's playful nature, bringing out her true blazing self.
notes_loc: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.

officialZh.name: lina_fiery_soul
officialZh.desc_loc: 莉娜每次利用技能击中一个敌人都会使她获得攻击和移动速度加成。可以叠加。持续%fiery_soul_stack_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 舞动的火焰体现了莉娜爱玩的天性，展示了她真实炙热的自我。
notes_loc: 每次技能击中敌人时都会刷新持续时间。
使用物品不会触发炽魂。

official.name: lina_flame_cloak
official.desc_loc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.
official.lore_loc: A natural defense equally suited to keeping anything from unwanted sisters to snarling hellbeasts at bay.

officialZh.name: lina_flame_cloak
officialZh.desc_loc: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一道天然的屏障，不论是拦住讨厌的姐妹还是可怕的野兽都能轻松做到。

official.name: lina_slow_burn
official.desc_loc: Lina's abilities deal an additional %burn_damage_pct%%% damage as burn damage over %burn_duration%s.

officialZh.name: lina_slow_burn
officialZh.desc_loc: 莉娜的技能会在%burn_duration%秒内额外造成%burn_damage_pct%%%原伤害的烧灼伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: lina_laguna_blade
official.desc_loc: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
official.lore_loc: The air around Lina becomes so intensely torrid that it scorches a foe that comes too close with white-hot lightning.
notes_loc: Laguna Blade has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
official.shard_loc: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
facets_loc: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

officialZh.name: lina_laguna_blade
officialZh.desc_loc: 对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莉娜身边的空气变得极度炙热，产生白热的闪电来灼烧过于接近的敌人。
notes_loc: 神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。
facets_loc: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

official.name: lion_impale
official.desc_loc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
official.lore_loc: The Demon Witch exercises his demonic covenant, opening a fissure from hell.
notes_loc: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

officialZh.name: lion_impale
officialZh.desc_loc: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并受到伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 恶魔巫师使用他的恶魔契约，打开一条来自地狱的裂缝。
notes_loc: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

official.name: lion_voodoo
official.desc_loc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
official.lore_loc: Lion is compelled to share his transfiguration, twisting the essence of those who oppose him.
notes_loc: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

officialZh.name: lion_voodoo
officialZh.desc_loc: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，受害者无法使用所有特殊能力。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莱恩被迫分享他的变形术，让反抗他的人扭曲了他们的精华。
notes_loc: 即刻摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

official.name: lion_mana_drain
official.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.

Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
official.lore_loc: Lesser magi are nothing more than a source of magical restoration for the Demon Witch.
notes_loc: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
official.shard_loc: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
facets_loc: Mana Drain deals damage equal to %damage_pct%%% of mana stolen.

officialZh.name: lion_mana_drain
officialZh.desc_loc:
持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。

可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对恶魔巫师来说，较为弱小的法师只不过是他回复魔力的来源。
notes_loc: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。
officialZh.shard_loc: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。
facets_loc: 法力吸取会造成%damage_pct%%%吸魔量的伤害。

official.name: lion_to_hell_and_back
official.desc_loc:
Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

officialZh.name: lion_to_hell_and_back
officialZh.desc_loc: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供%debuff_amp%%%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续%duration%秒的%spell_amp%%%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: lion_finger_of_death
official.desc_loc:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills.

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
official.lore_loc: Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.
notes_loc: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
official.scepter_loc: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

officialZh.name: lion_finger_of_death
officialZh.desc_loc:
撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。

使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为%punch_attack_range%，并拥有移动速度加成。

每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。

技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 莱恩丑陋的手正是他最强大力量的来源，能够用恶魔的力量让受害者完全崩溃。
notes_loc: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后%grace_period%秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。

official.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
official.desc_loc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Originally used to open shows with the travelling con-man, Rhasta's lightning display shocks adversaries in more ways than one.
notes_loc: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
officialZh.desc_loc: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 最初是给流浪艺人作开场秀用的，罗斯塔的闪电之炫能分成数叉来震击不止一个对手。
notes_loc: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。

official.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
official.desc_loc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
official.lore_loc: Rhasta often ended performances by turning himself into a chicken - now, the humiliation is shared.
notes_loc: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
officialZh.desc_loc: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 罗斯塔通常将自己变成一个小鸡来结束表演——现在他把这个屈辱分享给别人了。
notes_loc: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

official.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
official.lore_loc: A self-defense incantation, Rhasta developed shackles after his master was slain in the Bleeding Hills.
official.scepter_loc: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一个用于自卫的咒语，是罗斯塔的师傅在流血丘陵罹难后，他所开发的枷锁咒。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

official.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
official.desc_loc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: Rhasta had to learn early on how to stay one step ahead of those who (rightfully or wrongfully) wished him harm.
notes_loc: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.
official.shard_loc: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
officialZh.desc_loc:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 罗斯塔必须尽早学会如何能快人一步，抢到哪些想（正当或不正当地）伤害他的人前头。
notes_loc: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。
officialZh.shard_loc: 伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。

official.name: shadow_shaman_urnaconda
official.desc_loc: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has %megaward_multiplier_tooltip%x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts %ward_duration%s.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_urnaconda
officialZh.desc_loc: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的生命值和攻击力为平常群蛇守卫的%megaward_multiplier_tooltip%倍，持续%ward_duration%秒。

official.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
official.desc_loc: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.
official.lore_loc: Snake charming was a big part of the Shadow Shaman's act; now Rhasta can empower the snakes to do his bidding.
official.shard_loc: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
facets_loc: Summons a single massive Serpent Ward with %mega_ward_multiplier_damage%x damage and %mega_ward_multiplier_health%x health and bounty values.

officialZh.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤%ward_count%个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 耍蛇曾是演艺中的重头戏；现在罗斯塔可以授予蛇力量，以服从他自己的吩咐。
officialZh.shard_loc: 可以使用巨蟒之瓮技能制造一个巨蛇守卫。
facets_loc: 召唤一个巨大的毒蛇守卫，攻击力为%mega_ward_multiplier_damage%倍，生命值和击杀金钱为%mega_ward_multiplier_health%倍。

official.name: slardar_sprint
official.desc_loc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
official.lore_loc: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.
notes_loc: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.
facets_loc: Slardar has slow resistance and even more movement speed at the beginning of Guardian Sprint.

officialZh.name: slardar_sprint
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯拉达向前蜿行，移动速度得到显著提升，并且可以穿越单位。在最初%speed_burst_max_duration%内斯拉达获得%slow_resistance_tooltip%%%<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>会在剩余的冲刺时间内逐渐衰减。
officialZh.lore_loc: 斯拉达从深海来到陆地后，发现有必要用强有力的尾巴冲刺来代替游泳。
notes_loc: 开启此技能不会打断持续施法。
facets_loc: 守卫冲刺开始时斯拉达获得减速抗性和额外的移动速度。

official.name: slardar_slithereen_crush
official.desc_loc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
official.lore_loc: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.
official.shard_loc: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.

officialZh.name: slardar_slithereen_crush
officialZh.desc_loc: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 强力的快速碎击，溅起的水浪打破最坚固的防御。
officialZh.shard_loc: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升鱼人碎击水洼的作用范围和持续时间。

official.name: slardar_bash
official.desc_loc: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
official.lore_loc: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.
notes_loc: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

officialZh.name: slardar_bash
officialZh.desc_loc: %attack_count%次攻击后，下次攻击会<font color='#2dd5e4'>重击</font>目标。
officialZh.lore_loc: 偷窃深海一族宝藏的盗贼在近身战斗中遇到了鱼人守卫的残暴之力。
notes_loc: 不能与碎颅锤叠加。

official.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
official.desc_loc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
official.scepter_loc: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.

officialZh.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯拉达在水洼、水迹或河道中将获得移动速度、生命恢复、攻击力和护甲加成。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 在水洼、水迹或河道中获得额外生命恢复、护甲，还有<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>。水洼/水迹的作用范围提升%scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%%，水洼的持续时间提升%scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%秒。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: slardar_amplify_damage
official.desc_loc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
official.lore_loc: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.
facets_loc: Corrosive Haze increases Slardar's armor by %armor_pct%%% of the total armor reduced.

officialZh.name: slardar_amplify_damage
officialZh.desc_loc: 削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
officialZh.lore_loc: 即使是最坚硬的铠甲，一旦遇到海水也是不堪一击。
facets_loc: 斯拉达的护甲提升，数值为侵蚀雾霭降低护甲总数的%armor_pct%%%。

official.name: tidehunter_gush
official.desc_loc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
official.lore_loc: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
official.scepter_loc: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

officialZh.name: tidehunter_gush
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在沉没之岛的竞赛中，利维坦赢得了对公海的统治。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。

official.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell
official.desc_loc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
facets_loc: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.

officialZh.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell
officialZh.desc_loc:
加厚潮汐猎人的外皮，可以被动格挡物理伤害。对非英雄单位的格挡伤害有所减少。潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过临界值后还将移除负面的状态效果。

可以主动开启，以%active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%%移动速度的代价使伤害格挡量加倍。持续%active_duration%秒。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 铁帆海军里有一个传言，说是有只强大的海兽，明明被矛刺中被剑砍伤依然能践踏舰队。
facets_loc: 锚击效果下的敌方英雄阵亡会使海妖外壳获得永久伤害格挡。

special_values.name: bonus_reduction_per_kill
special_values.heading_loc: 每次击杀提升伤害格挡：

official.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
official.desc_loc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
official.lore_loc: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.
notes_loc: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

officialZh.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
officialZh.desc_loc: 潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + %additional_range%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从舰队统帅昆卡的一艘旗舰上偷来的重锚，被利维坦用作有效的近战武器。
notes_loc: 锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

official.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
official.desc_loc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.
official.lore_loc: Anchors Aweigh!

officialZh.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
officialZh.desc_loc: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚%chain_length%距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至%max_movement_speed%，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚承受%attacks_to_destroy%次英雄攻击后会被摧毁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 起锚！

official.name: tidehunter_ravage
official.desc_loc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.
notes_loc: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.

officialZh.name: tidehunter_ravage
officialZh.desc_loc: 猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>附近所有敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 呼唤深海之神麦尔朗恩的举动导致了整支武装舰队在海上失踪。
notes_loc: 毁灭能伤害隐身单位。
毁灭以%speed%的速度向外扩散。

official.name: tidehunter_leviathans_catch
official.desc_loc:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
notes_loc: Enemies can destroy the fish.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

officialZh.name: tidehunter_leviathans_catch
officialZh.desc_loc:
每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得%fish_health_bonus%点最大生命值，%fish_attack_range%攻击距离和%fish_damage_block%额外伤害格挡。

潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。
notes_loc: 敌人可以摧毁鱼。
额外伤害格挡只会在有伤害格挡来源施加给即将受到的物理攻击时才会施加

official.name: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
official.desc_loc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
official.lore_loc: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.
notes_loc: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
facets_loc: Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.

officialZh.name: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
officialZh.desc_loc: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巫医回收倒下的友军和敌人的尸骨，磨成粉末用作他的符咒和炼丹术的材料。
notes_loc: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。
facets_loc: 麻痹药剂每次弹跳造成额外伤害。

official.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
official.desc_loc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
official.lore_loc: Zharvakko's hocus pocus is not limited only to hexxing his opponents and is quite adept at curing ailments.
notes_loc: Healing is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.
facets_loc: Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.

officialZh.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
officialZh.desc_loc: 巫医集中魔力<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 扎瓦克的药酒不仅可以用来戏弄对手，用来治疗小伤也不错。
notes_loc: 治疗间隔为%heal_interval%秒。
对减益免疫单位有效。
facets_loc: 巫毒疗法对敌人造成伤害，只会治疗巫医自身。

official.name: witch_doctor_maledict
official.desc_loc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
official.lore_loc: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.
notes_loc: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
facets_loc: Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.

officialZh.name: witch_doctor_maledict
officialZh.desc_loc: 对一个较小区域内所有敌方英雄和玩家控制的目标施放诅咒，他们将每秒受到固定伤害，并且从诅咒开始每4秒根据失去的血量再受到爆发伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 用对了巫毒法术会让敌人后悔招惹巫医。
notes_loc: 受到作用的英雄如果在结算时当前血量高于原血量，则额外伤害为0。
facets_loc: 被诅咒的敌人阵亡后会对%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，数值等于下次爆发伤害的%spread_pct%%%。

official.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo
official.desc_loc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

officialZh.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo
officialZh.desc_loc: 巫医暂时变成死亡守卫，死亡守卫的攻击速度有所降低。这段时间内自己为隐藏状态。

official.name: witch_doctor_gris_gris
official.desc_loc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.

Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

officialZh.name: witch_doctor_gris_gris
officialZh.desc_loc:
巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的%death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每%gold_tick_interval_tooltip%秒会增加1金。

右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: witch_doctor_death_ward
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
official.lore_loc: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.
notes_loc: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
official.scepter_loc: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
facets_loc: Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

officialZh.name: witch_doctor_death_ward
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。死亡守卫拥有%bonus_accuracy%%%额外必中率。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巫医跳起他的传统巫毒舞蹈，在生者的梦中作祟。
notes_loc: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。
facets_loc: 死亡守卫同时攻击%initial_target_count%个目标，但伤害降低。次级目标受到%secondary_attack_damage_pct%%%伤害。

official.name: lich_frost_nova
official.desc_loc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.
official.lore_loc: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.

officialZh.name: lich_frost_nova
officialZh.desc_loc: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续%abilityduration%秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冰霜法师艾斯瑞安从没忘记哪怕最简单的冰系操控咒。

official.name: lich_frost_shield
official.desc_loc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
official.lore_loc: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.
notes_loc: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
facets_loc: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.

officialZh.name: lich_frost_shield
officialZh.desc_loc: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每%interval%秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在人世的那些年最初学会的护身法术，而艾斯瑞安现在编织在周围的冰霜魔法随着时间愈发冰冷。
notes_loc: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。
facets_loc: 每当敌人死于冰霜魔盾的效果下，技能的持续时间都会增加。

official.name: lich_sinister_gaze
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
official.lore_loc: Mind the cold...
official.scepter_loc: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

officialZh.name: lich_sinister_gaze
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当心寒意……
officialZh.scepter_loc: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

official.name: lich_ice_spire
official.desc_loc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take %max_hero_attacks% hero hits or %max_creep_attacks% creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.
official.lore_loc: The waters within the Black Pool remain liquid far below the point of freezing and immediately crystallize when removed.

officialZh.name: lich_ice_spire
officialZh.desc_loc:
在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受%max_hero_attacks%次英雄攻击或%max_creep_attacks%次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。

连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。

巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。
officialZh.lore_loc: 暗黑之湖的水远在冰点之下，但仍处于液态，取走以后立刻结晶。

official.name: lich_death_charge
official.desc_loc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes_loc: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

officialZh.name: lich_death_charge
officialZh.desc_loc:
牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。

游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
notes_loc: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。

official.name: lich_chain_frost
official.desc_loc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
official.lore_loc: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.
notes_loc: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
facets_loc: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.

officialZh.name: lich_chain_frost
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
officialZh.lore_loc: 几乎所有人都认为是冰霜法术中的终极咒语，艾斯瑞安的霜死之珠能用恐惧击打那些胆敢站出来反对他的人们。
notes_loc: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。
facets_loc: 连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
连环霜冻击杀敌人后会增加弹跳次数。

official.name: riki_smoke_screen
official.desc_loc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
official.lore_loc: Since his escape during the night of his betrayal, Riki has valued the use of a simple smoke screen to confuse his opponents.
notes_loc: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
official.shard_loc: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.

officialZh.name: riki_smoke_screen
officialZh.desc_loc: 丢下一个烟雾弹，<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
officialZh.lore_loc: 自从力丸在背叛之夜逃脱后，他就很看重利用朴素的烟幕来迷惑对手。
notes_loc: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。
不能阻止使用物品。
officialZh.shard_loc: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低%armor_reduction%点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

official.name: riki_blink_strike
official.desc_loc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
official.lore_loc: The Stealth Assassin's agile movement makes him impossible to escape.

officialZh.name: riki_blink_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成%slow_pct_tooltip%%%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 隐形刺客迅捷的动作让他的目标几乎不可能逃脱。

official.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
official.lore_loc: The Stealth Assassin is not afraid to fight dirty, and specializes in attacking his opponents from behind.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
facets_loc: Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.

officialZh.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的%interval_targets%个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 隐形刺客从不忌讳使用肮脏的战斗手法，尤其擅长从对手的背后发动攻击。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离至%AbilityCastRange%。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有%scepter_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升%scepter_bonus_duration%秒，并且额外发动%scepter_bonus_attacks%次攻击。
facets_loc: 绝杀秘技攻击非英雄单位时拥有%creep_agility_multiplier%倍敏捷加成。只要力丸在绝杀秘技期间击杀一个非英雄单位，冷却时间就会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%秒。

official.name: riki_innate_backstab
official.desc_loc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes_loc: Works when denying friendly units at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.
facets_loc: Riki receives bonus experience for assists and kills.

officialZh.name: riki_innate_backstab
officialZh.desc_loc: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。
notes_loc: 反补友方单位时具有%ally_multiplier%%%效果。
力丸的幻象也会有背刺的动作，但是不会造成额外伤害。
facets_loc: 力丸获得助攻和击杀时会获得额外经验。

special_values.name: bonus_xp_assist_other
special_values.heading_loc: 击杀守卫/信使奖励经验：

official.name: riki_backstab
official.desc_loc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.
official.lore_loc: Riki comes for you.

officialZh.name: riki_backstab
officialZh.desc_loc: 力丸遁入阴影，变为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。
officialZh.lore_loc: 力丸来找你了。

official.name: enigma_malefice
official.desc_loc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Strange gravities pull at the core of those who would oppose you, holding them in place.
official.shard_loc: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

officialZh.name: enigma_malefice
officialZh.desc_loc: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。每%tick_rate%秒<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>一次。
officialZh.lore_loc: 奇特的重力将敌人的重心进行拖拽，让他们动弹不得。
officialZh.shard_loc: 憎恶的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间增加%shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%秒，并且每次<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

official.name: enigma_demonic_conversion
official.desc_loc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
official.lore_loc: Enigma is capable of drawing aspects of himself from other dimensions - the result is a trio of dark eidolons that hunt the corporeal plane.

officialZh.name: enigma_demonic_conversion
officialZh.desc_loc: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的%current_health_pct%%%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 谜团具备将自身的形体吸入另一个维度的能力——随之产生的就是三个追猎肉体位面的暗黑虚灵。

official.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
official.desc_loc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
official.lore_loc: A section of the world slowly descends into the void.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.

officialZh.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
officialZh.desc_loc: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成%base_damage% + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 世界的一部分缓缓跌入虚空。
notes_loc: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。

official.name: enigma_event_horizon
official.desc_loc: Units in a %radius% radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

officialZh.name: enigma_event_horizon
officialZh.desc_loc: %radius%范围内的单位远离谜团时会受到移速惩罚。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: enigma_black_hole
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
official.lore_loc: The ground trembles as Enigma channels his ultimate vortex of destruction, a singularity with the power to end worlds.
official.scepter_loc: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.

officialZh.name: enigma_black_hole
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 谜团将毁灭的终极漩涡，具有毁天灭地力量的奇点进行引导，大地因此颤抖。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位%scepter_pct_damage%%%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个%scepter_radius%范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为%scepter_drag_speed%。

official.name: tinker_laser
official.desc_loc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
official.lore_loc: Boush perfected this rock cutting laser in his subterranean laboratory, never considering its combat utility.
official.scepter_loc: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

officialZh.name: tinker_laser
officialZh.desc_loc: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
officialZh.lore_loc: 鲍什在他的地下实验室完善了这把激光岩石切割器，但并未考虑到它的作战效用。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。

official.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
official.desc_loc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
official.lore_loc: Even though the laboratory has since been sealed off, the ability to radio in robotic drones is still in working order.
notes_loc: Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.
official.scepter_loc: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
facets_loc: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.

officialZh.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
officialZh.desc_loc: 征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就算实验室最后被封锁了，呼叫机械无人机的无线电还是畅通的。
notes_loc: 机器人的产生速率是每秒%machines_per_sec%个。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。
facets_loc: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

official.name: tinker_deploy_turrets
official.desc_loc: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
official.scepter_loc: Turrets fire missiles %missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%% faster.

officialZh.name: tinker_deploy_turrets
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 炮塔发射导弹的速度加快%missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%%。

official.name: tinker_warp_grenade
official.desc_loc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
official.lore_loc: Tinker's deadliest weapon instantly turns an enemy into space dust. Research to resolve the annoying 'perfect copy' side effect... is ongoing.
notes_loc: Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.

officialZh.name: tinker_warp_grenade
officialZh.desc_loc:
向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续%debuff_duration%秒。

目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
officialZh.lore_loc: 修补匠最致命的武器能瞬间将敌人化为太空尘埃。研究如何解决令人讨厌的 “完美复制” 副作用... 还在进行中。
notes_loc: 最大传送距离为%warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。

official.name: tinker_rearm
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.
official.lore_loc: A new battery here, another set of rockets there, Boush continually improves on existing technology.

officialZh.name: tinker_rearm
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 这儿换块新电池，那儿塞几枚火箭弹，鲍什不断改进现有的技术。

official.name: tinker_eureka
official.desc_loc: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.

officialZh.name: tinker_eureka
officialZh.desc_loc: 修补匠的每%int_per_one_cdr%点智力提供%one_percent_tooltip%%%物品冷却时间减少，最多为%max_cdr%%%。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: sniper_shrapnel
official.desc_loc: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Kardel's modular rifle also fires incendiary rounds, useful for assaulting entrenched locations.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
facets_loc: Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.

officialZh.name: sniper_shrapnel
officialZh.desc_loc: 消耗一点能量射出一发带有爆炸弹片的榴霰弹，在目标区域降下弹雨。区域内的敌军受到伤害并被减速。榴霰弹将给予目标区域的视野。榴霰弹的能量每过%abilitychargerestoretime%秒恢复1点。
officialZh.lore_loc: 卡德尔的模块化步枪还能发射燃烧弹，对攻击战壕中的敌人很有用。
notes_loc: 总共造成11次伤害，第一次在技能生效时，接下来每秒造成一次伤害。
不会对建筑造成伤害。
将拥有目标区域的视野。
facets_loc: 榴霰弹的减速和伤害提升，但是持续时间减少。

official.name: sniper_headshot
official.desc_loc: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.
official.lore_loc: Taking potshots at steepstalkers in his childhood has been thoroughly refined into perfect leads on enemy combatants.

officialZh.name: sniper_headshot
officialZh.desc_loc: 狙击手提高他的精确度，有一定概率造成%damage%点额外伤害并击退敌人。敌人距离狙击手越近，击退距离越远。爆头会短暂地降低敌人%slow%%%移动和攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 童年时对潜行兽的胡乱射击现在被练就成攻击敌人的技术。

official.name: sniper_take_aim
official.desc_loc:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
official.lore_loc: Kardel always takes it upon himself to stay as far from harm as he can while still performing his role - taking perfect aim.

officialZh.name: sniper_take_aim
officialZh.desc_loc:
被动提升狙击手%passive_attack_range_bonus%攻击距离。

主动开启后，狙击手的视野距离、爆头几率和攻击距离提升。自身在持续时间内减速%slow%%%，并且视野限制在前方的锥形区域内。
officialZh.lore_loc: 卡德尔总是保持自己待在远处的安全距离，同时他仍然可以作为狙击手进行完美的射击。

special_values.name: active_attack_range_bonus
special_values.heading_loc: 主动效果攻击距离加成：

official.name: sniper_concussive_grenade
official.desc_loc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
official.lore_loc: ATTN: IN CASE OF DANGER PULL PIN
official.shard_loc: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.

officialZh.name: sniper_concussive_grenade
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 注意：如有危险，请拔出插销
officialZh.shard_loc: 降低冷却时间，提升伤害并允许技能也能击退狙击手。

official.name: sniper_keen_scope
official.desc_loc: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.

officialZh.name: sniper_keen_scope
officialZh.desc_loc: 狙击手和目标相距每%bonus_damage_distance%距离，他的攻击都会造成额外伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: sniper_assassinate
official.desc_loc: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
official.lore_loc: In order to fulfill the prophecy and return to his home town, Kardel must make another shot as perfect as the one on the day of his ancient test.
notes_loc: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.

officialZh.name: sniper_assassinate
officialZh.desc_loc: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
officialZh.lore_loc: 为了完成预言然后返回家乡，卡德尔必须和参加古老考验那天一样，做出完美的射击。
notes_loc: 准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间更久。

official.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
official.desc_loc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
official.lore_loc: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.
notes_loc: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师向他的周围释放死亡波纹，伤害敌方单位并<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友军单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 可怜的灵魂们，屈从于罗坦德吉利的瘟疫后遭到回收，沦为他用。
notes_loc: 死亡脉冲不能被躲避。

official.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
official.desc_loc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
official.lore_loc: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.
facets_loc: Necrophos gains movement speed equal to %movement_transfer%%% of the movement speed lost by enemies. Enemies lose %enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%% of the restoration amplification gained by Necrophos.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师步入将生者与死者相隔的领域。散发出一片灵气，减缓周围敌人的移动速度。在这个形态下，瘟疫法师为<font color='#57e550'>虚无</font>状态，无法攻击或被攻击，受到的魔法伤害增加，但是生命/魔法恢复效果加强。
officialZh.lore_loc: 罗坦德吉利利用手中的亡者灵魂搭建出从生到死的桥梁。
facets_loc: 瘟疫法师获得移动速度加成，数值等于%movement_transfer%%%敌人损失移速。敌人的恢复增强减少，数值等于瘟疫法师获得的%enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%%。

official.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
official.desc_loc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
official.lore_loc: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.
notes_loc: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
official.scepter_loc: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师让敌人的心脏停跳，使附近敌方单位按最大生命值一定百分比持续流失生命。
officialZh.lore_loc: 接近瘟疫法师就会感受到在他周围的空气中存在的瘟疫和灾祸。
notes_loc: 伤害不会禁用像闪烁匕首等物品。
不能作用于远古生物。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 竭心光环的生命流失伤害提升，数值为瘟疫法师当前生命恢复的%heal_regen_to_damage%%%。

official.name: necrolyte_death_seeker
official.desc_loc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
official.lore_loc: The Rumusque Faithful consider Necrophos to be more plague than person.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell reflect.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_death_seeker
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。
officialZh.lore_loc: 鲁姆斯克的信徒认为瘟疫法师比起人更像是瘟疫。
notes_loc: 不会触发法术反弹。

official.name: necrolyte_sadist
official.desc_loc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_sadist
officialZh.desc_loc: 瘟疫法师每次击杀单位都将获得可叠加的恢复效果，持续%regen_duration%秒。击杀英雄后获得数倍的效果。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

official.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
official.desc_loc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
official.lore_loc: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

officialZh.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
officialZh.desc_loc: <font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
officialZh.lore_loc: 空气中充斥的死亡和苦难增强了瘟疫法师的瘟疫魔法。
notes_loc: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。

special_values.name: damage_per_health
special_values.heading_loc: 每点损失生命值造成伤害：

official.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
official.desc_loc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
official.lore_loc: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
notes_loc: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

officialZh.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
officialZh.desc_loc: 将数个可见的敌方单位连接在一起，其中一人所受伤害的一定百分比会被其他所有人感受到。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一个远古咒语，能将多个生命体的生命能量连接成一个集合体。
notes_loc: 共享伤害的类型与原伤害相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

official.name: warlock_shadow_word
official.desc_loc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
official.lore_loc: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.

officialZh.name: warlock_shadow_word
officialZh.desc_loc: 术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。目标单位也会被<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 戴蒙的奥术有无穷的用途，可以用来强化友军也可以用作诅咒伤害敌人。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升作用范围。现在暗言术会施加给%cast_aoe%范围内%additional_targets%个额外单位，以英雄优先。额外单位的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>和伤害量减少%secondary_reduction%%%。

official.name: warlock_upheaval
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
official.lore_loc: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
notes_loc: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
official.shard_loc: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

officialZh.name: warlock_upheaval
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多%abilitychanneltime%秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速%duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 戴蒙操纵时空，削弱所有敌军。
notes_loc: 减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。
officialZh.shard_loc: 持续施法时每%imps_interval%秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

official.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
official.desc_loc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
official.shard_loc: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

officialZh.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
officialZh.desc_loc: 只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
official.desc_loc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
official.lore_loc: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
official.scepter_loc: Calls %number_of_golems_scepter% Golems.
facets_loc: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.

officialZh.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
officialZh.desc_loc: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人%stun_duration%秒。地狱火持续%golem_duration%秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 戴蒙释放被他关在恐惧之木法杖中的异界灵魂，在敌阵中引发毁灭。
notes_loc: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 召唤%number_of_golems_scepter%个地狱火。
facets_loc: 混乱之祭地狱火会根据术士的生命和魔法恢复造成更高的永久献祭伤害。

official.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
official.lore_loc: While learning to maneuver in nature alone, the Beastmaster also mastered the use of a pair of tomahawks, adept at cutting down trees as well as adversaries.
notes_loc: This ability destroys trees.
official.shard_loc: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在独自学习野外生存时，兽王也掌握了飞斧的运用技巧，使他能够熟练地砍下树木，或者敌人的脑袋。
notes_loc: 此技能将摧毁树木。
officialZh.shard_loc: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

official.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.
official.lore_loc: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 度过了与异兽互惠互助的孩童时期，兽王学会了如何随时召唤野兽。

official.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
official.lore_loc: After befriending the strange beast of his childhood, Beastmaster has learned to call to animals in times of need.
official.shard_loc: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王召唤%hawk_count%只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以%hawk_base_attack_interval%秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
officialZh.lore_loc: 度过了与异兽互惠互助的孩童时期，兽王学会了如何随时召唤野兽。
officialZh.shard_loc: 战鹰的持续时间提升%bonus_duration%秒，并且额外召唤一只战鹰。

official.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
official.desc_loc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
official.lore_loc: Beastmaster's ability to incite the innate strength of animals was seen in the mauling of the king of Slom.
notes_loc: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
facets_loc: Attack Speed bonus is increased by the number of units affected by Inner Beast.
Can be activated to increase Beastmaster's attack speed and allow him to apply the Wild Axes damage amplification debuff on his attack target.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
officialZh.desc_loc: 唤起兽王和他控制单位的内心狂怒，被动提高他们的攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 兽王激起野兽先天力量的能力，在他袭击斯洛姆国王时得到了展现。
notes_loc: 破坏会使被动攻击速度加成失效。
facets_loc: 攻击速度加成根据野性之心作用下的单位数量还会有所增加。
可以主动开启，提升兽王的攻击速度，并且他会对他的攻击目标施加野性之斧的伤害加深负面效果。

official.name: beastmaster_drums_of_slom
official.desc_loc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.
official.lore_loc: Nature's rage is timeless, and for those who know the secrets, it's easy to stir the echoes of ire that rejoiced in the downfall of Slom.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_drums_of_slom
officialZh.desc_loc:
兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，%max_stacks%次攻击后降低至最短%min_drum_hit_interval%秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。

使用原始咆哮时自动增加%primal_roar_stacks%层敲鼓叠加效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 自然的愤怒是永恒的，而知晓这个秘密的人就能非常轻松地重新激发在斯洛姆衰亡之际雀跃的怒火。

special_values.name: max_stacks
special_values.heading_loc: 最短间隔所需攻击次数：

special_values.name: creep_heal_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 非英雄伤害<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>量：

official.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
official.desc_loc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: The Beastmaster has learned to channel his primal instincts into an animalistic roar, causing devastation in the ranks of enemies.

officialZh.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
officialZh.desc_loc: 兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得%movement_speed%%%移动速度提升，持续%movement_speed_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 兽王学会将他的原始本能凝聚为猛兽般的怒吼，在敌阵之中引发巨大的破坏。

official.name: queenofpain_shadow_strike
official.desc_loc: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Akasha's envenomed dagger allows her to delight in the drawn out suffering of her victims.
notes_loc: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

officialZh.name: queenofpain_shadow_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续%duration%秒。每%damage_interval%秒会再造成一次伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿卡莎的淬毒匕首让她从受害者的痛苦中得到愉悦。
notes_loc: 受到作用的单位在持续时间内将逐秒缓慢地恢复至初始移动速度。
受到暗影突袭作用的单位在生命值低于最大值25%时可以被队友反补。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 暗影突袭变为%aoe_radius%范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。

official.name: queenofpain_blink
official.desc_loc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
official.lore_loc: The Secret Queen lives up to her title, making her pain impossible to escape.
notes_loc: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
official.shard_loc: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals %shard_damage% damage in a %shard_aoe% AoE and silences the target for %shard_duration% seconds.

officialZh.name: queenofpain_blink
officialZh.desc_loc: 短距离传送，能让痛苦女王自由出入战场。
officialZh.lore_loc: 秘密中的女王名副其实，你无法从她的痛苦逃脱。
notes_loc: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
officialZh.shard_loc: 在痛苦女王的闪烁起点和落地点各释放一次音爆。在%shard_aoe%范围内造成%shard_damage%点伤害，并<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>%shard_duration%秒。

official.name: queenofpain_scream_of_pain
official.desc_loc:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.
