%damage_reflected_to_self%%% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
official.lore_loc: The sultry voice of Akasha beckons her opponents while stealing their souls.
notes_loc: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

officialZh.name: queenofpain_scream_of_pain
officialZh.desc_loc:
痛苦女王发出刺耳的尖叫，对周围敌人造成伤害。

造成伤害的%damage_reflected_to_self%%%会反弹回她身上。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿卡莎那魅惑的声音吸引着敌人的同时也在偷取他们的灵魂。
notes_loc: 痛苦尖叫能作用隐身单位。
痛苦尖叫无法被躲避。
对幻象造成的伤害不会反弹。反弹的伤害为减免前的，而且不致死。
反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

official.name: queenofpain_succubus
official.desc_loc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.
facets_loc: Spell Lifesteal also applies to Pure & Magical reflected damage.

officialZh.name: queenofpain_succubus
officialZh.desc_loc: 所有来源的技能吸血也对纯粹伤害生效。痛苦女王获得技能吸血，与敌人的距离越近效果越强。敌人距离她不到%close_radius%距离时达到最强效果，距离她超过%max_radius%距离时为最弱效果。
facets_loc: 技能吸血也对反弹的纯粹和魔法伤害有效。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: queenofpain_sonic_wave
official.desc_loc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
official.lore_loc: Her most exquisite of all of torments, Akasha's Sonic Wave puts her poor foes out of their misery.
notes_loc: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.

officialZh.name: queenofpain_sonic_wave
officialZh.desc_loc: 痛苦女王在她面前制造出强大的声波，对其轨迹上的所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将他们击退。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿卡莎最为精致的折磨，她的音波让可怜的敌人从痛苦中得到解脱。
notes_loc: 超声冲击波最远能伤害1150距离外的单位。

official.name: venomancer_venomous_gale
official.desc_loc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
official.lore_loc: A concoction of various stings, poisons, and toxins gathered from the jungles of Jidi Isle, victims surviving it are rare.
notes_loc: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every %tick_interval% seconds.
Slow starts at %movement_slow%%%, and decreases as time passes.
official.shard_loc: Increases cast range and projectile speed by %shard_travel_tooltip%%%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, %num_created_wards_tooltip% Plague Wards are created around them.

officialZh.name: venomancer_venomous_gale
officialZh.desc_loc: 沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一种由基迪岛丛林里搜集的各种毒针、毒液和毒素混合而成的药剂，几乎没有人能在沾到它后存活下来。
notes_loc: 瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每%tick_interval%秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为%movement_slow%%%，减速效果将逐渐降低。
officialZh.shard_loc: 施法距离和弹道速度提升%shard_travel_tooltip%%%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造%num_created_wards_tooltip%个瘟疫守卫。

official.name: venomancer_snakebite
official.desc_loc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

officialZh.name: venomancer_snakebite
officialZh.desc_loc: 剧毒术士召唤阿克特克的幼体，把它的毒牙刺入一个敌人，造成魔法伤害，并施加造成每秒伤害的剧毒。目标在感染时发动攻击，他就会再次受到初始伤害。

official.name: venomancer_plague_ward
official.desc_loc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.
official.lore_loc: A mixture of his old herbalist talents and newfound toxic mastery creates a living embodiment of plague.

officialZh.name: venomancer_plague_ward
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 他通过将早先的草药学天赋，和后天获得的毒素专精混合起来，创造出一个活体化瘟疫。

official.name: venomancer_poison_sting
official.desc_loc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
official.lore_loc: The paralytic sting of the creature which caused his transformation now belongs to the Venomancer.
notes_loc: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.
official.shard_loc: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

officialZh.name: venomancer_poison_sting
officialZh.desc_loc: 剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 造成他变异的生物身上的麻痹毒刺，现在属于剧毒术士了。
notes_loc: 毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。
officialZh.shard_loc: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

official.name: venomancer_noxious_plague
official.desc_loc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
official.lore_loc: Deep in the heart of the jungles of Jidi, the seeds of extermination freely grow.
notes_loc: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
official.scepter_loc: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.

officialZh.name: venomancer_noxious_plague
officialZh.desc_loc: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在基迪岛丛林中心的深处，灭绝的种子自由地生长。
notes_loc: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

official.name: faceless_void_time_walk
official.desc_loc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Darkterror tears a hole in time, passing through Claszureme, and appearing back in an instant.
notes_loc: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.
official.scepter_loc: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_time_walk
officialZh.desc_loc: 冲到目标位置，并取消最近%backtrack_duration%秒内受到的任何伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 暗惧者将时间撕裂，穿过超维视界并瞬间重现。
notes_loc: 虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。

official.name: faceless_void_time_dilation
official.desc_loc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
official.lore_loc: For those facing off against Darkterror, each moment seems to stretch into eternity.
notes_loc: Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.
official.shard_loc: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_time_dilation
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚空假面将附近所有敌人困在一个时间膨胀场中，技能的冷却都会减慢。施加时每个受困的敌人都会获得一层时间膨胀的叠加效果，每有一个技能处于冷却就再获得一层。每层叠加效果造成每秒伤害，并降低移动速度和攻击速度降低。持续时间在时间结界作用下会暂停。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对于挑战暗惧者的人，每个时刻都像是延展成了永恒。
notes_loc: 不会影响物品的冷却时间。
效果期间叠加层数还会改变。施放技能后如果技能进入冷却就会提供一层叠加效果。如果技能冷却在时间膨胀期间完成，效果会被移除。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。

special_values.name: damage_per_stack
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加额外每秒伤害：

special_values.name: self_movespeed_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加自身移速加成：

special_values.name: self_attackspeed_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加自身攻速加成：

official.name: faceless_void_time_lock
official.desc_loc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
official.lore_loc: The strike of the Faceless Void lands with dimension shifting force.
notes_loc: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_time_lock
officialZh.desc_loc: 攻击有一定概率将一个敌方目标<font color='#2dd5e4'>锁定</font>在时间中，再次发动攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虚空假面的突袭伴随着维度转移之力。
notes_loc: 不与碎颅锤叠加。

official.name: faceless_void_time_walk_reverse
official.desc_loc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
official.lore_loc: It's all relative.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_time_walk_reverse
officialZh.desc_loc: 时间漫游落地后1.5秒内可使用。施放时，自身将逆转时间漫游，回到上一个施放地点。不会影响生命值或触发神杖效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一切都是相对的。

official.name: faceless_void_distortion_field
official.desc_loc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_distortion_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚空假面附近%friendly_hero_distance%范围内以他或友方英雄为目标的敌方攻击弹道在进入目标%slow_distance_max%范围后会被减速%attack_projectile_slow%%%。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: faceless_void_chronosphere
official.desc_loc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
official.lore_loc: When a rift opens to Claszureme, all poor souls caught within will likely never return.
notes_loc: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.

officialZh.name: faceless_void_chronosphere
officialZh.desc_loc: 在时空中创造一个泡状遮罩，将所有位于其中的单位定住，并使虚空假面在其内部来去自如。只有虚空假面和他控制的单位不受影响。在其中的隐形敌人会显形。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当超维视界的裂隙突现之时，所有被其困住的可怜灵魂都将万劫不复。
notes_loc: 能够定住所有单位和建筑，不论敌我。除了虚空假面控制的单位。
虚空假面不受任何时间结界的影响。

official.name: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast
official.desc_loc: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
official.lore_loc: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.

officialZh.name: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 奥斯塔里昂激活他的冥魂怒意，毁灭他的敌人。

official.name: skeleton_king_bone_guard
official.desc_loc: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
official.lore_loc: Wraith King's blade drains his enemy's essence to feed his aura.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.

officialZh.name: skeleton_king_bone_guard
officialZh.desc_loc: 击杀2个非英雄单位可获得1点能量，击杀1名英雄可获得2点能量。可以主动使用，消耗所有能量点数召唤可以复活一次的骷髅兵。骷髅兵享受吸血灵魂的吸血效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冥魂大帝的剑刃汲取敌人的精华，填补自身的元气。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
对敌人施放冥火爆击会导致骷髅兵攻击该敌人。

special_values.name: skeleton_building_damage_reduction
special_values.heading_loc: 骷髅兵对建筑伤害降低：

special_values.name: skeleton_bonus_hero_damage
special_values.heading_loc: 骷髅兵对英雄额外伤害：

official.name: skeleton_king_mortal_strike
official.desc_loc: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
official.lore_loc: One blow to crush a foe.
official.shard_loc: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take %curse_damage_pct%%% of the initial attack damage again as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage after a %curse_delay% second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.

officialZh.name: skeleton_king_mortal_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥魂大帝被动地在攻击时造成额外伤害，本技能具有冷却时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 单凭一击，斩敌无匹。
officialZh.shard_loc: 本命一击会诅咒目标，使其在%curse_delay%秒延迟后再次受到%curse_damage_pct%%%原攻击伤害的<font color="#d8ae53">纯粹</font>伤害。吸血灵魂的吸血效果对诅咒伤害有效。

official.name: skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit
official.desc_loc: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
notes_loc: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
Does not affect Reincarnate deaths.
Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.
official.scepter_loc: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.

officialZh.name: skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥魂大帝获得吸血效果。被击杀时冥魂大帝变为移动无视地形的冥魂，拥有额外攻击和移动速度，持续较短时间，自身死亡延后。冥魂大帝变为冥魂后无法重生。
notes_loc: 对于死亡被延缓的友军，其成为冥魂前所受的最后一击来源即为击杀者。
触发绝冥再生时没有效果。
破坏只会使被动吸血失效。
复活时间会根据冥魂持续时间而减少。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 吸血灵魂变为光环，使友方英雄被击杀时也能变为冥魂。延长冥魂的持续时间。

official.name: skeleton_king_reincarnation
official.desc_loc: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
official.lore_loc: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
notes_loc: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.
official.scepter_loc: Reduces cooldown.
facets_loc: When reincarnating, %shard_skeleton_count% skeletons are spawned and attack each nearby enemy hero.
When reincarnating, nearby enemy heroes have their curse cooldowns reset.

officialZh.name: skeleton_king_reincarnation
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥魂大帝倒下后，他飞散的冥魂会重组，使他复活。死亡时附近%slow_radius%范围内的敌人会被减速，会产生骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。可以对自身施放，使冥魂大帝立刻阵亡。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冥魂大帝的对头们一直很疑惑，为什么他就是不会死透。
notes_loc: 如果魔法不足冥魂大帝将不会重生。
如果冥魂大帝拥有不朽之守护，同时绝冥再生不处于冷却状态，死亡后将首先触发绝冥再生。
重生后生命值和魔法值全满。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 减少冷却时间。
facets_loc: 重生过程中会产生%shard_skeleton_count%个骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。
重生过程中附近每个敌方英雄的诅咒冷却时间都会重置。

special_values.name: shard_skeleton_count
special_values.heading_loc: 每个英雄产生骷髅兵数量：

official.name: death_prophet_carrion_swarm
official.desc_loc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
official.lore_loc: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.
notes_loc: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

officialZh.name: death_prophet_carrion_swarm
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克萝贝露丝在鬼门关的来来回回聚集了一大群被诅咒的生物。
notes_loc: 最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

official.name: death_prophet_silence
official.desc_loc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
official.lore_loc: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.
notes_loc: Doesn't prevent usage of items.
facets_loc: Silenced enemies are also slowed.

officialZh.name: death_prophet_silence
officialZh.desc_loc: 放出一个弹道，<font color='#6db6e9'>阻止</font>目标区域内的敌人施放魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 透过她敌人的命运之纱，克萝贝露丝看到的是沉默的未来。
notes_loc: 不能阻止使用物品。
facets_loc: 被沉默的敌人也会被减速。

official.name: death_prophet_spirit_siphon
official.desc_loc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
official.lore_loc: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.
notes_loc: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
official.shard_loc: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.

officialZh.name: death_prophet_spirit_siphon
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。每秒吸取生命值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克萝贝露丝乐意向他人展示她独自无法走上的道路。
notes_loc: 多个连接不能同时作用于一个目标。
officialZh.shard_loc: 吸魂巫术的能量点数提升%shard_bonus_charges%点，敌人连续%shard_consecutive_siphon_duration%秒受到吸魂巫术作用后会被<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>%shard_fear_duration%秒。

official.name: death_prophet_witchcraft
official.desc_loc: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

officialZh.name: death_prophet_witchcraft
officialZh.desc_loc: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。

official.name: death_prophet_exorcism
official.desc_loc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
notes_loc: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
official.scepter_loc: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

officialZh.name: death_prophet_exorcism
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。对建筑造成50%%伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 伴随着无数次的死亡，她前世死亡幻化出的女妖们总是萦绕于现世。
notes_loc: 作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 敌人受到死亡先知的技能作用，或被死亡先知攻击时，会有一只恶灵飞出攻击敌人，造成高于平常的伤害，再返回使自身回复生命。

official.name: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
official.desc_loc: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
official.lore_loc: The first skill learned by the Sisters of the Veil often signals an incoming hit.
notes_loc: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.

officialZh.name: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
officialZh.desc_loc: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为%base_damage%+幻影刺客攻击伤害的%attack_factor_tooltip%%%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 魅影之纱成员学习到的第一个技能，中招就意味着下一次攻击要来了。
notes_loc: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。

official.name: phantom_assassin_phantom_strike
official.desc_loc: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
official.lore_loc: Mortred's silken veil is the last thing her unfortunate target sees.

officialZh.name: phantom_assassin_phantom_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 传送到一个单位身旁，敌我皆可，如果目标是敌方单位将进行攻击并获得攻速加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 茉崔蒂的真丝面纱是她倒霉的目标临终所见之物。

official.name: phantom_assassin_blur
official.desc_loc: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
official.lore_loc: Meditation allows a Veiled Sister to carefully anticipate her opponents in combat.
notes_loc: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.
official.shard_loc: Decreases Cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.

officialZh.name: phantom_assassin_blur
officialZh.desc_loc: 幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
officialZh.lore_loc: 长期的冥想使得魅影之纱的成员能够谨慎地预知到敌人的到来。
notes_loc: 通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。
officialZh.shard_loc: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快%cooldown_refund_pct%%%最高冷却时间。

official.name: phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives
official.desc_loc: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.
official.lore_loc: A sister is generally given a single name, but powerful names often have plentiful allies.

officialZh.name: phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives
officialZh.desc_loc: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 通常魅影之纱只会赋予一个名字，但是多个强大的名字意味着众多的盟友。

official.name: phantom_assassin_immaterial
official.desc_loc:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

officialZh.name: phantom_assassin_immaterial
officialZh.desc_loc:
幻影刺客专注一心，闪避敌人攻击的技艺得到提升。

与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

official.name: phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace
official.desc_loc: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
official.lore_loc: A divine strike, Mortred honors her opponent by choosing them for death.
facets_loc: Coup de Grace procs every %attacks_to_proc% attacks on the same hero or %attacks_to_proc_creeps% attacks on non hero units. Stifling Dagger counts as %two_tooltip% attacks.

officialZh.name: phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace
officialZh.desc_loc: 幻影刺客的战斗技能得到精进，每次攻击时有几率获得致命专注。攻击时若带有致命专注，幻影刺客会消耗该效果，并且必定产生一次致命一击。窒碍短匕拥有额外几率获得致命专注。
officialZh.lore_loc: 神圣的一击，茉崔蒂通过赐予对手死亡来向他们致以敬意。
facets_loc: 每攻击同个英雄%attacks_to_proc%次触发恩赐解脱，或者攻击同个非英雄单位%attacks_to_proc_creeps%次触发。窒碍短匕计为%two_tooltip%次攻击。

official.name: pugna_nether_blast
official.desc_loc: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area.  Deals %structure_damage_mod%%% damage to structures.
official.lore_loc: The Arts of Oblivion include a deafening blast of emerald flames from the Nether Reaches.
notes_loc: Damage is delayed by %delay% seconds.

officialZh.name: pugna_nether_blast
officialZh.desc_loc: 一个爆炸性脉冲，对敌方单位造成伤害。对建筑物造成%structure_damage_mod%%%伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 湮灭术中有一招是来自三途川的碧绿轰击。
notes_loc: 伤害生效延迟为%delay%秒。

official.name: pugna_decrepify
official.desc_loc: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
official.lore_loc: A now-mastered relic from his childhood, Pugna delights in banishing others into the Nether Realm, whether for good, evil, or simple enjoyment.
notes_loc: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.

officialZh.name: pugna_decrepify
officialZh.desc_loc: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入<font color='#57e550'>虚无</font>状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 作为童年时期遗留下来的癖好，现在帕格纳精通于把人放逐到幽冥之境，而不管那人是善还是恶，或者仅仅是他的一时兴起。
notes_loc: 只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。

official.name: pugna_nether_ward
official.desc_loc: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
official.lore_loc: While at the lamasery for the Arts of Oblivion, Pugna learned to dominate his classmates with a simple ward charged with Nether magic.
notes_loc: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.
official.shard_loc: Increases cast range to %AbilityCastRange%.
facets_loc: Nether Ward restores mana and health to Pugna based on how much damage is dealt.

officialZh.name: pugna_nether_ward
officialZh.desc_loc: 帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光。幽冥守卫造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。
officialZh.lore_loc: 还在喇嘛寺里时，帕格纳就学会了操控富有幽冥魔力的守卫来支配他的同学。
notes_loc: 技能施放后幽冥守卫先造成伤害，技能才会生效，所以如果施法者因此阵亡，施放的技能将没有效果。
幽冥守卫可以受到衰老的作用。
幻象和非英雄单位对幽冥守卫造成25%的伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 施法距离提升至%AbilityCastRange%。
facets_loc: 幽冥守卫会根据造成的伤害使帕格纳回复魔法和生命。

official.name: pugna_oblivion_savant
official.desc_loc:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives %tower_scale%%% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

officialZh.name: pugna_oblivion_savant
officialZh.desc_loc:
帕格纳可以在持续施法期间施放技能和使用物品。

每摧毁一座防御塔，帕格纳都会获得%tower_scale%%%技能增强。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: pugna_life_drain
official.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
official.lore_loc: Pugna has truly become more powerful than even the grandmaster of Oblivion.
official.shard_loc: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
official.scepter_loc: Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.

officialZh.name: pugna_life_drain
officialZh.desc_loc:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。
officialZh.lore_loc: 帕格纳的力量甚至已经超越湮灭术前任的上师。
officialZh.shard_loc: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

special_values.name: ally_healing
special_values.heading_loc: 每秒友军汲取/<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>：

official.name: templar_assassin_refraction
official.desc_loc: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
official.lore_loc: Manipulating her psionic veil, Lanaya bends nature's law to her will.
notes_loc: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).
official.shard_loc: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.

officialZh.name: templar_assassin_refraction
officialZh.desc_loc: 圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>，同时获得攻击力加成。攻击力加成和<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。如果<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。如果单次伤害超过了剩余的<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
officialZh.lore_loc: 通过操控她的灵能面纱，拉娜娅让自然法则为她所用。
notes_loc: 生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。
officialZh.shard_loc: 攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。

official.name: templar_assassin_meld
official.desc_loc: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for %debuff_duration% seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
official.lore_loc: Lanaya is as elusive as her covenant with the Hidden Temple.
notes_loc: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.
facets_loc: Meld bonus damage and armor reductions are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
When in Meld, Templar increases her attack range by up to an additional %attack_range_increase_max% range over %attack_range_increase_time%s.

officialZh.name: templar_assassin_meld
officialZh.desc_loc: 圣堂刺客将自己隐藏起来，只要静止不动将一直处于<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态。只要在隐匿状态下攻击敌人打破<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，拉娜娅的攻击将对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低其护甲，持续%debuff_duration%秒。额外伤害和隐匿的负面效果会施加给灵能之刃飞溅距离内所有敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 拉娜娅本人就和她与隐之圣堂的契约一样神秘。
notes_loc: 除了停留在原地或持续施放灵能投射，其他任何动作都会打破隐匿效果。
隐匿的护甲降低作用对防御塔无效。
facets_loc: 隐匿的额外伤害和护甲降低效果会施加给灵能之刃飞溅距离内所有敌人。
隐匿状态下圣堂刺客会在%attack_range_increase_time%秒内逐渐提升她的攻击距离，最高为额外%attack_range_increase_max%距离。

official.name: templar_assassin_psi_blades
official.desc_loc: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
official.lore_loc: Her blades pierce the skin as much as the mind, furthering her understanding of the mystery that is reality.
notes_loc: Split damage hits invisible units.
Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.

officialZh.name: templar_assassin_psi_blades
officialZh.desc_loc: 圣堂刺客锋利的灵能之刃可以穿透敌人，对其正后方的敌方单位造成伤害，并且攻击距离得到提升。每对一个单位造成伤害后，飞溅伤害都会减少一定百分比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 她的灵刃刺进了他人的皮肤，也刺进了他们的心智，使她对现实这一奥秘有了更深的理解。
notes_loc: 飞溅伤害可以伤害隐身单位。
重击等攻击特效只对主目标有效。

official.name: templar_assassin_trap_teleport
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for %abilitychanneltime% seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing %extra_damage% bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.
official.lore_loc: In reward for her service, Lanaya has been granted access to secrets that unlock new techniques for her psionic gifts.

officialZh.name: templar_assassin_trap_teleport
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 圣堂刺客经过%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法后可以传送至任意灵能陷阱，到达时引爆灵能陷阱，陷阱总是最大效果，并且立刻造成%extra_damage%点额外伤害。灵能投射在持续施法时不会脱离隐匿效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 作为她效忠的报酬，拉娜娅得以查探秘密，使她的灵能天赋解开了新的技巧。

official.name: templar_assassin_psionic_trap
official.desc_loc: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
official.lore_loc: Calling upon the reach of the Hidden Temple, none escape the eye of the Templar.
notes_loc: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
official.scepter_loc: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.

officialZh.name: templar_assassin_psionic_trap
officialZh.desc_loc: 圣堂刺客放下一个<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>的神秘陷阱监视敌人的动向。引爆后将减缓%trap_radius%范围内敌人的移动速度，陷阱放置时间越久，引爆后减速效果越强，最低为%movement_speed_min%%%，放置%trap_max_charge_duration%秒后引爆将达到最大减速效果，为%movement_speed_max%%%，并且还能造成额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 召来隐之圣堂的力量后，无人能逃脱圣堂刺客的追杀。
notes_loc: 陷阱没有时间限制。
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为%trap_fade_time%秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。他们可以承受2次远程英雄的攻击，1次近战英雄的攻击，或4次非英雄单位的攻击。
陷阱的视野是250/250，不能阻止中立生物刷新。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 现在陷阱引爆后还会<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>受到作用的敌人。

special_values.name: min_silence_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 最短<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>持续时间：

special_values.name: max_silence_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 最长<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>持续时间：

official.name: templar_assassin_inner_peace
official.desc_loc: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for %time_until_meditation%s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after %time_until_max_bonus%s of meditating.

officialZh.name: templar_assassin_inner_peace
officialZh.desc_loc: 原地不动且未受到伤害超过%time_until_meditation%秒后，圣堂刺客开始冥想，获得生命恢复和魔法恢复加成，冥想%time_until_max_bonus%秒后达到最大加成。

special_values.name: time_until_max_bonus
special_values.heading_loc: 达到最大加成的冥想时间：

official.name: viper_poison_attack
official.desc_loc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
official.lore_loc: The Netherdrake's inborn toxic breath quickly drains the vitality of its afflicted.
official.shard_loc: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

officialZh.name: viper_poison_attack
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冥界亚龙天生带有剧毒的吐息能迅速抽干敌人的生命力。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

official.name: viper_nethertoxin
official.desc_loc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
official.lore_loc: Poison from the Nether Reaches turns wounds into fatalities, and fatigue into death.
notes_loc: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.

officialZh.name: viper_nethertoxin
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇向目标区域释放幽冥剧毒。范围内的单位持续受到伤害，在区域内停留的时间越长，受到的伤害也越高。同时他们的攻击速度会被降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 三途川的剧毒让小伤也能致死，而疲乏可以送命。
notes_loc: 多个幽冥剧毒不会叠加。

special_values.name: max_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 最高每秒伤害所需时间：

official.name: viper_corrosive_skin
official.desc_loc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a %max_range% radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
official.lore_loc: It is not unusual for sword and shield alike to corrode in the very hands of those who attack the Netherdrake.
notes_loc: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
official.scepter_loc: Corrosive Skin applies %effect_multiplier%x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within %effect_multiplier_distance% distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to %nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%% increased effect after %nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%s.

officialZh.name: viper_corrosive_skin
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇分泌出感染性的毒素，%max_range%范围内任何伤害它的敌人都将受到伤害，同时攻击速度也被降低。这种酸性分泌物还能提高蝮蛇的魔法抗性。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对冥界亚龙出击后，手中的刀剑和盾牌会遭到腐蚀并不稀奇。
notes_loc: 与其他提升魔法抗性的物品和技能叠加。
破坏会使腐蚀皮肤不再施加效果。极恶俯冲还是会施加腐蚀皮肤。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙%effect_multiplier_distance%范围内的敌人施加%effect_multiplier%倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在%nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%秒后，达到最高的%nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%%提升。

official.name: viper_nose_dive
official.desc_loc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
official.lore_loc: It was thought that Netherdrake wings touch ground only in death, but some surmise that those who've witnessed more intentional landings merely haven't survived to tell the tale.

officialZh.name: viper_nose_dive
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且%corrosive_radius%范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续%effect_duration%秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。
officialZh.lore_loc: 世人认为冥界亚龙的翅膀只有在死亡时才会碰到地面，不过也有揣测是有人见证了更为刻意的着陆，只是没能活着说出他的故事。

official.name: viper_predator
official.desc_loc: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

officialZh.name: viper_predator
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥界亚龙的攻击会根据目标英雄缺失的生命百分比额外造成一次物理伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: viper_viper_strike
official.desc_loc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.
official.lore_loc: Once used to slay his sadistic summoner, the most powerful of Netherdrake infections spreads through the veins of those foolish enough to cross Viper.

officialZh.name: viper_viper_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇降低敌方目标单位的移动和攻击速度，同时<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>其被动技能并造成持续毒素伤害。移动和攻击速度会在毒素的持续时间内逐渐恢复。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冥界亚龙身上最具威力的毒素，曾用于屠戮它残酷的主人。不论是谁，只要愚蠢到与蝮蛇作对就会被毒杀。

official.name: luna_lucent_beam
official.desc_loc: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
official.lore_loc: Selemene smites those who encroach upon the Nightsilver Woods.
official.shard_loc: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant %damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%% of the damage amount.

officialZh.name: luna_lucent_beam
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。
officialZh.lore_loc: 那些侵犯银夜森林的家伙会受到赛莉蒙妮的毁灭打击。
officialZh.shard_loc: 每次一名敌方英雄被月光击中时，露娜都会获得一个攻击力加成的状态效果。月蚀的月光提供%damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%%数值。

official.name: luna_lunar_orbit
official.desc_loc: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
official.lore_loc: None may approach Selemene's chosen without favor from the goddess herself.
official.shard_loc: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.
facets_loc: Rotating glaives provide damage reduction while active.

officialZh.name: luna_lunar_orbit
officialZh.desc_loc: 产生%rotating_glaives%个月刃在露娜身旁%rotating_glaives_movement_radius%范围内旋转。任何碰到月刃的敌方单位都会受到露娜攻击伤害的一定百分比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 没有赛莉蒙妮本人的青睐，谁也不能接近女神钦定之人。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得%bonus_movement_speed%%%移动速度加成。
facets_loc: 旋转的月刃在开启时提供承受伤害降低的效果。

official.name: luna_moon_glaive
official.desc_loc: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
official.lore_loc: Carefully sharpened, Luna's boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.
notes_loc: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.

officialZh.name: luna_moon_glaive
officialZh.desc_loc: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳造成的伤害都会减少。
officialZh.lore_loc: 露娜精心打磨过的回旋镖型武器可以从大群敌人中杀出一条血路。
notes_loc: 月刃不会触发致命一击以外的任何攻击特效。

official.name: luna_lunar_blessing
official.desc_loc: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
official.lore_loc: The Goddess of the Moon smiles upon her kin.

officialZh.name: luna_lunar_blessing
officialZh.desc_loc: 提升露娜和附近%radius%范围内友方英雄的攻击力，露娜获得双倍的攻击力加成。夜晚期间月之祝福为全地图生效，并且露娜受到福佑后夜间视野提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 月之女神对她的族人微笑。

official.name: luna_eclipse
official.desc_loc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
official.lore_loc: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.
notes_loc: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a %beam_interval% seconds gap between beams, %beam_interval_scepter% seconds with scepter.
official.scepter_loc: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

officialZh.name: luna_eclipse
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一次月蚀，以她当前技能等级的月光随机打击附近敌人。月光只有伤害效果，不会造成眩晕，而且单一目标只能受到有限次数的打击。月蚀会暂时将白天变为黑夜。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在急需其帮助的时候，赛莉蒙妮亲自降临世间，遮蔽照向敌人的光芒，以及他们的希望。
notes_loc: 如果露娜没有升级月光，月蚀将无法造成伤害，但是变为黑夜效果有效。
露娜阵亡后月光马上中止。
不能伤害隐身单位。
每道月光之间都有%beam_interval%秒的间隔。神杖升级后间隔为%beam_interval_scepter%秒。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 露娜可以对友方单位或自身施放月蚀，使月蚀的效果跟随目标，或者对一片区域施放。增加月光数量，减少月蚀持续时间，并且移除单体打击次数上限，月光的产生间隔缩短一半。

official.name: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
official.desc_loc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
official.lore_loc: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
facets_loc: Damage type changed to Physical.

officialZh.name: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
officialZh.desc_loc: 向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 龙骑士达维安的气息已经变成了斯莱瑞克的古龙之息，人们还记得它将无数骑士烧成了焦炭。
notes_loc: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
facets_loc: 伤害类型改为物理。

official.name: dragon_knight_dragon_tail
official.desc_loc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
official.lore_loc: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.
facets_loc: Damage type changed to Physical.

officialZh.name: dragon_knight_dragon_tail
officialZh.desc_loc: 龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 达维安将神龙的天赋和骑士的技艺完美结合，使他在近身肉搏中无比勇猛。
facets_loc: 伤害类型改为物理。

official.name: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
official.desc_loc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

officialZh.name: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
officialZh.desc_loc: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有<font color='#c450e5'>作用范围</font>加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 斯莱瑞克的血液流遍达维安的全身，他获得了寻常骑士身上双倍的活力。

official.name: dragon_knight_fireball
official.desc_loc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
official.lore_loc: Most Dragon Knights name no greater horror than the scourge of dragon's fire.
facets_loc: Damage type changed to Physical.

officialZh.name: dragon_knight_fireball
officialZh.desc_loc: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。
officialZh.lore_loc: 大多数龙骑士声称的恐怖莫过于让生灵涂炭的龙火。
facets_loc: 伤害类型改为物理。

official.name: dragon_knight_dragon_blood
official.desc_loc:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.

Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
official.lore_loc: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.
facets_loc: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.

officialZh.name: dragon_knight_dragon_blood
officialZh.desc_loc:
神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的生命恢复和护甲。

在古龙形态下生命恢复和护甲均提升%regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 斯莱瑞克的血液流遍达维安的全身，他获得了寻常骑士身上双倍的活力。
facets_loc: 攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害，并且技能和物品的作用范围提升。
攻击附带致命的毒素，可作用于敌方单位和建筑，降低护甲并持续造成物理伤害。
攻击带有冰霜，会作用于敌方单位，降低移动速度和攻击速度，同时降低生命回复。

official.name: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
official.desc_loc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
official.lore_loc: The dormant dragon power springs forth from within Davion, combining the powers of a legendary knight with a legendary Eldwurm.
official.scepter_loc: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

officialZh.name: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
officialZh.desc_loc:
龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。

1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。

2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。

3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 潜藏的神龙力量从达维安体内涌出，骑士之力和古龙之威完美地合二为一。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

official.name: dazzle_poison_touch
official.desc_loc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
official.lore_loc: One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.
notes_loc: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

officialZh.name: dazzle_poison_touch
officialZh.desc_loc: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 少数进攻性的德尊仪式之一，麻痹魔法经常显示出它的有用之处。
notes_loc: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

official.name: dazzle_shallow_grave
official.desc_loc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
official.lore_loc: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.
notes_loc: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

officialZh.name: dazzle_shallow_grave
officialZh.desc_loc: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有经验老道的暗影侍僧才能正确做出免死之仪式。
notes_loc: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。

special_values.name: heal_amplify
special_values.heading_loc: 每缺失10%生命增强<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>：

official.name: dazzle_shadow_wave
official.desc_loc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
official.lore_loc: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
notes_loc: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
official.scepter_loc: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

officialZh.name: dazzle_shadow_wave
officialZh.desc_loc: 放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然对暗影牧师来说，暗影波只是很简单也很日常的仪式，不过它确实是取胜的关键所在。
notes_loc: 优先治疗友方英雄
如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>附近友军，数值为%scepter_heal_pct%%%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

official.name: dazzle_innate_weave
official.desc_loc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
official.lore_loc: His ethereal journey into the Nothl realm has allowed Dazzle to mend together the powers of light and dark, creating shifting waves of enchantments.
official.shard_loc: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
facets_loc: Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.
Weave applies %enemy_multiplier%x stacks to enemies.

officialZh.name: dazzle_innate_weave
officialZh.desc_loc: 戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
officialZh.lore_loc: 戴泽在虚无之境的以太之旅让他能将光与暗的力量融在一起，创造出有两种力量的魔力波动。
officialZh.shard_loc: 对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗%ally_heal%点。
facets_loc: 编织会对友军施加%ally_multiplier%倍叠加层数。编织的每层叠加效果会使来自戴泽的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果增强%heal_amplification_pct%%%。
编织会对敌人施加%enemy_multiplier%倍叠加层数。

official.name: dazzle_nothl_projection
official.desc_loc: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
official.lore_loc: The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.
notes_loc: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.
official.shard_loc: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.

officialZh.name: dazzle_nothl_projection
officialZh.desc_loc:
戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：
剧毒之触带有妖术效果；
薄葬结束时会治疗；
暗影波的冷却时间变短。

效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虚无之境的魅力令人沉醉，但戴泽从没忘记过他前去的目的。
notes_loc: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过%leash_start%距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。
officialZh.shard_loc: 虚无投影可以在戴泽被控制时施放。他在虚无之境时治疗效果得到增强。

official.name: rattletrap_battery_assault
official.desc_loc: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
official.lore_loc: Some of Rattletrap's contraptions don't quite work correctly, so detonating them proves useful as an offensive maneuver.
notes_loc: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.

officialZh.name: rattletrap_battery_assault
officialZh.desc_loc: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 瑞托崔普挂载的部分装置运作不良，因此将其引爆也是种有效的进攻手段。
notes_loc: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。

official.name: rattletrap_power_cogs
official.desc_loc:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned.

Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
official.lore_loc: One of Clockwerk's inventions of which he is most proud is the power cog - though it is sometimes despised by his allies.
notes_loc: Cogs can shock invisible units.

officialZh.name: rattletrap_power_cogs
officialZh.desc_loc:
在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且%mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。

敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出%projectile_distance%距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
officialZh.lore_loc: 发条技师最骄傲的发明之一就是他的能量齿轮——虽然有时会被他的盟友轻视。
notes_loc: 齿轮可以震退隐身单位。

official.name: rattletrap_rocket_flare
official.desc_loc: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: What started as a festive display has become a useful scouting and bombardment tool.

officialZh.name: rattletrap_rocket_flare
officialZh.desc_loc: 向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供%duration%秒击中区域的视野。
officialZh.lore_loc: 最初用作节日的焰火，现在成了侦察和轰炸敌人的工具。

official.name: rattletrap_overclocking
official.desc_loc:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.
official.lore_loc: Rattletrap understands the limitations of his armor. Just as he understands the risks of pushing past them in times of need.

officialZh.name: rattletrap_overclocking
officialZh.desc_loc:
使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：

弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。
能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。
照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。
发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。
喷气背包：移动得更快。

持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 瑞托崔普明白他装甲的局限性。就像他明白在必要的情况下越界的风险。

special_values.name: hookshot_radius_bonus_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 发射钩爪额外作用范围：

special_values.name: hookshot_duration_bonus_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 发射钩爪额外<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间：

special_values.name: rocket_flare_duration_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 照明火箭额外持续时间：

official.name: rattletrap_jetpack
official.desc_loc: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.
official.lore_loc: Sure it's blown up over fourteen testing dummies, but at least they all flew!

officialZh.name: rattletrap_jetpack
officialZh.desc_loc: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。
officialZh.lore_loc: 的确是炸掉了十四个测试的假人，但至少他们都飞起来了！

official.name: rattletrap_hookshot
official.desc_loc: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
official.lore_loc: A somewhat unwieldy device, the Hookshot sends the otherwise clunky Clockwerk armor flying through the air.
notes_loc: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
facets_loc: If there's another allied hero within %radius_ally% of Hookshot's hit target, Clockwerk and all allies in the area receive bonus armor, while refunding a portion of Hookshot's cooldown and manacost.

officialZh.name: rattletrap_hookshot
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近%stun_radius%范围内所有敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 钩爪虽然是有点笨重的设备，但能让更加厚重的发条装甲在半空中来去如风。
notes_loc: 发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。
facets_loc: 如果发射钩爪击中的目标附近%radius_ally%范围内还有另一名友方英雄，那么发条技师和范围内所有友军都会获得护甲加成，并且部分退还冷却时间和魔法消耗。

official.name: rattletrap_armor_power
official.desc_loc:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by %damage_per_armor%%% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
facets_loc: Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.

officialZh.name: rattletrap_armor_power
officialZh.desc_loc:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加%damage_per_armor%%%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。
facets_loc: 发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: leshrac_split_earth
official.desc_loc: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
official.lore_loc: Twisting nature to his vile will, the shifting earth consumes those unlucky enough to cross Leshrac's path.
notes_loc: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.
official.shard_loc: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location %shard_max_count% additional times, with a %shard_secondary_delay% second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by %shard_radius_increase%. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.

officialZh.name: leshrac_split_earth
officialZh.desc_loc: 撕裂敌人脚下的大地。造成伤害和短暂的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 拉席克用他恶毒的意志扭曲大自然，撕裂大地摧毁那些挡他路的倒霉鬼。
notes_loc: 撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
技能经过%delay%秒延迟后生效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复%shard_max_count%次，重复间隔为%shard_secondary_delay%秒。每次作用范围增加%shard_radius_increase%。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。

official.name: leshrac_diabolic_edict
official.desc_loc: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
official.lore_loc: Chronoptic energy bursts from one plane to the other, evaporating anything it touches.
notes_loc: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.
facets_loc: Diabolic Edict hits enemies with an increased explosion rate but it no longer damages buildings.

officialZh.name: leshrac_diabolic_edict
officialZh.desc_loc: 使拉席克周围的区域充满魔法性爆炸，对敌方单位和建筑造成纯粹伤害。范围内的敌人越少，他们受到的伤害就越高。
officialZh.lore_loc: 古老的能量从一个位面向另一个位面爆发，将触碰到的一切化为灰烬。
notes_loc: 即使拉席克死亡，爆炸还是会在原地继续。
facets_loc: 恶魔敕令以更高的爆炸速度击中敌人，但是不再对建筑造成伤害。

official.name: leshrac_lightning_storm
official.desc_loc: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.
official.lore_loc: The Tormented Soul's mastery of the elements is evident in the massive storms that strike down armies before him.

officialZh.name: leshrac_lightning_storm
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一片闪电风暴攻击目标敌方单位，并跳跃到附近的敌方单位。被攻击的敌人将会被降低移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 受折磨的灵魂用来击倒敌人的闪电风暴展现出他对操控元素的精通。

official.name: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm
official.desc_loc: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.
official.lore_loc: When it serves his purpose, Leshrac briefly reduces his presence in the Terrene Plane.

officialZh.name: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm
officialZh.desc_loc: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为<font color='#57e550'>虚无</font>状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。
officialZh.lore_loc: 拉席克可以暂时减少他在尘世位面的存在，只要这能助他达成目的。

official.name: leshrac_defilement
official.desc_loc: Leshrac gains %aoe_per_int% Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.

officialZh.name: leshrac_defilement
officialZh.desc_loc: 拉席克的每点智力都会提供%aoe_per_int%<font color='#c450e5'>作用范围</font>加成。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: leshrac_pulse_nova
official.desc_loc: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.
official.lore_loc: If necessary, the Tormented Soul can manipulate space time itself, ravaging lesser beings.

officialZh.name: leshrac_pulse_nova
officialZh.desc_loc: 拉席克在他周围创造破坏性的能量波，每秒对附近敌方单位造成伤害。每次脉冲都会消耗拉席克的魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 必要时，受折磨的灵魂能操纵时空本身，毁灭弱小的存在。

official.name: furion_sprout
official.desc_loc: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
official.lore_loc: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
notes_loc: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
facets_loc: After Sprout is cast, all trees in a %healing_radius% radius emit an aura that heals nearby allies. Allied Tangos provide double the heal duration when consuming a tree created by Sprout.

officialZh.name: furion_sprout
officialZh.desc_loc: 使一圈树木在一个单位的周围发芽，将其困在其中并造成伤害，提供%vision_range%范围内的视野。
officialZh.lore_loc: 疯长的绿苗是那些攻击自然先知的人报告的常见病症。
notes_loc: 发芽的施放目标可以是任何单位或者地面。
发芽产生的树木跟英雄技能的相互作用与平常树木相同。
facets_loc: 施放发芽后附近%healing_radius%范围内的树木会散发出治疗附近友军的光环。友军的树之祭祀吞食发芽产生的树木会提供双倍治疗时间。

official.name: furion_teleportation
official.desc_loc: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
official.lore_loc: The Prophet keeps his sentinel over the forest, protecting it when in need.
notes_loc: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

officialZh.name: furion_teleportation
officialZh.desc_loc: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。
officialZh.lore_loc: 先知保护着整片森林，当森林需要他的时候立刻出现。
notes_loc: 魔耗和冷却时间都是在技能施放结束后结算。自然先知在施放技能时被打断将不会耗费魔法或使技能进入冷却。
施法开始后，目标地点将产生视觉特效，对队友和敌人均可见。

official.name: furion_force_of_nature
official.desc_loc: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
official.lore_loc: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.
notes_loc: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.
facets_loc: Summons a reduced number of stronger Treants with reinforced damage.

officialZh.name: furion_force_of_nature
officialZh.desc_loc: 将一片树木转化成由自然先知操控的树人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 维萝迪希娅赐予先知召唤树人守卫的能力，这是大自然的神话军队。
notes_loc: 自然的呼唤产生的树人不会超过目标区域内树木的数量。
facets_loc: 召唤的树人数量减少，但是威力变大，而且拥有坚锐技能。

official.name: furion_curse_of_the_forest
official.desc_loc: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within %range% range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within %radius% radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.
official.lore_loc: Though powerful, Nature's Prophet's gifts do not include all-sight, and he must rely heavily upon reconnaissance and aid from a long-standing network of stalwart friends.

officialZh.name: furion_curse_of_the_forest
officialZh.desc_loc: 对%range%范围内所有敌方英雄施加诅咒，使他们在迷雾中显形，根据%radius%范围内树木的数量对他们造成减速和持续伤害。在此情况下树人也被视为树木。
officialZh.lore_loc: 自然先知虽然天赋异禀，但是并非无所不见，他必须严重依赖忠实的朋友组成的天网为他提供侦查和援助。

official.name: furion_spirit_of_the_forest
official.desc_loc: Nature's Prophet gains %damage_per_tree_pct%%% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
notes_loc: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.
facets_loc: Treant multiplier increased.

officialZh.name: furion_spirit_of_the_forest
officialZh.desc_loc: 附近的每棵树都会让自然先知获得%damage_per_tree_pct%%%攻击力加成。每个树人也会让自然先知获得若干倍数的加成，不论相距多远。树人也拥有这个技能。
notes_loc: 树人会从周围的树木和其他树人获得加成效果。
树精卫士不提供任何加成。
facets_loc: 树人的倍数增加。

official.name: furion_wrath_of_nature
official.desc_loc: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit.
official.lore_loc: Nature's Prophet calls Verodicia's fury to strike down those who might ravage the wilderness.
notes_loc: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.
official.scepter_loc: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from %scepter_min_entangle_duration%s up to %scepter_max_entangle_duration%s seconds at max bounce.

officialZh.name: furion_wrath_of_nature
officialZh.desc_loc: 伤害性的能量在全地图跳跃，打击视野中的敌人，会先从距目标点最近的敌人开始打击。每击中一个敌人伤害都会增加，击中%max_targets%个目标后达到最高伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 自然先知召唤维萝迪希娅的狂怒，消灭那些想要毁坏自然的敌人。
notes_loc: 自然的愤怒只能伤害视野内的单位。
可以通过点击小地图施放；初始目标将选择施放地点最近的有效单位。
officialZh.scepter_loc: <font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从%scepter_min_entangle_duration%秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为%scepter_max_entangle_duration%秒。

official.name: life_stealer_rage
official.desc_loc:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: The madness and brutality of N'aix makes him a vicious and unrelenting foe in combat.

officialZh.name: life_stealer_rage
officialZh.desc_loc:
进入狂暴状态，变成<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>，提升魔法抗性和移动速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 奈克斯的疯狂和残暴使得他在战斗中异常凶狠无情。

official.name: life_stealer_open_wounds
official.desc_loc: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
official.lore_loc: Fresh wounds and the scent of blood often draw out the scavengers to finish the job.
notes_loc: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.
facets_loc: Open Wounds' cooldown is refreshed if a unit dies while afflicted by Open Wounds.

officialZh.name: life_stealer_open_wounds
officialZh.desc_loc: 噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害<font color='#07d738'>回复</font>一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 新鲜的伤口和鲜血的芳香通常能引来清道夫清理善后。
notes_loc: 撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。
facets_loc: 如果有单位在撕裂伤口效果下阵亡，撕裂伤口的冷却时间将会重置。

official.name: life_stealer_feast
official.desc_loc: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
official.lore_loc: After escaping from his cell in Devarque, N'aix subsisted on flesh and bones of those unfortunate to cross his path.
notes_loc: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
facets_loc: Feast's max HP per hero kill is increased.

officialZh.name: life_stealer_feast
officialZh.desc_loc: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从德瓦克的监狱中逃离后，奈克斯就靠着吞噬那些挡路的倒霉蛋的血肉维持生命。
notes_loc: 对友军和敌人有效。对肉山无效。
回复量与造成伤害相互独立。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
facets_loc: 盛宴的击杀英雄获得生命上限已经提升。

special_values.name: hp_leech_percent
special_values.heading_loc: 来自目标最大生命值的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>：

special_values.name: bonus_hp_per_hero
special_values.heading_loc: 击杀英雄获得生命上限：

special_values.name: bonus_hp_per_creep
special_values.heading_loc: 击杀非英雄获得生命上限：

official.name: life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy
official.desc_loc: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.
official.lore_loc: Distant memories of the Vile Council fuel one mind to plotting and the other to more immediate dark ends.

officialZh.name: life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy
officialZh.desc_loc: 被动提升噬魂鬼的攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对邪恶议会的遥远记忆让一个意识开始策划，而另一个则是马上实施暗黑的手段。

official.name: life_stealer_infest
official.desc_loc:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: With this infestation, N'aix consumes the life blood of the host, restoring him back to full unholy power.
notes_loc: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
official.shard_loc: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
official.scepter_loc: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
facets_loc: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health. Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.

officialZh.name: life_stealer_infest
officialZh.desc_loc:
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 奈克斯通过寄生吞噬宿主的生命之血，使他的不洁之力恢复如初。
notes_loc: 噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。
被感染控制的单位会获得感染的移动速度加成。
不会触发法术反弹。
感染可以对远古生物使用。
officialZh.shard_loc: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。
facets_loc: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。感染可以对远古中立生物使用。

special_values.name: self_regen
special_values.heading_loc: 自身最大生命值每秒恢复：

special_values.name: creep_max_hp_drain_pct_per_second
special_values.heading_loc: 生物每秒最大生命值流失：

special_values.name: dot_damage_as_pct_of_damage_dealt
special_values.heading_loc: 剩余生命值作为总伤害：

official.name: dark_seer_vacuum
official.desc_loc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
official.lore_loc: Ish'Kafel modifies the center of gravity to a place of his choosing.
notes_loc: This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.

officialZh.name: dark_seer_vacuum
officialZh.desc_loc: 黑暗贤者在目标区域制造一个真空环境，将周围的敌方单位吸入，具有打断效果并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 依什卡菲尔能把重心改为他选定的地点。
notes_loc: 此技能可以打断持续施法。
牵引过程为%duration%秒，伤害在牵引后产生。
真空中央附近的树木将会被摧毁。

official.name: dark_seer_ion_shell
official.desc_loc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
official.lore_loc: The Dark Seer slices holes into the 'Land Behind the Wall,' causing prismatic energy to seep forth.
notes_loc: Deals small amounts of damage in %tick_interval% second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.

officialZh.name: dark_seer_ion_shell
officialZh.desc_loc: 将目标用一个尖刺之盾包裹起来，对周围的敌人造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 黑暗贤者打通“幻墙之末”，让其中的光棱力量渗透出来。
notes_loc: 每%tick_interval%秒造成一次若干伤害。
离子外壳对其作用单位没有伤害。
如果对已经套上离子外壳的单位再次施放，新的离子外壳会取代旧的。

official.name: dark_seer_surge
official.desc_loc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
official.lore_loc: Ish'Kafel once used his speed of mind to navigate the maze between the walls.
notes_loc: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
official.shard_loc: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.

officialZh.name: dark_seer_surge
officialZh.desc_loc: 为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 依什卡菲尔曾经用他迅捷的神智走出幻墙之间的迷宫。
notes_loc: 奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。
officialZh.shard_loc: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为%trail_radius%，持续%trail_duration%秒，对附近的敌人造成%trail_move_slow%%%减速，并且每秒造成%trail_damage%点伤害，伤害间隔为%trail_damage_interval%秒。可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。

official.name: dark_seer_normal_punch
official.desc_loc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past %recent_duration% seconds. Max power is reached after %max_distance% distance moved.
official.lore_loc: As a young soldier, long before he became a leader of his people, Ish'Kafel was known amongst his fellow recruits as quite the pugilist.

officialZh.name: dark_seer_normal_punch
officialZh.desc_loc: 被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去%recent_duration%秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。移动%max_distance%距离以上将造成最大威力。
officialZh.lore_loc: 早在依什卡菲尔成为族人的领袖之前，他身为年轻的士兵在战友中就被称为拳击手。

official.name: dark_seer_aggrandize
official.desc_loc:
Dark Seer gains %int_to_atkspd% Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

officialZh.name: dark_seer_aggrandize
officialZh.desc_loc:
黑暗贤者从每点智力获得%int_to_atkspd%攻击速度。

黑暗贤者升级时会恢复最大生命值和魔法值的一定百分比。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
official.desc_loc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
official.lore_loc: The Dark Seer, while unable to return to his natural realm, can channel part of the prismatic wall with powerful strength of mind, sowing confusion amongst enemy ranks.
notes_loc: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.

officialZh.name: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
officialZh.desc_loc: 制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管黑暗贤者无法重返原来的国度，但他仍然能运用强大的心智力量召唤出幻墙的一部分，在敌阵中散播混乱。
notes_loc: 幻象不会产生幻象。
每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。

official.name: clinkz_strafe
official.desc_loc:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a %strafe_skeleton_radius% radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and %archer_attack_speed_pct%%% of the attack speed bonus.

Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.
official.lore_loc: The closest Clinkz can come to peace is knowing that this was the last thing Maraxiform ever saw.
facets_loc: Clinkz and each Skeleton Archer apply a stacking debuff, one stack per attacking Skeleton Archer, causing them to miss %bonus_blind_pct%%% of their attacks per stack for %debuff_duration%s. Applies to buildings as well.

officialZh.name: clinkz_strafe
officialZh.desc_loc:
克林克兹获得攻击速度和攻击距离加成。克林克兹%strafe_skeleton_radius%范围内现有的骷髅弓手也会获得攻击距离加成和%archer_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度加成。

施放扫射不会脱离骨隐步的隐身状态。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克林克兹感到最接近平静的时刻，就是知道这一幕是莫拉格斯临终之所见。
facets_loc: 克林克兹和每个骷髅弓手都会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，每个攻击的骷髅弓手会施加一层叠加效果，每层会使目标的%bonus_blind_pct%%%攻击落空，持续%debuff_duration%秒。也会对建筑施加。

official.name: clinkz_searing_arrows
official.desc_loc:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for %skeleton_damage_pct%%% damage.
official.lore_loc: Clinkz simply lights his arrows from his flaming essence for quite the destructive effect.
notes_loc: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.

officialZh.name: clinkz_searing_arrows
officialZh.desc_loc:
让克林克兹的箭矢带有火焰，造成更多伤害。

骷髅弓手在攻击克林克兹的攻击目标时会发射灼热之箭，造成%skeleton_damage_pct%%%伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克林克兹用他的灼热精华点燃弓箭，造成毁灭性打击。
notes_loc: 灼热之箭能对建筑造成伤害。
伤害直接作为物理伤害加到克林克兹的攻击伤害中。

official.name: clinkz_death_pact
official.desc_loc: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
official.lore_loc: Sutherex' bond of life and death has become a part of Clinkz, and his old bones are refreshed with repetition of the pact on lesser beings.
notes_loc: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
facets_loc: Death Pact teleports Clinkz towards his victim. Reduces Death Pact cooldown. If Alt-Cast behavior is activated, or Clinkz is Rooted or Leashed, he will not teleport to the target location.

officialZh.name: clinkz_death_pact
officialZh.desc_loc: 克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
officialZh.lore_loc: 萨瑟雷克斯的死亡契约已经成了克林克兹的一部分，他通过杀死那些低等生物来使自己的枯骨获得新生。
notes_loc: 如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。
facets_loc: 死亡契约会把克林克兹传送至目标。降低死亡契约的充能时间。如果设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），或者克林克兹被缠绕或束缚，那他就不会传送至目标地点。

official.name: clinkz_burning_barrage
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
official.lore_loc: It's hard to say whether the blur around the Bone Fletcher is from his flaming heart or his speed with the quiver.
notes_loc: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.

officialZh.name: clinkz_burning_barrage
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。
officialZh.lore_loc: 其他人很难分辨骷髅弓箭手身边缭绕的劲风到底是来自他心中的火焰还是他出箭的速度。
notes_loc: 攻击距离加成会提升炽烈火雨的长度。

official.name: clinkz_burning_army
official.desc_loc: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.
official.lore_loc: Existing on the brink of life and death, Clinkz has learned to temporarily bridge the gap between the two.

officialZh.name: clinkz_burning_army
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标地点召唤一列烈焰骷髅弓手。
officialZh.lore_loc: 克林克兹存在于生与死的边缘，他能自如地在这两者之间架起短暂的桥梁。

official.name: clinkz_wind_walk
official.desc_loc:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal %skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
