official.lore_loc: With a burst of fire and puff of smoke, the Bone Fletcher was nowhere to be seen.
notes_loc: Has a fadetime of %fade_time% seconds.

officialZh.name: clinkz_wind_walk
officialZh.desc_loc:
克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。

骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低%skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。
officialZh.lore_loc: 随着火焰的爆裂和烟雾的升起，骷髅弓箭手的身形遁于无形。
notes_loc: 渐隐时间为%fade_time%秒。

special_values.name: skeleton_health_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 骷髅弓手摧毁所需攻击次数：

official.name: clinkz_infernal_shred
official.desc_loc:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to %max_armor_piercing_pct%%% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies %hero_stacks%%% per attack, and skeletons apply %skeleton_stacks%%%.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

officialZh.name: clinkz_infernal_shred
officialZh.desc_loc:
克林克兹和他的骷髅弓手会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使他们的攻击可以穿透最高目标%max_armor_piercing_pct%%%总物理护甲（不会降低他们的护甲）。克林克兹每次攻击施加%hero_stacks%%%，骷髅弓手施加%skeleton_stacks%%%。

持续%duration%秒。

official.name: omniknight_purification
official.desc_loc: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Priests of the Omniscience are adept at removing impurities from fellow warriors.
official.shard_loc: After a %recast_delay%s delay, the target is Purified again with %recast_effectiveness_pct%%% effectiveness.

officialZh.name: omniknight_purification
officialZh.desc_loc: 立即<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>一个友方单位，并对周围的敌军造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 全知的牧师们善于清除己方战士们身心中的污杂。
officialZh.shard_loc: %recast_delay%秒延迟后目标会再次受到%recast_effectiveness_pct%%%威力的洗礼。

official.name: omniknight_martyr
official.desc_loc: Grants Debuff Immunity with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.
official.lore_loc: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.

officialZh.name: omniknight_martyr
officialZh.desc_loc: 提供减益免疫状态和%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性，以及额外生命恢复。
officialZh.lore_loc: 全知之主对那些被普利斯特称为“朋友”的人降下保护结界。

official.name: omniknight_hammer_of_purity
official.desc_loc:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

Omniknight heals for %heal_pct%%% of the damage dealt over %heal_duration%s.
official.lore_loc: The knight is merely a means to move the hammer.

officialZh.name: omniknight_hammer_of_purity
officialZh.desc_loc:
全能骑士将神圣之力注入他的战锤，使他的攻击距离提升，会根据基础攻击力的一定百分比造成纯粹伤害，并且使目标短时间内被减速。

全能骑士会在%heal_duration%秒内回复%heal_pct%%%造成的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 骑士仅仅是让锤子动起来的一种手段。

official.name: omniknight_degen_aura
official.desc_loc: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
official.lore_loc: The holy embodiment of Purist Thunderwrath is enough to weaken those of lesser faith.
notes_loc: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.
facets_loc: Omniknight's damage to a target is increased by %bonus_damage_per_stack%%% for every %stack_interval%s they spend affected by the aura.

officialZh.name: omniknight_degen_aura
officialZh.desc_loc: 削弱过于靠近的敌方单位的移动能力，降低其移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 作为神圣的化身，普利斯特·雷霆之怒足以削弱那些不忠之徒。
notes_loc: 对减益免疫单位无效。
facets_loc: 目标受到光环作用的时间每达到%stack_interval%秒，全能骑士对该目标的伤害都会增加%bonus_damage_per_stack%%%。

official.name: omniknight_guardian_angel
official.desc_loc: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
official.lore_loc: The All Seeing One casts down his protection over those that Purist calls friend.
official.scepter_loc: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.

officialZh.name: omniknight_guardian_angel
officialZh.desc_loc: 全能骑士召唤出守护天使，使全能骑士附近的所有友方单位对物理伤害免疫。
officialZh.lore_loc: 全知之主对那些被普利斯特称为“朋友”的人降下保护结界。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 守护天使的作用范围为全地图，影响建筑并增强生命回复。

official.name: enchantress_impetus
official.desc_loc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
official.lore_loc: While Aiushtha favors peaceful means, she is capable of a magical onslaught from a distance, her spears gaining energy from the natural life around her.
notes_loc: The damage is capped at %distance_cap% distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.

officialZh.name: enchantress_impetus
officialZh.desc_loc: 激活后每次攻击都有附魔效果，根据与目标的距离造成额外伤害。目标越远，伤害越高。对幻象造成双倍伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然爱由莎更喜欢和平的处事方式，但她还是会用远距离的魔法突击来解决一些问题，她扔出的长矛会从掠过的空气中获得能量。
notes_loc: 造成伤害上限的距离是%distance_cap%。
计算与目标之间的距离在攻击弹道击中目标时。

official.name: enchantress_enchant
official.desc_loc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: A true steward of the forest, Aiushtha befriends all within it - from lowly trolls to powerful centaurs.
notes_loc: Illusions can be converted.
official.scepter_loc: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
facets_loc: Cast Range of Enchant is increased. If the enemy is a hero, Enchantress and units she controls have increased attack range against the target.

officialZh.name: enchantress_enchant
officialZh.desc_loc:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 作为森林真正的管家，无论是卑贱的巨魔还是强大的半人马，爱由莎都会和他们成为朋友。
notes_loc: 可以转化幻象。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。
facets_loc: 魅惑的施法距离增加。如果目标是英雄，魅惑魔女和她控制的单位对目标的攻击距离增加。

special_values.name: enchant_health
special_values.heading_loc:
对非英雄单位：
最大生命值加成：

official.name: enchantress_natures_attendants
official.desc_loc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
official.lore_loc: Whimsical spirits of the woods possess a healing power that is quite subtle, but gains strength in numbers.
notes_loc: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.
facets_loc: Whenever Enchantress takes more than %overprotective_damage_threshold% damage from enemy heroes, %overprotective_wisp_count% wisp appears for %overprotective_wisp_duration%s to heal her. A maximum of %overprotective_max_wisps% overprotective wisps can exist at the same time.

officialZh.name: enchantress_natures_attendants
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一群小精灵治疗魅惑魔女以及身边的友方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 古怪的森林小精灵拥有的疗伤之力虽然微弱，但可以用数量弥补。
notes_loc: 不会选择满血单位进行治疗。
facets_loc: 只要魅惑魔女受到敌方英雄的伤害超过%overprotective_damage_threshold%点，%overprotective_wisp_count%个小精灵就会出现，%overprotective_wisp_duration%秒内进行治疗。同一时间最多只能存在%overprotective_max_wisps%个过度保护的小精灵。

official.name: enchantress_bunny_hop
official.desc_loc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the %attack_targets% furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + %bonus_attack_range%.
official.lore_loc: Sproink is as Sproink does.

officialZh.name: enchantress_bunny_hop
officialZh.desc_loc: 向后跳跃，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，并向魅惑魔女的攻击距离+%bonus_attack_range%范围内最远的%attack_targets%个敌方单位发动一次附有推进的攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 跃动就是活跃灵动。

official.name: enchantress_little_friends
official.desc_loc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for %duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: The laws of the forest may be oblique, but punishment for breaking them is swift and smiling.

officialZh.name: enchantress_little_friends
officialZh.desc_loc: 魅惑魔女<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续%duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 森林的法则可能有点模糊，但违反法则的惩罚会来得非常迅速，而且迷人。

special_values.name: root_per_target
special_values.heading_loc: 每个单位增加<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>时间：

official.name: enchantress_untouchable
official.desc_loc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
official.lore_loc: After attacking Aiushtha, most opponents are overwhelmed with guilt having attacked such a natural beauty.
notes_loc: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.

officialZh.name: enchantress_untouchable
officialZh.desc_loc: 魅惑魔女让她的敌人神魂颠倒，受到他们攻击时会降低其攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在攻击爱由莎之后，大多数敌人都会由于攻击了这样一个天然的美人而不知所措。
notes_loc: 所有直接攻击魅惑魔女的敌方单位都会被减速。
减速效果在攻击单位产生攻击动作时出现，而不是伤害生效时。

official.name: enchantress_rabblerouser
official.desc_loc: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
notes_loc: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.

officialZh.name: enchantress_rabblerouser
officialZh.desc_loc: 魅惑魔女使所有中立生物和魅惑魔女控制下的单位对敌方英雄造成额外伤害。
notes_loc: 不会影响劝化的中立生物、痛苦魔方和肉山。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: huskar_inner_fire
official.desc_loc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
official.lore_loc: Not even Huskar's own flesh can contain the unending expansion of his life force.

officialZh.name: huskar_inner_fire
officialZh.desc_loc: 在炽烈的狂暴下将附近所有敌人击退至固定距离外，造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就连哈斯卡自己的肉体都容纳不了他不断膨胀的生命力。

official.name: huskar_burning_spear
official.desc_loc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
official.lore_loc: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
notes_loc: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.
official.scepter_loc: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.
facets_loc: Burning Spears also burns enemies for a percentage of their max health. Costs Max Health instead of Current Health.

officialZh.name: huskar_burning_spear
officialZh.desc_loc: 哈斯卡将其长矛点燃，在普通攻击的同时对敌方单位造成持续伤害。多次攻击会造成持续伤害叠加。每次攻击都将牺牲哈斯卡部分生命值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 神灵武士的武器经过自身鲜血的沾染，燃起了烈火——敌人将领受远超己痛的苦楚。
notes_loc: 沸血之矛在多次施放到目标身上效果可以叠加。没有叠加上限。
哈斯卡不能使用此技能自杀。
炙矛可热不会对肉山造成额外的最大生命值烧灼伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 沸血之矛会对哈斯卡攻击距离内随机敌人额外发射%multishot_targets%支长矛。
facets_loc: 沸血之矛还会燃烧敌人一定百分比的最大生命值。会消耗最大生命值，而不是当前生命值。

official.name: huskar_berserkers_blood
official.desc_loc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
official.lore_loc: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.
notes_loc: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
official.shard_loc:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
facets_loc:
Berserker's Blood can be activated for a health cost. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

officialZh.name: huskar_berserkers_blood
officialZh.desc_loc: 哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从虚无之境逃出后，哈斯卡的力量会随着血液的损失而增强，使他能够造成致命的物理性破坏。
notes_loc: 加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，%hp_threshold_max%%%生命时达到最大加成。
officialZh.shard_loc:
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facets_loc:
狂战士之血可以消耗一定生命来主动开启。驱散哈斯卡，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散

special_values.name: activation_heal_pct_per_debuff
special_values.heading_loc: 每个负面效果提供最大生命值<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>：

official.name: huskar_blood_magic
official.desc_loc:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

officialZh.name: huskar_blood_magic
officialZh.desc_loc:
哈斯卡没有魔法值。物品的魔法消耗会转换为生命消耗。

哈斯卡的生命消耗为魔法伤害，可以被魔法抗性减少。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: huskar_life_break
official.desc_loc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: No matter the danger, Huskar thrusts himself into melees that only he can survive.
notes_loc: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
official.scepter_loc: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
facets_loc: Life Break also slows enemies in a radius around the target.
Life Break also heals friendly units in a radius around the target.

officialZh.name: huskar_life_break
officialZh.desc_loc:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 哈斯卡不顾危险，冲入只有他能幸存的激烈近身战。
notes_loc: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。
facets_loc: 牺牲还会使目标附近的敌人减速。
牺牲还会治疗目标附近的友方单位。

official.name: night_stalker_void
official.desc_loc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
official.lore_loc: Balanar creates a vortex of infinite night, tearing opponents violently into the eternal darkness that once was.
notes_loc: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.
official.shard_loc: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
facets_loc: Enemies affected by Void do not share vision with their allies. Affected enemies take damage per second when they are not visible to their allies.
Increases the max level of Void. Level %max_level% Void at night becomes ground targeted, increases movement and attack slow, and applies to a %cast_radius_tooltip% AoE.

special_values.name: invisible_damage_pers
special_values.heading_loc: DAMAGE PER SECOND WHEN NOT VISIBLE:

officialZh.name: night_stalker_void
officialZh.desc_loc: 制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巴拉那制造一个无限之夜的漩涡，将敌人猛烈地撕扯进永恒的黑暗。
notes_loc: 虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。
officialZh.shard_loc: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。
facets_loc: 虚空作用下的敌人不会与友军共享视野。当不在友军视野中，他们会受到每秒伤害。
提升虚空的最高等级。%max_level%级虚空在夜间变为以范围为目标的技能，移动速度和攻击速度降低效果提升，并且施加%cast_radius_tooltip%范围效果。

official.name: night_stalker_crippling_fear
official.desc_loc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.
official.lore_loc: A vision of the twisted maw of Balanar etches itself into the minds of the poor souls unlucky enough to cross his path.

officialZh.name: night_stalker_crippling_fear
officialZh.desc_loc: 暗夜魔王恐吓附近所有敌人，使他们在他身边时被<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>，并受到伤害。效果在夜晚持续更久。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对于那些不幸挡住他前路的可怜虫，巴拉那扭曲的喉咙在他们的脑海里挥之不去。

official.name: night_stalker_midnight_feast
official.desc_loc: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
notes_loc: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.

officialZh.name: night_stalker_midnight_feast
officialZh.desc_loc: 暗夜魔王攻击敌方单位时<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>自身。在夜晚可以主动施放，秒杀一个非远古非英雄单位，并回复暗夜魔王的最大生命值和最大魔法值的一定百分比。
notes_loc: 攻击获得的生命值受到生命回复的影响，攻击非英雄目标时会减少。

official.name: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night
official.desc_loc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
official.lore_loc: The hunting prowess of Balanar improves as the night beckons.
official.shard_loc: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.
official.scepter_loc: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
facets_loc: Increases the max level of Hunter in the Night to %max_level_tooltip%. Night Stalker starts with a bonus level of Hunter in the Night.

officialZh.name: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night
officialZh.desc_loc: 暗夜魔王在夜晚如鱼得水，攻击和移动都变得迅速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巴拉那的狩猎技术随着夜晚降临大幅精进。
officialZh.shard_loc: 可以主动对一个普通单位施放暗夜猎影，将其秒杀并恢复暗夜魔王最大生命和魔法的一定百分比。在白天无法对远古生物施放。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 移动速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%%，攻击速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。
facets_loc: 暗夜猎影的最高等级提升至%max_level_tooltip%级。暗夜魔王初始就额外拥有一级暗夜猎影。

official.name: night_stalker_darkness
official.desc_loc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
official.lore_loc: It is a humbling sight to see when the mightiest of warriors become afraid of the dark.

officialZh.name: night_stalker_darkness
officialZh.desc_loc: 暗夜魔王遮住太阳，让夜晚立刻降临，使他的力量可以得到最大程度的发挥。在此期间暗夜魔王获得飞行能力和攻击力加成。拥有顺畅视野。
officialZh.lore_loc: 最强大的战士都变得害怕黑暗，真是个令人感到羞耻的场景。

official.name: broodmother_insatiable_hunger
official.desc_loc: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.
official.lore_loc: While most of her prey is wrapped in silken cocoons and saved for her young, the Broodmother herself has a taste for wandering heroes.
official.shard_loc: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by %shard_damage_per_tick%%% every %shard_damage_tick_interval%s.
facets_loc: Insatiable Hunger also applies to nearby Spiderlings.

officialZh.name: broodmother_insatiable_hunger
officialZh.desc_loc: 对活物体液的强烈饥渴提高了育母蜘蛛的攻击力，并使她和她的小蜘蛛的攻击附带吸血效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然大多数猎物都被她用丝茧包裹，作为饲料留给后代，但育母蜘蛛对那些迷路的英雄情有独钟。
officialZh.shard_loc: 开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每%shard_damage_tick_interval%秒提升%shard_damage_per_tick%%%。
facets_loc: 极度饥渴还会施加给附近的小蜘蛛。

official.name: broodmother_spin_web
official.desc_loc:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
official.lore_loc: Weaving a bed of silken fibers, Arachnia's web both protects her and her offspring, as well as giving advancing opponents a sense of foreboding.
notes_loc: Also affects Spiderlings.
facets_loc: Reduces health restoration of enemies on webs that are in the same web network as Broodmother.

officialZh.name: broodmother_spin_web
officialZh.desc_loc:
编织出一张蜘蛛网，育母蜘蛛在蛛网里被动提升移动速度和转身速率，并且获得无视地形移动的能力。

织网现在可向其他蛛网触及的区域全地图施放。蛛网永久存在，不过可以手动摧毁。当其数量超过上限，最早的蛛网将会消失。
officialZh.lore_loc: 编制出一张蛛丝之床，艾拉齐娜的网保护她和她的后代，同时给予前进的敌人警告。
notes_loc: 也会作用于小蜘蛛。
facets_loc: 减少育母蜘蛛所在蛛网上敌人的生命回复。

official.name: broodmother_incapacitating_bite
official.desc_loc: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
official.lore_loc: Paralytic toxins come from Black Arachnia's fangs, causing a slow and painful death to those who intrude on her webs.
notes_loc: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.

officialZh.name: broodmother_incapacitating_bite
officialZh.desc_loc: 育母蜘蛛用毒液削弱敌方单位，使她的攻击带有减速效果，中毒单位的攻击有一定概率落空，并且被攻击时承受额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 布蕾克·艾拉齐娜的尖牙中布满麻痹毒素，对侵入蛛网的敌人造成缓慢而痛苦的死亡。
notes_loc: 攻击落空几率与闪避和上下坡丢失叠加。

official.name: broodmother_sticky_snare
official.desc_loc: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.
official.lore_loc: The slightest tremor of her web is all Arachnia needs to find her prey.

officialZh.name: broodmother_sticky_snare
officialZh.desc_loc: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多%count%个触碰已有蛛网的<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。
officialZh.lore_loc: 蛛网上细微的颤动就是艾拉齐娜找到猎物所需要的一切。

official.name: broodmother_spiders_milk
official.desc_loc: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a %kill_heal_aoe% radius receive a buff for %kill_heal_duration%s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every %tick_rate% seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by %kill_creeps_penalty%%%.

officialZh.name: broodmother_spiders_milk
officialZh.desc_loc: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和%kill_heal_aoe%范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续%kill_heal_duration%秒的状态效果，每%tick_rate%秒<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少%kill_creeps_penalty%%%。

official.name: broodmother_spawn_spiderlings
official.desc_loc: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
official.lore_loc: Black Arachnia continues to raise her young, even amidst the field of combat.  The brood quickly learns how to support their mother.
notes_loc: If the target is killed within %buff_duration% seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.

officialZh.name: broodmother_spawn_spiderlings
officialZh.desc_loc: 育母蜘蛛将她的卵注入敌人体内，造成伤害和减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。如果目标在感染期间被击杀，卵会孵化成小蜘蛛。
officialZh.lore_loc: 布蕾克·艾拉齐娜不断抚育她的后代，即使是在战场上。新孵化的小蜘蛛很快就学会如何支援她们的母亲。
notes_loc: 如果目标在受到此技能后%buff_duration%秒内被杀死，小蜘蛛就会孵化。
被小蜘蛛杀死的单位会生出额外的小蜘蛛。

official.name: bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss
official.desc_loc: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
official.lore_loc: While the shuriken may be small, Gondar's precise aim can cause critical damage.
official.scepter_loc: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

officialZh.name: bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss
officialZh.desc_loc: 向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围%bounce_aoe%范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管飞镖很小，但刚铎精确的瞄准可以带来致命伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。

official.name: bounty_hunter_jinada
official.desc_loc: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
official.lore_loc: Gondar's vast experience ensures he never walks away from a transaction empty-handed.

officialZh.name: bounty_hunter_jinada
officialZh.desc_loc: 赏金猎人准备好他的下次攻击，造成额外伤害并窃取若干不可靠金钱。
officialZh.lore_loc: 刚铎庞杂的经验能确保他在交易后不会空手而归。

official.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
official.desc_loc: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
official.lore_loc: The court jesters present during King Goff's assassination can recount no other image than a dancing shadow.
notes_loc: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.

officialZh.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
officialZh.desc_loc: 赏金猎人进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>目标。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当回忆起暴君伽夫被刺杀时的那个宫廷小丑，人们脑海中只能想起那舞动的暗影。
notes_loc: 开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。

official.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally
official.desc_loc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
official.lore_loc: Useful for the rare instances when a contested bounty is actually wanted alive.

officialZh.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally
officialZh.desc_loc: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是%fade_time%秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在极少数情况下，当悬赏对象需要活捉的时候，这就派上了用场。

official.name: bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter
official.desc_loc: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

officialZh.name: bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter
officialZh.desc_loc: 如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升%kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%%。敌方英雄的财产总和在他们团队中排名为前三就被视为重大目标。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: bounty_hunter_track
official.desc_loc: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
official.lore_loc: Using his elevated senses of sight and smell, Gondar's hits have quite a good chance of success.
notes_loc: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.

officialZh.name: bounty_hunter_track
officialZh.desc_loc: 追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。如果目标在被追踪期间死亡，赏金猎人和附近友方英雄都将获得若干金钱奖励。施放追踪术不会脱离<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 利用他高度敏锐的视觉和嗅觉，刚铎的袭击成功率很高。
notes_loc: 只要目标在追踪术期间以任何方式死亡，赏金猎人都能获得金钱奖励。
追踪术效果仅对友方单位可见。
鼠标移至目标技能栏上方的负面效果图标可以看到目标携带的金钱数额。
金钱奖励为不可靠金钱。

official.name: weaver_the_swarm
official.desc_loc: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
official.lore_loc: Skitskurr opens a gap in the space time fabric, allowing young Weavers to slip through and aid him in combat.
notes_loc: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in %destroy_attacks% attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
Beetles provide vision.
facets_loc: Weaver gains experience when The Swarm beetles attack heroes.

officialZh.name: weaver_the_swarm
officialZh.desc_loc: 编织者放出%count%只编织者幼虫，每只幼虫都会紧紧缠住它遇到的敌人，攻击敌人并削弱他们的护甲，直到幼虫被杀死。
officialZh.lore_loc: 斯吉茨格尔打开时空之纱的缺口，让编织者幼虫穿越而出，帮助他战斗。
notes_loc: 甲虫抓住目标后将一直留在目标身上，除非甲虫被击杀或持续时间结束。
甲虫免疫技能，需要一个单位的%destroy_attacks%次攻击才能被击杀。英雄造成双倍伤害。
幼虫提供视野。
facets_loc: 虫群的甲虫攻击英雄时编织者会获得经验。

official.name: weaver_shukuchi
official.desc_loc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
official.lore_loc: As the Weavers worked in the fabric of creation, small wormholes allowed them to slip through time to better work their craft.
notes_loc: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.
official.shard_loc: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
facets_loc: Shukuchi movespeed increased and slows enemies when passing through them.

officialZh.name: weaver_shukuchi
officialZh.desc_loc: 编织者进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>身，达到移动速度上限，在穿过敌方单位时还将造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 编织者曾为创世之纱工作，小小的虫洞让他们可以穿越时间来更好的发挥他们的手艺。
notes_loc: 每次施放的技能只能对相同单位造成一次伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 缩地在造成伤害的敌人身上留下一个标记，持续%geminate_attack_mark_duration%秒。编织者脱离缩地状态%shukuchi_attack_delay%秒后，附近%shukuchi_attack_mark_radius%范围内拥有印记的敌人都会被连击的第二次攻击击中。
facets_loc: 缩地的移动速度增加，穿越敌人时会造成减速。

official.name: weaver_geminate_attack
official.desc_loc: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
official.lore_loc: Skitskurr's relationship with time is somewhat variable, causing his actions to be witnessed - and felt - more than once.
notes_loc: Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.
official.shard_loc: Geminate Attack will also hit units within %shard_beetle_search_range% range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.

officialZh.name: weaver_geminate_attack
officialZh.desc_loc: 允许编织者立刻发动两次攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 斯吉茨格尔与时间有着多变的联系，使他的动作被看到和感受到，不止一次。
notes_loc: 第二次攻击将在编织者第一次攻击的%delay%秒后发出，并且没有距离限制。
额外伤害仅对连击的攻击有效，初始攻击没有额外伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 连击还会击中虫群附着目标%shard_beetle_search_range%范围内的单位。

official.name: weaver_time_lapse
official.desc_loc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.
notes_loc: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.
official.scepter_loc: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.

officialZh.name: weaver_time_lapse
officialZh.desc_loc:
编织者回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 如果斯吉茨格尔认为世界当前的现实与他所渴望的不合，他就爬回过去的时间点来纠正错误。
notes_loc: 能够移除编织者身上大部分的负面状态。
时光倒流可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 时光倒流可以对%abilitycastrange%施法距离内的友方英雄施放。

official.name: weaver_threads_of_fate
official.desc_loc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

officialZh.name: weaver_threads_of_fate
officialZh.desc_loc: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们%thread_setup_distance%范围内停留达到%thread_setup_time%秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: jakiro_dual_breath
official.desc_loc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
official.lore_loc: Pyrexae dragons have tremendously dangerous breath for each branch of the species; combining them is unimaginable.
notes_loc: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

officialZh.name: jakiro_dual_breath
officialZh.desc_loc: 杰奇洛对面前的敌人先后喷出寒冰和火焰。寒冰吐息减速敌人，火焰吐息对敌人造成持续伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 灼霜龙族的各个物种分支都拥有极端危险的气息；这些气息相结合后场面难以想象。
notes_loc: 最远能伤害1025距离外的单位。
两次吐息有%fire_delay%秒的间隔。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

official.name: jakiro_ice_path
official.desc_loc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
official.lore_loc: Jakiro's cunning right head calls upon its frozen heritage, glazing the earth with blistering cold.
notes_loc: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
facets_loc: Jakiro can choose to destroy the Ice Path at any time, stunning and damaging enemies again.
Ice Path lasts longer and detonates upon expiration, dealing damage and stunning enemies a second time. Ice Path can be manually detonated early.

officialZh.name: jakiro_ice_path
officialZh.desc_loc: 在杰奇洛前方制造一条冰封路径，对触及到的敌人造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 杰奇洛狡猾的右首使出它的冰封天赋，用骇人的酷寒冻结大地。
notes_loc: 路径完全成形需要%path_delay%秒。
冰封路径消失后眩晕效果也会消失。
facets_loc: 杰奇洛可以选择随时摧毁冰封路径，再次对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
冰封路径的持续时间变长，并且结束时会引爆，再次对敌人造成伤害和眩晕。冰封路径可以手动提前引爆。

official.name: jakiro_liquid_fire
official.desc_loc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
official.lore_loc: The left maw of Jakiro opens, laying waste to any in its path.
notes_loc: Works on both units and buildings.
official.shard_loc: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

officialZh.name: jakiro_liquid_fire
officialZh.desc_loc: 杰奇洛的火焰燃烧效果范围内的敌人，并降低他们的攻击速度。和液态冰共用冷却时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 杰奇洛的左喉大开，使前方生灵涂炭。
notes_loc: 对单位和建筑都有效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 杰奇洛的液态火没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态冰共用冷却时间。

official.name: jakiro_liquid_ice
official.desc_loc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
official.lore_loc: The right maw of Jakiro opens, punishing all with bitter frost.
official.shard_loc: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

officialZh.name: jakiro_liquid_ice
officialZh.desc_loc: 杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续%duration%秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 杰奇洛的右喉大开，用严霜惩治一切。
officialZh.shard_loc: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

official.name: jakiro_double_trouble
official.desc_loc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
notes_loc: The second attack ignores Damage Block.
facets_loc: Jakiro deals more damage with his double attacks.

officialZh.name: jakiro_double_trouble
officialZh.desc_loc: 杰奇洛攻击时两个头都会发动攻击，不过每个头造成的伤害减少。
notes_loc: 第二次攻击无视伤害格挡。
facets_loc: 杰奇洛的双重攻击造成更高伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: jakiro_macropyre
official.desc_loc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
official.lore_loc: Ice and fire combine to rip the battlefield to shreds with extreme temperatures.
notes_loc: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.

officialZh.name: jakiro_macropyre
officialZh.desc_loc: 杰奇洛释放出烈焰风暴，烈焰风暴作用范围很宽，并持续数秒。烈焰风暴每秒都会对作用范围内的敌人造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冰与火融合而来的极端温度将使战场百孔千疮。
notes_loc: 被烈焰焚身击中后离开区域还将额外受到%linger_duration%秒伤害效果。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升烈焰焚身的持续时间，并且变为纯粹伤害。杰奇洛会在烈焰焚身边缘放出两道冰墙，对试图穿过的所有敌人减速%ice_edge_movement_slow%%%。

official.name: batrider_sticky_napalm
official.desc_loc: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to %max_stacks% stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
official.lore_loc: It's not uncommon to hear the Rider cackle while he increases the flammability of his opponents.
notes_loc: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to creeps.
official.shard_loc:
Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.

Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.
facets_loc: Increases the max level of Sticky Napalm. Level %max_level_tooltip% Sticky Napalm causes every attack to apply %napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip% stack of Sticky Napalm.

officialZh.name: batrider_sticky_napalm
officialZh.desc_loc: 用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 蝙蝠骑士给他的对手泼燃油时，经常能听见他在喋喋不休。
notes_loc: 所有来自蝙蝠骑士的伤害均会加深，辉耀，淬毒之珠，影之灵龛和魂之灵瓮除外。
粘性燃油无需转身即可施放。
粘性燃油对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc:
粘性燃油不再具有叠加上限。

粘性燃油会对建筑造成伤害。
facets_loc: 提升粘性燃油的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级粘性燃油会使每次攻击施加%napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip%层粘性燃油。

official.name: batrider_flamebreak
official.desc_loc: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.
official.lore_loc: A molotov cocktail is the weapon of choice for Batrider.

officialZh.name: batrider_flamebreak
officialZh.desc_loc: 投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 蝙蝠骑士选择用燃烧弹作为武器。

official.name: batrider_firefly
official.desc_loc: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
official.lore_loc: When an enemy escapes into the Yama Raskav Jungle, most would cut through the brush to find the fugitive.  Batrider just chooses to destroy the jungle along with his foes.
notes_loc: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.
facets_loc: Firefly also lights Batrider on fire. He gains increasingly more Move Speed and burns away a portion of his max health each second. Maximum bonuses are reached at the end of Firefly's duration. Self-burn damage is constant and does not increase over time.

officialZh.name: batrider_firefly
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝙蝠骑士飞向天空，从空中留下一道燃烧的尾迹。飞行时，燃烧尾迹会破坏树木，对经过的敌人造成伤害。在火焰飞行持续时间的最后会达到最高移动速度加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当敌人逃进荒狱丛林时，大部分人都不得不先砍开挡道的树丛。而蝙蝠骑士却选择直接将他的敌人，连同丛林一起破坏殆尽。
notes_loc: 火焰飞行期间蝙蝠骑士可以飞越任何单位，树木和不可通行的地形。
如果蝙蝠骑士在持续时间结束时正好在不可通行的地形上方，那么他将会卡住。
蝙蝠骑士死亡后火焰效果将继续存在。
facets_loc: 火焰飞行还会使蝙蝠骑士着火。他每秒会被烧灼一定百分比的最大生命值，但是移动速度会逐渐大幅提升。对自身的烧灼伤害恒定，不会逐渐增加。

official.name: batrider_smoldering_resin
official.desc_loc: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals %tick_attack_damage_pct%%% of the attack damage every %tick_rate%s for %total_ticks%s.

officialZh.name: batrider_smoldering_resin
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝙蝠骑士的攻击会施加一个负面效果，每%tick_rate%秒造成%tick_attack_damage_pct%%%攻击伤害，持续%total_ticks%秒。

official.name: batrider_flaming_lasso
official.desc_loc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
official.lore_loc: Few dare to ask to ride on the bat, as Batrider gives them free of charge.
notes_loc: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.
official.scepter_loc: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within %grab_radius_scepter% units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.

officialZh.name: batrider_flaming_lasso
officialZh.desc_loc: 用枷锁捆住一个敌人，在蝙蝠骑士的后面拖行。被拖行的单位不能移动、攻击或使用技能。传送或闪烁会打破枷锁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就算蝙蝠骑士说免费，也几乎没人敢去骑他的蝙蝠。
notes_loc: 杀死目标或蝙蝠骑士都能在技能结束前打破枷锁。
如果蝙蝠骑士在0.05秒内移动距离超过425码枷锁将会断裂。
蝙蝠骑士在使用燃烧枷锁时不能攻击。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 燃烧枷锁除了抓取目标外，还能抓取目标附近%grab_radius_scepter%范围内最近的友方英雄。第二目标将与第一目标相连。

official.name: chen_penitence
official.desc_loc: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.
official.lore_loc: Although Chen's brand of animal enthrallment isn't quite strong enough to control the minds of enemy heroes, it still tests their resolve in combat.

officialZh.name: chen_penitence
officialZh.desc_loc: 对敌方单位造成伤害，并使其移动变慢，友军攻击他时攻速提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管陈控制动物的能力还没有强到可以控制敌方英雄，不过还是可以用来考验他们的战斗意志。

official.name: chen_holy_persuasion
official.desc_loc: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to %health_min%. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last %unsummon_time% seconds to unsummon it.
official.lore_loc: Although they may not be knights, Chen incorporates beasts into the Fold in the same way he himself was converted.
notes_loc: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.
official.shard_loc: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.

officialZh.name: chen_holy_persuasion
officialZh.desc_loc: 陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。被劝化目标的最大生命值会被设为%health_min%。被劝化的单位将提升移动速度和伤害输出。陈自己的单位如果在%unsummon_time%秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管他们可能当不了骑士，但陈还是将野兽们纳入教会，就像他自己当年被改变信仰一样。
notes_loc: 如果达到劝化生物的数量上限后再劝化生物，最早劝化的单位将立即死亡。
拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后可以对远古中立生物施放本技能。
升级此技能后在升级前劝化的单位并不会增加生命值。
劝化时单位的魔法恢复至满魔。
officialZh.shard_loc: 神圣劝化可以对远古中立生物施放。根据上帝之手等级可以控制最多1/2/3个远古生物。使中立生物的部分技能额外升1级。

official.name: chen_divine_favor
official.desc_loc:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.
official.lore_loc: Chen's zeal is infectious, blessing his allies with vitality and compelling them to his side.

officialZh.name: chen_divine_favor
officialZh.desc_loc:
被动提供光环，提供生命恢复加成。可以主动对友军施放，提供护甲加成，以及<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>和生命恢复增强。

对陈施放后，陈控制的所有单位都会获得增益效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 陈的狂热极具感染力，他的盟友得到了生命力的祝福，还被迫在他身旁战斗。

official.name: chen_zealot
official.desc_loc:
Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy. The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage. The Zealot respawns next to Chen.

Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a %teleport_delay% second delay. If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.

officialZh.name: chen_zealot
officialZh.desc_loc:
陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈身边复活。

狂热者技能可以主动使用，在%teleport_delay%秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。

official.name: chen_hand_of_god
official.desc_loc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.
official.lore_loc: Using the mental link with his thralls, Chen calls down restoration and well-being to those who share his fanaticism.
notes_loc: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
official.scepter_loc: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.

officialZh.name: chen_hand_of_god
officialZh.desc_loc: <font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>地图上的所有友军英雄以及陈控制的所有单位。一开始先施加高额治疗，在之后%hot_duration%秒内持续进行小额治疗。
officialZh.lore_loc: 陈利用他的奴隶与他之间的精神连接，给拥有其狂热的盟军带来康复和幸福。
notes_loc: 可以治疗无敌和被隐藏/放逐友军。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 上帝之手的冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多%AbilityChannelTime%秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，拥有%debuff_immune_resist%%%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升%nearby_hot_boost%%%。

special_values.name: ancient_creeps_scepter
special_values.heading_loc: 魔晶升级神圣劝化远古生物数量：

official.name: spectre_spectral_dagger
official.desc_loc: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
official.lore_loc: Mercurial's dagger eclipses the physical plane in shadow, a state in which mortals cower, but spectres thrive.
notes_loc: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

officialZh.name: spectre_spectral_dagger
officialZh.desc_loc: 幽鬼掷出一把匕首，留下一条暗影之径，对路径上的敌人造成伤害并减缓其移动速度。被匕首击中的单位移动时也会留下暗影之径。幽鬼在暗影之径上移速提升，并且可以无视地形移动。
officialZh.lore_loc: 墨丘利的匕首将物质位面遮蔽于暗影中，凡人在其中畏缩不前，但幽鬼们相当强势。
notes_loc: 在离开暗影之径后%dagger_grace_period%秒内碰撞体积依然为0，作为缓冲时间。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

official.name: spectre_shadow_step
official.desc_loc:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
official.lore_loc: With great focus of will, Mercurial can sometimes limit the extent of her division.

officialZh.name: spectre_shadow_step
officialZh.desc_loc:
对目标制造一个无法控制的幻象，对其进行攻击。

子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在强大的专注力下，墨丘利有时可以限制自己分裂的限度。

official.name: spectre_dispersion
official.desc_loc: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
official.lore_loc: A daunting task lies before enemies of Mercurial - killing a shadow with blade and magic.
notes_loc: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
Illusions don't get this ability.
Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
official.shard_loc: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by %activation_bonus_pct%%% of its base values for %activation_duration%s. Cooldown %activation_cooldown%. Manacost %activation_manacost%.

officialZh.name: spectre_dispersion
officialZh.desc_loc: 幽灵会分散对她造成的部分伤害，将其反弹给附近的所有敌人。敌人离她越远，受到的伤害越低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一个令人却步的任务出现在墨丘利的敌人面前——用刀剑和魔法消灭一个影子。
notes_loc: 幽鬼本身不承受被折射的伤害。
幻象并不继承此技能。
伤害在减免前折射，并且折射的伤害与原伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
officialZh.shard_loc: 折射可以主动施放，吸收和反弹的伤害比例提升%activation_bonus_pct%%%，持续%activation_duration%秒。冷却时间为%activation_cooldown%秒。魔法消耗为%activation_manacost%点。

official.name: spectre_desolate
official.desc_loc: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
official.lore_loc: Often times, warriors find themselves alone with a vision of Mercurial - the fated question is if it is the true Spectre.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
Spectre's illusions also have Desolate.
facets_loc: Spectre deals %bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%x damage with Desolate. Spectre's illusions no longer have Desolate.

officialZh.name: spectre_desolate
officialZh.desc_loc: 当敌人附近%radius%范围内没有他们的友军时，幽鬼和她的幻象的攻击对他们造成额外纯粹伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 战士们常常发现自己落单后还能在身边看到墨丘利——不得不质疑，这是不是真正的幽鬼。
notes_loc: 伤害在幽鬼攻击前产生。
幽鬼的幻象继承荒芜。
facets_loc: 幽鬼自身的荒芜造成%bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%倍伤害，但是幽鬼的幻象不再触发荒芜。

official.name: spectre_haunt
official.desc_loc:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
official.lore_loc: At the height of combat, Mercurial's physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.
official.scepter_loc:
The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.

Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.

officialZh.name: spectre_haunt
officialZh.desc_loc:
创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。

鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。

子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在战斗最焦灼的时候，墨丘利的实体形态破裂，幽影的碎片在生者身边作祟。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。

冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。

official.name: ancient_apparition_cold_feet
official.desc_loc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after %AbilityDuration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Kaldr's presence draws those around him into a frozen void, threatening to lock them in an icy prison for eternity.
notes_loc: Deals damage every half second.
facets_loc: Cold Feet becomes an AoE point targeted ability, with the radius depending on the current level of Ice Blast.

officialZh.name: ancient_apparition_cold_feet
officialZh.desc_loc: 对一个敌人施加诅咒，造成持续伤害。如果目标没有在%AbilityDuration%秒内远离初始地点走出足够距离，那么将被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并冻在原地。
officialZh.lore_loc: 卡尔德的存在将他周围的敌人吸入冰封的虚空，甚至能将他们永远关进寒冰的监牢。
notes_loc: 每0.5秒造成一次伤害。
facets_loc: 寒霜之足变为范围型技能，作用范围取决于冰晶爆轰的当前等级。

official.name: ancient_apparition_ice_vortex
official.desc_loc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
official.lore_loc: Frozen, caustic winds are at the whim of Kaldr, chilling the field of battle.
notes_loc: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

officialZh.name: ancient_apparition_ice_vortex
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一个寒冰能量的漩涡，对范围内敌人造成伤害和减速，并增加他们受到的魔法伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 卡尔德恣意带来腐蚀性的冰风，将战场变寒冷。
notes_loc: 提供放置地点的小片视野。

official.name: ancient_apparition_chilling_touch
official.desc_loc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
official.lore_loc: The Ancient Apparition's eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.
official.scepter_loc: Removes cooldown.

officialZh.name: ancient_apparition_chilling_touch
officialZh.desc_loc: 使自己的普通攻击附带距离提升，高额魔法伤害和减速效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 远古冰魄的永恒知识为他的出击赋予了冰冷的魔咒。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 移除了冷却时间。

official.name: ancient_apparition_bone_chill
official.desc_loc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Base Strength Reduction by %tooltip_scepter_bonus%.

officialZh.name: ancient_apparition_bone_chill
officialZh.desc_loc: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌人造成魔法伤害，敌人就会减速一段时间。如果目标是英雄，力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 基础力量降低提升%tooltip_scepter_bonus%。

official.name: ancient_apparition_ice_blast
official.desc_loc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
official.lore_loc: Ice storms from ages past flow through Kaldr's frosty limbs, crashing into the world and turning its inhabitants into monuments to his eternal power.
notes_loc: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
official.shard_loc: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.

officialZh.name: ancient_apparition_ice_blast
officialZh.desc_loc: 向地图的任意位置发出爆炸冰球，在冰球飞行时再次施放此技能将使其停下，使所在区域产生毁灭性的冰爆。冰球飞行的距离越长，冰爆影响的范围也将越大。冰爆范围内的所有敌方单位将马上受到大量伤害，而处于冰球飞行路径上的敌方英雄将与冰爆范围内的敌方英雄一同受到寒霜诅咒的作用，持续受到小幅伤害，同时无法恢复生命值。在此期间如果生命值低于一定百分比，该英雄将立刻死亡。
officialZh.lore_loc: 卡尔德的寒霜之体中流出远古的寒冰风暴，将这个世界的居民冻成他永恒力量的纪念碑。
notes_loc: 施放后本技能替换为释放，将使指向球停在目标区域。
作用范围的大小是%radius_min% + %radius_grow%*指向球的飞行时间，上限为%radius_max%。
击杀目标的英雄由触发即死的伤害来源决定。
斩杀效果对幻象无效。
寒霜诅咒的负面状态无法被驱散，包括身处泉水附近，但魂断、时光倒流和超新星除外。
officialZh.shard_loc: 冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间的%cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%%。

official.name: doom_bringer_devour
official.desc_loc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
official.lore_loc: Lucifer's appetite and greed are never sated.
notes_loc: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
official.shard_loc: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.

officialZh.name: doom_bringer_devour
officialZh.desc_loc: 消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
officialZh.lore_loc: 路西法的食欲和贪婪永远不会得到满足。
notes_loc: 末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。
officialZh.shard_loc: 吞噬拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。

official.name: doom_bringer_scorched_earth
official.desc_loc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
official.lore_loc: The Fallen One spreads destruction in his wake, sparing none from the flame which sustains him.
notes_loc: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

officialZh.name: doom_bringer_scorched_earth
officialZh.desc_loc: 用火焰覆盖周围的土地，对敌人造成伤害，同时末日使者的移动速度和生命恢复得到提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 堕落者在他所及之处散布毁灭，支撑他的火焰不会宽恕任何人。
notes_loc: 焦土会跟随末日使者，以他所在位置为中心。

official.name: doom_bringer_infernal_blade
official.desc_loc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
official.lore_loc: Lucifer shares the fire branding bestowed upon him at the time of his exile.
notes_loc: Interrupts channeling abilities.

officialZh.name: doom_bringer_infernal_blade
officialZh.desc_loc: 末日挥舞他的炽烈之剑，将敌人点燃。造成%ministun_duration%秒<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，并施加一个燃烧效果，持续%burn_duration%秒，每秒造成伤害，数值为基础伤害+目标最大生命值的一定百分比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 路西法很乐意与他人分享自己被放逐时身受的火焰烙印。
notes_loc: 可以打断持续施法类技能。

official.name: doom_bringer_doom
official.desc_loc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, doom is sure to follow.
official.scepter_loc: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
facets_loc: Every %upgrade_interval% minutes, Doom's duration is increased by %upgrade_amount%s.

officialZh.name: doom_bringer_doom
officialZh.desc_loc:
对敌人施加末日诅咒，对其进行驱散，并且使其<font color='#6db6e9'>无法施放技能</font>或获得任何<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果，同时造成持续伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 每当佤什昂都的丧钟传出一个名字，这个名字的主人就必将迎来末日。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 末日对敌人施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。末日作用下目标%scepter_aura_radius%范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。
facets_loc: 末日的持续时间每%upgrade_interval%分钟都会提升%upgrade_amount%秒。

official.name: doom_bringer_lvl_pain
official.desc_loc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After %damage_debuff_duration%s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a %spread_radius% AoE for %bonus_damage_pct_base%%% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is %bonus_at_level_pct%%% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of %level_multiplier%.
notes_loc: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.

officialZh.name: doom_bringer_lvl_pain
officialZh.desc_loc: 末日使者的攻击会诅咒敌方英雄。%damage_debuff_duration%秒后，被诅咒的英雄会爆发出一根火柱，对自身和%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量为诅咒期间内承受来自末日使者的%bonus_damage_pct_base%%%伤害。如果被诅咒的英雄等级为%level_multiplier%的倍数，诅咒的伤害和作用范围会提升%bonus_at_level_pct%%%。
notes_loc: 末日使者达到满级后也会生效。

official.name: ursa_earthshock
official.desc_loc: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %abilityduration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: The very steps of a male ursine shake the ground as well as the resolve of opposing warriors.
official.shard_loc: Earthshock applies %fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit% Fury Swipes to enemies hit.

officialZh.name: ursa_earthshock
officialZh.desc_loc: 熊战士向前跳跃%hop_distance%距离并猛击地面带来强烈的冲击，对附近范围内的所有敌方单位造成伤害并减速%abilityduration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 雄性熊怪有力的步伐撼动着大地，展示了他们坚定的战士之心。
officialZh.shard_loc: 震撼大地对击中的敌人施加%fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit%层怒意狂击。

official.name: ursa_overpower
official.desc_loc: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
official.lore_loc: For a behemoth of his size, Ursa is deceptively nimble.
notes_loc: Missing an attack still consumes a charge of Overpower.

officialZh.name: ursa_overpower
officialZh.desc_loc: 乌尔萨在战斗中运用他的技艺，提升了接下来几次攻击的攻击速度，同时还获得了<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 乌尔萨有着让人难以和他巨大的体型联想到一起的敏捷。
notes_loc: 攻击丢失还是会消耗超强力量的攻击次数。

official.name: ursa_fury_swipes
official.desc_loc: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
official.lore_loc: In nature, the wounded rarely survive the attacks of hungry predators.
notes_loc: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

officialZh.name: ursa_fury_swipes
officialZh.desc_loc: 熊战士的利爪深深地撕裂敌人的伤口，对同一敌人连续攻击将造成更多伤害。如果同一个目标在%bonus_reset_time%秒内不受攻击，将失去额外伤害加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在大自然中，很少有受伤的动物能在饥饿的捕食者攻击下幸存。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。

official.name: ursa_maul
official.desc_loc: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

officialZh.name: ursa_maul
officialZh.desc_loc: 熊战士获得攻击力加成，数值为当前生命值的一定百分比。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: ursa_enrage
official.desc_loc:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: Ulfsaar succumbs to his ancient spirit, becoming the most ferocious creature on the battlefield.
official.scepter_loc: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.
facets_loc: When damaged during Enrage, Ursa gains bonus attack damage.

officialZh.name: ursa_enrage
officialZh.desc_loc:
乌尔萨进入狂怒状态，承受的伤害降低并获得<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>。施放时将移除所受的负面效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 乌尔萨放纵他的远古之魂，成为战场上最凶残的生物。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 减少冷却时间，而且熊战士可以在被控制的状态下使用激怒。
facets_loc: 激怒期间受到伤害时，熊战士获得攻击力加成。

special_values.name: damage_increase
special_values.heading_loc: 降低的伤害转为攻击力：

official.name: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
official.desc_loc:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
official.lore_loc: Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.
notes_loc: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
official.shard_loc: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
facets_loc: Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.

officialZh.name: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
officialZh.desc_loc:
裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。

途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巴拉森带着一股狂蛮之力从黑暗中冲出。
notes_loc: 裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。
officialZh.shard_loc: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成提升%bonus_movement_speed%。
facets_loc: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成会在冲刺结束后逐渐消失。

official.name: spirit_breaker_bulldoze
official.desc_loc: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
official.lore_loc: Barathrum warps the fabric of reality around him, lessening its influence on his physical form.

officialZh.name: spirit_breaker_bulldoze
officialZh.desc_loc: 裂魂人获得移动速度和<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>加成，在敌人之间横冲直撞。可以在冲刺期间使用。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巴拉森扭曲了他周遭现实的结构，减轻他的肉体形态受到的影响。

official.name: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
official.desc_loc: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
official.lore_loc: The signature strike of Barathrum's ghostly ball and chain.
notes_loc: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
official.scepter_loc: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
facets_loc: Greater Bash chance is increased if you've bashed more than one hero within the last %bonus_chance_duration%s. Each additional hero past the first increases Greater Bash chance by %bonus_chance_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
officialZh.desc_loc: 攻击时有一定概率<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并击退敌方单位。重击的伤害值为移动速度的一定百分比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巴拉森幽灵般链球的标志性一击。
notes_loc: 不与碎颅锤叠加。
破坏会使攻击触发巨力重击失效。暗影冲刺或幽冥一击还是会施加巨力重击。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到%cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%%伤害），并且原目标再次受到%cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%%的巨力重击伤害。
facets_loc: 过去%bonus_chance_duration%秒内对不止一名英雄触发了巨力重击就会使重击的概率提升。第一个英雄之后每个英雄都会使巨力重击的概率提升%bonus_chance_pct%%%。

official.name: spirit_breaker_planar_pocket
official.desc_loc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
official.lore_loc: Barathrum's unyielding focus forms a pocket of planar convergence from which not even the most powerful arcane energies can escape.
notes_loc: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves %break_distance% units away from the target.

officialZh.name: spirit_breaker_planar_pocket
officialZh.desc_loc: 巴拉森获得魔法抗性，并扭曲选定英雄附近的现实，使敌方英雄施放的任意指向性技能转向裂魂人。可以对友方和敌方英雄施放，但是只有裂魂人的敌人施放的技能才会转向。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巴拉森顽强的专注力形成了位面汇聚点的空洞，就连最强大的奥术能量也无法逃逸。
notes_loc: 如果裂魂人和目标之间的距离超过%break_distance%，位面空洞效果会停止。

official.name: spirit_breaker_bull_rush
official.desc_loc: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
notes_loc: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.

officialZh.name: spirit_breaker_bull_rush
officialZh.desc_loc: 裂魂人只要<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人就会获得移动速度加成。来自多个<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>的效果会叠加，并且拥有独立的持续时间。暗影冲刺期间持续时间会暂停。
notes_loc: 神行太保的加成状态使裂魂人能够突破移动速度上限。

official.name: spirit_breaker_nether_strike
official.desc_loc: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
official.lore_loc: Barathrum temporarily returns to the realm from where he came, bringing with him the retribution of both worlds.
notes_loc: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.
official.scepter_loc: Greatly increases knockback.
facets_loc: Enemy targets hit by Nether Strike will be moved further by allied knockback effects.

officialZh.name: spirit_breaker_nether_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 裂魂人遁入幽冥领域，从不幸的目标身旁再次出现，发动当前等级的巨力重击并造成额外伤害。击退距离为平常的两倍。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巴拉森暂时回到他原来所在的元素领域，然后带回来自两个世界的回击。
notes_loc: 裂魂人将在目标身后出现并发动巨力重击。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 大幅提升击退效果。
facets_loc: 被幽冥一击击中的敌方目标受到友方的击退效果的移动距离更远。

official.name: gyrocopter_rocket_barrage
official.desc_loc: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts %barrage_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Aurel's new craft has an increased payload for rockets, enhancing their rapid-fire capabilities.
notes_loc: Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.
facets_loc: Every successful hit of a Rocket Barrage rocket on an enemy hero increases Gyrocopter's movement speed.

officialZh.name: gyrocopter_rocket_barrage
officialZh.desc_loc: 向矮人直升机附近一定范围内的敌方单位齐射导弹。持续%barrage_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 奥雷尔的新飞行器有更大的火箭载弹量，增强了速射能力。
notes_loc: 火箭弹幕不能伤害矮人直升机视野之外的单位。
追踪导弹发射的火箭弹幕不会触发加力燃烧器。
facets_loc: 火箭弹幕每次成功击中敌方英雄都会提升矮人直升机的移动速度。

official.name: gyrocopter_homing_missile
official.desc_loc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
official.lore_loc: The biggest missile Aurel could possibly attach to his craft, The Bomb has carefully calculated aerodynamics and explosives for maximum impact.
notes_loc: Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
official.shard_loc: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.

officialZh.name: gyrocopter_homing_missile
officialZh.desc_loc: 发射一枚会自动定位目标单位的追踪导弹。导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。敌方单位可在导弹接近前将其击落。
officialZh.lore_loc: 奥雷尔的飞行器上所能装载的最大的导弹，为了实现最佳效果，他对空气动力学和爆炸物进行精心计算才得到了炸蛋™。
notes_loc: 防御塔对导弹造成半额伤害。
准星效果仅对队友可见。
导弹会跟随并击中隐身单位。
officialZh.shard_loc: 追踪导弹现在从施放%shard_delay%秒后开始不断发射%shard_radius%作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。

special_values.name: tower_hits_to_kill_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 摧毁所需防御塔攻击次数：

official.name: gyrocopter_flak_cannon
official.desc_loc: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds or until the attacks are used.
official.lore_loc: This newly revamped Gyrocopter has attached enough armaments to assault in a 360 degree radius.
notes_loc: Attack range for the primary attack is unchanged.

officialZh.name: gyrocopter_flak_cannon
officialZh.desc_loc: 矮人直升机的攻击会击中目标周围一定范围内的所有敌人，持续一定次数的攻击。只有主要目标会受到致命一击等攻击特效。持续%abilityduration%秒或攻击次数耗尽。
officialZh.lore_loc: 这架新近改造的旋翼机装备了足够的弹药，可以攻击360度全范围内的敌人。
notes_loc: 对主目标的攻击距离没有改变。

official.name: gyrocopter_afterburner
official.desc_loc: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

officialZh.name: gyrocopter_afterburner
officialZh.desc_loc: 矮人直升机通过攻击或技能对敌人造成伤害后，在短时间内获得移动速度提升。

official.name: gyrocopter_side_gunner_spawn_ability
official.desc_loc: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a %AbilityCastRange% unit radius every %sidegunner_fire_rate%s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
notes_loc: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.

officialZh.name: gyrocopter_side_gunner_spawn_ability
officialZh.desc_loc: 矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每%sidegunner_fire_rate%秒对矮人直升机附近%AbilityCastRange%范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。
notes_loc: 即使矮人直升机被控制，侧翼机枪也能攻击。

official.name: gyrocopter_call_down
official.desc_loc: Call down %total_strikes% aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is %strike_separation% distance from the previous one.
official.lore_loc: 'Bombs Away!'
notes_loc: The visual indicator is visible to allies only.

officialZh.name: gyrocopter_call_down
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤%total_strikes%波防空导弹，对目标区域内的敌方单位造成减速和伤害。每次打击与上一次间隔%strike_separation%距离。
officialZh.lore_loc: “开始轰炸！”
notes_loc: 视觉指示范围仅对队友可见。

official.name: alchemist_acid_spray
official.desc_loc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.
official.lore_loc: Using traditional Alchemy from the Darkbrew family, Razzil concocts an acid that dissolves even the toughest metals.

officialZh.name: alchemist_acid_spray
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标区域喷洒高压酸雾。穿过受污染地带的敌人每秒会受到物理伤害，同时护甲被削弱。
officialZh.lore_loc: 用黑酿家族的祖传化学知识，拉泽尔配出一种能溶解最坚硬金属的强酸。

official.name: alchemist_unstable_concoction
official.desc_loc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
official.lore_loc: A silver lining to the failure of turning a mountain into gold, this volatile solution has destructive potential.
notes_loc: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.
facets_loc: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: alchemist_unstable_concoction
officialZh.desc_loc: 炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。调制的时间越久，伤害越大，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间也越长。炼金术士在调制期间获得移动速度加成。调制%brew_time%秒后达到最大伤害量和最长<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间。然而，若%brew_explosion%秒后未扔出药剂，则会在炼金术士自己手中爆炸。
officialZh.lore_loc: 将整座山转变成黄金的实验失败后带来的副产品，这种易挥发的药剂有着破坏的潜力。
notes_loc: 摇制开始后，本技能替换为投掷不稳定化合物。炼金术士在摇制期间可以像平常一样移动和攻击。
炼金术士的头顶会有倒计时，提示剩余的摇制时间。倒计时对敌人可见。
可以用此技能将自己反补。
不稳定化合物无法被躲避，并且不稳定化合物被掷出后会停止调制。
不稳定化合物的爆炸会对英雄和非英雄单位造成伤害。
facets_loc: 炼金术士处于化学狂暴作用时，冷却时间减少%chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

official.name: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry
official.desc_loc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply %stacks_per_attack% stacks. Unstable Concoction applies %one_tooltip% stack per second of brew time.
official.lore_loc: A powerful solvent that turned out to work all too well.

special_values.name: attack_dmg_per_stack
special_values.heading_loc: BASE ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION PER STACK:

officialZh.name: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry
officialZh.desc_loc:
炼金术士使他的武器浸满强酸，对击中的敌人施加可叠加的减速和基础攻击力降低效果。

每次攻击施加%stacks_per_attack%层叠加效果。不稳定化合物每调制1秒施加%one_tooltip%层叠加效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一种强大的溶剂，事实证明效果实在是太好了。

special_values.name: attack_dmg_per_stack
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加降低基础攻击力：

official.name: alchemist_berserk_potion
official.desc_loc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: After Razzil's great grandfather tested an early version of this potion on himself, a surviving family member immediately saw the profit potential.
facets_loc: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.

officialZh.name: alchemist_berserk_potion
officialZh.desc_loc:
炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 拉泽尔的曾祖父在他自己身上试验了这种药水的早期版本，之后一名幸存的家族成员马上看到了潜在的商机。
facets_loc: 炼金术士处于化学狂暴作用时，冷却时间减少%chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

official.name: alchemist_goblins_greed
official.desc_loc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
official.lore_loc: While it is not a mountain, Razzil has mastered the conversion of smaller compounds to line his pockets.
official.scepter_loc: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
facets_loc: Alchemist gains %gpm_increase_per_stack% GPM for each Aghanim's Scepter he has granted to allies.

officialZh.name: alchemist_goblins_greed
officialZh.desc_loc: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来%duration%秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管对付不了一座山，但拉泽尔还是掌握着技术，能转化一些较小的化合物来填满他的荷包。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。
facets_loc: 炼金术士每对友军送出一把阿哈利姆神杖就获得%gpm_increase_per_stack%每分钟金钱。

official.name: alchemist_chemical_rage
official.desc_loc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: The brew Razzil gave to the Ogre during their prison bust has become a useful potion in the midst of combat.
notes_loc: Has a %transformation_time% second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.

officialZh.name: alchemist_chemical_rage
officialZh.desc_loc:
炼金术士诱发他的食人魔同伴进入化学狂暴，降低攻击间隔，提高移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 拉泽尔在越狱时给食人魔喝的酿造物成了激战中的有效药剂。
notes_loc: 拥有%transformation_time%秒的变身时间，可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道以及眩晕技能。

official.name: invoker_quas
official.desc_loc: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
official.lore_loc: A quelling cold.
notes_loc: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
official.scepter_loc: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
facets_loc: <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional level.

officialZh.name: invoker_quas
officialZh.desc_loc: 允许祈求者掌控冰元素。每个活跃的<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>元素会让祈求者获得生命恢复加成。每级<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>被动提供额外力量。
officialZh.lore_loc: 刺骨的寒意。
notes_loc: 祈求者最多只有3个元素。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。
facets_loc: <font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>会自动额外获得一级。

official.name: invoker_wex
official.desc_loc: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
official.lore_loc: A withering wind.
notes_loc: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
official.scepter_loc: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
facets_loc: <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional level.

officialZh.name: invoker_wex
officialZh.desc_loc: 允许祈求者掌控雷元素。每个活跃的<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>元素会让祈求者获得移动和攻击速度加成。每级<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>被动提供额外敏捷。
officialZh.lore_loc: 凛冽的暴风。
notes_loc: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。
facets_loc: <font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>会自动额外获得一级。

official.name: invoker_exort
official.desc_loc: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
official.lore_loc: An exacting flame.
notes_loc: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
official.scepter_loc: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
facets_loc: <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional level.

officialZh.name: invoker_exort
