officialZh.desc_loc: 允许祈求者掌控火元素。每个活跃的<font color='#cabe68'>火</font>元素会让祈求者获得攻击力加成。每级<font color='#cabe68'>火</font>被动提供额外智力。
officialZh.lore_loc: 严酷的炽焰。
notes_loc: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。
facets_loc: <font color='#cabe68'>火</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#cabe68'>火</font>会自动额外获得一级。

official.name: invoker_invoke
official.desc_loc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level. Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level%, and %third_ability_level%.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options. The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
official.lore_loc: So begins a new age of knowledge.
notes_loc: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

officialZh.name: invoker_invoke
officialZh.desc_loc:
将当前掌握的元素精华融合，创造出新的法术供祈求者施放。每个元素球的等级都会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_orb%秒元素祈唤的冷却时间。祈求者达到%first_ability_level%、%second_ability_level%和%third_ability_level%时会分别额外获得一点技能点。

祈求者高深的魔法学识让他可以从多个阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果中进行选择。物品必须先激活才能生效，而且选择后无法更改。

点击帮助按钮可查看所有可用法术。
officialZh.lore_loc: 知识的新纪元就此开启。
notes_loc: 生成的技能与三个球的排列顺序无关。
只是交换现有技能的位置并不会消耗魔法，也不会触发元素祈唤的冷却。
元素祈唤不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

official.name: invoker_cold_snap
official.desc_loc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
official.lore_loc: Sadron's Protracted Frisson.
notes_loc: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

officialZh.name: invoker_cold_snap
officialZh.desc_loc: 祈求者将敌人的热量抽空，将其降到绝对零度，持续时间取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>等级。敌人将受到伤害并被短暂冻结，后续攻击会使敌人再次冻结并造成额外伤害。被冻结的频率固定，但是冻结的冷却时间将会随着<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>等级提高而缩短。
officialZh.lore_loc: 塞卓昂的无尽战栗。
notes_loc: 只有%damage_trigger%点以上的实际伤害才能触发急速冷却。

special_values.name: duration
special_values.heading_loc: 急速冷却持续时间（<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>）：

official.name: invoker_ghost_walk
official.desc_loc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
official.lore_loc: Myrault's Hinder-Gast.
notes_loc: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.
official.shard_loc: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.

officialZh.name: invoker_ghost_walk
officialZh.desc_loc: 祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>等级成反比。
officialZh.lore_loc: 米瑞特之阻碍。
notes_loc: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。

official.name: invoker_tornado
official.desc_loc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Claws of Tornarus.
notes_loc: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
official.scepter_loc: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, dealing damage based on <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)

officialZh.name: invoker_tornado
officialZh.desc_loc:
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助地漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。最大距离取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>等级。滞空时间取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>等级。落地伤害取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 托纳鲁斯之爪。
notes_loc: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每%twister_tick_rate%秒在%twister_radius%范围内基于<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）

official.name: invoker_emp
official.desc_loc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains %self_mana_restore_pct%%% of the mana drained.
official.lore_loc: Endoleon's Malevolent Perturbation.
notes_loc: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
official.shard_loc: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.

officialZh.name: invoker_emp
officialZh.desc_loc: 祈求者在指定位置召唤出一道强力的自爆电磁脉冲，%delay%秒后将自动爆炸。爆炸将覆盖一定区域，并根据<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级损毁敌方的魔法值。对敌方英雄造成损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。祈求者将获得%self_mana_restore_pct%%%损毁的魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 恩多利昂的恶之混动。
notes_loc: 对被吹起的单位（强袭飓风或Eul的神圣法杖）无效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒%drag_speed%距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。

special_values.name: mana_burned
special_values.heading_loc: 最大燃烧魔法量（<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>）：

official.name: invoker_alacrity
official.desc_loc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> and their damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
official.lore_loc: Gaster's Mandate of Impetuous Strife.

officialZh.name: invoker_alacrity
officialZh.desc_loc: 祈求者给友方单位灌注强大的能量，提高其攻击速度和攻击力。攻击速度提升程度取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>等级，攻击力提升取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>等级。
officialZh.lore_loc: 盖斯特的猛战号令。

official.name: invoker_chaos_meteor
official.desc_loc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, and rolling further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
official.lore_loc: Tarak's Descent of Fire.
notes_loc: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

officialZh.name: invoker_chaos_meteor
officialZh.desc_loc: 祈求者从太空中召唤一枚燃烧的流星打击指定位置。流星着陆后会向前滚动一段距离，每隔一段时间撞击一次作用范围内的敌人，造成基于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>等级的撞击伤害，滚动距离取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级。每被撞击一次都将持续受到烧灼伤害，烧灼伤害取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级。
officialZh.lore_loc: 塔拉克的天坠之火。
notes_loc: 每个敌方单位受到撞击伤害的间隔为%damage_interval%秒，后续较低的烧灼伤害持续%burn_duration%秒。
陨石移动的速度为%travel_speed%。

official.name: invoker_sun_strike
official.desc_loc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
official.lore_loc: Harlek's Incantation of Incineration.
notes_loc: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
official.shard_loc: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
official.scepter_loc: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.

officialZh.name: invoker_sun_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。伤害取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>等级，区域内敌人将平摊所有伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 哈雷克之火葬魔咒。
notes_loc: 施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。
officialZh.shard_loc: 阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为%cataclysm_cooldown%秒。每个敌方英雄附近%cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range%范围内产生%cataclysm_count%个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有%cataclysm_damage_pct%%%伤害。

official.name: invoker_forge_spirit
official.desc_loc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
official.lore_loc: Culween's Most Cunning Fabrications.
notes_loc: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

officialZh.name: invoker_forge_spirit
officialZh.desc_loc: 祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。熔炉精灵的攻击力和护甲取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级，攻击距离、持续时间和生命值取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级。元素的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。熔炉精灵的产生数量取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>和<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>中等级较低的元素。
officialZh.lore_loc: 卡尔维因的至邪造物。
notes_loc: 施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。

official.name: invoker_ice_wall
official.desc_loc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
official.lore_loc: Killing Wall of Koryx.
official.scepter_loc: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.

officialZh.name: invoker_ice_wall
officialZh.desc_loc: 在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙，持续时间取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成减速和伤害，减速效果取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级，每秒伤害取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级。
officialZh.lore_loc: 科瑞克斯的杀戮之墙。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 寒冰之墙变成浮冰，以矢量为目标。经过短暂延迟后，浮冰出现再产生一道%wall_width%宽度的寒冰之墙。在浮冰内停留超过%root_delay%秒的敌方英雄会基于<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>的等级被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>并受到魔法伤害。

official.name: invoker_deafening_blast
official.desc_loc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
official.lore_loc: Buluphont's Aureal Incapacitator.

officialZh.name: invoker_deafening_blast
officialZh.desc_loc: 祈求者在自己前方释放出超强的声波，对所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量取决于<font color='#cabe68'>火元素</font>的等级。声波的绝对冲击能够将敌方单位击退，击退时间取决于<font color='#7998b5'>冰元素</font>的等级，同时让他们无法进行攻击，禁止攻击时间取决于<font color='#d671a9'>雷元素</font>的等级。
officialZh.lore_loc: 布鲁冯特之无力声波。

official.name: silencer_curse_of_the_silent
official.desc_loc:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
official.lore_loc: Nortrom's lack of incantations is less of a problem for him than it is for his adversaries.
notes_loc: Affects creeps.

officialZh.name: silencer_curse_of_the_silent
officialZh.desc_loc:
诅咒目标区域，造成伤害并使敌人持续受到伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。

期间受到作用的英雄一旦施放魔法，持续时间就会延长。目标被沉默时不计入负面效果的持续时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 无法使用咒语对诺崇来说不是什么问题，但对他的敌人来说，这可是个大问题。
notes_loc: 非英雄单位也会受到作用。

official.name: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
official.desc_loc: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
official.lore_loc: Although lacking in traditional incantations, Nortrom's pedigree of the Aeol Drias gives him uncanny wisdom, which he applies to physical combat.
official.shard_loc: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.
facets_loc: Increases the max level of Glaives of Wisdom. Level %max_level_tooltip% Glaives of Wisdom bounce %bounce_count_tooltip% time to a random target within %bounce_range_tooltip% range. The bounce costs mana upon hit and prioritizes heroes.

officialZh.name: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
officialZh.desc_loc: 沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管无法使用传统咒语，但诺崇的风蚀之寒血统赋予他一种诡异的智慧，在肉搏中助他一臂之力。
officialZh.shard_loc: 使智慧之刃向%bounce_range% 范围内的随机敌人弹射%bounce_count%次，并提升智力窃取。
facets_loc: 提升智慧之刃的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级智慧之刃会向%bounce_range_tooltip%范围内的一个随机目标弹射%bounce_count_tooltip%次。弹射击中时会消耗魔法，以英雄优先。

official.name: silencer_last_word
official.desc_loc: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
official.lore_loc: Nortrom ensures that spells uttered by his opponents will be their last.
notes_loc: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.

officialZh.name: silencer_last_word
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标施加魔咒，提供目标的视野，并且只要目标施放技能或魔咒消失，目标就会受到伤害并被<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。根据沉默术士和目标的智力差还将造成额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 诺崇的敌人念出的咒语往往将成为他们的遗言。
notes_loc: 持续施法类技能在英雄结束施法后触发此技能的效果。

official.name: silencer_brain_drain
official.desc_loc:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.
official.shard_loc: Increases the Intelligence stolen per kill.

officialZh.name: silencer_brain_drain
officialZh.desc_loc:
沉默术士对被沉默的目标造成更多伤害，受到来自他们的伤害减少。

只要敌方英雄在沉默术士附近%permanent_int_steal_range%范围内阵亡或者死亡时带有沉默术士的负面效果，沉默术士都会永久窃取其%permanent_int_steal_amount%点智力。如果敌方英雄阵亡时被沉默，将额外窃取%silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount%点智力。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升每次击杀窃取的智力值。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: silencer_global_silence
official.desc_loc: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
official.lore_loc: With a shock to the ground, all magic and sound pauses, and Nortrom fulfills his prophecy.
notes_loc: This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.
official.scepter_loc: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.
facets_loc: The first time Global Silence ends on a unit it is applied again.

officialZh.name: silencer_global_silence
officialZh.desc_loc: 沉默术士停止一切声音，<font color='#6db6e9'>阻止</font>地图上所有敌方英雄和单位施法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 随着大地一震，所有的魔法和声音都停止了，诺崇实现了他的预言。
notes_loc: 沉默效果对隐身和减益免疫单位有效，但是期间获得减益免疫状态将移除该效果。
来自阿哈利姆神杖升级全领域静默的多个奥术诅咒不会叠加。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 全领域静默在全领域静默的持续时间内对英雄施加奥术诅咒。
facets_loc: 全领域静默在一个单位身上第一次结束后还会再次施加。

official.name: obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb
official.desc_loc: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
official.lore_loc: Harbinger's outworldly knowledge allows it to tap into the ebb and flow of all spiritual energy, infusing it into his being.
notes_loc: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.
official.scepter_loc: Arcane Orb bounces to an additional target for %bounce_damage_reduction%%% less damage.

officialZh.name: obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb
officialZh.desc_loc: 殁境神蚀者的攻击附带基于剩余魔法值的额外纯粹伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 先兆者的殁境学识使他可以洞悉所有精神能量的涨落，并将其融入自身。
notes_loc: 根据使用此技能后的魔法值计算附加伤害。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 奥术天球额外弹跳至一个目标，造成的伤害降低%bounce_damage_reduction%%%。

official.name: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
official.desc_loc: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
official.lore_loc: Locked away in the pocket between this world and the Outworld, victims realize their infantile knowledge and mortality.
notes_loc: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
official.shard_loc: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
facets_loc: Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.

officialZh.name: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
officialZh.desc_loc: 窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 被关在现世和殁境之间的空间中，受害者认识到自己如孩童般的学识和血肉之躯。
notes_loc: 被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。
officialZh.shard_loc: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以%allied_movement_speed_pct%%%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。
facets_loc: 受到作用的英雄会获得一个魔力邪印的负面效果，持续%debuff_duration%秒，每次施放技能都会治疗殁境神蚀者。

official.name: obsidian_destroyer_objurgation
official.desc_loc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
official.scepter_loc: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below %automatic_trigger_threshold%%% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every %automatic_trigger_cd% seconds.

officialZh.name: obsidian_destroyer_objurgation
officialZh.desc_loc: 提升殁境神蚀者的最大魔法值。施放后，殁境神蚀者获得<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>，数值为固定值 + 最大魔法值的一定百分比。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升最大魔法值转为<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>的比例。阻止让殁境神蚀者的血量低于%automatic_trigger_threshold%%%的伤害。阻止生效时，殁境神蚀者获得一次强驱散，和不可驱散的责难效果。这个效果每%automatic_trigger_cd%秒只能触发一次。

special_values.name: mana_to_barrier
special_values.heading_loc: 最大魔法值转为<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>：

official.name: obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium
official.desc_loc: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.
official.lore_loc: The Outworld is awash in arcane energy, inclined to diffuse through any of Harbinger's rifts.
facets_loc: When Essence Flux restores mana, it also temporarily increases maximum mana.

officialZh.name: obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium
officialZh.desc_loc: 被动拥有一定几率在施放技能时回复最大魔法值的一定百分比。通过攻击特效的技能回复的魔法会减少。
officialZh.lore_loc: 殁境充斥着奥术能量，将穿过先兆者的裂隙进行扩散。
facets_loc: 精华变迁回复魔法时，还会暂时增加最大魔法值。

official.name: obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse
official.desc_loc: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.
official.lore_loc: When an Outworld crystal ruptures, cataclysmic energies are released, and the reverberations of this power are felt interdimensionally.
facets_loc: Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.

officialZh.name: obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放出一道神智冲击波，伤害数值基于自身与目标的最大魔法值之差。神智之蚀可以作用于星体禁锢中的单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当一块殁境的水晶破裂之时，灾难性的能量被释放出来，甚至在其他的空间也能感受到这股能量的回响。
facets_loc: 受到作用的英雄会获得一个魔力邪印的负面效果，持续%debuff_duration%秒，每次施放技能都会治疗殁境神蚀者。

official.name: lycan_summon_wolves
official.desc_loc: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
official.lore_loc: The very enchantment that twisted his being also summons canine familiars.
notes_loc: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.
official.shard_loc: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
facets_loc: Summoned Wolves are invulnerable and uncontrollable spirits that do not attack, but provide health and damage bonuses to Lycan.

Max Level increased to %max_level%. Level 5 wolves gain Hamstring, which empowers their attacks to root enemies and cause them to take more physical damage on attacks. Level 6 wolves have Hightail, an active ability that gives wolves phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

officialZh.name: lycan_summon_wolves
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 扭曲他生命本质的魔法还能召唤出他的犬科伙伴。
notes_loc: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。
officialZh.shard_loc: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。
facets_loc: 召唤的狼为不可控的无敌幽灵，不会攻击，但会为狼人提供生命和攻击力加成。
最高等级可升至%max_level%级。5级精灵狼获得断筋，使他们的攻击可以缠绕敌人，并且使敌人被攻击时承受更多物理伤害。6级精灵狼拥有健步如飞，主动开启后精灵狼获得相位移动状态、闪避、移动速度和攻击速度。

official.name: lycan_howl
official.desc_loc: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.
official.lore_loc: Blood-curdling wolf cries signal to opponents that Banehallow is among them.
facets_loc: Max level decreased to %max_level%.

officialZh.name: lycan_howl
officialZh.desc_loc: 使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围%radius%范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。
officialZh.lore_loc: 毛骨悚然的狼嚎让敌人明白贝恩霍勒就在他们之中。
facets_loc: 最高等级减少至%max_level%级。

official.name: lycan_feral_impulse
official.desc_loc: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.
official.lore_loc: His animalistic symbiosis with canine kind gives Banehallow enhanced reflexes and hunting capabilities.
facets_loc: Max level decreased to %max_level%.

officialZh.name: lycan_feral_impulse
officialZh.desc_loc: 提升狼人和所有他控制的单位的生命恢复和攻击力。
officialZh.lore_loc: 贝恩霍勒与犬类野兽的共生强化了他的反应和狩猎能力。
facets_loc: 最高等级减少至%max_level%级。

official.name: lycan_wolf_bite
official.desc_loc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain %lifesteal_percent%%% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within %lifesteal_range% range of each other.
official.lore_loc: Does this bite look infected?
notes_loc: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.

officialZh.name: lycan_wolf_bite
officialZh.desc_loc: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得%lifesteal_percent%%%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过%lifesteal_range%就能共用吸血效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 咬的这一口像是被传染了吗？
notes_loc: 饿狼撕咬的冷却时间与变身的当前等级相同。

official.name: lycan_apex_predator
official.desc_loc: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

officialZh.name: lycan_apex_predator
officialZh.desc_loc: 狼人和他控制的单位对中立生物造成额外伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: lycan_shapeshift
official.desc_loc: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
official.lore_loc: Forever a slave to his lycanthropy, Banehallow has come to accept his curse, and embrace his own savagery.
notes_loc: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.
facets_loc: Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control. Enemy heroes killed by Lycan or his units extends Shapeshift duration by %kill_duration_extension%s.

officialZh.name: lycan_shapeshift
officialZh.desc_loc: 狼人展现出他的凶狼形态，获得致命一击的能力，并且提升夜间视野。在变身期间，狼人达到超高移动速度，并且不能被减速。移动速度和致命一击也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 贝恩霍勒接受了永恒的狼人诅咒，拥抱了他的野性，也永远成为了他狼性的奴仆。
notes_loc: 狼人的移动速度不会受到妖术的影响。
facets_loc: 移动速度和致命一击加成效果也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。狼人或他的单位击杀敌方英雄后会使变身的持续时间延长%kill_duration_extension%秒。

official.name: brewmaster_thunder_clap
official.desc_loc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.
official.lore_loc: A slam of Mangix' mighty keg starts the festivities.

officialZh.name: brewmaster_thunder_clap
officialZh.desc_loc: 猛击地面，造成伤害并降低附近敌方单位的移动速度和攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 曼吉克斯巨大酒桶的一击标志着庆典的开始。

official.name: brewmaster_cinder_brew
official.desc_loc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.
official.lore_loc: The Order of the Oyo's solution to all problems - another round!
facets_loc: Cinder Brew is now a rolling barrel of ale that drenches enemies in its path and explodes at the end.

officialZh.name: brewmaster_cinder_brew
officialZh.desc_loc:
向敌人扔出一个酒桶，对沿途的敌人造成伤害，并在目标地点溅出酒液。

路径上和溅酒点的敌人会浸满余烬佳酿，并且被减速。受到魔法或纯粹伤害后还将被点燃。点燃时持续时间增加%extra_duration%秒，并且受到持续伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 奥尤社解决所有问题的方法——再喝一轮！
facets_loc: 余烬佳酿现在是装满酒的滚动酒桶，会使路径上的敌人浸满酒，并且在终点爆炸。

official.name: brewmaster_drunken_brawler
official.desc_loc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%%% for %brewed_up_duration%s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
official.lore_loc: When Mangix won his title as the Brewmaster of the Order of Oyo, he also claimed his place in the mastery of inebriation.
notes_loc: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

officialZh.name: brewmaster_drunken_brawler
officialZh.desc_loc:
酒仙可以根据操控的元素来切换拳法。

每当酒仙施放技能，他都会进入浸酒状态，拳法的威力提升%brewed_up_bonus%%%，持续%brewed_up_duration%秒。如果他在浸酒状态下又施放了技能，持续时间会延长%brewed_up_duration_extend%秒。浸酒状态结束后，他会进入大醉状态，%hangover_time%秒内无法再次进入浸酒状态。

大地拳法 - 获得护甲和魔法抗性加成。

狂风拳法 - 获得闪避和移动速度加成。

烈火拳法 - 获得攻击速度加成，并且拥有几率造成致命一击伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 曼吉克斯赢得奥尤社的酒仙称号的同时，也确立了他在精通醉拳方面的地位。
notes_loc: 与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

official.name: brewmaster_liquid_courage
official.desc_loc: When Brewmaster drops below %min_health_threshold%%% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every %speed_toggle_time%s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at %max_health_threshold%%% Health.
official.shard_loc:
Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting %max_hp_regen%%% Max HP Regen per second.

Lasts %drink_duration% seconds.

officialZh.name: brewmaster_liquid_courage
officialZh.desc_loc: 当酒仙的生命值低于%min_health_threshold%%%，他就会获得<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>加成，而且他的移动速度每%speed_toggle_time%秒都会在加速和减速之间改变。血量越低，效果越强，从0开始到%max_health_threshold%%%生命值时达到最大数值。
officialZh.shard_loc:
向队友丢出一杯烈酒，或自己一饮而尽，获得壮胆酒的最大效果，并且还会获得每秒%max_hp_regen%%%最大生命值的回复。

持续%drink_duration%秒。

official.name: brewmaster_primal_split
official.desc_loc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
official.lore_loc: It isn't clear whether Mangix is consciously aware of his potent bond with nature, as it often occurs in the midst of a drunken stupor.
notes_loc: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.
official.scepter_loc:
Primal Split gains %scepter_bonus_levels% max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.

Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

officialZh.name: brewmaster_primal_split
officialZh.desc_loc: 酒仙分裂成元素，产生3个各有所长的战士，生存能力极强，每个都拥有独特技能。只要其中任何一个在召唤时间结束后存活下来，酒仙就能重生。每个战士都会获得对应的醉拳拳法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 没有人清楚曼吉克斯是否注意到自己和自然之间强大的连结，因为这总是发生在他醉得不省人事之时。
notes_loc: 大地战士将继承酒仙的所有光环，以及真视宝石的真视效果。
烈火战士拥有相位移动的能力。
技能结束后，酒仙会根据大地→狂风→烈火的顺序选择未阵亡的元素重生。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
元素分离获得%scepter_bonus_levels%级最高和当前等级，强化元素战士和他们的技能。

元素分离可以提前结束，而且元素分离开始时元素战士是浸酒状态。

official.name: shadow_demon_disruption
official.desc_loc: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.
official.lore_loc: The pain of deception comes not while it happens, but when it is revealed.

officialZh.name: shadow_demon_disruption
officialZh.desc_loc: 将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。
officialZh.lore_loc: 欺骗的痛苦不是在其发生之时，而是在其被揭露之时。

official.name: shadow_demon_disseminate
official.desc_loc: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within %radius% range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
official.lore_loc: Friends and families share in the suffering when Shadow Demon finds a new victim.
notes_loc: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
facets_loc: If the target is an enemy, they lose %health_lost%%% of their health, regaining half of it after the effect is lifted. If the target is an ally, increases their health by that amount instead.

officialZh.name: shadow_demon_disseminate
officialZh.desc_loc: 只要目标受到伤害，目标附近%radius%范围内所有敌人，若目标为敌人那也包括目标自身，他们都将受到该伤害的一定百分比。可以对敌方或友方目标施放。敌人被崩裂禁锢隐藏时效果暂停。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当暗影恶魔找到新的受害者，受害者的亲友也会遭受同样的痛苦。
notes_loc: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
facets_loc: 如果目标是敌人，他们会损失%health_lost%%%生命值，效果结束后会回复一半的生命。如果目标是友军，会增加相应数值的生命。

official.name: shadow_demon_shadow_poison
official.desc_loc: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
official.lore_loc: The ever growing influence of the Shadow Demon can pollute the most valiant and pure of heroes.
notes_loc: Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.

officialZh.name: shadow_demon_shadow_poison
officialZh.desc_loc: 在一条直线上造成伤害，并以毒咒折磨敌方单位。根据目标身上的叠加层数，毒咒造成1/2/4/8/16倍的叠加伤害，至多%max_multiply_stacks%层。更多层的叠加每层造成%bonus_stack_damage%点伤害。这部分延缓的伤害在暗影毒的持续时间结束后生效，或者使用附属技能立刻造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 暗影恶魔不断增长的影响力能够玷污最勇敢最纯洁的英雄。
notes_loc: 暗影剧毒可以作用处于崩裂禁锢的单位。

official.name: shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse
official.desc_loc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: The only one permitted to harm his more useful followers is Shadow Demon himself.
notes_loc: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.

officialZh.name: shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse
officialZh.desc_loc:
净愈目标友方单位，在持续时间内移除负面效果。在持续时间结束时该单位受到治疗效果。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净愈的效果。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 唯一容许伤害他的追随者的，就是暗影恶魔本人。
notes_loc: 净愈的持续时间内将持续移除目标的负面状态。

official.name: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
official.desc_loc:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Once Shadow Demon no longer has any need for his collected cultist, he releases it from its subservience - and its life.
notes_loc: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.

officialZh.name: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
officialZh.desc_loc:
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 一旦暗影恶魔不再需要他的信徒，他会抛弃对它的奴役——还有它的生命。
notes_loc: 减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 邪恶净化具有<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

official.name: shadow_demon_menace
official.desc_loc: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for %duration% seconds that increases their damage taken.
notes_loc: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

officialZh.name: shadow_demon_menace
officialZh.desc_loc: 暗影恶魔的攻击会对敌人施加一个可叠加的负面状态，使他们受到的伤害增加，持续%duration%秒。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。

official.name: lone_druid_entangle
official.desc_loc:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
notes_loc: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.
official.scepter_loc: Entangle applies %hits_required% stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.

officialZh.name: lone_druid_entangle
officialZh.desc_loc:
敌方英雄获得%hits_required%层叠加效果后独行德鲁伊可以缠绕敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。

施放时，对区域内每个敌方英雄施加%hits_incremented_on_active%层叠加效果，对敌方非英雄单位施加%hits_required%层。独行德鲁伊的攻击还会被强化%lone_druid_buff_duration%秒，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加%lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip%层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。

升级这个技能也会升级熊灵的缠绕之爪技能。
notes_loc: 被缠绕的单位将无法使用闪烁类技能，如果进入隐身状态也会显形。
独行德鲁伊的强化增益和敌人叠加计数减益无法被驱散。
缠绕的减益效果可以被驱散。
独行德鲁伊或者熊灵的攻击不会使非英雄单位获得叠加效果，只会在施放缠绕之根时使他们被缠绕。
对肉山的作用机制和英雄相同。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 缠绕之根会对区域内敌方英雄施加%hits_required%层叠加效果，并且作用范围提升。触发缠绕的敌人不再受到保护，可以继续获得新的叠加层数。

official.name: lone_druid_spirit_link
official.desc_loc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
official.lore_loc: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.
notes_loc: Break disables the shared lifesteal.
official.scepter_loc:
Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for %duration%s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by %active_bonus%%%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.
facets_loc: Shared Armor increased. Damage dealt by either the Spirit Bear or Lone Druid will heal the other.
Only damage dealt by Spirit Bear heals Lone Druid.

officialZh.name: lone_druid_spirit_link
officialZh.desc_loc: 连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 悉拉在他伙伴身旁倍感鼓舞，熊灵每次挥爪都让他的生命力得到补充。
notes_loc: 破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
独行德鲁伊切断与熊灵的链接，并与目标友方英雄建立链接，与他们共享灵魂链接的加成效果，持续%duration%秒。护甲共享和攻击速度加成的效果均提升%active_bonus%%%。友军造成的伤害会治疗独行德鲁伊，反之亦然。

熊灵在变形期间会被恐惧，除非熊灵也拥有阿哈利姆神杖。
facets_loc: 共享护甲提升。熊灵和独行德鲁伊造成的伤害可以分别治疗对方。
只有熊灵造成的伤害可以治疗独行德鲁伊。

official.name: lone_druid_savage_roar
official.desc_loc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
official.lore_loc: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.
notes_loc: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
official.shard_loc:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

officialZh.name: lone_druid_savage_roar
officialZh.desc_loc: 独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加%bonus_speed%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 悉拉研习并精通失落的熊族技艺，他的行动也因此与自然高度协调。
notes_loc: 被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与熊灵共享冷却时间。
officialZh.shard_loc:
施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。施法效果会在独行德鲁伊和熊灵之间复制，不论双方是否可以施法。

驱散类型：弱驱散

official.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear
official.desc_loc:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves %bear_attack_leash_range% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies. Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
official.lore_loc: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.
notes_loc: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
facets_loc: Increases the distance from Lone Druid at which the Spirit Bear can attack.

officialZh.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear
officialZh.desc_loc:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。

若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过%bear_attack_leash_range%，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的%backlash_damage%%%作为反冲伤害。 熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 悉拉终生的伙伴与他的魂和心共生，在他需要时随时前来相助。
notes_loc: 熊灵受到的大多数技能效果与英雄相同。
熊灵的基础属性为0，基础护甲为0并拥有%base_magic_resistance%%%基础魔法抗性。熊灵装备的物品或享受的加成效果具有的属性对熊灵的加成效果与全才英雄类似。
熊灵无法获得经验。熊灵会跟随独行德鲁伊一起升级。
熊灵拥有自己的阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果。
熊灵会获得独行德鲁伊身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。
facets_loc: 提升了独行德鲁伊和熊灵相距较远时允许熊灵攻击的距离。

official.name: lone_druid_true_form
official.desc_loc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
official.lore_loc: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.
facets_loc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining increased bonus armor, more health, and improved versions of Entangling Claws and Demolish.
Lone Druid morphs his Spirit Bear into an enraged form that gains bonus armor, attack speed, demolish damage, and a %entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% cooldown on Entangling Claws.

officialZh.name: lone_druid_true_form
officialZh.desc_loc: 独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击的能力，但是获得额外护甲，额外生命值和额外攻击力。
officialZh.lore_loc: 强大的熊是森林之王，它们单纯地依靠力量就获得了这一位置。
facets_loc: 独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击能力，但获得了额外护甲和生命值并获得更厉害的缠绕之爪和粉碎击。
独行德鲁伊把自己的熊灵变为狂怒形态，获得额外护甲、攻击速度和粉碎击伤害，并且缠绕之爪的冷却时间减少至%entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

official.name: chaos_knight_chaos_bolt
official.desc_loc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
official.lore_loc: Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.
notes_loc: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
official.shard_loc: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.

officialZh.name: chaos_knight_chaos_bolt
officialZh.desc_loc: 对目标单位投掷一支神秘的能量箭。造成随机时间的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和随机的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 甚至混沌骑士自己都无法预测这不洁之力会有何种效果。
notes_loc: 眩晕持续时间和伤害值为负相关。
附近的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
officialZh.shard_loc: 混乱之箭会制造一个混沌之军的幻象来攻击目标。这个幻象造成的伤害减少%illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%%。

official.name: chaos_knight_reality_rift
official.desc_loc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
official.lore_loc: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.
notes_loc: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.
official.shard_loc: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.
facets_loc: Reality Rift has equal chances of applying Break, Disarm, or Silence for %additional_debuff_duration_percent%%% of the base debuff duration in addition to its normal effects.

officialZh.name: chaos_knight_reality_rift
officialZh.desc_loc: 将混沌骑士及混沌骑士的幻象和目标单位传送到混沌骑士与目标连线上的一点。降低敌方单位的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 天劫的铁蹄跨过不同位面的世界，让混沌骑士的敌人无处可藏。
notes_loc: 目标单位将会强制面向混沌骑士，而且混沌骑士和幻象默认对目标发动攻击。
officialZh.shard_loc: 实相裂隙可以对自身或幻象1200范围内的任意敌方英雄施放。自身英雄和所有幻象会集合，并传送至敌方目标处。
facets_loc: 实相裂隙除了平常效果外，还有均等几率施加破坏、缴械或沉默，持续时间为基础负面效果时间的%additional_debuff_duration_percent%%%。

official.name: chaos_knight_chaos_strike
official.desc_loc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
official.lore_loc: Chaos Knight's unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.

officialZh.name: chaos_knight_chaos_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 混沌骑士和他的幻象在攻击时有几率造成威力不一的致命一击，并且触发时具有吸血效果。对非英雄单位的吸血效果减少。
officialZh.lore_loc: 混沌骑士用巨大的蛮力砸向面前的敌人，击碎最厚的盔甲。

official.name: chaos_knight_fundamental_forging
official.desc_loc: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
notes_loc: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

officialZh.name: chaos_knight_fundamental_forging
officialZh.desc_loc: 混沌骑士的中立物品额外获得一个随机附魔。
notes_loc: 随机附魔会从该级别的所有可选附魔中选取，包括一般不会对力量英雄开放的附魔，拥有负面效果的附魔除外。
随机附魔不会和选定附魔重复。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: chaos_knight_phantasm
official.desc_loc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.
notes_loc: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
official.scepter_loc:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

officialZh.name: chaos_knight_phantasm
officialZh.desc_loc:
从其他维度召唤若干个混沌骑士的幻象。幻象继承%outgoing_damage_tooltip%%%攻击力，但是承受%incoming_damage_tooltip%%%伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 凭借混沌骑士在各个世界丰富的战斗经验，他的幻象足以压制所有敢于反抗他的人。
notes_loc: 能够移除混沌骑士的大部分负面状态。
混沌骑士在施放时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以躲避眩晕和伤害技能。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有%bonus_illusion_chance%%%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。

施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。

official.name: meepo_earthbind
official.desc_loc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
official.lore_loc: Catching dinner in the Riftshadow Ruins can be quite the task.
notes_loc: Affects invisible units, revealing them.
Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

officialZh.name: meepo_earthbind
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标地点扔出一张网，<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>区域内所有敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在裂影荒墟抓住晚饭可是件体力活。
notes_loc: 地之束缚可以使敌方单位在进入隐身后显形，但是不能作用于已经隐身的单位。
对减益免疫单位和肉山无效。

official.name: meepo_poof
official.desc_loc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
official.lore_loc: Sometimes breaking one of the Riftshadow Crystals can be just the trick for getting yourself out of a bind.  Or your other self.
notes_loc: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.

officialZh.name: meepo_poof
officialZh.desc_loc:
通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。

如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
officialZh.lore_loc: 有时候打碎一块影墟水晶可以作为自己摆脱陷阱的方法。或是另外一个自己。
notes_loc: 可以点击小地图施放。
可以传送至米波的幻象。

official.name: meepo_ransack
official.desc_loc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
official.lore_loc: So you gonna need that, or...?
notes_loc: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification

officialZh.name: meepo_ransack
officialZh.desc_loc:
每次攻击都会窃取敌人的生命值，并治疗所有其他米波相同数值生命。

对非英雄单位的效果减少至60%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 所以你要吗，还是……？
notes_loc: 治疗数值会被生命回复增强效果提升。

official.name: meepo_petrify
official.desc_loc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: I'm diggin' here!

officialZh.name: meepo_petrify
officialZh.desc_loc:
挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续%duration%秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的%hp_restore%%%。被缠绕时无法施放。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 我在这挖呀挖呀挖！

official.name: meepo_megameepo
official.desc_loc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%%% more damage for each Meepo on top.
official.lore_loc: Hi, Meepos!

officialZh.name: meepo_megameepo
officialZh.desc_loc:
主米波将%radius%范围内其他米波放到自己的肩膀上。在这个形态下，他会获得其他米波%stats_pct%%%的属性，并且可以把他们扔向敌人，造成伤害和减速。

生效时地之束缚会产生额外的网，身上每只米波都会使忽悠造成额外%poof_damage_factor%%%伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 嘿，米波们！

official.name: meepo_divided_we_stand
official.desc_loc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.
official.lore_loc: Do I know you?
facets_loc: Can now be upgraded at level %required_level% and every %bonus_levels_between_upgrades% levels afterwards to a max level of %max_level%. Duplicate Meepos receive %main_meepo_stats_pct%%% of the main Meepo's bonus attributes.
All Meepos have a stackable aura that increases nearby Meepos' attack speed by %support_group_attack_speed_pct%%% and armor by %support_group_armor%. Radius: %support_radius%.

officialZh.name: meepo_divided_we_stand
officialZh.desc_loc:
米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。

来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少%dps_penalty_pct%%%。

任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。
officialZh.lore_loc: 我是不是在哪见过你？
facets_loc: 现在可以在%required_level%级时学习，之后每%bonus_levels_between_upgrades%级可以再升级一次，最高为%max_level%级。米波克隆体获得米波本体%main_meepo_stats_pct%%%的额外属性。
所有米波都拥有可叠加的光环，提升附近米波%support_group_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度和%support_group_armor%点护甲。作用范围：%support_radius%。

official.name: meepo_geomancy
official.desc_loc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%%% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.
notes_loc: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

officialZh.name: meepo_geomancy
officialZh.desc_loc:
米波会根据所在地形给予自身和克隆体可叠加的加成效果。每个米波都会给予其他米波自身的加成。

如果%tree_radius%范围内有树木，他会获得%tree_regen%点/秒生命恢复。

如果他站在土地上，他会获得%dirt_move_speed%%%移动速度加成。

如果他在水中，他的攻击会减缓目标%water_move_slow%%%移速，持续%water_slow_duration%秒。
notes_loc: 土地包括所有水之外的地形。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: meepo_megameepo_fling
official.desc_loc: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
official.lore_loc: You go first!
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell reflect.

officialZh.name: meepo_megameepo_fling
officialZh.desc_loc: 在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向%AbilityCastRange%范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 你先上！
notes_loc: 不会触发法术反弹。

official.name: treant_natures_grasp
official.desc_loc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%%% less damage to creeps.
official.lore_loc: The tendrils of Rooftrellen's influence stretch to all corners of the forest.

officialZh.name: treant_natures_grasp
officialZh.desc_loc: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少%creep_penalty%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 带有鲁夫特伦影响力的卷须延伸到了森林的各个角落。

official.name: treant_leech_seed
official.desc_loc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
official.lore_loc: Rooftrellen nurtures the beings under his stewardship, sustained by the lifeforce of trespassers into his sacred ground.
facets_loc: Leech Seed can be ground targeted, planting a tree that heals allies and damages all enemies in the effect radius for the duration of the ability. Damage to creeps is reduced by %creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%. If the tree is cut down, it immediately re-grows again.

officialZh.name: treant_leech_seed
officialZh.desc_loc: 树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>和<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 鲁夫特伦悉心培育的这些生命完全靠闯入他圣地的入侵者的生命力维持。
facets_loc: 寄生种子可以对地施放，种下一棵树，在技能的持续时间内治疗作用范围内的友军并对敌人造成伤害。对非英雄单位的伤害和治疗均减少%creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%。树被砍掉会立刻长回来。

official.name: treant_living_armor
official.desc_loc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
official.lore_loc: The roots and tendrils of the Treant Protectors are far-reaching, stimulating the growth and rejuvenation of all of nature.
notes_loc: Instances of damage less than %damage_block_threshold% are ignored.
official.shard_loc: Increases the Damage Blocked by Living Armor. Treant now also passively benefits from Living Armor, with the damage block resetting after not taking damage for %passive_reset_cd% seconds.

officialZh.name: treant_living_armor
officialZh.desc_loc: 将目标英雄或建筑笼罩在保护性外壳中，<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>目标并格挡来自玩家控制来源的伤害。每次本技能格挡伤害后，下次的伤害格挡量都会减少。如果伤害格挡量降至0，加成效果会提前移除。
officialZh.lore_loc: 树精卫士的根须广泛蔓延，促进自然万物的生长和恢复。
notes_loc: 低于%damage_block_threshold%点的伤害会被无视。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升活体护甲的伤害格挡量。树精卫士现在还会被动获得活体护甲的加成效果，%passive_reset_cd%秒内未受到伤害后伤害格挡量会重置。

official.name: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
official.desc_loc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
official.lore_loc: One can never be too certain who, or what, might need protecting.
notes_loc: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.

officialZh.name: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
officialZh.desc_loc: 树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续%duration%秒，为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对于需要守卫的，谁也不能打包票究竟是什么人，或什么东西。
notes_loc: 丛林之眼的树木产生的疯狂生长效果也可以造成伤害。
如果敌人拥有真实视域，他们将会发现被灌注魔力的树木。

official.name: treant_natures_guise
official.desc_loc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
official.lore_loc: The Protectors don't often come into vision; their natural state being nestled within their leafy brethren.
notes_loc: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.

officialZh.name: treant_natures_guise
officialZh.desc_loc: 只要靠近树木就会获得移动速度加成。树精卫士在%cooldown_time%秒内不受到伤害就会额外获得树木穿行。树木穿行时，自然蔽护可以主动使用，使树精卫士获得<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，直到他主动攻击，或不再靠近树木。
officialZh.lore_loc: 树精卫士不常出现在人们的视线中；他们舒适地隐蔽于枝繁叶茂的同胞当中并保持自然的形态。
notes_loc: 自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。
自然卷握的藤蔓在这个技能下被视为树木。
树木穿行时，受到伤害并不会禁用主动效果或树木穿行。

official.name: treant_overgrowth
official.desc_loc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
official.lore_loc: Rooftrellen calls the ancestral spirit of nature, releasing its power through all of his kin.
notes_loc: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.
official.scepter_loc: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.

officialZh.name: treant_overgrowth
officialZh.desc_loc: 在树精卫士周围召唤出疯狂生长的伤害性藤条和枝干，造成伤害并且阻止被缠绕的敌人移动、闪烁、进入隐身或攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 鲁夫特伦召唤自然的先祖之魂，将其力量施予他的同胞。
notes_loc: 效果无视减益免疫，但是在期间获得减益免疫状态将挣脱控制。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒。施放疯狂生长时，树精卫士从土壤中汲取力量，他的身体急剧增大，持续%bloom_duration%秒。变大后他会获得<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态，移动速度为固定%movement_speed%，%strength_bonus%%%力量加成，并且拥有在%splash_radius%范围内造成%splash_pct%%%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。

official.name: ogre_magi_fireblast
official.desc_loc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
official.lore_loc: The Ogre Magi is easily amused, entertained for hours by playing with fire.
notes_loc: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.
official.scepter_loc: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.

officialZh.name: ogre_magi_fireblast
officialZh.desc_loc: 以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 食人魔魔法师很容易就能被逗乐，玩火就能玩上几个小时。
notes_loc: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，施法速度提升%bonus_cast_speed%%%。

official.name: ogre_magi_ignite
official.desc_loc: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
official.lore_loc: Batter up!
notes_loc: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a %ignite_multicast_aoe% area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.

officialZh.name: ogre_magi_ignite
officialZh.desc_loc: 使目标和另一个随机单位浸透在挥发性化学物质中，导致其瞬间被火焰吞噬。目标处在极度痛苦之中，受到伤害并且移动缓慢。
officialZh.lore_loc: 准备好！
notes_loc: 多重施法将使此技能有几率对%ignite_multicast_aoe%范围内的随机敌方单位进行多次施放。
引燃现在击中已受到作用的单位后会增加持续时间。

official.name: ogre_magi_bloodlust
official.desc_loc: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
official.lore_loc: 'Running's not as fun as hitting... Not one bit fun.'
notes_loc: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_bloodlust_aoe% area of effect to receive Bloodlust.

officialZh.name: ogre_magi_bloodlust
officialZh.desc_loc: 激起一个友方单位的狂暴，增加其移动和攻击速度。对食人魔魔法师自身施放时攻击速度加成更高。可以对防御塔施放。
officialZh.lore_loc: “跑来跑去可没有打人爽……太无聊了。”
notes_loc: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_bloodlust_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得嗜血术效果。

official.name: ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast
official.desc_loc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
official.lore_loc: The 'who-casts-spell-first' argument between himself is solved simply by both casting at once.
notes_loc: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.

officialZh.name: ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast
officialZh.desc_loc: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成%base_damage% + %str_multiplier%倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的%scepter_mana%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 食人魔魔法师关于“谁先施法”的自我争论最后用同时施法解决了。
notes_loc: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。

official.name: ogre_magi_smash
official.desc_loc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
official.lore_loc: There is immense luck involved in Aggron not just setting friends on fire.
notes_loc: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_fireshield_aoe% area of effect to receive Fire Shield.

officialZh.name: ogre_magi_smash
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来%attacks%次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。
officialZh.lore_loc: 阿格隆没把火放到朋友身上就已经是走了大运了。
notes_loc: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_fireshield_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得烈火护盾效果。

official.name: ogre_magi_dumb_luck
official.desc_loc: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

officialZh.name: ogre_magi_dumb_luck
officialZh.desc_loc: 食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。

special_values.name: mana_per_str
special_values.heading_loc: 每点力量提供最大魔法：

special_values.name: mana_regen_per_str
special_values.heading_loc: 每点力量提供魔法恢复：

official.name: ogre_magi_multicast
official.desc_loc: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%%.
official.lore_loc: Despite being largely incapacitated by his IQ, the Ogre Magi's success in battle is attributed to pure skill.
notes_loc: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.
facets_loc: Each point of Ogre Magi's Strength adds %strength_mult%%% to Ogre Magi's Multicast chance.

officialZh.name: ogre_magi_multicast
officialZh.desc_loc: 使食人魔魔法师在单次施法中有概率多次施放同一技能和物品。每%strength_for_one_pct%点力量提升%one_tooltip%%%多重施法几率。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管很大程度上受到智商的制约，但食人魔魔法师仍能依靠纯熟的技巧在战斗中取胜。
notes_loc: 只有指向性技能和物品有几率触发多重施法。
指向性技能和物品额外对食人魔周围一定作用范围内敌人和中立生物生效。火焰爆轰和未精通的火焰爆轰将对同个目标生效多次。
facets_loc: 食人魔魔法师的每点力量值都会使多重施法的几率提升%strength_mult%%%。

official.name: undying_decay
official.desc_loc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
official.lore_loc: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.
notes_loc: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
Affects invisible units.
official.scepter_loc: Increases strength steal.

officialZh.name: undying_decay
officialZh.desc_loc: 不朽尸王偷取区域内所有敌方英雄的力量，造成基础伤害并将敌人的力量据为己有。对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_multiplier%倍伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 生者的力量只不过是借用自死者。
notes_loc: 窃据的力量可以叠加，但是敌方英雄的力量至少为1点。
力量的窃取先于技能造成的伤害。
可以作用隐形单位。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升力量窃取。

official.name: undying_soul_rip
official.desc_loc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
official.lore_loc: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.
notes_loc: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.
facets_loc: Casting Soul Rip on allies increases their Strength by a percentage of Undying's Strength.

officialZh.name: undying_soul_rip
officialZh.desc_loc: 不朽尸王从附近的所有单位身上扯出生命力，并使用它<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>队友或伤害敌人。可以使用噬魂<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>墓碑。
officialZh.lore_loc: 即使是友军也能从不朽尸王的存在中感受到绝望。
notes_loc: 可以治疗墓碑，但是不能治疗或伤害其他建筑。
不会扯出隐身单位、无敌单位、战争迷雾内单位或减益免疫敌人的生命力。
可以扯出减益免疫友军，包括僵尸的生命力。
facets_loc: 对友军施放噬魂会使他们的力量提升，数值为不朽尸王力量的一定百分比。

special_values.name: damage_per_unit
special_values.heading_loc: 每个单位提供伤害/<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>量：

official.name: undying_tombstone
official.desc_loc: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
official.lore_loc: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.
notes_loc: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.
official.shard_loc: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.

officialZh.name: undying_tombstone
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标位置召唤一座墓碑。墓碑会不断在其附近的每个敌方单位身边产生僵尸攻击他们。僵尸拥有死亡渴望技能，使他们的攻击带有减速效果，并且若目标的生命值低于一定百分比，僵尸的攻击和移动速度会提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 挽歌召唤他倒下的战友为死亡之神作战。
notes_loc: 墓碑免疫技能，但是可以被噬魂治疗。
僵尸和墓碑均免疫技能。
如果初始目标死亡或丢失视野，僵尸将会死亡。
officialZh.shard_loc: 墓碑可以对友方英雄施放，让他们躲进墓碑。进入墓碑的英雄%tombstone_bunker_cd%秒内无法离开，离开后同样的时间内无法再次进入。如果英雄在内时墓碑被摧毁，该英雄会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>%tombstone_stun_penalty%秒。

official.name: undying_ceaseless_dirge
official.desc_loc: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.
official.lore_loc: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.

officialZh.name: undying_ceaseless_dirge
officialZh.desc_loc: 不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有死亡之神的挽歌停息，这场死士的行军才会最终结束。

official.name: undying_flesh_golem
official.desc_loc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
official.lore_loc: The flesh of the recently dead add to the power of Dirge's plague.
facets_loc: While transformed into a Flesh Golem, attacks spawn a zombie.

officialZh.name: undying_flesh_golem
officialZh.desc_loc: 不朽尸王变身为一具令人毛骨悚然的血肉傀儡。在这个状态下，他获得一定百分比的力量加成，移动速度加成，并且攻击附带减速和伤害加深效果，还会产生墓碑的僵尸。
officialZh.lore_loc: 新近死者的血肉增强了挽歌瘟疫的力量。
facets_loc: 变身为血肉傀儡后，每次攻击会产生一个僵尸。

official.name: rubick_telekinesis
official.desc_loc: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
official.lore_loc: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.
notes_loc: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
official.shard_loc: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.

officialZh.name: rubick_telekinesis
officialZh.desc_loc: 拉比克利用他的隔空取物能力，将敌人短暂抬到空中，然后猛投向地面。被投下的单位会砸晕落地点附近的敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 即使是最伟大的魔导师也会将他的力量用来娱乐。
notes_loc: 目标滞空时，拉比克可以使用次级技能将目标扔往目标方向。
单位落地后，自身不会受到范围眩晕效果。
officialZh.shard_loc: 可以对自身或友军施放隔空取物。投掷距离增加至%max_land_distance%，投掷延迟降低至%shard_teammate_throw_delay%秒。

official.name: rubick_fade_bolt
official.desc_loc: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
official.lore_loc: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.

officialZh.name: rubick_fade_bolt
officialZh.desc_loc: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在处决刺杀他的人时，拉比克最爱用的法术其实是一个相当简单的咒语。

official.name: rubick_arcane_supremacy
official.desc_loc: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
official.lore_loc: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...
facets_loc: Casting a spell temporarily increases the area of effect for all subsequent spells.

officialZh.name: rubick_arcane_supremacy
officialZh.desc_loc: 拉比克对奥术的熟稔使他拥有更远的施法距离，和额外技能增强。
officialZh.lore_loc: 不是每一个魔导师都能成为大魔导师……
facets_loc: 施放技能会暂时提升拉比克施放后续技能的作用范围。

official.name: rubick_spell_steal
official.desc_loc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
official.lore_loc: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.
notes_loc: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
official.shard_loc: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
official.scepter_loc: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
facets_loc: Stolen spells also have lower mana cost.

officialZh.name: rubick_spell_steal
officialZh.desc_loc: 拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
officialZh.lore_loc: ……不过即使是他们那些低级魔法也能变得非常实用。
notes_loc: 无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。
officialZh.shard_loc: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。
facets_loc: 窃取技能的魔法消耗也会降低。

special_values.name: stolen_spell_cooldown_percent
special_values.heading_loc: 窃取的技能冷却时间减少：

official.name: rubick_curiosity
official.desc_loc:
Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

officialZh.name: rubick_curiosity
officialZh.desc_loc:
拉比克现在每级获得%curiosity_per_level%层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供%curiosity_attack_damage%点基础攻击力，%curiosity_modifier_amp%%%增益/减益持续时间，和%curiosity_aoe_bonus%作用范围加成。

如果拉比克看到%charge_radius%范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得%curiosity_per_spell_cast%层奇心，持续%curiosity_duration%秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后%grace_period%秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得%curiosity_per_kill%层奇心。

official.name: disruptor_thunder_strike
official.desc_loc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
official.lore_loc: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.
official.shard_loc: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.
facets_loc: Thunder Strike additionally hits all enemies within Kinetic Field. Thunder Strike Slow duration is increased to %slow_duration%s.

officialZh.name: disruptor_thunder_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 用闪电反复打击目标单位。每次打击会伤害附近小范围内的敌方单位，并施加%slow_duration%秒的%slow_amount%%%攻击速度和移动速度降低效果。提供目标的视野。
officialZh.lore_loc: 干扰者的充能线圈有时会超负荷，然后他的敌人就只剩一块烤焦的盔甲碎片或者一簇毛皮了。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升风雷之击的施法距离和打击次数。还可以对地施放，使风雷之击先潜伏最多%shard_ground_delay%秒，并附着到第一个进入作用范围的敌人身上。
facets_loc: 风雷之击还会额外打击动能力场内所有敌人。风雷之击的减速时间提升至%slow_duration%秒。

official.name: disruptor_glimpse
official.desc_loc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
official.lore_loc: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.
notes_loc: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

officialZh.name: disruptor_glimpse
officialZh.desc_loc: 将目标英雄传送回他%backtrack_time%秒前所在位置。瞬间消灭幻象单位。根据瞥视距离的一定百分比造成伤害，不能超过最大伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对电流的把玩能产生出人意料的结果。
notes_loc: 飞行时间由目标的飞行距离决定。

official.name: disruptor_kinetic_field
official.desc_loc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
official.lore_loc: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.
notes_loc: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.
official.shard_loc: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

officialZh.name: disruptor_kinetic_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一个敌人无法通过的环形动能屏障。
officialZh.lore_loc: 干扰者的坐骑不会受到那摧残敌人的狂风的影响。
notes_loc: 力场不能困住减益免疫单位。
officialZh.shard_loc: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

official.name: disruptor_kinetic_fence
official.desc_loc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.
official.lore_loc: For a brief moment, it's as if the wind itself had turned solid.

officialZh.name: disruptor_kinetic_fence
officialZh.desc_loc: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 有一瞬间，就好像风本身都凝固了。

official.name: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
official.desc_loc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
official.lore_loc: Safe harbor found inside the storm.
notes_loc: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.

officialZh.name: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
officialZh.desc_loc: 每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。
officialZh.lore_loc: 风暴中找到的避风港。
notes_loc: %damage_reset_interval%秒后伤害计数会重置。

official.name: disruptor_static_storm
official.desc_loc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
official.lore_loc: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.
official.scepter_loc: Mutes items.

officialZh.name: disruptor_static_storm
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>区域内的所有敌方单位。伤害刚开始时很低，但会在持续时间内逐渐增加。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有高地人能从杜鲁德的夏日风暴中幸存。
officialZh.scepter_loc: <font color='#c3e1db'>锁闭</font>物品。

official.name: nyx_assassin_impale
official.desc_loc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
official.lore_loc: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.
notes_loc: The spikes move at %speed% units per second, over %length% range.
Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

officialZh.name: nyx_assassin_impale
officialZh.desc_loc: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位受到伤害，然后被抛向空中，落地时被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 所有狂热的圣甲虫都拥有地底通道的秘密学识，并用其为自己带来优势。
notes_loc: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%，最远作用距离为%length%。
穿刺不会被林肯法球格挡。

official.name: nyx_assassin_jolt
official.desc_loc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
official.lore_loc: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.
facets_loc: Mind Flare burns mana equal to a percentage of the target's max mana.

officialZh.name: nyx_assassin_jolt
officialZh.desc_loc: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有虫后养育的才能使用他们的想法去触碰周围的世界。
facets_loc: 神智爆裂会燃烧相当于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。

official.name: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
official.desc_loc:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
official.lore_loc: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.
notes_loc: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

officialZh.name: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
officialZh.desc_loc:
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>攻击者。激活尖刺外壳不会打破复仇的<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态。

钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>周围的敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然甲壳相对较薄，不过保护身体的是一圈伸缩自如，剃刀般锋利的尖刺。
notes_loc: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
尖刺外壳只有在受到玩家控制来源的伤害后会反弹。
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

official.name: nyx_assassin_burrow
official.desc_loc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
official.lore_loc: Some castes of zealot scarab are known to create small burrows to lie in wait, ready to ambush their prey.
notes_loc: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.

officialZh.name: nyx_assassin_burrow
officialZh.desc_loc: 司夜刺客经过短时间的掘地后钻入地下。钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。钻地后司夜刺客固定在原地，无法攻击，并且是<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态。同时司夜刺客受到的所有伤害都会降低。
