officialZh.lore_loc: 狂热圣甲虫中某些层级的成名绝技是挖掘小型洞穴，守株待兔，做好伏击猎物的准备。
notes_loc: 施放复仇将取消钻地状态。

special_values.name: carapace_radius
special_values.heading_loc: 钻地后尖刺外壳作用范围：

official.name: nyx_assassin_neuro_sting
official.desc_loc: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

officialZh.name: nyx_assassin_neuro_sting
officialZh.desc_loc: 司夜刺客对敌人造成伤害还会燃烧造成伤害一定百分比的魔法。

official.name: nyx_assassin_vendetta
official.desc_loc: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
official.lore_loc: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.
notes_loc: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.
official.shard_loc: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

officialZh.name: nyx_assassin_vendetta
officialZh.desc_loc: 司夜刺客进入<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态并获得移动速度加成。如果司夜刺客以攻击打破<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。司夜刺客当次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且攻击动作加快%attack_animation_bonus%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 圣甲虫为女王的荣耀而杀戮。
notes_loc: 如果在隐身期间使用了技能，或者隐身时间结束，额外伤害的效果将会消失。
会在造成额外伤害前施加破坏效果。
officialZh.shard_loc: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。在复仇的最初%free_pathing_duration%秒内，司夜刺客为极速状态，并且移动无视地形。

official.name: naga_siren_mirror_image
official.desc_loc:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.
notes_loc: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

officialZh.name: naga_siren_mirror_image
officialZh.desc_loc:
制造多个受娜迦海妖控制的镜像。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 司里希丝天生就很强大，并且众人皆知其难以追踪。
notes_loc: 娜迦海妖在施法时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
施放后，将会移除娜迦海妖身上大部分效果。
施放时现有的镜像幻象将被摧毁。

official.name: naga_siren_ensnare
official.desc_loc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
official.lore_loc: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.
official.scepter_loc: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

officialZh.name: naga_siren_ensnare
officialZh.desc_loc: 打断目标的动作并将其困在原地，使其无法移动或闪烁。可以对海妖之歌作用下的单位施放。
officialZh.lore_loc: 想要逃脱鱼人的追杀，唯一的办法就是一开始就不要与之作对。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。

official.name: naga_siren_rip_tide
official.desc_loc: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
official.lore_loc: A torrent from the Deep Ones crushes the defenses of the Siren's enemies.
notes_loc: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.

officialZh.name: naga_siren_rip_tide
officialZh.desc_loc: 娜迦海妖和她的幻象每经过%hits%次攻击后就会对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 海妖的敌人被深海涌出的洪流冲刷，防御遭到粉碎。
notes_loc: 使用激流不会打断持续施法。

official.name: naga_siren_eelskin
official.desc_loc: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within %radius% radius.

officialZh.name: naga_siren_eelskin
officialZh.desc_loc: 娜迦海妖拥有闪避加成，%radius%内每增加一个娜迦海妖都会提升。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: naga_siren_song_of_the_siren
official.desc_loc: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
official.lore_loc: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.
notes_loc: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.
official.shard_loc: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.

officialZh.name: naga_siren_song_of_the_siren
officialZh.desc_loc: 娜迦海妖周围的所有敌人受到魔法影响陷入停滞状态，既无法行动也不会受到攻击。再次使用海妖之歌可以提前停止效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 司里希丝具有魔力的声音使敌人不自觉地沉醉其中，同时在需要的时候召唤她的族人前来助战。
notes_loc: 海妖之歌作用下的单位处于无敌状态，不会受到任何伤害。
海妖之歌的作用范围以娜迦海妖为中心，如果她远离了作用单位，他们将会醒来。
officialZh.shard_loc: 海妖之歌范围内友军每秒会恢复一定百分比的生命和魔法。

official.name: keeper_of_the_light_illuminate
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
official.lore_loc: Ezalor's hidden light reveals itself in marvelous fashion.
notes_loc: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

officialZh.name: keeper_of_the_light_illuminate
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
officialZh.lore_loc: 伊扎洛深藏的光芒显现之时璀璨夺目。
notes_loc: 在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。

official.name: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
official.desc_loc: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: The Primordial light turns the tides of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.
notes_loc: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

officialZh.name: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
officialZh.desc_loc: 一道致盲之光在目标区域闪现，把区域内的单位击退到区域边缘，并造成致盲，使他们的部分攻击不能命中。最短击退距离是在%knockback_duration%秒内击退%knockback_distance%距离。
officialZh.lore_loc: 原初的光芒将战局的优势转向伊扎洛和他的盟友。
notes_loc: 落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。

official.name: keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic
official.desc_loc: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
official.lore_loc: In the same vein, Ezalor bestows his harmony among others.
notes_loc: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.

officialZh.name: keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic
officialZh.desc_loc: 恢复目标单位的魔法值，并减少所有冷却中基础技能（非大招）的冷却时间。对自身使用时效果提升%self_bonus%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 通过同样的渠道，伊扎洛将他的协律授予他人。
notes_loc: 查克拉魔法无法减少终极技能的冷却时间。

official.name: keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind
official.desc_loc: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
official.lore_loc: Even a glimpse of the First Light is enough to rob enemies of their senses.
official.shard_loc: Grants %AbilityCharges% charges.

officialZh.name: keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind
officialZh.desc_loc: 削弱一个敌人的魔法抗性，并施加减速效果，目标移动的距离越长，减速效果越大。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就算只是瞥了一眼原初之光，敌人的理智也会被剥夺。
officialZh.shard_loc: 获得%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。

official.name: keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp
official.desc_loc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
official.lore_loc: Though he would not claim to 'know' them, Ezalor holds an uncanny influence over many powerful creatures always willing to come to his aid.
notes_loc: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.

officialZh.name: keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然伊扎洛不会宣扬自己“认识”他们，但他离奇地影响着很多愿意援助他的强大生物。
notes_loc: 幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。

official.name: keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form
official.desc_loc: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.
official.lore_loc: In a flash of light, Ezalor reveals his true nature.
official.shard_loc: Increases illuminate heal.
facets_loc: Grants the Solar Bind ability while active.
Grants the Recall ability while active.

officialZh.name: keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form
officialZh.desc_loc: 伊扎洛暂时使身体发光，获得施法距离加成，提升光明速度的移速加成，并且冲击波将由一个单独的灵魂施法，可以治疗友军。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在一闪而逝的光芒中，伊扎洛展现他真实而原本的形态。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升冲击波的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。
facets_loc: 灵魂形态生效时获得炎阳之缚技能。
使用后获得召回技能。

official.name: keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed
official.desc_loc:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

officialZh.name: keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed
officialZh.desc_loc:
光之守卫每%intelligence_per_speed%点智力都会获得1移动速度。

只要光之守卫移动%movement_per_vision%距离，他就会留下一道光，可以看到%vision_radius%范围，持续%vision_duration%秒。

official.name: wisp_tether
official.desc_loc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
official.lore_loc: The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.
notes_loc: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.
official.shard_loc: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for %damage_to_heal%%% of the damage done.

officialZh.name: wisp_tether
officialZh.desc_loc: 将艾欧和一个友方单位连接在一起，提高双方的移动速度。当艾欧回复生命或魔法时，连在一起的友军将获得一部分回复效果。距离过远时连接将会断开，也可以主动断开连接。羁绊会减速触碰到的敌人。
officialZh.lore_loc: 艾欧善意的接触从不同位面之间带来力量。
notes_loc: 如果羁绊的目标距离艾欧700码以外，艾欧将链接目标并将自己向目标牵引（牵引后相距300码）。
被羁绊连接的单位回复速度相比更快，艾欧满血时也能回复。
艾欧的移动速度与羁绊目标一致。
officialZh.shard_loc: 羁绊会对触碰到的敌人造成伤害。艾欧会回复%damage_to_heal%%%造成伤害。

special_values.name: slow
special_values.heading_loc: 对敌移动/攻击速度降低：

official.name: wisp_spirits
official.desc_loc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
official.lore_loc: Io twists the particles of the universe with its unimaginable capabilities.
notes_loc: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
official.scepter_loc: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

officialZh.name: wisp_spirits
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤五个围绕艾欧起舞的幽魂，对所有碰触到的单位造成伤害。如果碰到的是敌方英雄，幽魂会爆炸，对其附近的所有敌人造成伤害。普通单位碰到幽魂会受到轻微伤害，但是不会使其爆炸。持续时间结束后，幽魂将自动爆炸。
officialZh.lore_loc: 艾欧用它不可思议的力量扭曲了宇宙中的粒子。
notes_loc: 召唤后艾欧可以拉近或拉远幽魂。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 每秒被动产生幽魂围绕艾欧，直至数量上限。幽魂撞到英雄会将其短暂减速。可以主动施放来引爆幽魂。

official.name: wisp_overcharge
official.desc_loc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
official.lore_loc: Drawing on the energy of matter from all worlds, Io begins the unravelling of time.
facets_loc: Overcharge grants attack speed and spell amplification to Io and any Tethered allies.
Overcharge grants armor and magic resistance to Io and any Tethered allies.

officialZh.name: wisp_overcharge
officialZh.desc_loc: 艾欧获得攻击速度、技能增强和基于最大生命值的生命恢复。如果艾欧和一个友军连接，该单位也会获得过载提供的所有增益效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从所有位面的世界吸取一切物质的能量，艾欧开始展示时间的真相。
facets_loc: 过载会使艾欧和羁绊友军获得攻击速度和技能增强。
过载会使艾欧和羁绊友军获得护甲和魔法抗性。

official.name: wisp_spirits_in
official.desc_loc: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

officialZh.name: wisp_spirits_in
officialZh.desc_loc: 让幽魂靠近你。可以切换开关状态。

official.name: wisp_spirits_out
official.desc_loc: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

officialZh.name: wisp_spirits_out
officialZh.desc_loc: 让幽魂远离你。可以切换开关状态。

official.name: wisp_relocate
official.desc_loc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
official.lore_loc: Io is the embodiment of the mystery of the universe.
notes_loc: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.

officialZh.name: wisp_relocate
officialZh.desc_loc: 将艾欧和与其连接的友军传送到地图上任何位置。持续时间结束后艾欧和相连的友军会被传送回原位。双击将传送回己方的泉水。
officialZh.lore_loc: 艾欧本身就是宇宙奥秘的体现。
notes_loc: 敌人在施法延迟期间会在大地图和小地图上目标区域都收到视觉特效提示。
如果艾欧在施法延迟期间被控制，降临将会取消。
如果羁绊连接了友方英雄，该英雄将和你一起被传送。你可以随时断开连接，防止英雄和你一同传送。
只有英雄、类英雄单位和幻象可以降临。

official.name: wisp_equilibrium
official.desc_loc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

officialZh.name: wisp_equilibrium
officialZh.desc_loc: 艾欧获得伤害输出增强，血量越高，数值越高。同时，艾欧还获得生命回复和<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>增强，血量越低，数值越高。

official.name: visage_grave_chill
official.desc_loc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
official.lore_loc: The warmth of the sun is never felt in the dark cold of the Narrow Maze.
notes_loc: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

officialZh.name: visage_grave_chill
officialZh.desc_loc: 维萨吉吸取目标单位的移动和攻击速度，自身和附近的佣兽获得等量加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 温暖的阳光到了黑暗的狭窄迷宫里只剩下寒意。
notes_loc: 两个状态效果是分开驱散的。
速度加成和目标的速度减少相互独立。
维萨吉周围%radius%内的佣兽也将获得黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

official.name: visage_soul_assumption
official.desc_loc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
official.lore_loc: The collected souls of the dead reach out to bring another into their fold.
notes_loc: Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
facets_loc: Soul Assumption kills give %bonus_soul_charge_gold% gold per soul charge, up to %bonus_gold_max_tooltip% gold. Reduced gold from creeps. Enemy heroes killed within %gold_grace_period_hero%s of being affected by Soul Assumption also give gold.

officialZh.name: visage_soul_assumption
officialZh.desc_loc: 每次附近英雄（不论敌我）受到的伤害超过%damage_limit%点，维萨吉就能集聚灵魂精华的能量。将精华释放后，会对目标单位造成基础伤害，每一点集聚的能量还将造成额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 收集的死者亡魂四散而去带回生魂。
notes_loc: 能量点数只计算来自玩家或肉山的伤害，必须大于%damage_min%点小于%damage_max%点。自残型伤害和灵魂超度造成的伤害不计算在内。
facets_loc: 灵魂超度击杀时每点灵魂能量会提供%bonus_soul_charge_gold%金，最高为%bonus_gold_max_tooltip%金。击杀非英雄时获得的金钱有所减少。灵魂超度作用于敌方英雄后%gold_grace_period_hero%秒内英雄阵亡也会获得金钱。

official.name: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
official.desc_loc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
official.lore_loc: Visage's tough scales share equal properties of ghost and stone, making it nearly impervious to blade and magical assault.
notes_loc: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
official.shard_loc: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.

officialZh.name: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
officialZh.desc_loc:
维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。

维萨吉的佣兽在%radius%范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
officialZh.lore_loc: 维萨吉坚硬的鳞片同时具有鬼魂和石像的属性，刀剑和魔法的突袭对他来说不痛不痒。
notes_loc: 每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围%radius%范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复%shard_hp_restoration_pct%%%生命值。

official.name: visage_silent_as_the_grave
official.desc_loc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.
official.lore_loc: Those on the mortal plane are blind to the stirrings of the agents of the afterlife.
official.scepter_loc: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

officialZh.name: visage_silent_as_the_grave
officialZh.desc_loc: 维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在%bonus_duration%秒内拥有额外攻击力。
officialZh.lore_loc: 来世的媒介在尘世间四处扰动，但世人视而不见。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。

official.name: visage_summon_familiars
official.desc_loc:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
official.lore_loc: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's Familiars stand watch over his domain.
notes_loc: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
facets_loc: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

Familiars will automatically attack the target Visage tried to attack last, and will return if that target is out of Visage's attack range, or Visage issues the cancel current action or hold position commands.

The ability can be toggled to the Auto-Cast state to command the Familiars to return to Visage and not leave his side until the state has been disabled.
The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

officialZh.name: visage_summon_familiars
officialZh.desc_loc:
召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
officialZh.lore_loc: 死灵飞龙的佣兽，也是狭窄迷宫的守卫，俯视着他的领地。
notes_loc: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。
facets_loc: 技能可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，期间他们无法攻击或行动。

佣兽会攻击维萨吉最后尝试攻击的目标，如果目标超出了维萨吉的攻击距离，或者维萨吉下达了取消当前动作或固守原地的命令后，佣兽会返回。

技能可以设为自动施法，命令佣兽回到维萨吉身旁，在技能关闭前不会离开。
技能可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，期间他们无法攻击或行动。

official.name: slark_dark_pact
official.desc_loc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.
notes_loc: %delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
You can't kill yourself with this skill.
The pulses stop if Slark dies.

officialZh.name: slark_dark_pact
officialZh.desc_loc:
短暂延迟后，斯拉克牺牲部分生命力，清除大部分负面状态并对自己和周围敌方单位造成伤害。斯拉克自身只受到造成伤害的%self_damage_pct%%%。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 鱼人具有使鳍快速重新生长的能力，这样在重伤下也能救回自己的命。
notes_loc: 经过%delay%秒施法延迟后，每隔%pulse_interval%秒释放1道伤害波造成伤害，总共%total_pulses%道。
每道伤害波还会移除斯拉克身上的负面效果。
不能使用此技能自杀。
如果斯拉克死亡，伤害波将停止释放。

official.name: slark_pounce
official.desc_loc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
official.lore_loc: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
notes_loc: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
official.scepter_loc: Provides charges and increases range.
facets_loc: Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.

officialZh.name: slark_pounce
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。该单位只能在斯拉克着地点附近的有限范围内移动。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在暗黑之礁的服刑期间，斯拉克成长为危险的刺客；举止凶残，无所畏惧。
notes_loc: 施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。
不能束缚减益免疫单位。
斯拉克落地点附近的树木将会被摧毁。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。
facets_loc: 突袭在击中敌方英雄时会施加能量转移的叠加次数。

official.name: slark_saltwater_shiv
official.desc_loc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

officialZh.name: slark_saltwater_shiv
officialZh.desc_loc:
斯拉克用他的海浪短刀划开目标，窃取目标一部分的移动速度、生命恢复和生命回复。

这个效果独立叠加。

official.name: slark_depth_shroud
official.desc_loc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.
official.lore_loc: Nothing worse than a job going bad thanks to some clompy-footed friend.

officialZh.name: slark_depth_shroud
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标地点创造一团云雾。作用范围内所有友军为隐藏状态，受到暗影之舞的作用。
officialZh.lore_loc: 没有比搞砸更难受的事了，全怪某个笨手笨脚的朋友。

official.name: slark_essence_shift
official.desc_loc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
official.lore_loc: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.
notes_loc: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

officialZh.name: slark_essence_shift
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯拉克的攻击会偷走敌方英雄的生命能量，每次吸取他们的%stat_loss%点全属性并转化成自身额外%agi_gain%点敏捷值。只要敌方英雄带着该效果在斯拉克300范围内阵亡，他将永久窃取%stat_loss%点敏捷。
officialZh.lore_loc: 每攻击一次敌人，斯拉克对他们的弱点就多了解一分。
notes_loc: 属性值最少为1点。
斯拉克或受到作用的单位死亡后，阵亡单位因能量转移变化的属性值将回归正常。但是两方的属性值相互独立，并无关联。
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。
破坏会使技能无法获得临时的叠加效果。依然可以获得永久的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

official.name: slark_shadow_dance
official.desc_loc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
official.lore_loc: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.

officialZh.name: slark_shadow_dance
officialZh.desc_loc:
当斯拉克不处于敌方视野内时，他会被动获得移动速度加成和生命恢复。如果受到来自中立单位的伤害，%neutral_disable%秒内会失去被动移速和生命恢复加成。

主动开启后，斯拉克将自己藏进暗影之云，变成隐身状态，不会被反隐手段发现。攻击、施法、使用物品都不会使斯拉克显形，但是敌人可以看见暗影之云。
officialZh.lore_loc: 秘而不宣的第十三个逃犯是个浑身滑溜的敌人。

official.name: medusa_split_shot
official.desc_loc:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
official.lore_loc: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.
notes_loc: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
official.scepter_loc: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

officialZh.name: medusa_split_shot
officialZh.desc_loc:
美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。

额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
officialZh.lore_loc: 遇到了被诅咒的蛇发女妖，那就会领教到她的愤怒。
notes_loc: 次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。

official.name: medusa_mystic_snake
official.desc_loc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
official.lore_loc: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.
notes_loc: Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.
facets_loc: Mystic Snakes returning to Medusa empower her next %max_attacks% attacks with +1 additional damage for each %mana_per_damage% mana restored. Lasts up to %attack_buff_duration%s.

officialZh.name: medusa_mystic_snake
officialZh.desc_loc: 放出一条秘术异蛇在敌人之间跳跃，造成伤害。每次跳跃后伤害和速度都会增加。抵达最后一个目标后，它会返回到美杜莎身上为其恢复魔法值。异蛇会返还所有目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 蛇发女妖所受的诅咒也是她最强大的力量。
notes_loc: 秘术异蛇无法躲避。
facets_loc: 秘术异蛇返回至美杜莎后，根据异蛇回复的魔法值，每%mana_per_damage%点魔法都会使她接下来的%max_attacks%次攻击附带+1 额外伤害。加成状态持续最多%attack_buff_duration%秒。

special_values.name: snake_scale
special_values.heading_loc: 每次跳跃递增伤害/速度：

official.name: medusa_gorgon_grasp
official.desc_loc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
official.lore_loc: The best predators don't even need to pounce.

officialZh.name: medusa_gorgon_grasp
officialZh.desc_loc: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出%volley_count%组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 顶尖的掠食者根本不用扑上去。

official.name: medusa_cold_blooded
official.desc_loc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.
official.lore_loc: Point your gaze at her if you dare.

officialZh.name: medusa_cold_blooded
officialZh.desc_loc: 美杜莎受到指向性技能作用后会对该敌人放出单体的秘术异蛇，把他们变成石头，持续%stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 要是有胆就把目光放她身上。

official.name: medusa_mana_shield
official.desc_loc: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
official.lore_loc: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.
notes_loc: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.
facets_loc: Mana Shield can be activated, draining %aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%% of max mana per second to gain %aspd_increase_rate_pct%%% attack speed bonus per second, up to %aspd_increase_max_tooltip%%%. Maximum effect reached after %aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%s. Buff lasts %aspd_increase_buff_duration%s and Cooldown is %attack_buff_cooldown%s.

officialZh.name: medusa_mana_shield
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一个魔法护盾，消耗美杜莎的魔法值以吸收%absorption_pct%%%的伤害。幻象的伤害吸收系数减少%illusion_percentage%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管美杜莎生来没被赐以永恒的生命，但她所受的诅咒赋予了她独一无二的防御力量。
notes_loc: 伤害的吸收先于任何伤害减免机制，所以提高物理护甲，物理格挡和魔法抗性都不能减少吸收相同伤害所需的魔法。
facets_loc: 魔法盾可以主动开启，每秒消耗%aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%%最大魔法值并每秒获得%aspd_increase_rate_pct%%%攻击速度加成，最高为%aspd_increase_max_tooltip%。%aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%秒后获得最大效果。加成状态持续%aspd_increase_buff_duration%秒。冷却时间为%attack_buff_cooldown%秒。

official.name: medusa_stone_gaze
official.desc_loc: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
official.lore_loc: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.
notes_loc: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.

officialZh.name: medusa_stone_gaze
officialZh.desc_loc: 任何盯着蛇发女妖的敌方单位的攻击速度和移动速度均将被减缓。如果一单位在石化凝视期间盯着蛇发女妖超过%face_duration%秒，该单位会被完全石化。被石化的单位处于<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>状态，受到物理攻击时承受额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 美杜莎的美貌感天动地。
notes_loc: 无论敌方单位是在美杜莎施放技能期间的何时受到石化凝视作用，他受到的技能效果都是满额的持续时间。

official.name: troll_warlord_switch_stance
official.desc_loc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.

Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.
official.lore_loc: Jah'rakal has a variety of ways to get under an enemy's skin.

officialZh.name: troll_warlord_switch_stance
officialZh.desc_loc:
巨魔战将从使用远程攻击切换为近战攻击。近战下巨魔战将的基础攻击间隔降低至%base_attack_time%。

巨魔战将每拥有%attack_speed_interval%攻击速度加成获得%armor_per_interval%点护甲。
officialZh.lore_loc: 杰拉考有很多办法激怒敌人。

official.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged
official.desc_loc: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
official.lore_loc: Only axes fueled by hate whirl with such a deadly spin.
notes_loc: Does not affect Roshan.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
official.scepter_loc:
Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

officialZh.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged
officialZh.desc_loc: 巨魔战将掷出手中的五把飞斧，减速并伤害前方%axe_range%范围锥形区域内的敌方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有注入了憎恨的斧头旋转起来才会如此致命。
notes_loc: 无法作用于肉山。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
旋风飞斧（远程）可以驱散敌人。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。

驱散类型：弱驱散

official.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
official.desc_loc: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
official.lore_loc: Keep your enemies close.
notes_loc: Does not affect Roshan.
official.scepter_loc:
Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

officialZh.name: troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee
officialZh.desc_loc: 巨魔战将掷出两把飞斧环绕在他周围，使敌方单位受到伤害，并且部分普通攻击将不能命中。
officialZh.lore_loc: 要靠近你的敌人。
notes_loc: 无法作用于肉山。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
旋风飞斧（近战）可以驱散自己。降低冷却时间和魔法消耗。

驱散类型：弱驱散

official.name: troll_warlord_fervor
official.desc_loc: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
official.lore_loc: If at first you don't succeed, strike, strike again.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.
official.shard_loc: Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.
facets_loc: Fervor grants armor per stack while in melee form.

officialZh.name: troll_warlord_fervor
officialZh.desc_loc: 当巨魔战将持续攻击同一个目标时，他会攻击得越来越快。如果改变目标，则额外的攻速加成清零。
officialZh.lore_loc: 如果第一下没成功，那就接着出招呗。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏会使阿哈利姆魔晶的几率触发失效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 巨魔战将在攻击敌方单位时拥有%base_chance%%% + 热血战魂叠加次数*%extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%%的几率对远程攻击距离 + %range_buffer%范围内任意单位发动一次额外的远程攻击。
facets_loc: 近战形态下热血战魂的叠加效果提供护甲。

official.name: troll_warlord_berserkers_rage
official.desc_loc:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.
official.lore_loc: Like his anger, Troll Warlord's supply of axes is infinite.

officialZh.name: troll_warlord_berserkers_rage
officialZh.desc_loc:
近战形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率触发诱捕，阻止目标移动或使用位移类技能。另外近战形态下还拥有额外移动速度。

远程形态下巨魔战将的攻击有几率使目标残废，造成额外伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 跟巨魔战将的怒火一样，他的斧头也是源源不断。

official.name: troll_warlord_battle_trance
official.desc_loc:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, slow resistance and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: An adrenaline rush of pure hatred quickens your blades.
notes_loc: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.
facets_loc: During Battle Trance, Troll Warlord has increased max Fervor stacks and no attack speed limit. Battle Trance grants allied heroes %attack_speed_share_percent%%% of the attack speed bonus.

officialZh.name: troll_warlord_battle_trance
officialZh.desc_loc:
巨魔战将释放出强大的战斗专注，强迫自身持续攻击%range%距离内最近的敌方单位，以英雄优先。专注期间不会因伤害而阵亡。提供额外吸血，攻击速度，减速抗性和移动速度。施放时施加弱驱散。 

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 纯粹的仇恨让气血迅速上涌，刀剑也随之飞舞。
notes_loc: 巨魔战将在战斗专注作用下仍然可以使用他的物品技能，但是无法执行其他指令。
斧王的淘汰之刃还是能斩杀巨魔战将。
巨魔战将会获得目标的视野。
facets_loc: 战斗专注期间巨魔战将的热血战魂叠加层数上限变高，而且没有攻击速度上限。战斗专注为友方英雄提供%attack_speed_share_percent%%%攻击速度加成。

special_values.name: stack_limit_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 战斗专注期间热血战魂最高叠加次数：

official.name: centaur_hoof_stomp
official.desc_loc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.
official.lore_loc: When the mighty hoof of the Warrunner touches soil, the tremors are felt far and wide.

officialZh.name: centaur_hoof_stomp
officialZh.desc_loc: 经过短暂的蓄力后，半人马战行者猛踏地面，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并伤害身边的敌方单位。在延迟期间，他被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>，但可以移动。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当战行者健壮的马蹄碰到了土壤，大地的震颤各处都能感受到。

official.name: centaur_double_edge
official.desc_loc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
official.lore_loc: In the spurs of combat, Bradwarden's vicious strikes sometimes cause self-inflicted collateral damage.
notes_loc: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.
official.shard_loc: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of %shard_max_stacks% stacks.

officialZh.name: centaur_double_edge
officialZh.desc_loc: 半人马战行者以猛烈的力量进行近战攻击，对目标周围单位和自身造成伤害。将基于力量值造成额外伤害。此技能无法用于自杀。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在激烈的战斗中，布拉德瓦登凶猛的撞击有时候会对自己造成伤害。
notes_loc: 双刃剑对目标和自身都造成魔法伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 双刃剑可以对敌人造成减速，并且每击中一名英雄都会暂时提升半人马战行者的力量值。每次叠加都会刷新持续时间，最多叠加%shard_max_stacks%次。

official.name: centaur_return
official.desc_loc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
official.lore_loc: Bradwarden has no need to parry his opponent's attacks; his armor-like hide does it for him.
notes_loc: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Retaliate deals damage to towers.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

officialZh.name: centaur_return
officialZh.desc_loc: 半人马战行者向攻击他的单位发出反击。反弹固定伤害加上自身力量的一定百分比。对防御塔的伤害减半。
officialZh.lore_loc: 布拉德瓦登无需回避对手的攻击；这由他那盔甲般的马皮负责。
notes_loc: 反伤会在受到攻击时触发。
反伤能对防御塔造成伤害。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

official.name: centaur_work_horse
official.desc_loc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.
official.lore_loc: It is a great honor to be offered a ride by Centaur Warrunner and a grave mistake to refuse it.

officialZh.name: centaur_work_horse
officialZh.desc_loc: 半人马战行者套上一辆便车。开启后半人马战行者获得当前等级奔袭冲撞的加成效果，而且可以对友方目标施放便车。
officialZh.lore_loc: 能够得到半人马战行者的搭乘邀请是莫大的荣幸，而拒绝则是严重的错误。

official.name: centaur_stampede
official.desc_loc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.
official.lore_loc: The great belt of Omexe, which labels Bradwarden as the greatest warrior of his kind, incites his fellow gladiators to follow him into barbarous combat.

officialZh.name: centaur_stampede
officialZh.desc_loc: 半人马战行者带领所有队友向胜利冲锋，所有友方英雄达到极限移动速度，并使踩到的敌人减速。每个敌人只会受到一次踩踏作用，并受到基于半人马战行者力量值的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 欧梅克斯的巨大腰带，彰显着布拉德瓦登是同族中最伟大的战士，激励着他的格斗士同伴在野蛮的战斗中跟随他。

official.name: centaur_horsepower
official.desc_loc:
Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%%% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

officialZh.name: centaur_horsepower
officialZh.desc_loc:
半人马战行者获得移动速度加成，数值为%strength_to_movement_pct%%%自身力量值。

这个移动速度加成不与鞋类物品叠加。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: magnataur_shockwave
official.desc_loc: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.
official.lore_loc: Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.
facets_loc: Increases the max level of Shockwave. Level %max_level% Shockwave causes it to return towards Magnus's current location after reaching max length. The return Shockwave travels %return_shockwave_bonus_distance% distance further and hits enemies a second time for %return_damage_pct_tooltip%%% of the damage.

officialZh.name: magnataur_shockwave
officialZh.desc_loc: 马格纳斯放出一道能量波，对一条直线上的敌方单位造成伤害，并将他们朝自身牵引，同时受到短暂减速效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 杰尔拉克山体并不稳定，马格纳斯已经学会如何将山体里的回响引导出来。
facets_loc: 提升震荡波的最高等级。%max_level%级震荡波会在到达最大长度后会返回至马格纳斯的当前位置。返回的震荡波行进距离增加%return_shockwave_bonus_distance%，对再次击中敌人并造成%return_damage_pct_tooltip%%%伤害。

official.name: magnataur_empower
official.desc_loc:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
official.lore_loc: With a deep bellow, Magnus displays his true power.
notes_loc: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.

officialZh.name: magnataur_empower
officialZh.desc_loc:
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。

授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有%self_multiplier%%%额外效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 随着一声怒吼，马格纳斯展示了他真正的力量。
notes_loc: 攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

official.name: magnataur_skewer
official.desc_loc: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
official.lore_loc: Magnoceros horns are valuable in direct proportion to their danger to prospective merchants.
notes_loc: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
official.shard_loc: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.

officialZh.name: magnataur_skewer
officialZh.desc_loc: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对潜在的商人来说，半人犀牛的犀角价值与犀角能够造成的破坏成正比。
notes_loc: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

official.name: magnataur_horn_toss
official.desc_loc: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.
official.lore_loc: Survivors of Joerlak will never forget the sight of Magnus tossing countless enemies into rivers of fire and clouds of ash.

officialZh.name: magnataur_horn_toss
officialZh.desc_loc: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空%air_duration%秒并处于<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 杰尔拉克山的幸存者不会忘记那一幕，马格纳斯把无数的敌人抛进火焰的河流和灰烬的云朵。

official.name: magnataur_solid_core
official.desc_loc: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

officialZh.name: magnataur_solid_core
officialZh.desc_loc: 马格纳斯的<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>得到提升，并且受到敌人技能和物品的击退效果减少。

official.name: magnataur_reverse_polarity
official.desc_loc: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.
official.lore_loc: Magnus fights with the fury of the erupting Mt. Joerlak.

officialZh.name: magnataur_reverse_polarity
officialZh.desc_loc: 马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 作战时愤怒的马格纳斯如同喷发的杰尔拉克山。

official.name: shredder_whirling_death
official.desc_loc: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.
official.lore_loc: In the case that Rizzrack gets surrounded by the vines and plants of his nightmares, he has an immediate chainsaw defense.

officialZh.name: shredder_whirling_death
officialZh.desc_loc: 伐木机使极其锋利的刀刃飞旋，对敌人造成伤害并摧毁他周围的树木。如果敌方英雄受到了作用，他的主属性将在短时间内降低少许。如果该技能施放过程中砍倒了树木则会根据砍倒的数量造成额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在瑞兹拉克被梦魇般的藤蔓和植物包围的情况下，他马上操起链锯进行自卫。

official.name: shredder_timber_chain
official.desc_loc: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.
official.lore_loc: You never know when you might need to escape from malevolent saplings.
facets_loc: When Timbersaw collides with the target tree, it shatters, sending %tree_splinter_count% splinters in all directions, up to %tree_splinter_distance% distance. If a splinter hits an enemy, they take damage and are slowed for a brief duration.

officialZh.name: shredder_timber_chain
officialZh.desc_loc: 伐木机发射一条锯链，锯链会嵌入第一棵碰到的树里，然后将他拉向那棵树。行进过程中任何碰到的敌方单位都会受到伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 你可猜不到自己什么时候需要逃离邪恶的树苗。
facets_loc: 伐木机与目标树木相撞时，树木会破碎，向四面八方放出%tree_splinter_count%片碎木，最远为%tree_splinter_distance%距离。如果碎木击中了敌人，将会造成伤害和短时间的减速。

official.name: shredder_reactive_armor
official.desc_loc: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as %stacks_per_hero_attack%x the amount.
official.lore_loc: The saw-suit is equipped to react to the slightest touch with fortified defenses.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
official.scepter_loc: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and %initial_shield% damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw %shield_per_sec% + %shield_per_sec_per_enemy% barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within %radius% radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of %max_shield%. After %duration% seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within %explosion_radius% radius equal to %base_explosion% + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.

officialZh.name: shredder_reactive_armor
officialZh.desc_loc: 伐木机每受到一次物理攻击，他的生命恢复和护甲值都会提升。英雄攻击提供%stacks_per_hero_attack%倍提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 锯齿机器上的设备可以用强化防御来应对轻微的触碰。
notes_loc: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 活性护甲可以主动施放，获得最大叠加次数和%initial_shield%点生命的<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>。<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>的恢复速度为每秒%shield_per_sec% + 伐木机%radius%范围内每名敌方英雄都会增加%shield_per_sec_per_enemy%，最高为%max_shield%。%duration%秒后伐木机会对%explosion_radius%范围内每个英雄造成伤害，数值为%base_explosion% + <font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>剩余生命，而且失去全部<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>。

official.name: shredder_flamethrower
official.desc_loc: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.
official.lore_loc: A single saw can only cut so much. A single spark can burn forever.

officialZh.name: shredder_flamethrower
officialZh.desc_loc: 伐木机向面朝的方向放出一道火焰。施加一个负面效果，造成每秒伤害，并减缓敌人的移动速度。对建筑造成的伤害有所减少。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一把锯子只能砍那么点东西。一个火花可以永远燃烧下去。

official.name: shredder_chakram
official.desc_loc: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
official.lore_loc: The ultimate in anti-flora weaponry.
notes_loc: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over %break_distance% distance away.

officialZh.name: shredder_chakram
officialZh.desc_loc: 伐木机将主锯刃射向目标区域，锯刃会高速旋转，对周围的敌方单位造成伤害。在锯刃作用范围内的敌方单位每损失最大生命值的%slow_health_percentage%%%，他们的移动速度都会进一步被降低。锯刃在发射和收回的过程中都将造成伤害并砍倒碰到的树木。在发射锯刃后伐木机将无法攻击，同时会持续消耗魔法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 消灭植物的终极武器。
notes_loc: 如果伐木机魔法不足或移动超过%break_distance%距离，锯齿飞轮将会飞回。

official.name: shredder_exposure_therapy
official.desc_loc: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

officialZh.name: shredder_exposure_therapy
officialZh.desc_loc: 伐木机只要摧毁一棵树就会获得魔法。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo
official.desc_loc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
official.lore_loc: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.
facets_loc: Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.

officialZh.name: bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo
officialZh.desc_loc: 用鼻涕包裹一个敌方单位，降低护甲和移动速度，持续%goo_duration%秒。多次施放的效果会叠加，并且刷新持续时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 被大雪困住的时候着了凉，但是钢背兽让这为他所用。
facets_loc: 提升了最大叠加层数和每层护甲降低。

official.name: bristleback_quill_spray
official.desc_loc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.
notes_loc: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

officialZh.name: bristleback_quill_spray
officialZh.desc_loc: 将尖刺喷射向敌人，对钢背兽附近的敌人造成伤害。任何单位最近%quill_stack_duration%秒内每次受到刺针扫射的打击都会受到额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 执法者的荣誉维护起来非常棘手。他的刺针也是。
notes_loc: 刺针扫射的伤害不能被伤害格挡类技能减免。

official.name: bristleback_bristleback
official.desc_loc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
official.lore_loc: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
notes_loc: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
official.scepter_loc: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
facets_loc: Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.

officialZh.name: bristleback_bristleback
officialZh.desc_loc: 如果伤害来自钢背兽的侧面或者背后，他所受的伤害将会降低。钢背兽每次从背后受到一定量伤害会自动释放一次当前等级的刺针扫射。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在战斗中背部迎人或许正好合适。
notes_loc: 钢背兽的背面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈70度角的扇形区域。
钢背兽的侧面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈110度角的扇形区域，背面的扇形区域不算在内。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 钢毛后背增加主动效果。钢背兽将背部转向目标方向，%activation_delay%秒后以%activation_spray_interval%秒间隔朝背部前方的锥形范围强行连续喷出%activation_num_quill_sprays%次刺针扫射。钢背兽在这段时间内面朝方向被锁定，被缴械，并且移动速度减缓%activation_movement_speed_pct%%%。
facets_loc: 他受到伤害时不再释放刺针扫射，而是对附近所有敌人发射当前等级的粘稠鼻液。

official.name: bristleback_hairball
official.desc_loc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.
official.lore_loc: Every part of Bristleback's body is a weapon -- even the parts he accidentally swallowed.

officialZh.name: bristleback_hairball
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标地点咳出一团满是刺针的毛团。毛团会在该地点爆开，范围内的敌人都将受到多个鼻液叠加效果和单次刺针扫射的作用。
officialZh.lore_loc: 钢背兽身体的每个部位都是武器——就连他不小心吞下的也是。

official.name: bristleback_warpath
official.desc_loc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
official.lore_loc: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.
notes_loc: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Items will not trigger Warpath.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
facets_loc: Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.

Warpath can be activated to grant bonus attack damage and movement speed for a short duration. While Seeing Red, Bristleback's vision is reduced to a narrow cone and he does not receive vision from his allies.

officialZh.name: bristleback_warpath
officialZh.desc_loc: 钢背兽每次使用技能时都会进入狂暴状态，移动速度和攻击力都将提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: “别没事就发火”，他母亲总是这样训斥他。但是在战斗中，火冒三丈将有非凡效果。
notes_loc: 钢背兽的幻象也能继承加成效果。
使用物品不会触发战意。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
facets_loc: 战意提供攻击速度加成，而不只有攻击力。
战意可以主动开启，获得额外的攻击力和移动速度加成，持续较短时间。红光满面期间，钢背兽的视野减少至狭窄的锥形，并且不会获得友军的视野。

official.name: bristleback_prickly
official.desc_loc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

officialZh.name: bristleback_prickly
officialZh.desc_loc: 钢背兽攻击身后的敌方英雄时拥有额外伤害和负面效果持续时间增强。

special_values.name: amp_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 伤害和负面效果持续时间增强：

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: tusk_ice_shards
official.desc_loc: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for %shard_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: In the frozen tundra near the Barrier, after the last sun of autumn has set, ice can form with alarming speed.
notes_loc: Creates an impassable barrier.

officialZh.name: tusk_ice_shards
officialZh.desc_loc: 巨牙海民将数块寒冰碎片压缩成蕴含冰冻能量的冰球，对所有接触到冰球的敌人造成伤害。冰球到达目标地点时会产生一个障碍物，持续%shard_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在冰盾附近的冻原上，秋天最后一个日落后，结冰的速度非常惊人。
notes_loc: 将创造不可通行的障碍。

official.name: tusk_snowball
official.desc_loc: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
official.lore_loc: Tales are still told of the wild feat that ended the grand brawl at White Fields.
notes_loc: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.

officialZh.name: tusk_snowball
officialZh.desc_loc: 巨牙海民开始卷成雪球。右键点击%snowball_grab_radius%范围内的友方英雄能使其加入雪球。发动雪球后，雪球经过的单位将会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并受到伤害。雪球每卷入一个英雄，它的伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间都会得到提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 至今还有故事在讲述白色荒原上终结那场空前格斗的狂野之举。
notes_loc: 雪球在发动后经过最大3秒将会解体。
使用发动雪球技能就能提前发动雪球。
幻象不会进入雪球，但是米波的克隆体以及巨牙海民控制的其他单位将一同进入雪球。
米波的分身也能卷入雪球，并提升雪球的伤害。
队友可以点击雪球，使自己进入雪球。

special_values.name: stun_duration_bonus
special_values.heading_loc: 每个英雄提升<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间：

official.name: tusk_tag_team
official.desc_loc: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts %debuff_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Even far from Cobalt, Tusk carries the 'Barrier Chill' in his very bones.
notes_loc: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.

officialZh.name: tusk_tag_team
officialZh.desc_loc: 主动使用后暂时施加一个具有负面效果的光环，使作用范围内的敌人被攻击时承受额外物理伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。持续%debuff_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就算远离钴蓝冰原，巨牙海民骨子里还是有着“寒战屏障”。
notes_loc: 影响来自友方英雄、巨牙海民和他控制的所有单位的普通攻击。

official.name: tusk_drinking_buddies
official.desc_loc: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
official.lore_loc: The only thing better than finding a good drinking buddy is finding an equally good enemy the two of you can punch.
notes_loc: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within %min_distance% range of each other.
Cannot be used during Snowball.

officialZh.name: tusk_drinking_buddies
officialZh.desc_loc: 巨牙海民伸出手来触碰友方单位，拉近彼此。触碰后巨牙海民和他的友军获得移动速度和护甲加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 比找到一个好酒友更好的只有唯一一件事，就是找到和你们俩势均力敌的劲敌。
notes_loc: 如果巨牙海民和目标友军相距在%min_distance%距离以内，就不会拉动他们。
在雪球期间无法使用。

official.name: tusk_walrus_kick
official.desc_loc: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within %search_radius% radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by %creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% if kicking a creep.
official.lore_loc: Tusk may have made his name with his fists, but the wise enemy is wary of any and all limbs.

officialZh.name: tusk_walrus_kick
officialZh.desc_loc: 将最近的敌方单位向目标方向踢上一脚，对其造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，伤害和减速。另外对落地区域%search_radius%范围内所有英雄造成伤害。飞踢非英雄单位会使冷却时间减少%creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巨牙海民的拳头大名鼎鼎，但聪明的敌人会提防所有肢体动作。

official.name: tusk_walrus_punch
official.desc_loc: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
official.lore_loc: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.
notes_loc: Walrus PUNCH has true strike.

officialZh.name: tusk_walrus_punch
officialZh.desc_loc: 巨牙海民为他强力的海象神拳做好准备，下一次攻击将会造成额外伤害并暴击，同时将目标打到半空中。
officialZh.lore_loc: 谁打出第一拳往往不重要，看的可是最后一拳。
notes_loc: 海象神拳！拥有克敌机先效果。

official.name: tusk_bitter_chill
official.desc_loc: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a %radius% unit radius.

officialZh.name: tusk_bitter_chill
officialZh.desc_loc: 被动降低%radius%范围内所有敌方英雄的攻击速度。

official.name: skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt
official.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
official.lore_loc: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
notes_loc: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.
official.shard_loc: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

officialZh.name: skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt
officialZh.desc_loc: 天怒法师施放出缓慢移动的奥术鹰群，对敌方单位造成基于天怒法师智力值的伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 面对苍白之巢内无穷的诡计，只有沉稳的聪明人才能幸存。
notes_loc: 鹰群移动得非常缓慢（500移速），提供325范围的视野。击中目标后，将给予目标区域的视野，持续3.34秒。
奥法鹰隼无法被躲避。
officialZh.shard_loc: 天怒法师施放奥法鹰隼时，会产生%total_bolt_count%个鹰隼，其中一个飞往原目标，而另外的两个飞往原目标附近%extra_bolt_search_radius%范围内随机敌人。以英雄为首要目标。

official.name: skywrath_mage_concussive_shot
official.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
official.lore_loc: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.
notes_loc: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
Damages creeps around the impact area.
Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
official.scepter_loc: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

officialZh.name: skywrath_mage_concussive_shot
officialZh.desc_loc: 天怒法师释放一个远距离的光弹，将击中超大范围内最近的英雄。击中后会对英雄附近范围内所有单位造成伤害和减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 侍奉苍白之巢王庭就会对身边的暗流涌动不加关注。必须要时刻明白周围最近的危险所在。
notes_loc: 如果作用范围内没有英雄或英雄处于迷雾中，震荡光弹将以最近的敌方小兵或中立生物为目标。
击中英雄后附近的非英雄单位也会受到伤害。
光弹将给予400范围的附近视野，击中后将获得目标区域的视野，持续3.34秒。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 天怒法师施放震荡光弹时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

official.name: skywrath_mage_ancient_seal
official.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
official.lore_loc: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.
notes_loc: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
official.scepter_loc: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

officialZh.name: skywrath_mage_ancient_seal
officialZh.desc_loc: 天怒法师利用上古符文将目标单位封印，目标单位将被<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>，受到魔法伤害时将承受额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一个神圣的咒语，只要被亚未里亚的符印所包围就必然在无声的忏悔中受难。
notes_loc: 减少魔法抗性的效果对非英雄单位无效。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 天怒法师施放上古封印时，会随机对原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人施放相同的技能。以英雄为首要目标。

official.name: skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion
official.desc_loc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.
official.lore_loc: The court mages of Skywrath may only deploy their magic in defense of the kingdom and the throne.

officialZh.name: skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion
officialZh.desc_loc: 每次天怒法师用技能对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时，他都会获得小型的<font color='#1278b9'>魔法伤害护盾</font>。每个加成状态独立叠加。
officialZh.lore_loc: 天怒王国的当朝法师只能使用他们的法力来保卫王国和王座。

official.name: skywrath_mage_mystic_flare
official.desc_loc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.
notes_loc: Mystic Flare only affects Heroes. Mystic Flare does not damage creep heroes.
Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.
official.scepter_loc: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within %scepter_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

officialZh.name: skywrath_mage_mystic_flare
officialZh.desc_loc: 天怒法师操控终极魔力，召唤精准致命的奥术力场毁灭对手。%duration%秒期间对范围内所有敌方英雄造成大量伤害，伤害由所有英雄平摊。
officialZh.lore_loc: 天怒一族中只有勤加修炼的法师才能将苍天塑造成这样的风暴。
notes_loc: 神秘之耀只会作用于英雄。神秘之耀不会对类英雄单位造成伤害。
神秘之耀在没有敌方英雄时将对敌方非英雄单位造成伤害。
神秘之耀会立刻摧毁幻象。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 天怒法师施放神秘之耀时，原目标附近%scepter_radius%范围内另一个敌人的位置上也会产生一个神秘之耀。以英雄为首要目标。

official.name: abaddon_death_coil
official.desc_loc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
official.lore_loc: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.
notes_loc: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.
facets_loc: Mist Coil also deals %damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%% attack damage and applies effects from items and abilities. Self Damage increased when targeting enemies.

officialZh.name: abaddon_death_coil
officialZh.desc_loc: 亚巴顿以自身的部分生命为代价，释放出一团致命迷雾，可以对敌方单位造成伤害，或者<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 亚巴顿的气息中充盈着来自魔霭圣池的神秘之汽，他能随意将其释放。
notes_loc: 亚巴顿不能使用此技能自杀。
facets_loc: 迷雾缠绕还会造成%damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%%攻击伤害，并且施加物品和技能的效果。对敌人施放时对自身的伤害增加。

official.name: abaddon_aphotic_shield
official.desc_loc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.
notes_loc: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.
official.shard_loc: %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
facets_loc: Damage barrier amount increased, but no longer bursts upon expiration. %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies. Increases cooldown.

officialZh.name: abaddon_aphotic_shield
officialZh.desc_loc:
召唤黑暗能量环绕友方单位，驱散他们并创造一个<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>，<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>在消失前能吸收一定量的伤害。<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>消失或被摧毁后将会爆炸，对附近区域的单位造成伤害，伤害值为<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>的最大吸收量。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 升腾的黑雾将敌人的招数一一吞噬，如同吞噬日光。
notes_loc: 不论护盾因持续时间结束或吸收足够伤害后被摧毁都将造成最大伤害。
爆炸将不会对战争迷雾内单位造成伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 会对附近敌人造成吸收伤害的%absorb_to_damage%%%。
facets_loc: 伤害护盾数值提升，但是护盾被摧毁后不再爆炸。%absorb_to_damage%%%吸收伤害会反弹给附近的敌人。增加冷却时间。

official.name: abaddon_frostmourne
official.desc_loc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_pct%%%.
official.lore_loc: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.

officialZh.name: abaddon_frostmourne
officialZh.desc_loc: 亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。对建筑的持续伤害减少%tower_dps_pct%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 受洗之人能从圣池中汲取能量，而魔霭的恩赐会让一无所知的人逐渐衰弱。

official.name: abaddon_withering_mist
official.desc_loc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for %duration%s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by %heal_reduction_pct%%% if they are below %hp_threshold_pct%%% HP.

officialZh.name: abaddon_withering_mist
officialZh.desc_loc: 对敌人造成伤害时会施加凋零迷雾的负面效果，持续%duration%秒。受作用敌人如果血量低于%hp_threshold_pct%%%，那么生命回复会降低%heal_reduction_pct%%%。

official.name: abaddon_borrowed_time
official.desc_loc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding.  What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.
notes_loc: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
official.scepter_loc: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than %ally_threshold_scepter% damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.
facets_loc: While Borrowed Time is active, Abaddon and enemies within %immolate_aoe% radius take %immolate_damage% damage per second.

officialZh.name: abaddon_borrowed_time
officialZh.desc_loc:
启动后驱散自身，所有受到的伤害转而产生<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。只要技能不在冷却中，在生命值低于%hp_threshold%点时技能会自动启动。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 魔霭圣池中最为扭曲的馈赠，凡人对死亡的认知在此力量前显得异常可笑。敌之尖刀，我之伤药；死地后生，回光返照。
notes_loc: 在亚巴顿受到眩晕作用时依然可以手动开启回光返照，但是受到沉默作用时不可以。不过被沉默时被动效果依然能生效。
无光之盾在回光返照生效期间不会吸收伤害，因此也不会影响治疗效果。
破坏会使回光返照无法自动触发。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升持续时间。启动回光返照后，亚巴顿附近迷雾缠绕的施法距离内友方英雄受到的伤害超过%ally_threshold_scepter%点时亚巴顿就会自动对其施放迷雾缠绕。
facets_loc: 回光返照生效时亚巴顿和%immolate_aoe%范围内的敌人每秒会受到%immolate_damage%点伤害。

official.name: elder_titan_echo_stomp
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
official.lore_loc: The force of creation still echoes in the stomp of the Titan.
notes_loc: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
official.shard_loc: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.

officialZh.name: elder_titan_echo_stomp
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 创世之力依然在巨神的重踏下回响。
notes_loc: 若同时处于灵体游魂和上古巨神的回音重踏作用范围内将受到两次伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 减少冷却时间。回音重踏可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，使上古巨神完成重踏后会取代灵体游魂。

official.name: elder_titan_ancestral_spirit
official.desc_loc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
official.lore_loc: Like the four fundamentals, Elder Titan exists across all planes at once and can draw other aspects of himself to assist in times of need.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance for %scepter_magic_immune_per_hero% seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.

officialZh.name: elder_titan_ancestral_spirit
officialZh.desc_loc:
上古巨神放出他的灵体游魂，灵魂对任何经过的单位都会造成伤害。当它与巨神合体时，它每伤害过一个单位都会给予若干攻击力和移动速度加成。

灵体游魂拥有回音重踏，回归和自然秩序三个技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 就像四大基本法则，上古巨神在所有位面同时存在，可以在需要协助的时候将其他位面的自己拖入。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得%scepter_magic_immune_per_hero%秒<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态和%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性提升。

official.name: elder_titan_natural_order
official.desc_loc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
official.lore_loc: As it was at the beginning, Elder Titan makes it so again.
notes_loc: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.
official.shard_loc: Every %tick_rate%s that enemy heroes stay under the effect of Natural Order, their armor is reduced by %armor_per_tick%, and magic resistance is reduced by %magic_resistance_per_tick%%%. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
facets_loc: Every %tick_rate%s that enemy heroes stay under the effect of Natural Order, their armor is reduced by %armor_per_tick%, and magic resistance is reduced by %magic_resistance_per_tick%%%. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.

officialZh.name: elder_titan_natural_order
officialZh.desc_loc: 使所有元素降低至基础水平，移除附近敌方单位的基础物理护甲和魔法抗性。护甲降低效果以英雄为中心，魔法抗性降低效果以灵体游魂为中心。
officialZh.lore_loc: 上古巨神又让创世之初重现。
notes_loc: 没有施放灵体游魂时，护甲和魔法抗性降低效果均以上古巨神为中心。
officialZh.shard_loc: 敌方英雄在自然秩序效果下每停留%tick_rate%秒，他们的护甲就会降低%armor_per_tick%点，魔法抗性降低%magic_resistance_per_tick%%%。叠加效果最多可叠加%max_stacks%次。
facets_loc: 敌方英雄在自然秩序效果下每停留%tick_rate%秒，他们的护甲就会降低%armor_per_tick%点，魔法抗性降低%magic_resistance_per_tick%%%。叠加效果最多可叠加%max_stacks%次。

official.name: elder_titan_momentum
official.desc_loc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
notes_loc: Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.

officialZh.name: elder_titan_momentum
officialZh.desc_loc: 上古巨神获得额外护甲，数值为移动速度加成的一定百分比。
notes_loc: 移动速度加成是指高于基础移动速度的部分。
上古巨神被减速到低于基础移动速度时动量不会降低上古巨神的护甲。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: elder_titan_earth_splitter
official.desc_loc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.
official.lore_loc: That which he created, the titan tears asunder.

officialZh.name: elder_titan_earth_splitter
officialZh.desc_loc: 上古巨神向前方放出一道不平坦的裂纹。3秒后裂纹塌陷，范围内的单位将被减速，并受到基于他们自身生命最大值的伤害。其中一半伤害为魔法伤害，另一半为物理伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 巨神创造之世，他亲手将其撕裂。

official.name: legion_commander_overwhelming_odds
official.desc_loc: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a %movement_slow%%% impact slow for %slow_duration%s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
official.lore_loc: The archers of Stonehall are ready at Tresdin's command.
official.shard_loc: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.

officialZh.name: legion_commander_overwhelming_odds
officialZh.desc_loc: 用敌人的数量反制他们，对附近的所有敌人造成伤害，击中时施加%movement_slow%%%减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。范围内每个敌方单位和英雄都会使伤害提升。另外还会向军团指挥官提供攻击速度加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 石堂城的弓箭手就等特蕾丝汀一声令下。
officialZh.shard_loc: 压倒性优势的范围更大，会根据对敌方英雄造成的伤害提供<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>。

official.name: legion_commander_press_the_attack
official.desc_loc:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion is able to inspire any heart.
official.scepter_loc: Increases movement speed and becomes an %radius% area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.

officialZh.name: legion_commander_press_the_attack
officialZh.desc_loc:
移除友方目标单位的负面效果和控制技能，并提升其移动速度和生命恢复，持续一定时间。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 古铜军团的重振号角可以鼓舞人心。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升移动速度，变为%radius%范围型技能，而且使用时总是会作用于军团指挥官。

official.name: legion_commander_moment_of_courage
official.desc_loc: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
official.lore_loc: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.
notes_loc: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.

officialZh.name: legion_commander_moment_of_courage
officialZh.desc_loc: 每当受到攻击达到一定次数，军团指挥官都会对目标立即作出反击，而且此次攻击具有吸血效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 特蕾丝汀知道，敌人出招最狠的时候也是他们最脆弱的时候。
notes_loc: 只有在攻击他人时受到攻击才会触发带有吸血的反击。

official.name: legion_commander_outfight_them
official.desc_loc: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within %radius% range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for %duration%s; allies gain %ally_factor%%% of the value.  This bonus stacks independently.

officialZh.name: legion_commander_outfight_them
officialZh.desc_loc: 如果军团指挥官或附近%radius%范围内的友方英雄施放技能，他们会获得%duration%秒的护甲加成；其中友军获得的数值为%ally_factor%%%。这个加成效果独立叠加。

official.name: legion_commander_duel
official.desc_loc: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
official.lore_loc: To face a soldier of Stonehall in single combat is a challenge few can resist.
notes_loc: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
official.scepter_loc: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.

officialZh.name: legion_commander_duel
officialZh.desc_loc: 军团指挥官强制与目标敌方英雄进行决斗，持续短暂的数秒。决斗开始后双方英雄不能使用任何物品，而目标敌方英雄不能使用技能。如果有英雄在决斗期间死亡，赢得决斗的英雄将永久获得攻击力加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 与石堂城的士兵进行单挑是令人无法抗拒的挑战。
notes_loc: 如果双方距离超过2000，决斗也会结束。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 如果军团指挥官在决斗中获胜，会在她周围自动触发强攻。

official.name: techies_sticky_bomb
official.desc_loc: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.

officialZh.name: techies_sticky_bomb
officialZh.desc_loc: 向目标区域抛出一个粘性炸弹。如果炸弹落在一个敌方英雄身旁，炸弹会粘上去，减缓其移动速度。数秒后炸弹会爆炸，对爆炸区域内造成伤害，并再次施加减速，持续%secondary_slow_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 这样革命性的才华本应与他人分享。

official.name: techies_reactive_tazer
official.desc_loc:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
official.lore_loc: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.

officialZh.name: techies_reactive_tazer
officialZh.desc_loc:
工程师对友军目标放出电荷，使他们短时间内获得移动速度加成。攻击目标的敌人会受到伤害被暂时缴械，并且受到弱驱散效果。

效果结束时，或者用子技能提前引爆后电荷将会爆炸，使范围内所有敌人缴械并受到伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 想要双手稳稳地握住炸弹更需要大量个人空间。

official.name: techies_suicide
official.desc_loc: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
official.lore_loc: Where we going?
notes_loc: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
This ability destroys trees.
facets_loc: Increased Blast Off! damage and self damage.

officialZh.name: techies_suicide
officialZh.desc_loc: 工程师冲到敌人中间，在相遇时引爆炸药，造成大量范围伤害，并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人。引爆时会对工程师造成当前生命值一定百分比的非致死伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 我们是要去哪？
notes_loc: 工程师在此次爆炸中受到的自身伤害为纯粹伤害，而且不会致死。
此技能将摧毁树木。
facets_loc: 提升爆破起飞！伤害和对自身伤害。

special_values.name: hp_cost
special_values.heading_loc: 对自身的当前生命值伤害：

official.name: techies_mutually_assured_destruction
official.desc_loc:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after %explosion_delay%s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
official.shard_loc: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.

officialZh.name: techies_mutually_assured_destruction
officialZh.desc_loc:
工程师获得相当于最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法恢复。

工程师阵亡时，他们会留下一个木桶，在%explosion_delay%秒后爆炸，对范围内敌人造成伤害。伤害数值是根据工程师的最大魔法值。
officialZh.shard_loc: 同归于尽变为主动技能。提升最大魔法值的伤害系数。工程师放置同归于尽木桶后，可以使用子技能手动引爆。同一时间主动技能只能放下一个同归于尽木桶。

official.name: techies_minefield_sign
official.desc_loc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal %bonus_mine_damage_pct%%% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts %lifetime% seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within %trigger_radius% units of a minefield sign, the %aura_radius% units area around the sign will become a minefield for %minefield_duration% seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
official.lore_loc: Watch your step!

officialZh.name: techies_minefield_sign
officialZh.desc_loc:
在指定地点放置警示牌，使作用范围内的感应地雷为无敌状态，并且造成的伤害增加%bonus_mine_damage_pct%%%。同一时间只能存在一个标识。持续%lifetime%秒。

敌方英雄进入标识的%trigger_radius%范围内时标识附近整个%aura_radius%范围变成一片雷区，持续%minefield_duration%秒。敌方单位在区域内移动都会受到伤害。雷区持续时间结束后标识会被摧毁。
officialZh.lore_loc: 别四处乱跑！

official.name: techies_land_mines
official.desc_loc: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
official.lore_loc: The bane of Toterin!
notes_loc: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
