Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.

officialZh.name: techies_land_mines
officialZh.desc_loc: 埋布<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐形</font>的地雷，不会被真实视域检测到，但是有敌方单位在地雷的%radius%生效范围内会显形。敌人在生效范围内停留超过%proximity_threshold%秒会使地雷爆炸，并且魔法抗性会被暂时降低。爆炸对%min_distance%范围内目标造成全额伤害，对边缘造成的伤害减少至%outer_damage%%%。对建筑物造成%building_damage_pct%%%伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 起重港的噩梦！
notes_loc: 感应地雷的%placement_radius%范围内不能再放置地雷。
感应地雷不会阻止中立生物产生。
地雷持续时间没有上限，除非爆炸或被摧毁。
隐形单位也能触发地雷。
敌方英雄将地雷摧毁可以获得30金钱。

official.name: ember_spirit_searing_chains
official.desc_loc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
official.lore_loc: Xin's harshest lessons often employed the use of red-hot chains.
notes_loc: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.

officialZh.name: ember_spirit_searing_chains
officialZh.desc_loc: 灰烬之灵释放出火焰绳索来<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>附近的敌人，将他们困于原地并每秒造成一定伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 炘之严训，炽链相伴。
notes_loc: 将随机选取炘周围的单位作为目标。
不能作用于减益免疫或隐身单位。

official.name: ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist
official.desc_loc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
official.lore_loc: The studied warrior must whip and weave through its enemies, burning each without pause.
notes_loc: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every %attack_interval% seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.
facets_loc: When Sleight of Fist connects with %min_enemies_for_double_sleight% or more enemies, the enemy closest to Ember Spirit will be attacked a second time. Damage for the second attack is reduced by %second_attack_damage_penalty%%%.

officialZh.name: ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist
officialZh.desc_loc: 灰烬之灵以燎原之火的速度横冲直撞，攻击目标区域内所有敌人，随后返回所在位置。对英雄造成额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 顷刻之间，鞭策众敌。
notes_loc: 在施放技能时作用的目标就已决定。
对目标的攻击每次间隔为%attack_interval%秒。
炘拥有的攻击特效（如致命一击、重击、分裂、连锁闪电等效果）在技能攻击期间都能生效。
施放无影拳时间可以使用其他技能和物品。
facets_loc: 无影拳击中的敌人超过%min_enemies_for_double_sleight%个时，距离灰烬之灵最近的敌人会再次受到攻击。第二次攻击的伤害减少%second_attack_damage_penalty%%%。

official.name: ember_spirit_flame_guard
official.desc_loc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
official.lore_loc: An enemy should never be allowed to approach without difficulty.
notes_loc: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional %linger_duration% seconds after application.

officialZh.name: ember_spirit_flame_guard
officialZh.desc_loc: 灰烬之灵用火焰之环将自己包裹起来，会消耗受到的魔法伤害，使受到的魔法伤害被吸收一定百分比。烈火罩开启后会对灰烬之灵周围的敌人造成每秒伤害。<font color='#1278b9'>护盾</font>消失后将失去伤害效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 近身之敌，自讨苦吃。
notes_loc: 魔法伤害的吸收伤害值计算先于任何伤害减免效果。
伤害在施加后会额外粘滞%linger_duration%秒。

official.name: ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant
official.desc_loc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.
official.lore_loc: With blazing speed does a spirit fly!

officialZh.name: ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant
officialZh.desc_loc: 选择残焰，灰烬之灵将向其冲去。
officialZh.lore_loc: 燎原之火，瞬息将至！

official.name: ember_spirit_immolation
official.desc_loc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
notes_loc: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
official.shard_loc: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.

officialZh.name: ember_spirit_immolation
officialZh.desc_loc: 灰烬之灵持续燃烧，时刻对周围所有敌人造成每秒伤害。
notes_loc: 破坏不会使阿哈利姆魔晶升级的残焰继承的献祭心失效。
officialZh.shard_loc: 使残焰获得献祭心，并且每秒伤害和作用范围提升。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: ember_spirit_fire_remnant
official.desc_loc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
official.lore_loc: By the spirit's power are Xin's teachings spread anew.
notes_loc: Starts with 3 charges (maximum).
official.shard_loc: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
official.scepter_loc: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.

officialZh.name: ember_spirit_fire_remnant
officialZh.desc_loc: 可以放出一个残焰，向目标地点冲去，速度为灰烬之灵移动速度的%speed_multiplier%%%。使用“激活残焰”技能后，灰烬之灵向所有残焰像冲去，将其摧毁并造成范围伤害，并移动至最近的残焰像。灰烬之灵最后会到达离目标地点最近的残焰像。
officialZh.lore_loc: 身怀灵力，重焕教义。
notes_loc: 学习后马上拥有3个残焰（上限数量）。
officialZh.shard_loc: 灰烬之灵附近范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时，恢复一点残焰能量点数。另外，灰烬之灵阵亡时会在原地留下一个残焰。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升施法距离、初始残焰速度和最大能量点数。

official.name: earth_spirit_boulder_smash
official.desc_loc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a %remnant_smash_radius_tooltip% radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.
official.lore_loc: It is with the power of a mountain that Earth Spirit strikes his enemies.

officialZh.name: earth_spirit_boulder_smash
officialZh.desc_loc: 大地之灵将敌方单位或友方单位作为目标，将其击飞，目标将沿他面朝的方向飞行一段距离。如果大地之灵点地为目标，他将击飞%remnant_smash_radius_tooltip%范围内距离最近的单位，优先以残岩为目标。击飞的单位或残岩会对碰到的所有单位造成伤害。如果敌人是被残岩击中还将额外被减速。残岩被击飞的距离比其他单位更远。
officialZh.lore_loc: 大地之灵的一招一式都蕴含着移山之力。

official.name: earth_spirit_rolling_boulder
official.desc_loc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
official.lore_loc: Calling upon his connection to the land, the Earth Spirit draws loose stone to him, which forms a protective ball that he can use to roll short distances.
notes_loc: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of %radius%.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.
facets_loc: Stone Remnants are not destroyed when rolled over, and the cooldown of Stone Remnant is refreshed when the roll is done.

Rolling over an allied hero grants the allied hero and Earth Spirit %allied_bonus_movespeed%%% bonus movespeed for %allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%s. If he rolls over an allied hero, Earth Spirit will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer,

officialZh.name: earth_spirit_rolling_boulder
officialZh.desc_loc: 大地之灵化身为巨石，经过%delay%秒延迟后向目标位置翻滚，对经过的敌人造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>，伤害值为%damage% + %damage_str%%%力量。如果撞到敌方英雄或自身被眩晕，翻滚都会中止。如果翻滚过程中经过残岩将会大幅提高翻滚距离和速度，造成的<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间更长。
officialZh.lore_loc: 大地之灵将自己与大地紧密结合，使松散的石块吸附到身上，从而组成一个防护圆球向前滚动。
notes_loc: 翻滚时经过残岩会将其摧毁。
巨石的作用范围为%radius%。
大地之灵在滚动时无法作为目标，而且无敌。
facets_loc: 残岩在翻滚时经过不会被摧毁，而且翻滚结束后残岩的冷却时间会重置。
滚过一名友方英雄后会使该友方英雄和大地之灵获得%allied_bonus_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，持续%allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%秒。而且滚过友方英雄时，大地之灵滚动的距离变远，速度变快，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人的时间也变长。

special_values.name: rock_bonus_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 额外<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>时间（经过残岩）：

official.name: earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip
official.desc_loc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
official.lore_loc: Like calls to like. Even the minerals found in the blood and bones of living beings are not immune to the call of the Earth Spirit.
notes_loc: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
official.shard_loc: Decreases cooldown to %AbilityCooldown%s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.

officialZh.name: earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip
officialZh.desc_loc:
大地之灵将目标残岩或友方单位拉扯到自己所在的位置，行进路径上被击中的敌人都会被沉默并受到伤害。

拉扯的残岩也会对击中的敌人造成伤害。

以友军为目标时施法距离减少。
officialZh.lore_loc: 同性相吸。即使是深藏于鲜血和骨头中的矿物都不能免疫大地之灵的呼唤。
notes_loc: 如果目标处于时间结界，决斗或黑洞之中则不起作用。
地磁之握还可以对友方小兵施放。
officialZh.shard_loc: 冷却时间减少至%AbilityCooldown%秒，对友方单位的施法距离和牵引速度提升。

official.name: earth_spirit_stone_caller
official.desc_loc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
official.lore_loc: Earth Spirit calls forth a remnant of his stone army, long buried with him in the dark embrace of the Earth.
facets_loc: Has a fixed cooldown instead of charges.

officialZh.name: earth_spirit_stone_caller
officialZh.desc_loc:
在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。

每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得%attack_damage_per_stone%%%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得%attack_damage_per_stone_used%%%攻击力加成，持续%buff_duration%秒（无法叠加）。
officialZh.lore_loc: 大地之灵唤出的残岩源自与他一同在大地黑暗的怀抱下埋藏多年的兵马俑。
facets_loc: 拥有固定的冷却时间，而不是能量点数。

official.name: earth_spirit_petrify
official.desc_loc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. < br>
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
official.lore_loc: Kaolin uses the elemental power of the Earth to temporarily petrify living beings, so that they might be conscripted into his stone funerary army.
notes_loc: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

officialZh.name: earth_spirit_petrify
officialZh.desc_loc:
大地之灵对一名英雄施法，使其暂时获得残岩的属性。经过短时间后残岩就会碎裂，释放出英雄，并对周围单位造成伤害。

可以对残岩施放。对残岩施放时冷却时间为5秒。
对友方英雄施放时施法距离更远。
officialZh.lore_loc: 考嶙操控大地的元素之力，使生命体暂时石化，将其收编于他的兵马俑大军中。
notes_loc: 如果大地之灵自身受到残岩魔咒的效果，也可以成为巨石冲击的目标。

official.name: earth_spirit_magnetize
official.desc_loc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.
official.lore_loc: At the Earth Spirit's call, the minerals in the blood and bones of his enemies rebel against the bodies they find themselves in.
facets_loc: Magnetizing a Stone Remnant gives Earth Spirit bonus attack damage for %magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration% seconds. Does not stack.

officialZh.name: earth_spirit_magnetize
officialZh.desc_loc: 将附近小范围内的敌方单位磁化，使其短时间内受到伤害。被磁化的英雄单位将会引起附近残岩的爆炸，每次爆炸都将摧毁残岩并刷新残岩附近单位身上的磁化时间（若附近单位未被磁化则为其施加一个磁化效果）。该过程可重复数次。如果一个被磁化的英雄受到了地磁之握或巨石冲击的作用，那么所有被磁化的英雄都会受到同样效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在大地之灵的呼唤下，敌人体内的鲜血和骨头中所含的矿物都开始倒戈。
facets_loc: 磁化一个残岩会让大地之灵获得攻击力加成，持续%magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration%秒。不会叠加。

special_values.name: rock_search_radius
special_values.heading_loc: 残岩刷新/爆炸作用范围：

official.name: abyssal_underlord_firestorm
official.desc_loc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
official.lore_loc: The flames of conquest blaze forth from the darkest depths of the abyss.
official.shard_loc: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

officialZh.name: abyssal_underlord_firestorm
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤数波火焰风暴攻击目标区域内的所有单位，并额外持续造成烧灼伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 征战的烈焰从深渊最黑暗的深处向外迸发。
officialZh.shard_loc: 火焰风暴可以对友军施放。施放后火焰风暴会跟随该英雄。火焰风暴的波数增加，伤害触发间隔/持续时间更短。

special_values.name: shard_wave_interval_reduction
special_values.heading_loc: 持续时间/伤害间隔减少：

official.name: abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice
official.desc_loc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Twisting into the seams of reality itself, Vrogros' manifest hatred paralyzes those who defy his will.

officialZh.name: abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标区域制造致命的深渊；踏入深渊的敌方单位将受到伤害并且被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>。每个敌方单位每隔%pit_interval%秒才会再次受到作用。
officialZh.lore_loc: 扭曲成现实本身的接缝，维洛格罗斯昭然的仇恨让蔑视他意志的人动弹不得。

official.name: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
official.desc_loc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
official.lore_loc: To merely stand in the presence of the Underlord is to feel the conviction of battle sapped from one's soul.
notes_loc: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
facets_loc: Underlord's attacks cleave while he has bonus damage from Atrophy Aura.

officialZh.name: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
officialZh.desc_loc: 周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 光是站在孽主面前就能感受到自己的战意从灵魂里被榨干。
notes_loc: 破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。
facets_loc: 孽主在拥有衰退光环的攻击力加成时攻击具有分裂效果。

official.name: abyssal_underlord_raid_boss
official.desc_loc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive %dark_portal_multiplier%x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

officialZh.name: abyssal_underlord_raid_boss
officialZh.desc_loc: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得承受伤害降低和移动速度加成。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得%dark_portal_multiplier%倍加成。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: abyssal_underlord_dark_portal
official.desc_loc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
official.lore_loc: They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.
notes_loc: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
official.scepter_loc: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
facets_loc: Underlord summons uncontrollable demonic Warriors and Archers after travelling through the Fiend's Gate that attack nearby enemies. These units deal %underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%% damage to buildings.

officialZh.name: abyssal_underlord_dark_portal
officialZh.desc_loc: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法%warp_channel_duration%秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过%minimum_distance%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 他们的到来全无征兆，王国曾经繁荣的地方只剩下烈火和血海。
notes_loc: 双击会在己方基地的泉水前打开另一个传送门。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 在传送门两端各召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。
facets_loc: 孽主穿过恶魔之扉后会召唤不可控的恶魔战士和射手，攻击附近敌人。这些单位对建筑造成%underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%%伤害。

official.name: terrorblade_reflection
official.desc_loc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
official.lore_loc: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy.  Now it is a lesson he teaches others.
notes_loc: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.

officialZh.name: terrorblade_reflection
officialZh.desc_loc: 恐怖利刃映出目标区域内所有敌方英雄的黑暗倒影对其进行反制，目标在短时间内将被自身倒影攻击，移动速度和攻击速度都会降低。倒影为无敌状态。
officialZh.lore_loc: 荒邪之狱的分形之墙中，恐怖利刃洞悉了古老的寓言：你就是自己最可怕的敌人。现在他也要让别人明白这个道理。
notes_loc: 无法以倒影的幻象为目标，并且幻象为无敌，减速效果被移除后幻象将被摧毁。
倒影只会攻击该技能指定的目标。

official.name: terrorblade_conjure_image
official.desc_loc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
official.lore_loc: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade.  Facing MORE Terrorblades!
notes_loc: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.
facets_loc: Conjure Image illusions always spawn at full health and cost health instead of mana.

officialZh.name: terrorblade_conjure_image
officialZh.desc_loc: 创造一个恐怖利刃的幻象，可以攻击敌人造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 比面对恐怖利刃更可怕的只有这么种情况：面对成倍的恐怖利刃！
notes_loc: 惑幻产生的幻象在外观上与普通幻象不同。
facets_loc: 惑幻的幻象总是满血，但施放时消耗生命，而不是魔法。

official.name: terrorblade_metamorphosis
official.desc_loc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
official.lore_loc: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control.  Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.
notes_loc: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.

officialZh.name: terrorblade_metamorphosis
officialZh.desc_loc: 恐怖利刃变换形态，化身成可怕的恶魔并具备远程攻击能力。任何恐怖利刃的幻象在%metamorph_aura_tooltip%范围内也将魔化。
officialZh.lore_loc: 暴躁生气，渐起怒意，激变形体。见识一下恐怖利刃最为恐怖的一面吧。
notes_loc: 近战或远程物品的冷却时间不同时将根据恐怖利刃在使用物品时处于远程或近战形态而定。

official.name: terrorblade_demon_zeal
official.desc_loc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
official.lore_loc: Fear is fueled by confusion when Terrorblade's enemies see that the first cut he makes is one to embolden himself.

officialZh.name: terrorblade_demon_zeal
officialZh.desc_loc: 施放需消耗恐怖利刃当前生命值的一部分，为恐怖利刃和他附近的幻象提供生命恢复、移动和攻击速度加成。不会影响倒影的幻象。魔化状态下无法施放，而且施放魔化会移除狂魔效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 当恐怖利刃的敌人发现他砍出的第一刀是为了给自己壮胆，他们的困惑加剧了恐惧。

official.name: terrorblade_terror_wave
official.desc_loc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
official.lore_loc: A shockwave of power strong enough to break the walls of Foulfell itself.

officialZh.name: terrorblade_terror_wave
officialZh.desc_loc: 放出一道能量波，朝所有方向向外行进，击中敌方英雄将使其<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>并造成伤害，同时恐怖利刃短时间内获得魔化状态。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一道威力十足的冲击波，可以冲破荒邪之狱的障壁。

official.name: terrorblade_sunder
official.desc_loc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
official.lore_loc: You didn't need that life, did you?  The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.
notes_loc: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.
facets_loc: There is no minimum health threshold for Sundered enemies.

officialZh.name: terrorblade_sunder
officialZh.desc_loc: 隔断恐怖利刃以及目标英雄的灵魂并将双方的当前血量百分比进行互换。交换后双方英雄的生命值必定在一定百分比以上。
officialZh.lore_loc: 你是不是不想要这条命？恶魔掠夺者偷走的正是你最为珍视的。
notes_loc: 减益免疫的敌人不会被影响生命值。
facets_loc: 魂断对敌人施放时没有最低生命值限制。

official.name: terrorblade_dark_unity
official.desc_loc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
notes_loc: Reflection Illusions are also affected.

officialZh.name: terrorblade_dark_unity
officialZh.desc_loc: 恐怖之刃控制的附近幻象拥有额外攻击伤害。
notes_loc: 倒影的幻象也会受到作用。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: phoenix_icarus_dive
official.desc_loc: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
official.lore_loc: Though no stranger to travelling the cosmic void, soaring within an atmosphere offers unique pleasures.
notes_loc: Icarus Dive has a %dive_duration% second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.

officialZh.name: phoenix_icarus_dive
officialZh.desc_loc: 凤凰向目标方向进行圆弧状飞行，飞行距离固定，对沿途的敌人造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度，然后返回初始位置。飞行过程中如果施放超新星将停止飞行。
officialZh.lore_loc: 尽管没少在宇宙虚空之间遨游，但在大气里振翅高飞还是有不同的快感。
notes_loc: 凤凰冲击的飞行时间为%dive_duration%秒，可以在飞行途中再次施放来终止飞行。

official.name: phoenix_fire_spirits
official.desc_loc: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
official.lore_loc: The ever-collapsing core of Phoenix often emits short-lived bursts of conscious light.
notes_loc: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.
official.shard_loc: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.

officialZh.name: phoenix_fire_spirits
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤4只围绕凤凰飞行的烈火精灵。每一只烈火精灵都能被单独发射到指定区域。对敌人持续造成伤害并大幅降低他们的攻击速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 凤凰那不断坍塌重生的内核经常释放出具有意识的霎那光流。
notes_loc: 烈火精灵现在到达目标区域后将获得1秒的视野。
officialZh.shard_loc: 烈火精灵变成被动充能技能。具有7秒充能时间。

official.name: phoenix_sun_ray
official.desc_loc: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
official.lore_loc: The vent through which such stellar energy flows is mere atoms wide.
notes_loc: Sun Ray has a width of %radius% units, and a length of %abilitycastrange% units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.
official.shard_loc: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.

officialZh.name: phoenix_sun_ray
officialZh.desc_loc: 凤凰以损失生命能量为代价，向前射出一束炽热的光线炙烤敌人。光线对敌人造成伤害，并且能<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友军，伤害和治疗的数值均为基础数值加上目标最大生命值的一定百分比。随着光线不断炙烤，百分比也会不断增加。
officialZh.lore_loc: 星体能量的这般释放对凤凰来说仅仅是打开了原子大小的豁口。
notes_loc: 烈日炙烤的宽度为%radius%，长度为%abilitycastrange%。
凤凰受到眩晕、沉默、飓风、妖术或睡眠等效果时烈日炙烤将会中断。
凤凰可以使用物品和其他技能，不会打断烈日炙烤。
officialZh.shard_loc: 超新星期间可以施放烈日炙烤。

official.name: phoenix_dying_light
official.desc_loc: Phoenix deals %damage_pct%%% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a %radius% radius every second.
notes_loc: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

officialZh.name: phoenix_dying_light
officialZh.desc_loc: 凤凰每秒对%radius%范围内所有敌人造成%damage_pct%%%自身缺失生命值的魔法伤害。
notes_loc: 消逝之光在凤凰变身为超新星期间也会造成伤害。

official.name: phoenix_supernova
official.desc_loc:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After %abilityduration% seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: The solar crucible of a Supernova may be fatal, yet from its flames arise new beacons to wander infinity.
official.scepter_loc: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

officialZh.name: phoenix_supernova
officialZh.desc_loc:
凤凰十分乐意终结自己现在的生命来换取重生。将自己变为一颗燃烧的恒星，灼烧附近一大片区域内的敌人。恒星受到敌方英雄一定次数的攻击后将会被摧毁。经过%abilityduration%秒后恒星将会爆炸，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>周围所有敌人。而凤凰的生命和魔法值都会回到满状态，并且所有技能的冷却时间都会刷新。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 超新星的烈日试炼致命非常，而从烈焰中，永生的凤吟将再一次升起。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 摧毁超新星所需的攻击次数增加，凤凰可以对友方英雄施放超新星，使双方共同变为恒星进行重生。

official.name: oracle_fortunes_end
official.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: The astral orb crackles with power while raw energy lances out, temporarily disrupting an enemy's connection to their own body.
notes_loc: Affects invulnerable units.

officialZh.name: oracle_fortunes_end
officialZh.desc_loc:
持续施法 - 将神谕者的力量汇聚为一股蕴含荡涤之力的能量，对敌方目标释放这股能量可以对其造成伤害，使其被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>，并且驱散其附近区域的魔法效果。如果目标是友军，将只造成驱散效果。缠绕时间随着持续施法时间逐渐提升。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 星体天球充沛的力量让四周充斥着静电爆裂声，而生能射向八方，使敌人暂时魂魄出窍。
notes_loc: 可以作用无敌单位。

official.name: oracle_fates_edict
official.desc_loc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%% magic damage resistance.
official.lore_loc: An unbreakable prophecy resounds: a chosen ally shall briefly suffer no magics.  Other kinds of suffering however...

officialZh.name: oracle_fates_edict
officialZh.desc_loc: 神谕者让目标沉醉，将其<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>并提升其%magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%%魔法抗性。
officialZh.lore_loc: 无法逾越的预言四处回响：神选之友将暂时不受魔法的折磨。但是折磨还有很多种……

official.name: oracle_purifying_flames
official.desc_loc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
official.lore_loc: Like a hall of mirrors might amplify the light of a single candle, the shattered walls of the universe can transform the light of prophecy into a burning torch.
notes_loc: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

officialZh.name: oracle_purifying_flames
officialZh.desc_loc: 将目标身上一切不洁之物净化，对其造成大量魔法伤害，并使其在接下来的一段时间内逐渐恢复生命值。恢复的生命值总量将超过受到的伤害。可对友方和敌方单位施放。
officialZh.lore_loc: 一支蜡烛的微光在挂满镜子的厅堂中异常耀眼，无独有偶，破碎的宇宙之壁可以将预言的微光变成炫目的火炬。
notes_loc: 涤罪之焰的治疗效果可以相互叠加。
涤罪之焰的伤害对友军不会致死。

official.name: oracle_rain_of_destiny
official.desc_loc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.
official.lore_loc: Through mixture of the astral and the atmospheric, Nerif bends a single reality into paradoxical alignment.

officialZh.name: oracle_rain_of_destiny
officialZh.desc_loc: 在目标范围内降下大雨。站在该区域的敌人受到每秒伤害，并且治疗增强被削弱。区域内友军被<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>，并且具有治疗增强效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 通过将精神与大气相混合，奈里夫把单一的现实扭曲成矛盾的结合。

official.name: oracle_false_promise
official.desc_loc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: Foes and false prophets oft make lies of men's fates.
notes_loc: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.

officialZh.name: oracle_false_promise
officialZh.desc_loc:
暂时篡改队友的命运，技能期间受到的任何<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>和伤害效果将在虚妄之诺结束后结算，其中<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果结算时效果更强。施放时将移除目标身上大部分的负面状态效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 敌人和虚妄的先知一样常常会编造他人的命运。
notes_loc: 伤害和治疗效果虽然被延缓结算，但是结算时依然会考虑护甲和魔法抗性的减免。
经过延缓的伤害和治疗效果在目标失去本技能效果后立刻结算。

official.name: oracle_prognosticate
official.desc_loc: Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom) as well as Roshan's exact respawn time.

officialZh.name: oracle_prognosticate
officialZh.desc_loc: 神谕者将预测并对友军宣布，下个强化神符出现的地点（上路或下路），以及肉山的准确复活时间。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: winter_wyvern_arctic_burn
official.desc_loc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second.
official.lore_loc: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.
notes_loc: This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

officialZh.name: winter_wyvern_arctic_burn
officialZh.desc_loc: 寒冬飞龙乘着一股极地寒风扶摇而上，移动将无视地形，每次攻击都将呼出逼人的寒气。高飞时，她的攻击距离更远，攻击弹道速度也更快，被攻击的敌人在寒意作用下，移动速度会被减缓，同时每秒损失%percent_damage%%%当前生命值。
officialZh.lore_loc: 其他龙点燃龙炎的器官在傲洛斯体内熔炼的是难以想象的寒气。从她咽喉的深处呼出的气息会将敌人送入烧灼的痛苦中。
notes_loc: 本技能无法作用于肉山。
寒冬飞龙的攻击前摇降低至%attack_point%秒。
严寒烧灼的持续伤害和减速可以被驱散。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 严寒烧灼变成开关型技能，开启后每秒消耗一定量魔法。提升寒冬飞龙的移动速度。

official.name: winter_wyvern_splinter_blast
official.desc_loc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
official.lore_loc: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.
notes_loc: The primary projectile moves at %projectile_speed% movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

officialZh.name: winter_wyvern_splinter_blast
officialZh.desc_loc: 向一个单位发射一团易碎的冰球。冰球一击中目标就会碎裂，而目标单位将不会受到任何效果，但是附近%split_radius%基础范围内敌人都将因碎片的冲击受到伤害，并且移动速度减缓%movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 这些冰渣由她冰冻的咽喉中特殊的囊泡慢慢生成，寒冬飞龙正借此轰击她的敌人。
notes_loc: 主弹道的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
主弹道无法被躲避，而且不能以寒冬飞龙自身为目标。

official.name: winter_wyvern_cold_embrace
official.desc_loc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
official.lore_loc: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.
official.shard_loc: Reduces cooldown by %shard_cooldown_reduction% seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.
facets_loc: Cold Embrace can be cast on buildings. Does not heal buildings. Allied units and buildings gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon. Duration is paused if the building is protected by both Glyph of Fortification and Cold Embrace.

officialZh.name: winter_wyvern_cold_embrace
officialZh.desc_loc: 将队友封入一个冰茧中，使其被冻在原地并恢复生命值，恢复数值为基础数值加上最大生命值的一定比例。冰茧将阻隔一切物理伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 寒冬之心中有着寒冷而治愈的拥抱。坚冰减缓了血液的流动，使治疗的魔力发挥得更加彻底。
officialZh.shard_loc: 冷却时间减少%shard_cooldown_reduction%秒。友方单位从冰茧解冻后获得额外攻击力。
facets_loc: 极寒之拥可以对建筑施放。不会治疗建筑。冰茧中的友方单位和建筑在冰茧解冻后获得攻击力加成。如果建筑同时处于极寒之拥和防御符文的作用，极寒之拥的持续时间会暂停。

special_values.name: heal_percentage
special_values.heading_loc: 每秒最大生命值<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>：

official.name: winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda
official.desc_loc: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %tooltip_int_pct%%% of its current value at the time of consumption.

officialZh.name: winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda
officialZh.desc_loc: 寒冬飞龙获得物品“古龙诗集”，可以消耗，使一个基础技能的当前和最高等级均提升一级，另外寒冬飞龙的基础智力提升，数值为消耗时相应数值的%tooltip_int_pct%%%。

official.name: winter_wyvern_winters_curse
official.desc_loc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
official.lore_loc: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.
notes_loc: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

officialZh.name: winter_wyvern_winters_curse
officialZh.desc_loc: 寒冬飞龙驱散一个敌方目标并将其冻在原地，附近的其他敌人将受到癫狂诅咒，对冻住的队友进行攻击，而且攻击速度得到提升。冻住的目标和被诅咒攻击队友的敌人不会受到任何来自敌方的伤害，不过寒冬飞龙或她控制的单位造成的伤害除外。敌方英雄进入施放后的诅咒范围内会增加诅咒的持续时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 这个诅咒在书龙咒语中最为古老，也是那句老话的真相：有时候我的敌人的敌人还是我的敌人。
notes_loc: 如果目标被其队友击杀，击杀者将仍是寒冰飞龙。
无视主目标的减益免疫状态，但是对目标周围的减益免疫队友无效。

special_values.name: bonus_duration_per_hero
special_values.heading_loc: 每个英雄的额外持续时间：

special_values.name: bonus_duration_per_creep
special_values.heading_loc: 每个非英雄的额外持续时间：

official.name: arc_warden_flux
official.desc_loc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
official.lore_loc: An infinitesimal fraction of the power which imprisoned the Ancients.
official.scepter_loc: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

officialZh.name: arc_warden_flux
officialZh.desc_loc: 将不稳定的涡流能量灌注到落单敌人体内，造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度。如目标周围有其他敌方单位 ，则不会造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 囚禁遗迹之力的无穷小碎片。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 目标落单时乱流具有<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>效果，造成更高伤害，而且持续时间更长。

official.name: arc_warden_magnetic_field
official.desc_loc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
official.lore_loc: Time and space are of little consequence to one as old as Zet.
facets_loc: Magnetic Field pulls runes. Runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.

officialZh.name: arc_warden_magnetic_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 天穹守望者制造一个充满磁能的圆形扭曲力场。磁场提供攻击速度加成，并且其中的友方单位可以闪避来自磁场外的攻击。磁场可以牵引神符，并且自动激活其中的神符。
officialZh.lore_loc: 时间与空间对于古老如泽特之人实在是无足轻重。
facets_loc: 磁场会牵引神符。磁场内的神符会自动激活。

official.name: arc_warden_spark_wraith
official.desc_loc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
official.lore_loc: Lesser fragments of Zet's original self.
notes_loc: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.

officialZh.name: arc_warden_spark_wraith
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤一个缓慢实体化的闪光怨灵萦绕在目标区域，直到有敌人进入范围。一旦有敌方单位进入范围，怨灵将贴近敌人自我熔化，造成魔法伤害并使目标减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 泽特原始自我的低级碎片。
notes_loc: 闪光幽魂无法被躲避。

official.name: arc_warden_runic_infusion
official.desc_loc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
facets_loc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

officialZh.name: arc_warden_runic_infusion
officialZh.desc_loc: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。
facets_loc: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。

official.name: arc_warden_tempest_double
official.desc_loc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
official.lore_loc: Warped by the power of its peers, Arc Warden becomes what it despises most: disharmony.
notes_loc: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.
official.shard_loc:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
facets_loc:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Power Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Level 1 - Arcane Rune.

Level 2 - Arcane and Invisibility Runes.

Level 3 - Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes.

officialZh.name: arc_warden_tempest_double
officialZh.desc_loc:
天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。

复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。
officialZh.lore_loc: 被同类的力量扭曲后，天穹守望者变成了自己最为不齿的：大分裂。
notes_loc: 复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。
officialZh.shard_loc:
风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。

不会触发神符灌注。
facets_loc:
风暴双雄产生时带有强化神符的加成效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。

1级 - 奥术神符。

2级 - 奥术和隐身神符。

3级 - 奥术、隐身和极速神符。

official.name: monkey_king_boundless_strike
official.desc_loc: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
official.lore_loc: The legendary Jingu Bang grows to match its master's will, ensuring no enemy can escape the Monkey King's reach.
official.shard_loc: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.

officialZh.name: monkey_king_boundless_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 传说中的金箍棒根据主人的意愿变大变长，确保敌人都逃不出齐天大圣的手心。
officialZh.shard_loc: 棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的%spring_channel_pct%%%。棒击大地设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。

official.name: monkey_king_tree_dance
official.desc_loc: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
official.lore_loc: Sun Wukong dances nimbly along the treetop canopy, always just out of arm's reach.
notes_loc: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
facets_loc: Increases the max level of Tree Dance. Level %max_level% Tree Dance reduces the cooldown to zero.

officialZh.name: monkey_king_tree_dance
officialZh.desc_loc: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
officialZh.lore_loc: 孙悟空在树顶上灵活地跳跃，总是一跃而至。
notes_loc: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。
facets_loc: 提升丛林之舞的最高等级。%max_level%级丛林之舞会把冷却时间降低至0。

official.name: monkey_king_jingu_mastery
official.desc_loc: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
official.lore_loc: Always sensitive to the moods of its master, the Jingu Bang radiates power when Sun Wukong's combat fervor is on full display.
notes_loc: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

officialZh.name: monkey_king_jingu_mastery
officialZh.desc_loc: 齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下%charges%次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 金箍棒能敏锐感知主人的情绪，在孙悟空展现战意时散发力量。
notes_loc: 棒击大地击中敌人时也会计入攻击次数。
再次攻击敌人将刷新如意棒法的计数持续时间。
敌人身上的计数效果无法被驱散。
自身的如意棒法效果可以被驱散。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

official.name: monkey_king_mischief
official.desc_loc: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.
official.lore_loc: Watch out for that tree.

officialZh.name: monkey_king_mischief
officialZh.desc_loc: 齐天大圣以周遭事物为启发进行伪装，改变自己的外形，从而欺骗对手。受到伤害，发动攻击或使用任意物品都会失去伪装效果。变化后%invul_duration%秒内免疫伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 要小心那棵树。

official.name: monkey_king_wukongs_command
official.desc_loc:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
official.lore_loc: Monkey King rips out a tuft of fur to blow at his enemies, charging each strand to transform into a copy of himself.
notes_loc: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.
official.scepter_loc: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
facets_loc: Monkey King's soldiers last longer and do not disperse unless he spends more than %leadership_time_buffer% seconds outside the area.
Grants the Changing of the Guard ability during Wukong's Command.

officialZh.name: monkey_king_wukongs_command
officialZh.desc_loc:
齐天大圣变出圆形的猴子猴孙阵列，猴子猴孙从他的位置散开。若齐天大圣离开范围，猴子猴孙将会消失。猴子猴孙继承齐天大圣的攻击力，攻击频率为固定的%attack_speed%秒，并且只会以敌方英雄为目标。在技能持续时间内齐天大圣获得护甲加成。

齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，短时间内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。
officialZh.lore_loc: 齐天大圣将一簇猴毛吹向敌人，每根毛都变成了自己的复制体。
notes_loc: 猴子猴孙不会获得如意棒法的加成效果。
猴子猴孙不会继承碎颅锤和深渊之刃的效果。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。
facets_loc: 齐天大圣的猴子猴孙持续时间更长，而且离开圆阵后不会马上消散，除非他在圆阵外停留的时间超过%leadership_time_buffer%秒。
在猴子猴孙期间获得技能“出神入化”。

special_values.name: scepter_spawn_interval
special_values.heading_loc: 单个猴子猴孙产生间隔：

special_values.name: scepter_spawn_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 单个猴子猴孙持续时间：

official.name: monkey_king_transfiguration
official.desc_loc: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a %transfiguration_duration%s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

officialZh.name: monkey_king_transfiguration
officialZh.desc_loc: 齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，%transfiguration_duration%秒内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。变身后齐天大圣为无敌，但是无法攻击或施放技能。

official.name: dark_willow_bramble_maze
official.desc_loc: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: The fae realm exists all around you, merely waiting to draw you in...
notes_loc: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

officialZh.name: dark_willow_bramble_maze
officialZh.desc_loc: %initial_creation_delay%秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出%placement_range%范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有%placement_count%棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被<font color='#cae96d'>缠绕</font>，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续%placement_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 仙灵之境将你环绕，只是在等着让你深陷……
notes_loc: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。

official.name: dark_willow_shadow_realm
official.desc_loc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: What you can't see will most definitely hurt you.
notes_loc: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
official.scepter_loc: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
facets_loc: While in Shadow Realm, Dark Willow emits a %aura_radius% radius aura that increases damage that she deals to enemies in its area of effect by up to %aura_damage_pct%%%. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm.

officialZh.name: dark_willow_shadow_realm
officialZh.desc_loc: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 你看不见的东西肯定会害你。
notes_loc: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。
facets_loc: 处于暗影之境时，邪影芳灵会散发出一个%aura_radius%范围的光环，使她对范围内的敌人造成的伤害增加，最高为%aura_damage_pct%%%。根据她在暗影之境内停留的时间，造成的伤害会随之增加。

official.name: dark_willow_cursed_crown
official.desc_loc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
official.lore_loc: Didn't anyone ever tell you? Never strike a deal with a fairy...
official.shard_loc: Cursed Crown creates %shard_bramble_amount% brambles in a %shard_spawn_radius% radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.
facets_loc: While ticking, Cursed Crown accumulates %accumulated_damage_pct%%% of all damage dealt by Dark Willow and %accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%% of attack damage dealt by allied heroes. When the counter ends, the accumulated damage is dealt again as magical damage to the whole area. This triggers even upon dispel with Aghanim's Shard.

officialZh.name: dark_willow_cursed_crown
officialZh.desc_loc: 邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 没人告诉过你吗？千万别和仙女打交道……
officialZh.shard_loc: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在%shard_spawn_radius%范围内产生%shard_bramble_amount%朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。
facets_loc: 倒计时期间诅咒王冠会累计邪影芳灵对目标造成所有伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct%%%，还有友方英雄对其造成攻击伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%%。倒计时结束时，累计的伤害会作为魔法伤害施加给整个区域。拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后，可以在技能被驱散时触发。

official.name: dark_willow_bedlam
official.desc_loc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.
official.lore_loc: You'll have to excuse my friend Jex. He's really into murder.

officialZh.name: dark_willow_bedlam
officialZh.desc_loc: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。
officialZh.lore_loc: 你得原谅我的朋友杰克斯。他是有点杀红了眼。

official.name: dark_willow_pixie_dust
official.desc_loc: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

officialZh.name: dark_willow_pixie_dust
officialZh.desc_loc: 邪影芳灵获得额外%hp_regen_amp%%%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至%hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%%。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: dark_willow_terrorize
official.desc_loc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
official.lore_loc: You think you know the first thing about fear? Jex'll show you what that word truly means...
notes_loc: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.

officialZh.name: dark_willow_terrorize
officialZh.desc_loc: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
officialZh.lore_loc: 你觉得你知道恐惧的意思？杰克斯会让你见识这词的真谛……
notes_loc: 恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。

official.name: pangolier_swashbuckle
official.desc_loc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
official.lore_loc: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.
notes_loc: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

officialZh.name: pangolier_swashbuckle
officialZh.desc_loc:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 石鳞剑士的剑比舌头还要灵活。
notes_loc: 在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。

official.name: pangolier_shield_crash
official.desc_loc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
official.lore_loc: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.
facets_loc: Pangolier can cast Shield Crash a second time mid-flight, dealing more damage and gaining more barrier. Longer flight time results in more damage and barrier increases.

officialZh.name: pangolier_shield_crash
officialZh.desc_loc:
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>。

地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有被敌人层层包围，石鳞剑士才能真正地一展雄风。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成%scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%%伤害。
facets_loc: 石鳞剑士可以在半空中再次施放甲盾冲击，造成更高的伤害，并获得更高数值的护盾。在空中的时间越久，伤害和护盾的数值越高。

official.name: pangolier_lucky_shot
official.desc_loc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
official.lore_loc: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.

officialZh.name: pangolier_lucky_shot
officialZh.desc_loc: 石鳞剑士孤注一掷，让命运决定敌人的下场。石鳞剑士的攻击或技能拥有一定几率大幅降低攻击速度，同时削弱护甲。
officialZh.lore_loc: 石鳞剑士出剑更多时候是因心血来潮，而非理智。

official.name: pangolier_rollup
official.desc_loc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.
official.lore_loc: It requires deft tailwork and immense balance to defy momentum in the heart of battle.

officialZh.name: pangolier_rollup
officialZh.desc_loc: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在战场的中心，需要灵巧的尾巴和极强的平衡感才能抵挡住各方的来势。

official.name: pangolier_gyroshell
official.desc_loc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...
notes_loc: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
facets_loc: Rolling Thunder movement and turn speed increased, but duration is decreased.

officialZh.name: pangolier_gyroshell
officialZh.desc_loc:
石鳞剑士卷成一个<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 他的祖先只能找到安全感的地方，石鳞剑士却看见了机遇……
notes_loc: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。
facets_loc: 地雷滚滚的移动和转身速度提升，但是持续时间减少。

official.name: pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold
official.desc_loc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes_loc: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

officialZh.name: pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold
officialZh.desc_loc: 附近敌人攻击石鳞剑士时，他们触发物品和技能的随机类攻击特效的几率有所降低。
notes_loc: 对英雄技能和物品有效。
效果是特效发生的几率相对降低。

official.name: grimstroke_dark_artistry
official.desc_loc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
official.lore_loc: The corruptive force of Grimstroke's ink, drawn from the reservoir of his fallen people, consumes any enemy caught in its path.
facets_loc: Stroke of Fate additionally launches a reflected curved stroke from the right hand. Enemies can only be hit by one Stroke, but the bonus damage is cumulative.

officialZh.name: grimstroke_dark_artistry
officialZh.desc_loc:
天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
officialZh.lore_loc: 天涯墨客的墨迹带有腐化的力量，吸取自他死去的族人，将吞噬抓住的任何敌人。
facets_loc: 绝笔额外从另一只手发出对称的墨迹曲线。每个敌人只能受到一道墨迹的伤害，但是同时计入两道墨迹的额外伤害。

special_values.name: bonus_damage_per_creep
special_values.heading_loc: 每个幻象/非英雄提高伤害：

official.name: grimstroke_ink_creature
official.desc_loc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
official.lore_loc: Grimstroke holds no sorrow for the downfall of his people. Only for Yaovhi, she who was most dear to him, does he feel even a semblance of longing.
notes_loc: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

officialZh.name: grimstroke_ink_creature
officialZh.desc_loc:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
officialZh.lore_loc: 天涯墨客并不为族人的毁灭感到悲伤。只有对瑶薇，他最亲近的女子，他才稍稍感觉到思念。
notes_loc: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

official.name: grimstroke_spirit_walk
official.desc_loc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
official.lore_loc: Now that the rise of the ink tide no longer threatens to overwhelm Grimstroke, its tendrils of power are never far from his hand.
official.shard_loc:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
facets_loc: Ink Swell can be manually detonated early.

officialZh.name: grimstroke_spirit_walk
officialZh.desc_loc: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。%buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 既然高涨的墨潮不再对天涯墨客构成威胁，那么力量的墨须就不难为他所用。
officialZh.shard_loc:
墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加%shard_bonus_damage_pct%%%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的%shard_heal_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
facets_loc: 墨涌可以手动提前引爆。

official.name: grimstroke_dark_portrait
official.desc_loc: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
official.lore_loc: No dark creation is beyond the skill of the master's hand.

officialZh.name: grimstroke_dark_portrait
officialZh.desc_loc: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。
officialZh.lore_loc: 没有暗黑的创造能逃得过大师之手的技艺。

official.name: grimstroke_soul_chain
official.desc_loc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
official.lore_loc: The Ascended were chosen sons of Ashkavor, granted immense power by the bonds forged between their own souls and those they were charged with protecting. In the years that followed the ruination of his kin, Grimstroke discovered much more sinister applications for the binding rituals...
notes_loc: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.

officialZh.name: grimstroke_soul_chain
officialZh.desc_loc: 将一名敌方英雄与束缚作用范围内最接近的队友相连，阻止他们远离彼此。任何指向性技能击中任一英雄时，这两名敌方英雄都会受到作用。若连接在效果截止前断裂，初始目标将再次与其距离内最接近的队友相连。
officialZh.lore_loc: 飞升之人皆为烬州城的选召之子，通过自己的灵魂和他们应守护的族人之间创造的束缚获得了巨大的力量。在同胞毁灭的多年之后，天涯墨客发现束缚仪式更为凶险的用途……
notes_loc: 如果与另一个单位一起被束缚，作用下单位均被束缚，而且无法使用闪烁类技能。
被束缚的单位都将提供视野。

official.name: grimstroke_ink_trail
official.desc_loc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for %debuff_duration%s.
notes_loc: Provides vision over affected heroes.
Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.

officialZh.name: grimstroke_ink_trail
officialZh.desc_loc: 天涯墨客的攻击和技能会使受作用的敌方英雄在身后留下一道墨痕，对天涯墨客造成的伤害减少，持续%debuff_duration%秒。
notes_loc: 获得作用下英雄的视野。
天涯墨客的幻象（包括暗绘）也拥有墨痕。

official.name: hoodwink_acorn_shot
official.desc_loc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
official.lore_loc: Though she'll make do with almost anything, Oak and Ironwood acorns make the most effective projectiles -- and the bulk of Hoodwink's stash.
notes_loc: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.
facets_loc: If there are no bounce targets within range of Acorn Shot, it can bounce off a nearby tree and set the remaining number of bounces to %bounces_after_tree_bounce%.

officialZh.name: hoodwink_acorn_shot
officialZh.desc_loc:
森海飞霞向目标单位发射一颗橡栗，可以弹射至附近敌人，减缓他们的移动速度，并造成攻击伤害的一定百分比和额外伤害。
可以对地面施放，在目标地点种出一棵树，而橡栗会弹射至附近目标。设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后会强制沿用该行为。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然她几乎什么都能凑合着用，不过橡树和铁树之木的栗子是最有效的炮弹——也是森海飞霞大部分的存货来源。
notes_loc: 同一个目标可以被击中超过一次。
弹射会搜寻525范围内战争迷雾中的单位，但无视隐身单位。
种下的树持续20秒。
facets_loc: 如果附近没有可弹射的目标，爆栗出击会弹射至附近的树木，剩余弹射次数将设为%bounces_after_tree_bounce%次。

official.name: hoodwink_bushwhack
official.desc_loc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
official.lore_loc: Hoodwink favors Ironwood groves for ambushes, but the wary step carefully in all areas of the mistwoods.
notes_loc: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.

officialZh.name: hoodwink_bushwhack
officialZh.desc_loc: 扔出一张网，对区域内靠近树木的敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。敌人会持续受到伤害并被拖拽到目标区域内最近的树上，并且眩晕期间视野降低至0。
officialZh.lore_loc: 森海飞霞喜欢利用铁树之木的树丛来伏击，但机警的人在永雾林渊的所有地方都会小心行走。
notes_loc: 若树木被摧毁，被影响的单位将解除眩晕。
野地奇袭不会击中隐身单位。

official.name: hoodwink_scurry
official.desc_loc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.
official.lore_loc: There's not a nook or cranny in the Wood Tomo'kan out of reach of Hoodwink's paws.
facets_loc: Scurry also provides bonus attack and cast range.

officialZh.name: hoodwink_scurry
officialZh.desc_loc: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为%evasion_multiplier%倍。
officialZh.lore_loc: 托莫干森林里没有一处角落或者裂缝是森海飞霞的爪子够不着的。
facets_loc: 密林奔走还会提供攻击和施法距离加成。

official.name: hoodwink_decoy
official.desc_loc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
official.lore_loc: The best traps trigger whether you touch them or not.

officialZh.name: hoodwink_decoy
officialZh.desc_loc: 森海飞霞变为<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 最好的陷阱是不论有没有碰到都会触发。

official.name: hoodwink_hunters_boomerang
official.desc_loc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.
official.lore_loc: A precious last vestige of Hoodwink's childhood, converted into deadly distraction.

officialZh.name: hoodwink_hunters_boomerang
officialZh.desc_loc: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。
officialZh.lore_loc: 森海飞霞童年的宝贵残存变成了致命的消遣。

official.name: hoodwink_sharpshooter
official.desc_loc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
official.lore_loc: While her first arbalest was a chance discovery, Hoodwink now takes great care in carving and caring for her own -- of course with some necessary components pilfered or otherwise cleverly procured.
official.scepter_loc: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.
facets_loc: Sharpshooter has a %quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%% reduced cooldown. Damage, debuff duration, and wind-up times are reduced by %quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%. Turn rate is increased by %turn_rate_tooltip%%%.

officialZh.name: hoodwink_sharpshooter
officialZh.desc_loc:
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，%max_charge_time%秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在%misfire_time%秒后自动发射。
由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退%recoil_distance%距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然森海飞霞的第一把弩机是碰巧发现的，但现在她非常精心地雕刻她自己的劲弩，并且做好防护工作 - 当然，某些必要的部件是顺手牵羊得来的，不然就是通过机智的手段获得。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。
facets_loc: 一箭穿心的冷却时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%%。伤害、负面状态持续时间和装载时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%。转身速率提升%turn_rate_tooltip%%%。

special_values.name: max_slow_debuff_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 最长负面状态持续时间：

official.name: hoodwink_mistwoods_wayfarer
official.desc_loc: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
notes_loc: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.

officialZh.name: hoodwink_mistwoods_wayfarer
officialZh.desc_loc: 森海飞霞有几率使敌人的攻击转向至附近的树木。
notes_loc: 受到转向攻击的树木会被摧毁。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: void_spirit_aether_remnant
official.desc_loc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
official.lore_loc: Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.
official.shard_loc: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.

officialZh.name: void_spirit_aether_remnant
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚无之灵向目标地点派出一个残像。残像观察着一片区域，面朝矢量的方向。当有目标进入其视线，残像会拉扯，并造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 无玄的存在远超时间和空间中的一个点。
officialZh.shard_loc: 额外产生一道观察路径，会围绕残阴旋转。残阴现在会提供真实视域，不再对非英雄单位触发，而是每秒在两道路径上造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。不会使守卫显形。

official.name: void_spirit_dissimilate
official.desc_loc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
official.lore_loc: Inai much prefers to observe our plane free from the confines of corporeal form.
facets_loc: Upon exiting Dissimilate, Aether Remnants are created at the %aether_remnant_count% portals furthest from Void Spirit. No effect if reassembling from the center portal. Remnants face towards the center portal and have reduced pull duration and damage.

officialZh.name: void_spirit_dissimilate
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚无之灵暂时遁入太虚，创造数个灵扉。穿过灵扉他能重组自身。穿出灵扉后，他对区域内所有敌人造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 无玄更愿意脱离肉体的限制，自由地观察我们的位面。
facets_loc: 退出异化时，距离虚无之灵最远的%aether_remnant_count%个灵扉处会产生残阴。如果在中央的灵扉重组则没有效果。残阴会面朝中央的灵扉，牵引时间和伤害降低。

official.name: void_spirit_resonant_pulse
official.desc_loc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
official.lore_loc: Inai never hesitates to shroud himself in the essence of his true self when forced to interact with the mortal plane.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
facets_loc: Resonant Pulse creates a larger all damage barrier instead of a physical barrier.

officialZh.name: void_spirit_resonant_pulse
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性<font color='#b94512'>护盾</font>之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，<font color='#b94512'>护盾</font>的伤害吸收量都会提升。
officialZh.lore_loc: 被迫与物质位面互动时，无玄从不犹豫将自己包裹在本真的精华中。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 共鸣脉冲可以<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>敌人，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。
facets_loc: 共鸣脉冲会产生更强的全伤害护盾，而不是物理伤害护盾。

special_values.name: absorb_per_hero_hit
special_values.heading_loc: 每击中一个英雄<font color='#b94512'>护盾</font>数值：

official.name: void_spirit_intrinsic_edge
official.desc_loc: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

officialZh.name: void_spirit_intrinsic_edge
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚无之灵从每点属性获得的攻击力提升%damage_stat_bonus_pct%%%，并且从力量中获得的生命恢复、敏捷中获得的攻击速度和智力中获得的魔法恢复提升%secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%%。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: void_spirit_astral_step
official.desc_loc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
official.lore_loc: A small step for Inai creates great devastation on the mortal plane.
notes_loc: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.

officialZh.name: void_spirit_astral_step
officialZh.desc_loc: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成%pop_damage_delay%秒减速，然后引爆。
officialZh.lore_loc: 无玄的一小步就能在凡间引发极大的毁灭。
notes_loc: 太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。

official.name: snapfire_scatterblast
official.desc_loc: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by %point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
official.lore_loc: A favorite from her collection, Beadie crafted Ol' Rackatee as her first line of defense when she ventured into the Outlands.
facets_loc: Scatterblast is narrower and longer. Bonus damage and slow when enemies are not in point blank range.

officialZh.name: snapfire_scatterblast
officialZh.desc_loc: 电炎绝手开枪产生大范围的爆炸，对锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害和减速。平射距离内的伤害提升%point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%%，移动速度减缓、攻击速度降低和减速持续时间额外提升%point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 碧婆婆珍藏中的最爱，她打造这把“老坏蛋”作为自己闯入世外之地的首道防线。
facets_loc: 电光石火更窄更长。对平射距离外的敌人造成额外伤害和减速。

official.name: snapfire_firesnap_cookie
official.desc_loc: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
official.lore_loc: With the help of a secret mixture that pairs Beadie's baking skills with her passion for black powder, these battle biscuits pack a punch.
notes_loc: The cookie projectile has a speed of %projectile_speed%.
official.shard_loc: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does %shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%% impact damage to the landing destination.

officialZh.name: snapfire_firesnap_cookie
officialZh.desc_loc: 电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在神秘配方的帮助下，碧婆婆的烘焙技艺和她对黑火药的热情相得益彰，这些战斗饼干相当猛烈。
notes_loc: 饼干的弹道速度为%projectile_speed%。
officialZh.shard_loc: 龙炎饼干变得更具威力，<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个%shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

official.name: snapfire_lil_shredder
official.desc_loc: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
official.lore_loc: Beadie constantly tinkers with a design she first dreamed up plotting an exodus from her old gang.
notes_loc: Sets base attack time to %base_attack_time%s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.

officialZh.name: snapfire_lil_shredder
officialZh.desc_loc: 电炎绝手开动蜥蜴坐骑上的加农炮，快速发动%buffed_attacks%次固定伤害加上自身攻击伤害一定百分比的攻击。每次攻击都将削弱敌人的护甲。在持续时间内提供攻击距离加成。
officialZh.lore_loc: 碧婆婆一直在修补她原来为秘密计划离开劫匪帮所设计的作品。
notes_loc: 持续时间内基础攻击间隔变为%base_attack_time%。
霹雳铁手的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

official.name: snapfire_gobble_up
official.desc_loc: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to %max_time_in_belly% seconds.
official.lore_loc: SHLORP!
notes_loc: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.

officialZh.name: snapfire_gobble_up
officialZh.desc_loc: 小莫迪吞下一个小兵或一名友方英雄，再朝敌人吐出。单位停留在他肚子里最多可达%max_time_in_belly%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 哧！
notes_loc: 电炎绝手在小兵被吐出并阵亡后获得相应的金钱。

official.name: snapfire_spit_creep
official.desc_loc: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.
official.lore_loc: SPITTOOO!

officialZh.name: snapfire_spit_creep
officialZh.desc_loc: 小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。留下的火痰根据蜥蜴绝吻的当前等级还将持续造成减速和伤害。喷吐没有最小发射距离。
officialZh.lore_loc: 噗！

official.name: snapfire_mortimer_kisses
official.desc_loc: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over %duration_tooltip% seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of %min_range%. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
official.lore_loc: Little did Beadie know when she adopted Mortimer, dragon toads--which aren't even toads at all--share more than just a name with their distant draconic cousins.
notes_loc: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of %min_lob_travel_time% and maximum travel time of %max_lob_travel_time%.

officialZh.name: snapfire_mortimer_kisses
officialZh.desc_loc: 电炎绝手的伙伴在%duration_tooltip%秒内喷吐出密集的火团。火团造成冲击伤害，在地面上产生炽烈的炎洼，可以使敌人减速并造成持续伤害。电炎绝手在持续时间内转身速率降低，并且具有最小喷吐距离，为%min_range%。点击右键可以选择火团的目标区域。
officialZh.lore_loc: 碧婆婆收养小莫迪时她一无所知，龙蜥——根本都不是蜥蜴——和他们遥远的龙族表亲并非只是名字一样而已。
notes_loc: 可以通过停止、停在原位或使用其他技能来终止。
最短飞行时间为%min_lob_travel_time%秒，最长飞行时间为%max_lob_travel_time%秒。

official.name: snapfire_boomstick
official.desc_loc: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

officialZh.name: snapfire_boomstick
officialZh.desc_loc: 电炎绝手对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: mars_spear
official.desc_loc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
official.lore_loc: The legendary Spear of Mars still glows with the heat of the forge god's fires.
notes_loc: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
official.shard_loc: Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.

officialZh.name: mars_spear
officialZh.desc_loc: 玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 玛尔斯的传奇战矛上依然闪耀着熔铸之神烈焰的热力。
notes_loc: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。
officialZh.shard_loc: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多%max_impale_targets%名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

official.name: mars_gods_rebuke
official.desc_loc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
official.lore_loc: There isn't a warrior alive who can stand unmoved by the sting of Mars' rebuke.
notes_loc: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

officialZh.name: mars_gods_rebuke
officialZh.desc_loc: 玛尔斯举起他的战盾粉碎前方的敌人，将他们击退并且基于自身攻击力造成致命一击伤害。攻击英雄时攻击伤害提升。具有克敌机先效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在玛尔斯谴戒的刺痛下世上还没有战士能纹丝不动。
notes_loc: 神之谴戒的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

official.name: mars_bulwark
official.desc_loc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs %redirect_chance%%% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
official.lore_loc: Only the very foolish dare to fight fair with the god of war.
notes_loc: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.
official.scepter_loc: Creates %soldier_count% invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.

officialZh.name: mars_bulwark
officialZh.desc_loc:
每当玛尔斯受到来自正面或侧面的攻击时，他就挥舞他那面巨大的战盾来格挡一定百分比的伤害。

可以开启，开启后获得相位移动状态，但无法攻击，自身锁定为面朝的方向，并且移动速度降低，但飞向队友的攻击弹道中%redirect_chance%%%将改变方向朝他飞去。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有蠢到家了才胆敢与战神公平作战。
notes_loc: 改向只会在弹道目标位于玛尔斯身后锥形区域内或他身边100范围内才会生效。
破坏会使正面和侧面减伤效果失效。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 开启护身甲盾后在玛尔斯的两侧共产生%soldier_count%名无敌的士兵。士兵会随着玛尔斯前进，继承全额攻击力和攻击特效并拥有攻击力加成，附带击退和减速效果。敌人在同一时间只会被1名士兵攻击。

official.name: mars_dauntless
official.desc_loc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in %radius% radius.

officialZh.name: mars_dauntless
officialZh.desc_loc: %radius%范围内敌方英雄数量更多时，玛尔斯就会获得生命恢复，敌人数量越多，生命恢复也越高。

special_values.name: health_regen_per_enemy
special_values.heading_loc: 每多一个敌人生命恢复：
