official.name: mars_arena_of_blood
official.desc_loc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
official.lore_loc: The long-dead members of the Ash Legion, assembled from the finest warriors to ever test the might of Mars, still revel in the thrill of combat, gladly beholden to the hand that fell them for as long as he so commands.
official.scepter_loc: Lowers cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%  of their max health and mana and get a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%  attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. This effect stacks.
facets_loc: If Mars is in the Arena when an enemy dies inside of it, he restores %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%% of his max health and mana and gets a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%% attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. Allies inside the Arena receive %allied_reduction_pct%%% of the bonuses.
Arena of Blood obscures vision and enemies within the arena do not share vision with their allies.

officialZh.name: mars_arena_of_blood
officialZh.desc_loc: 经过短暂的列队时间，玛尔斯召唤出环绕着战士的竞技场，战士们将阻挡敌人的攻击和动向。竞技场内的敌方英雄靠近边缘时将被战矛攻击，受到伤害并被击退。
officialZh.lore_loc: 余烬军团死去已久的成员，从考验玛尔斯力量的顶尖战士中集结而来，他们还依然陶醉在战斗的刺激之中，只要他下达命令，他们就欣然应战。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 冷却时间降低%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，持续时间提升。如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡，玛尔斯和竞技场内所有友军都会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。这个效果可以叠加。
facets_loc: 如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡时玛尔斯也在竞技场内，他会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得一个%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成效果，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。竞技场内的友军获得%allied_reduction_pct%%%加成效果。
热血竞技场会遮蔽视野，竞技场内的敌人不会与他们的友军共享视野。

official.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.
official.lore_loc: From unhappy crowds to unruly acts, nothing persuades a pack of animals quite like the crack of the Ringmaster's whip.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 百戏大王卷起他的鞭子，最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒，然后猛甩出去。被鞭打的敌人会受到伤害，并且被<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>，逃离百戏大王。持续施法时间会使伤害和<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>时间成倍增加，但是作用范围减少。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从难以取悦的观众到难以驾驭的表演，对于一群动物，百戏大王手中的长鞭最具有说服力。

official.name: ringmaster_the_box
official.desc_loc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
official.lore_loc: An adept assistant has nothing to fear within the confines of The Box. An amateur has...much darker prospects indeed.
official.scepter_loc: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_the_box
officialZh.desc_loc: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态，获得额外魔法抗性、<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被<font color='#c3e1db'>锁闭</font>、<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>和<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
officialZh.lore_loc: 熟练的助手在道具箱内不必心惊胆战。而业余的助手……前景就黯淡多了。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 逃生技拥有%max_charges%点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

official.name: ringmaster_impalement
official.desc_loc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.
official.lore_loc: Passed down through generations, it simply wouldn't be a Kettle Circus without the Great Cogliostro's signature trick.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_impalement
officialZh.desc_loc: 百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 代代相传的表演，少了伟大的科里奥斯特罗的招牌戏法，那就不能称之为卡特尔马戏团。

special_values.name: bleed_health_pct
special_values.heading_loc: 每秒最大生命值伤害（英雄）：

official.name: ringmaster_spotlight
official.desc_loc: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.
official.lore_loc: Are you ready for your fifteen seconds? The limelight draws no distinction between infamy and fame.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_spotlight
officialZh.desc_loc: 百戏大王用%spotlight_count%束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞%linger_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 上台的十五秒你准备好了吗？聚光灯下不必在意自己的名声。

official.name: ringmaster_wheel
official.desc_loc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.
official.lore_loc: No, brave friends, illusions are for charlatans and card sharks. What you witness today is the power of true magic. But only if you dare set your gaze upon...the mesmerizing wheel.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_wheel
officialZh.desc_loc:
百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速%aura_slow%%%。

敌方英雄面对转轮超过%face_duration%秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在%trap_duration%秒后转轮会自动爆炸。
officialZh.lore_loc: 不，勇敢的朋友们，幻术是骗子和赌徒的把戏。今天你见证的是魔法的真正力量。但前提是要敢于凝视……迷人的转轮。

official.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
official.desc_loc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
facets_loc: Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
officialZh.desc_loc:
只要百戏大王附近%souvenir_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。

如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。
facets_loc: 百戏大王的纪念品是哈哈镜，强力水和整蛊垫。
百戏大王的纪念品是水晶球，独轮车和超重派。

official.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
official.desc_loc:
Use: Proportion Distortion

Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes_loc: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
officialZh.desc_loc:
使用：比例失真

制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
notes_loc: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

official.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
official.desc_loc:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe

Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
officialZh.desc_loc:
使用：强力吸收

暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为%strength_bonus_base% + %strength_bonus_per_level% * 百戏大王等级，持续%duration%秒。效果会维持%effect_strength_max_duration%秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。

official.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
official.desc_loc:
Use: Whoopsie

Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
officialZh.desc_loc:
使用：噗

把英雄向前推动%leap_distance%距离。在身后留下一团%fart_cloud_radius%范围的臭云，持续%fart_cloud_duration%秒，使敌人减速%fart_cloud_slow%%%。

official.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
official.desc_loc:
Use: Saddle Up

Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

officialZh.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
officialZh.desc_loc:
使用：上车

召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

official.name: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
official.desc_loc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
official.lore_loc: Across the vast lineage of star progeny, there were multitudes unwilling to align with the aims of the Children of Light. To those who dared organize defiance, the Children would dispatch Valora and her hammer to show a measure of their power--to leave the rebels either shattered or set back to rights.
notes_loc: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.
official.shard_loc: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
facets_loc: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.

officialZh.name: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
officialZh.desc_loc: 破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在星辰后裔的庞大血脉中，有许多不愿追随光之子。对于胆敢挑战的星宿，光之子就会派出维罗拉和她的重锤，展示出他们的力量——让反对者粉身碎骨或幡然醒悟。
notes_loc: 破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以%movement_speed%的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要%self_stun_duration%秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人%swipe_slow%%%移动速度，持续%sweep_stun_duration%秒。
officialZh.shard_loc: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得<font color='#d76907'>减益免疫</font>，%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速%shard_movement_penalty%%%，移速最低为%movement_speed%。
facets_loc: 在星破天惊结束后每次破晓辰星挥击和锤击敌方英雄都会使%movespeed_bonus_radius%范围内她和所有友军获得攻击速度加成，持续%movespeed_bonus_duration%秒。

special_values.name: movespeed_bonus_self_max
special_values.heading_loc: 每次挥击的攻击速度加成：

special_values.name: movespeed_bonus_ally_max
special_values.heading_loc: 每次挥击的攻击速度加成（友军）：

official.name: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
official.desc_loc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
official.lore_loc: The Brightmaul is Valora's oldest companion and sole remaining connection to the glow of her creators.
notes_loc: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
facets_loc: When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.
Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.

officialZh.name: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
officialZh.desc_loc: 破晓辰星向一个目标扔出她的武器，对沿途的敌人造成伤害。战锤会在目的地停留%pause_duration%秒，再飞回她的手中，期间留下一道炽烈之径，减缓敌人的移动速度。破晓辰星可以随时召回战锤，将自身朝战锤牵引，使二者在中点相遇。
officialZh.lore_loc: 光明之锤是维罗拉最长久的伙伴，也是她与创造者们的光芒之间仅存的维系。
notes_loc: 战锤在飞出和飞回时都会对敌人造成伤害。
破晓辰星的会合移动距离不会超过技能的施法距离。
星破天惊无法在战锤脱手时施放。
facets_loc: 上界重锤停在地面时，会产生天光现世的治疗和伤害效果，数值减少%hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%%，作用于重锤附近%hammer_solar_guardian_radius%范围。重锤的停留时间提升至%pause_duration%秒。
友方英雄在上界重锤的炽烈之径上行走会获得移动速度加成。

official.name: dawnbreaker_luminosity
official.desc_loc: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
official.lore_loc: Diminished in power without access to the Children's replenishing light, Valora can still recharge herself and her allies by creating order from the chaos which resides within each fight.
notes_loc: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
official.scepter_loc: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
facets_loc: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.

officialZh.name: dawnbreaker_luminosity
officialZh.desc_loc: 破晓辰星在数次攻击后提升了力量，她的下一次攻击会造成致命一击，并<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>她附近%heal_radius%范围内所有友方英雄，治疗量为攻击伤害的一定百分比。攻击小兵和野怪产生的治疗量有所减少。对友军的治疗量为%allied_healing_pct%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 由于接触不到光之子的光芒，力量无法恢复而不断衰退，但维罗拉还是从每场战斗中存在的混沌里创造了秩序，使自身和盟友得到休整。
notes_loc: 熠熠生辉的治疗效果可以通过生命回复增强效果获得提升。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
officialZh.scepter_loc: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
facets_loc: 只要破晓辰星击中目标时触发了熠熠生辉的强化攻击，她所有技能的冷却时间都会减少。

special_values.name: heal_from_creeps
special_values.heading_loc: 攻击普通单位<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>减少：

official.name: dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn
official.desc_loc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
official.scepter_loc: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

officialZh.name: dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn
officialZh.desc_loc: 只要太阳出来，破晓辰星就会获得基础攻击力加成和额外视野，加成效果会在整个白天内逐渐降低。如果是破晓辰星制造的白天，在整个白天时间内加成效果始终是最大值。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 辰星破晓提供治疗增强，数值等于当前攻击力提升。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
official.desc_loc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
official.lore_loc: Only in defense of an ally will Valora relent to call upon the last reserves of her old powers that still allow cosmic flight.
notes_loc: Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
official.scepter_loc: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.

officialZh.name: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
officialZh.lore_loc: 只有为了保护盟友，维罗拉才会愿意召唤最后一点她原先的力量来完成穿越宇宙的飞行。
notes_loc: 脉冲间隔为%pulse_interval%秒。
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随%scepter_aura_duration%秒。

official.name: marci_grapple
official.desc_loc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
official.lore_loc: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.

officialZh.name: marci_grapple
officialZh.desc_loc: 玛西抓起一个友方或敌方目标，将其轻松地向她身后摔去，敌方目标将受到伤害并被减速。落地区域内所有敌方单位也会受到伤害并被减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 玛西擅于扫除米拉娜公主在路上碰到的障碍。

official.name: marci_companion_run
official.desc_loc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
official.lore_loc: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
notes_loc: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
official.shard_loc: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
facets_loc:
When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.

 Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.

If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.

 If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.

officialZh.name: marci_companion_run
officialZh.desc_loc:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。

回身踢设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得%ally_movespeed_pct%%%移动速度加成，持续%ally_buff_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 有了他人亲切或粗暴的托垫，玛西可以直入任何焦灼的战斗中。
notes_loc: 玛西冲刺时目标单位可以躲避该效果。
不会触发法术反弹。
<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>时不会带走被缠绕或束缚的友军。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。
facets_loc:
回身踢设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）时，玛西会把目标友军带向她的最终目的地。友军落地时对敌人造成%ally_impact_damage_pct%%%回身踢伤害。

不会影响被缠绕或束缚的友军。

如果玛西已升级怒拳破，回身踢落地后玛西会获得一次%postjump_flurry_charges%拳的狂怒连技。如果怒拳破已经开启，则改为持续时间延长%postjump_unleash_duration%秒。

如果拥有阿哈利姆神杖，本次狂怒连技的脉冲效果不会沉默敌人。

official.name: marci_bodyguard
official.desc_loc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
official.lore_loc: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.
notes_loc: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
facets_loc: While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share %shared_healing_percent%%% of health healed by this ability with each other.

officialZh.name: marci_bodyguard
officialZh.desc_loc:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的%max_partner_penalty%%%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的%shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%%会补充<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 玛西小时候就已经懂得，乱世之中最好的财富是可靠的伙伴。
notes_loc: 玛西无法对自身施放护卫术。
吸血效果对非英雄单位减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。
不论是玛西或她的搭档受到伤害都会使共用护盾的数值减少。
facets_loc: 在护卫术效果下玛西和她的搭档会共享本技能%shared_healing_percent%%%的生命治疗量。

official.name: marci_special_delivery
official.desc_loc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% bonus health.
official.lore_loc: Professional courtesy, from one courier to another.
notes_loc: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

officialZh.name: marci_special_delivery
officialZh.desc_loc:
玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。

所有友方信使被动获得%bonus_levels%级额外等级和%bonus_hp_tooltip%点额外生命。
officialZh.lore_loc: 从一个信使到另一个，都体现着专业的礼仪。
notes_loc: 特快专递的口哨具有%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇。
如果信使施放后没有移交任何物品，或还拥有物品，它都会停留在玛西身边。

official.name: marci_unleash
official.desc_loc:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
official.lore_loc: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.
notes_loc: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
official.scepter_loc:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

officialZh.name: marci_unleash
officialZh.desc_loc:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续%pulse_debuff_duration%秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续%time_between_flurries%秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升%bonus_movespeed%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然有不少人在探究玛西神力的源头，但玛西对他们全不理睬。
notes_loc: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
移除攻击速度限制。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散

official.name: primal_beast_onslaught
official.desc_loc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.
official.lore_loc: The Beast's single-minded focus on chosen prey leaves all other considerations scattered in his ruinous wake.

officialZh.name: primal_beast_onslaught
officialZh.desc_loc:
獸积蓄力量再向选定方向冲去，将敌人和队友同时击退。敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。蓄力时间越长，獸冲的距离越远。

可以随时使用停止指令来中止。
officialZh.lore_loc: 獸对眼中猎物的专一让其他犹豫不决的人在他毁灭性的冲击下四散而逃。

official.name: primal_beast_trample
official.desc_loc: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
official.lore_loc: As the only member of his species to arrive on this world, locals can only speculate on the Beast's size relative to his kin. Such observation would prove easier of course if the subject didn't eat everything it sees and destroy most of what it doesn't.
facets_loc: Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.

officialZh.name: primal_beast_trample
officialZh.desc_loc: 獸践踏一切。每行进%step_distance%距离就会对獸附近范围内所有敌人造成伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上獸攻击力的一定系数。獸在技能期间被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 由于獸是他的种族中唯一一个来到这个世上，当地人只能通过他的亲戚来推测獸的尺寸。要不是观测的目标会吃掉看到的一切，又消灭了大部分看不到的，那这样的观测肯定会容易很多。
facets_loc: 踏启动后会使獸和他的友军获得移动速度加成。

official.name: primal_beast_uproar
official.desc_loc:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
official.lore_loc: Already draped in a broken patchwork of barding and chains upon appearing in the mistwoods, the Beast tolerates no further attempts at subjugation.
notes_loc: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
official.scepter_loc: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.

officialZh.name: primal_beast_uproar
officialZh.desc_loc:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过%damage_limit%点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续%roar_duration%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 在永雾林渊现身时獸就已身披破碎的锁链，如今他不会容许任何征服的企图。
notes_loc: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出%projectile_waves%波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有%projectiles_per_stack%个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

special_values.name: roared_bonus_armor
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加咆哮护甲加成：

official.name: primal_beast_rock_throw
official.desc_loc:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.
official.lore_loc: AGAIN WITH THE ROCKS!

officialZh.name: primal_beast_rock_throw
officialZh.desc_loc:
獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。
officialZh.lore_loc: 又是岩石！

official.name: primal_beast_pulverize
official.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.
official.lore_loc: Though none are certain whether his utterances have true meaning, most concede the Beast's powerful grip and tendency to smash his enemies into naught but pulp and pieces communicates his intent well enough.

officialZh.name: primal_beast_pulverize
officialZh.desc_loc: 持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续%channel_time%秒。
officialZh.lore_loc: 虽然没人能肯定獸的嘟哝声是否具有真正的含义，但大多数都会同意，獸强劲的握力还有将一切粉碎为肉酱的倾向充分表达了他的意图。

official.name: primal_beast_colossal
official.desc_loc: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.

officialZh.name: primal_beast_colossal
officialZh.desc_loc: 獸拥有%base_slow_resist%%%基础<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>，每拥有%hp_per_threshold%点生命上限就获得+%aoe_per_threshold%%%<font color='#c450e5'>作用范围</font>加成和+%slow_resistance_per_threshold%%%<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: muerta_dead_shot
official.desc_loc:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
official.lore_loc: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.
notes_loc: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
official.scepter_loc: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
facets_loc: Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance to %gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%x for %gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%s.

officialZh.name: muerta_dead_shot
officialZh.desc_loc:
琼英碧灵向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时会对敌人造成伤害和短暂减速，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。

跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧。
officialZh.lore_loc: 握枪的手能纹丝不动，再加上永世的练习，产生了让凡人的头脑难以经受的花式射击。
notes_loc: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的%ricochet_distance_multiplier%倍。
可以弹离减益免疫目标。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。
facets_loc: 弹无虚发恐惧敌人后，神枪在手的触发几率提升至基础几率的%gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%倍，持续%gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%秒。

special_values.name: ricochet_fear_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 跳弹<font color='#1eddb7'>恐惧</font>持续时间：

official.name: muerta_the_calling
official.desc_loc: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
official.lore_loc: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.
facets_loc: Heroes killed inside The Calling refresh its duration, create another Revenant, and expand the radius of The Calling by %kill_radius_expansion%.

officialZh.name: muerta_the_calling
officialZh.desc_loc: 召唤%num_revenants%个亡魂，缓慢地环绕目标地点。在区域内的敌人会被减速。亡魂会在敌人穿过时造成伤害和<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 琼英碧灵的家人永远都在生界之外，但是她与死神的交易让她可以在需要的时候看望他们片刻。
facets_loc: 唤魂内有敌方英雄阵亡会刷新持续时间，再产生一个亡魂，并且唤魂的作用范围扩大%kill_radius_expansion%。

official.name: muerta_gunslinger
official.desc_loc: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
official.lore_loc: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.
notes_loc: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus %target_search_bonus_range%.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.
facets_loc: Gunslinger procs reduce Dead Shot cooldown by %dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%s.

officialZh.name: muerta_gunslinger
officialZh.desc_loc: 可以开关。开启后，琼英碧灵攻击时有几率对另一个目标再射一枪。
officialZh.lore_loc: 琼英碧灵会给予她所有目标仁慈。部分交上了好运还会获得恩泽。
notes_loc: 如果距离内没有其他单位，她会向原目标发射两枪。
第二枪可以击中琼英碧灵攻击距离加上%target_search_bonus_range%范围内的单位。
第二枪可以触发攻击特效。
以英雄优先，然后是非英雄单位，然后是建筑。
facets_loc: 神枪在手触发时，弹无虚发的剩余冷却时间减少%dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%秒。

official.name: muerta_spectral_slug
official.desc_loc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.

officialZh.name: muerta_spectral_slug
officialZh.desc_loc: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为<font color='#57e550'>虚无</font>状态，持续%duration%秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%bonus_spell_damage_pct%%%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

official.name: muerta_pierce_the_veil
official.desc_loc:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.
notes_loc: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
official.shard_loc:
Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.

officialZh.name: muerta_pierce_the_veil
officialZh.desc_loc:
琼英碧灵变身，成为虚无状态，获得基础攻击力加成和相位移动状态。

被动使总是可以攻击虚无状态下的目标，并且她在虚无状态下也能攻击。在她或目标处于虚无时，她的所有攻击伤害均为魔法伤害，她的物理吸血被视为技能吸血。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 琼英碧灵脱去她的实体形态，穿过生死之界，利用恶灵的愤怒打击她的敌人。
notes_loc: 琼英碧灵在变身期间可以躲避弹道。
琼英碧灵在变身后无法攻击建筑。
officialZh.shard_loc:
琼英碧灵在越界的持续时间内获得%spell_lifesteal%%%技能吸血。
越界生效时每次击杀敌方英雄或有敌方英雄在附近阵亡时琼英碧灵都会永久获得%spell_amp_steal%%%技能增强。永久加成具有追溯效果。

official.name: muerta_supernatural
official.desc_loc: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

officialZh.name: muerta_supernatural
officialZh.desc_loc: 每当琼英碧灵附近%stack_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，她就会获得一层%spell_amp_per_stack%%%技能增强的叠加效果。琼英碧灵阵亡时，她会失去一半（向下取整）的叠加层数。

official.name: kez_echo_slash
official.desc_loc: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
official.lore_loc: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.
notes_loc: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.

officialZh.name: kez_echo_slash
officialZh.desc_loc: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击%katana_distance%距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的%tag_slow%%%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 凯和他的师父克洛孜孜不倦地训练影武团，改进古代的技艺让空中的敌人失去平衡。
notes_loc: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

official.name: kez_grappling_claw
official.desc_loc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
official.lore_loc: The Kazurai have the speed and reach to drag even the highest flyers from the skies.

officialZh.name: kez_grappling_claw
officialZh.desc_loc: 凯向目标单位或者树木发射一枚抓钩并摆荡过去。抓钩碰到目标后，该单位会被减速。凯到达敌方目标时，落地会发动一次攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 影武者拥有极快的速度和强大的力量，在空中飞得再高也会被拽下来。

official.name: kez_kazurai_katana
official.desc_loc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
official.lore_loc: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
official.shard_loc: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

officialZh.name: kez_kazurai_katana
officialZh.desc_loc:
长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。

凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 为了反击英佩瑞雅和她的羽林卫，影武者必须熟练掌握消耗战的技巧。
officialZh.shard_loc: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血%lifesteal_pct%%%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。提升最大爆发叠加数值。

official.name: kez_switch_weapons
official.desc_loc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
official.lore_loc: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
official.scepter_loc:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

officialZh.name: kez_switch_weapons
officialZh.desc_loc:
凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。

基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。

凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 影武团的领袖，曾经也是翔影教团的追随者，他的武技可以在长刀和双钗这两种流派之间自如地切换。
officialZh.scepter_loc:
在使用流派变换后%scepter_cooldown_timer%秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。

施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。

special_values.name: katana_agility_bonus_base_damage
special_values.heading_loc: 长刀敏捷额外提供基础攻击力：

special_values.name: sai_swap_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 切换双钗加速持续时间：

official.name: kez_raptor_dance
official.desc_loc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
official.lore_loc: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
notes_loc: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

officialZh.name: kez_raptor_dance
officialZh.desc_loc:
凯进入不可控制的状态，持续%AbilityCastPoint%秒，%invuln_period%秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
officialZh.lore_loc: 陆行族内心的愤怒尽数释放，将敌人的精元吸收殆尽。
notes_loc: 斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至%illusion_lifesteal_pct%%%。

official.name: kez_falcon_rush
official.desc_loc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
official.lore_loc: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
notes_loc: Does not work on buildings.

officialZh.name: kez_falcon_rush
officialZh.desc_loc: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有<font color='#9019e3'>相位移动</font>状态和<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 古老的翔影战技，用来猎杀空中速度更快的敌人，窃取他们的优势，并在猎物惊慌失措地扇动一次翅膀的时间内发动多次攻击。
notes_loc: 不会对建筑生效。

official.name: kez_talon_toss
official.desc_loc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
official.lore_loc: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
notes_loc: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

officialZh.name: kez_talon_toss
officialZh.desc_loc: 凯向目标单位掷出一把钗，施加一次固定伤害的攻击，并造成<font color='#6db6e9'>沉默</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: 翔影教团学会了依靠距离和分神来对抗更强大的对手。
notes_loc: 固定伤害的攻击具有克敌机先效果。

official.name: kez_shodo_sai
official.desc_loc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
official.lore_loc: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
official.shard_loc: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

officialZh.name: kez_shodo_sai
officialZh.desc_loc:
装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。

凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续%parry_duration%秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕%parry_stun_duration%秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。

子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。
officialZh.lore_loc: 也许翔影教团已经迷失了方向，但是凯和影武团还是能利用翔影的知识造福人民。
officialZh.shard_loc: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

special_values.name: parry_bonus_stun_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 招架额外印记<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>：

official.name: kez_ravens_veil
official.desc_loc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
official.lore_loc: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
facets_loc: Increases Raven's Veil invisibility duration.

officialZh.name: kez_ravens_veil
officialZh.desc_loc: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>状态，直到他攻击或施法。
officialZh.lore_loc: 不论是见到威胁还是机遇，翔影的大师都会立刻进入暗影，使作战的条件重新对自己有利。
facets_loc: 提升渡鸦之纱的隐身时间。

special_values.name: blind_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 视野负面状态持续时间：

official.name: largo_catchy_lick
official.desc_loc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
official.lore_loc: After generations spent living on the ancient isaloth Velu'Mar, the descendants of the Murkroot exiles have grown resilient, happily sampling toxins that would've struck their ancestors dead.
notes_loc: Can lick runes to pull them.

officialZh.name: largo_catchy_lick
officialZh.desc_loc:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 在古老的岛屿泽鲁玛上生活了数个世代后，流亡暗根族的后代更具适应力，他们乐于尝试让他们祖先丧命的毒素。
notes_loc: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。

official.name: largo_frogstomp
official.desc_loc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.
official.lore_loc: Most Bard Monks spend decades mastering the musical arts, but even the top frog Largo has to admit that his young disciples have already grown shockingly good at counting a proper beat.

officialZh.name: largo_frogstomp
officialZh.desc_loc: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每%stomp_interval%秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。
officialZh.lore_loc: 乐手团的大多数用了数十年苦练音乐技艺，但就算是顶尖的朗戈也要承认，他的年轻弟子已经惊人地擅长数节拍了。

official.name: largo_croak_of_genius
official.desc_loc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
official.lore_loc: Largo loves to help his friends find glory through the power of music, never missing a chance at a killer duet.
notes_loc: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within %max_distance% units of each other.

officialZh.name: largo_croak_of_genius
officialZh.desc_loc:
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来%damage_duration%秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。

只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少%duration_reduction%秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
officialZh.lore_loc: 朗戈喜欢通过音乐的力量帮助他的朋友找到荣耀，从未错过任何一次上演精彩二重唱的机会。
notes_loc: 只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距%max_distance%以内时施加伤害。

official.name: largo_encore
official.desc_loc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
official.shard_loc:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

officialZh.name: largo_encore
officialZh.desc_loc: 朗戈对自身或队友施加的增益效果会延长持续时间。
officialZh.shard_loc:
只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。

只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
official.desc_loc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
official.lore_loc: The very first Bard Monk played a song that summoned a living island and saved the Murkroot exiles from a salt-worn death.
notes_loc: Items can be used while in this mode.
official.scepter_loc: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

special_values.name: song_cost_reduction_per_stack_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK:

officialZh.name: largo_amphibian_rhapsody
officialZh.desc_loc:
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被<font color='#afb912'>缴械</font>，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。

每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
officialZh.lore_loc: 乐手团的第一人弹了一首歌，召唤出一座有生命的岛屿，在海水的侵袭下即将灭亡的流亡暗根族因此得救。
notes_loc: 这个模式下可以使用物品。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。

special_values.name: song_cost_reduction_per_stack_tooltip
special_values.heading_loc: 每层叠加乐曲魔耗降低：

official.name: largo_song_fight_song
official.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
official.lore_loc: 'Hey, when a beach brawl breaks out, you gotta learn to throw your musical weight around or the party's over proper quick.'
official.scepter_loc: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

officialZh.name: largo_song_fight_song
officialZh.desc_loc: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成%burst_damage%点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: “嘿，沙滩上突然有人打架的时候，你要学会用上你的音乐实力，不然派对很快就结束咯。”
officialZh.scepter_loc: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成%damage_per_stack%点魔法伤害。

official.name: largo_song_double_time
official.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.
official.lore_loc: 'It's like that old story about the scary swamp witch. You better watch just where you're jumping when you're trying to do it lickety-split.'

officialZh.name: largo_song_double_time
officialZh.desc_loc: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。
officialZh.lore_loc: “这就像那个沼泽女巫的吓人老故事。要是跳的时候想再快点，最好看清楚往哪跳。”

official.name: largo_song_good_vibrations
official.desc_loc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.
official.lore_loc: 'If this song can heal an ageless isaloth, it can handle a few cuts and bruises on the lot of you.'

officialZh.name: largo_song_good_vibrations
officialZh.desc_loc: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>附近友方英雄。
officialZh.lore_loc: “假如这首歌能治愈永恒的孤岛，它就能处理你身上的擦伤和瘀青。”
